articleTitle: Practices and Challenge on Planning with Large-scale Renewable Energy Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of the wind and solar generation in the power grid, the renewable energy integration planning and evaluation are essential for a more comprehensive understanding of power system operational economics. For specific power grid, the maximum feasible renewable integration capacity can be calculated and thus provide the useful guidelines for government, independent system operators and investors to make planning and operational decisions toward higher penetration of renewable power: Planning study and electrical system design should be done before actual construction of the wind and solar power plant. The planning studies generally analysis the adequacy and flexibility of the power system, which including resource characteristics analysis, production simulation and reliability analysis. The Electrical system design generally analysis the connection mode and stability, which including interconnection and transmission design, power flow and stability analysis, power quality analysis. In technical aspect, modeling, methodologies and evaluation indices related to integration planning and evaluation are the most important parts should be considered in future activities.

articleTitle: A SVM Optimized by Particle Swarm Optimization Approach to Load Disaggregation in Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring in Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The essence of NILM (Non-intrusive load monitoring) is load decomposition whose results can be further used to improve the energy acquisition system, intelligent power consumption system, and hold out two-way interactive service and intelligent power consumption service. In this paper, a PSO-SVM approach is proposed for load disaggregation in non-intrusive load monitoring. A method in view of the power difference is used to do event detection for switching state of electrical equipment which is proved to be very effective. A multi-feature classification (MFC) on account of PSO-SVM is suggested that it can recognize the switching state of electrical equipment. The simulation results showed that the accuracy rate can attain 95.3% for switched-on state and 96.2% for switched-off state which are more precise than GA-BP and GA-SVM.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy System Considering New Energy Incentive Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, China is in a critical period of energy structure transformation. The development of integrated energy systems opens a new path for in-depth reform of the energy sector. However, integrated energy systems are currently facing problems such as high operating costs, limited consumption levels of new energy and low energy efficiency per unit equipment. Therefore, firstly, we propose an integrated energy system optimal operation model considering new energy incentive mechanism. By utilizing the lowest integrated energy system daily operation cost as the target, mixed integer linear programming method is adopted for calculation and solution, whilst artificial intelligence algorithm is introduced to ensure the accuracy of relevant prediction data. Secondly, the study fully considers the economy, rationality, efficiency and other requirements of system operation, improves constraint model of each unit equipment in the system and implementing four typical scenarios of incentive mechanism. Finally, the influence of the four typical scenarios on the integrated energy system operation is analyzed through the cases. The results show that the optimal model and incentive mechanism in this paper can further reduce the system operating cost, improve new energy consumption level, and improving each unit equipment operation flexibility and stability in the system, especially the regulating role of energy storage equipment in system operation. Meanwhile, the research results also quantitatively show the integrated energy system operating cost change rate under the different incentive mechanisms. It has great significance to the decision-making of system deployment and operation, clarifies the influence of different incentive mechanisms on the system operation economic benefits, and promotes the benefits of integrated energy system developing.

articleTitle: Research on Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In short, the ubiquitous power Internet of Things is the connection of the various devices and people in the power system. Specifically, firstly, it uses sensor technology to collect device-related data. Then, the data is sent to the server via communication technology. Finally, data is processed and stored through big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence and other technologies. Therefore, the user and the power supply company can grasp the relevant data of each link of the power grid, and realize the transparency and sharing of the data. The power system is a large system with many related equipments and complicated connections. Therefore, in order to meet the relevant requirements, a large structure is needed to cover all aspects of the ubiquitous power Internet of Things. In this paper, an architecture for ubiquitous power Internet of Things is proposed, covered from the collection of underlying data, to the encryption and transmission of data, to the storage of data. This architecture brings great convenience to the collection, transmission, processing and storage of data.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatching for Integrated Energy System Based on Coordinated Optimization of Power to Gas and Carbon Capture Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rise of power to gas technology provides an effective way for absorption of wind power and low-carbon power. In the carbon capture power plant, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emitted by generating units can be recycled and used in the energy conversion process of power to gas. Thus, the efficient utilization of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> can be realized. In view of the serious phenomenon of wind abandonment and high CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions, a low-carbon economic dispatching model of the integrated energy system based on power to gas and carbon capture power plants is proposed, which takes the power to gas and carbon capture power plants as a whole. The modified IEEE39-bus power network and Belgium 20-bus natural gas network are used for the example analysis. By comparing and analyzing the abandoned wind power, carbon capture capacity and the integrated operation cost of the system under the two models, it is verified that the model can improve the carbon utilization rate, enhance the ability of wind power accommodation, and reduce CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions and integrated operation cost.

articleTitle: Research on Melting and De-icing Methods of Lines in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution network lines are numerous and widely distributed. Large numbers of them are distributed in the harsh micro-topography and micro-climate areas, which are prone to suffer from freezing rain and snow, then lead to the dumping of tower and the breaking of line. Ice melting and deicing are effective methods to deal with ice disaster in distribution networks. Combined with years of experience in anti-ice in Hunan, this paper systematically introduces the anti-ice methods of distribution network lines. These methods include electric current ice-melting by AC or DC and manual de-icing. According to the characteristics of distribution network, a set of comprehensive ice-melting system and ice-melting principle are put forward. The system and principle can effectively guide the anti-ice work of distribution network lines. The melting and deicing methods and systems are applied well in Xiaoshajiang area of Hunan province and have obvious effect.

articleTitle: Electricity Charge Saved for Industrial and Commercial Utilizing Cloud Energy Storage Services
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: By utilizing the potential of existing policies, the government and industrial park can meet the urgent needs of reducing electricity bills. Based on the analysis of Chinese current peak-valley electricity prices policy, the distributed energy storage and centralized energy storage are comprehensively utilized to provide cloud storage and leasing services for industrial park users flexibly and economically. Considering the scales of economies that cloud storage has, this paper has developed three cloud energy storage leasing schemes that consider peak and valley electricity prices. Taking the lowest total cost of electricity for industrial park users as the objective function, the power balance and interaction restrictions with the main network and the limitation of cloud energy storage equipment are used to optimize the capacity and power of the leased cloud energy storage, and also can further analyze and discuss its economy. The results show that the introduction of cloud energy storage services by industry and commerce can effectively reduce the total cost of electricity consumption. Moreover, mixed energy storage and power storage have more significant economic value.

articleTitle: Active Reactive Power Control Strategy Based on Electrochemical Energy Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to resolve the key problem of continuous rectification fault, this paper proposes a joint control strategy based on electrochemical energy storage power station. Firstly, the influence of commutation failure on the AC system was analyzed, and a mathematical model with the minimum power grid fluctuation as the objective function was established; Then, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to solve the problem, so as to control the output of the electrochemical energy storage, so that the voltage of the DC converter station recovers rapidly after the fault, the power fluctuation of the regional power grid was the smallest, and the state feedback control of the energy storage system was controlled. Ensure that the energy storage equipment did not be overcharged and discharged. Secondly, the voltage fluctuation after the electrochemical energy storage power station was connected to be calculated by the power flow calculation, and discrete reactive power compensation was performed on the bus line to further adjust the voltage fluctuation. Finally, the simulation analysis is carried out by the DC standard test system in the electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD to verify the effectiveness of this joint control strategy and achieve the joint adjustment of power and voltage.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Feature Selection Method for Short-Term Electrical Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fluctuation of electrical power load is affected by numerous external factors, such as climate change, economic development, social form and special events etc. The optimal feature subset selection is the key to improving the accuracy of short-term power load forecasting. The traditional feature selection methods have encountered difficulties in balancing performance and computational consumption. The development of ensemble feature selection methods is a feasible way to solve this dilemma. In this paper, an embedded ensemble feature selection method is established and investigated on a short-term electrical load forecasting task. A new weighting approach is proposed to combine the result of individual embedded feature selection methods. The results of the embedded ensemble feature selection method show a significant increase in accuracy compared to the individual feature selection methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Energy Internet Under the Background of Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the progress of energy reform, the reform of energy system gradually moves forward from single energy field to comprehensive energy field. In 2019, the state grid corporation of China (SGCC) put forward the strategic idea of building the ubiquitous power internet of things (UPIoT), providing new support and guarantee for the construction of energy internet (EI). Based on the latest construction direction of UPIoT, the basic concept of UPIoT is expounded, and the key characteristics of UPIoT in connotation definition, hierarchical structure, application mode and other aspects are discussed in this paper. Furthermore, considering the strategic convergence point and operational focus of UPIoT and EI, the construction and integration mode is put forward, aiming to provide reference suggestions for the deep integration of physical network and information network. Final, the key technologies of EI construction under the background of PIoT are studied in the fields of perception, computing, networking and security. As the basic research framework of EI construction, the research content provides a certain method and path for relevant technical research.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network in Sequence to Short Sequence Form for Non-intrusive Load Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, the deep learning method of sequence to sequence (seq2seq) form has achieved excellent results in non-intrusive load monitoring(NILM). However, due to the particularity of NILM task, which requires continuous output of appliance power, when using this form, there will be a situation that only part of the operation time in appliances will be included in the input sequence of meter power, resulting in a decline in the effect of energy disaggregation. In this paper, a convolutional neural network in the form of sequence to short sequence (seq2sseq) is proposed. The seq2sseq network only outputs a short appliance power sequence corresponding to the middle position of the input sequence. As more input information outside the time period of the output sequence can be seen, the problem of inaccurate estimation in the sequence edge can be solved. The experiments show that the seq2sseq-based neural network can achieve better results than the seq2seq-based one while ensure computational efficiency. It is a more suitable form of neural network for NILM task.

articleTitle: A Reliable Approach to Protect and Control of Wind Solar Hybrid DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The working of a power system is constantly threatened by abnormal and fault conditions. This paper presents a system design to control voltage fluctuations caused by various load conditions in wind solar hybrid micro-grid (MG). In addition, A novel protection scheme which is named wind solar hybrid MG is presented for successful operation of healthy part of the system. The different defect conditions are analyzed on the common DC link, permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) and utility grid side. The over-current and over-voltage defects are analyzed through division into various protective zones. The discrimination is perfectly achieved by isolating various zones and preventing a system from completely shut down. The simulation result depicts that DC MG protection is achieved within time limit. Furthermore, this designed scheme can be implemented without any further modifications on real time applications.

articleTitle: Prosumers Peer-to-Peer Transaction Decision Considering Network Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of distributed renewable energies, distributed energy storage and controllable devices connected to end users, the traditional electricity consumers have been transformed into prosumers with dual characteristics of electricity production and consumption, which can carry out flexible peer-to-peer transactions anytime and anywhere. Firstly, this paper puts forward the framework of prosumers peer-to-peer transaction. Secondly, a peer-to-peer transaction model is constructed, which takes the constraints of energy conservation, energy storage charge and discharge, and interactive power into account. And the aim is maximizing the interests of prosumers. Then, considering the influence of distribution network physical constraints on the transaction results, the transmission power of the transmission line is calculated by the power transfer distribution factor (PTDF) to adjust the transaction. Finally, taking the distribution network with IEEE15 nodes to study the case, and analyzing the influence of distribution network physical constraints to the prosumers peer-to-peer transaction.

articleTitle: Damping Analysis and Parameter Adjustment of Hydraulic Turbine Governor under Ultra-low Frequency Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the damping effect of hydraulic turbine governor on ultra-low frequency oscillation (ULFO) based on damping torque analysis, comparing the damping of different operating modes of the governor. The ULFO of a hybrid power system is proposed, which consists of hydraulic and steam turbine. The eigenvalue analysis of state space matrix is used to deeply analyze the damping effect of key parameters of hydraulic turbine governing system on ULFO. The adjustment method of hydraulic turbine governor parameters considering both ULFO suppression and system transient frequency safety is proposed. The effectiveness of this method is verified based on a real power grid of China.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Speed Prediction of Wind Power System Based on GRU Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High precision and reliable wind speed forecasting is important for the management of the wind power. Under this background, the prediction system is established by using the GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), which is based on deep learning prediction model and combining the relevant historical data of wind power system. The power regulation capability of wind energy and solar energy equipment are improved. Then, the impact of randomness and intermittentity of wind energy on the output power quality of wind turbine is effectively reduced. Simulation results show that the prediction algorithm has high prediction accuracy, and the prediction system provides support for network structure analysis and control strategy of multi-energy system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Electricity Market and Piclo’s Local Matching Trading Platform in UK
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing demand of electricity, the current electricity market structure in UK is in transformation phase, transforming from traditional power system hierarchal structure towards a new exciting Peer-to-Peer (P2P) trading platform. Peer to Peer energy market is a novel concept of electricity power systemˈand it proposes an idea of consumers and prosumers to build decentralize and democratize electricity market where consumers can generate their own electricity from renewable energy resources and can become prosumers selling out the surplus energy to others local or utility grid. Due to the intermittent nature of renewable energy and rise in integration of Distributed energy Resources (DERs) in UK, more and more consumers have become prosumers that can save Surplus energy or trade with the local energy deficit consumers by saving their energy through reduce energy bill. This study discusses the basic sharing P2P Models, local community model along with the operation of peer-to-peer market in the UK. In addition, it elaborates the novelty of "Piclo" based local matching trading that offers peer-to-peer trading by using smart meter data to match demand and supply of electricity for every half hour. Finally, Piclo based local match price charging methodologies that includes calculating Distribution use of charging (DUoS) and price incentives model are highlighted.

articleTitle: Fractional-order Sliding Mode Control Strategy for Quasi-Z Source Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness and increase the fast response, a novel current controller with the fractional-order sliding mode control is proposed for the quasi-Z source inverter (qZSI). The state space equations of the qZSI are established, and the sliding surface of the proposed controller is built when the inductor current error between the reference and actual one is used as the state variable. Moreover, the stable, existence and arrival conditions of the sliding surface are derived. Simulations study on a MATLAB model shows that the proposed controller can achieve a faster dynamic response and realize stable and robust when the qZSI works in a wide input range compared to the traditional PI controller.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Air Conditioning Loads by Aggregator under Dynamic Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The key to the response of the air conditioning load demand is to deal with the relationship between power and indoor temperature. In this paper, an optimal scheduling strategy for an aggregator to control residential air conditionings under dynamic electricity price is proposed. Firstly, an aggregated model of a group air conditioning load model is introduced based on a single air conditioning load model. And an optimization model for aggregator considering the users’ temperature comfort is established. Then, according to the aggregated model, the power and temperature of air conditionings are decoupled, which are easier to be solved in the demand response. In these decoupled problems, the indoor temperature is the only control variable. The control strategy of air conditionings is obtained by resolving the model. This strategy can be used by the aggregator to adjust the air conditioning temperature according to the dynamic electricity price so as to minimize the electricity consumption cost on the premise of guaranteeing the users’ comfort. Finally, the accuracy of the method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Prospects for Energy Internet of Agricultural Engineering in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of China's agriculture, the energy consumption of agricultural production is getting bigger and bigger, and the traditional energy system is difficult to meet the current agricultural development. Agricultural engineering Energy Internet is an extension of the Energy Internet in the agricultural field and an important development direction for the future Energy Internet. It will promote China's agricultural development. This paper expounds the basic concepts and background of agricultural engineering Energy Internet, and further analyzes the development status at home and abroad, and finally introduces a microgrid project in rural North China and a facility agricultural photovoltaic greenhouse in Gansu province.

articleTitle: Research on Sub-synchronous Oscillation Characteristics between PMSG-based Wind Farms and Weak AC Grids Based on Prony Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To investigate the new type of sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) incidents in permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) based wind farm in Xinjiang grids, this paper establishes an equivalent grid model based on practical Xinjiang grids data in PSCAD/EMTDC. To avoid the complexity and limitations of eigenvalue analysis, the Prony method is adopted to obtain system damping information. Then, taking one of those wind farms as a research case, the impacts of main factors on SSO characteristics are discussed in detail. The analysis of results reveal that improper operating conditions would weak the sub-synchronous damping and stimulate SSO in wind farm. Additionaly, a possible safe operation range of one PMSG-based wind farm through extensive simulations is presented in this research work. To further extend the solution of exsiting problems, an additional mitigation strategy based on static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) is introduced to compensate the sub-synchronous voltage and thus to suppress the SSO.

articleTitle: Planning Model of Integrated Energy System Considering P2G and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is a magnificent method for China's energy and electric power industry to build integrated energy system in the future development. In this paper, a planning model of regional Integrated Energy System is established, which considers P2G and energy storage. The example shows that the model presented in this paper can effectively realize the coordinated optimization planning of energy subsystems like electric, heat and gas. Moreover, the presented model can also improve the resource allocation, certain economic advantages and environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Energy Management and Control System Architecture Based on Local Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the analysis of local energy internet architecture, an overall architecture of integrated energy management and control system, which consists of four layers, is proposed in this paper. The main functions and construction contents of each layer in the overall architecture are analyzed in turn, such as the control, service and transaction applications for the application layer. On this basis, a case for industrial park is discussed. The architecture proposed in this paper can be more flexible, adaptable, extensible and comprehensive than traditional solutions, satisfying the needs of local energy internet.

Author Keywords: integrated energy management and control system

articleTitle: Enhancing Power System Resilience - A review
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increase in the number and scale of natural disasters in recent years poses a serious threat and damage to the power system. In turn, total abstinence from damage caused by natural disasters or emergencies is much more difficult and impossible for some time. This article describes measures power system resilience to ensure that the energy system works as normally as possible in such an emergency and accelerates its return to normal after an emergency. Also, two different measures to improve the resilience of the system are studied, and various ways to improve it are recommended. Differences between resilience and reliability have been also studied.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Simulation of New Energy Ship power system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the energy efficiency and reduce emissions of ship, both of the diesel generator and fuel cell are used to supply power to the hybrid ship, in which the engine provides the basic load, and the rest power is provided by the fuel cell when the ship power load demand is greater than the basic load. Ship power transmission model and optimized performance indicators which can be calculated are deduced. The model of the ship electric propulsion system with energy storage units is established based on Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the running efficiency of diesel engine is improved, satisfying the power demand of ship by use of new energy controller and improving the stability of the system.

articleTitle: ADDP: Anomaly Detection for DTU Based on Power Consumption Side-Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the Internet of Things, the common information technologies are being applied to the power grid. It brings about the tremendous improvement in productivity, yet breaks down the safety barrier, which makes the power grid a popular target for attacks. The Distribution Terminal Unit (DTU) is a critical part of the power grid because of the acts as access points in the substation and controls the grid equipment. However, DTUs are vulnerable to different types of attacks, which can cause significant property loss or even casualties To monitor the operation of DTU, we proposed a real-time monitoring system by analyzing the side-channel information of power consumption. To validate this idea, we design 3 types of attacks and collect the power information separately, then we choose representational power features and machine learning algorithm for detecting those attacks. We validate that it is feasible to detect attacks and achieves a detection accuracy above 99%.

articleTitle: Studies on Big Data Mining Techniques in Wildfire Prevention for Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the propagation characteristics of big data for wildfire hazard prevention for power grid, the framework of big data platform is proposed in this paper. Internal relation between wildfire occurrence probability and the key meteorological factors like relative humidity, average daily precipitation, daily average temperature and daily extreme wind speed are unveiled through correlation analysis method. Wildfire hazard prevention system for power grid is established based on big data mining techniques. The above studies have already being successfully used in wildfire hazard prevention for provinces suffering from serious wildfire hazards of state grid corporation of China (SGCC) and is playing an important role in overcoming the wildfire for power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis and Countermeasure of 110KV Cable Joint Defects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, cable faults increases year by year with the widespread use of power cable lines, among which, cable joint defects become one of the most important factors affecting the safe and stable operation of transmission cables. Recently, a switch protection work of the 110kV cable line 131 tripped, resulting in power cables change and its three T-connection lines power failure. After the troubleshooting the author found that there are defects in the intermediate of No. 1 connector well cable. In this paper, a detailed introduction about this accident of cable equipment is made and the cause is analyzed in-depth. The study found that there are some problems in the design and installation of the cable joint weld joint. Due to many this type of cable lines run in power grid, and at the same time to avoid such equipment defects in new project, the corresponding suggestions based on the cause analysis and the accident situation was put forward, which is beneficial to eliminate safety hazards in time and ensure the stable operation of the cable lines.

articleTitle: Faults Detection and Identification Based on Robust Residual Generation for A Single-Phase PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault detection and identification for a single-phase PWM rectifier is addressed in this paper. Fault detection can be achieved by using an unknown input observer which is very insensitive to disturbance for any given minimum level of sensitivity to faults. The method proposed here is to determine an observer with minimum sensitivity to disturbance and maximum to the faults of the process to be monitored. To verify the effect of our method, the direct power control is used to achieve unity power factor operation and the regulation of dclink voltage. It been proved first mathematically, and at the end by Simulations on MATLAB/Simulink software that the suggested method is robust.

articleTitle: Real-time On-line Anti-icing and Ice-melting Power Calculation Method for Transmission Lines Based on Self-ice-melting Conductors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The aluminium which strands of self-ice-melting conductor is used to transmit electric energy. If there is a potential difference between the aluminium strands and the steel cores, the heating material that has been embedded between the aluminium strands and the steel cores will generate heating that make the self-ice-melting conductor have real-time on-line anti-icing and ice-melting capability. Accurate control of anti-icing and ice-melting power to make the conductor temperature in a reasonable state is the key technology of self-ice-melting conductor. For the power required for anti-icing, the anti-icing process can be divided into warming-up stage and warm-holding stage, and the power requirement of warming-up stage includes the energy absorbed by the conductor during warming-up process, the energy needed for melting the newly added icing during warming-up process and the energy needed for convective heat transfer on the conductor surface, for the warm-holding stage, the power required for anti-icing includes the energy needed for instant melting of newly added and the energy required for convective heat transfer on the conductor surface. The energy needed in the ice-melting process includes the energy needed in the warming-up stage and the energy needed in the ice-melting stage, and the energy required in the warming-up stage includes the energy required for conducting wires and water to rise above zero degrees Celsius and for convective heat dissipation, the energy required in the ice-melting stage includes the energy needed to melt the ice stock, the energy needed to melt the newly added ice and the energy lost by convective heat transfer outside the conductor. By the calculation method, the thermal energy requirement of self-ice-melting ice conductor can be effectively calculated.

articleTitle: Application of Non-player Character Simulation Technology in Union Dispatcher Training Simulator of Multi-level Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The joint anti-accident exercises between multilevel dispatching and control systems are using dispatcher training simulator (DTS). There are many problems with the existing DTS, such as communication difficulties, extraterritorial role simulation difficulties, uniformity of the training process, thus trainees cannot conduct self-training. This paper introduces non-player character (NPC) simulation technology into DTS to customize and intelligentize the training process. This paper firstly fused the NPC features of the game with the DTS system and established NPC model and behavior tree in DTS. Then simulation is conducted in behaviac software to realize the autonomous guidance and intelligent control of the simulation training process. The feasibility and effectiveness of NPC application in DTS are verified by comparison with the traditional DTS training process.

articleTitle: Development Model and Path of Future Power Grids under the Ubiquitous Electrical Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of the ubiquitous electrical Internet of things is an important link in the transformation of power companies to energy Internet enterprises. Relying on the Electrical Internet of Things (EIoT) and Internet technologies, power companies can provide customers with economic and efficient integrated energy services. Firstly, the overall framework of energy Internet is presented from the aspects of distributed renewable energy, distribution network operation, load forecasting and demand response. Then, the integrated energy service system of power companies has been proposed from two aspects, i.e., integrated energy supply and integrated services, based on the background of power market restructuring and energy transformation. Finally, the development path of power companies is proposed, and the problems to be further studied are also put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Current Transfer Arc-Extinguishing Technology of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The premise of reliable arc extinguishing performance by current transfer arc extinguishing technology is to accurately identify the fault phase. This paper analyzes the neutral point voltage and the relative ground voltage variation law when single-line-to-ground (SLG) fault occurs, and obtains a SLG fault phase selection method. Then, an improved scheme for the fault-phase misjudgment and anti-phase short circuit of the current transfer arc-extinguishing device is proposed to improve its reliability. Finally, the action flow of the current transfer arc extinguishing device is described. The feasibility of the principle of current transfer arc suppression technology and the rationality of the action flow are verified by simulation analysis. The results show that the current transfer arc extinguishing technology can theoretically achieve the purpose of quickly eliminating the arc grounding fault, and help to improve the power supply reliability of the power distribution system.

articleTitle: An evaluation approach of carbon emission reduction caused by power interconnection based on integrated generation-transmission planning model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transnational power grid interconnection is helpful for reducing carbon emissions. However, researches on the reasonable evaluation of carbon emission reduction caused by power grid interconnection are relatively limited. Most traditional approaches do not taken into account the influences of power grid interconnection on national power system planning. This paper proposes a novel evaluation approach of carbon emission reduction caused by power grid interconnection based on integrated transnational generation-transmission planning model. A case study is conducted on the Northeast Asia area, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Model Construction and Analysis of Transformer DC Magnetic Bias Induced by Rail Transit Stray Current
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, transformer DC magnetic bias caused by rail transit stray current is researched. The logic relation and core elements of stray current and DC magnetic bias are analyzed. The mathematics model is instituted through the data from subway operation and power grid monitoring. This model can not only be used for the assessment and treatment of transformer DC magnetic bias, but also can be used to locate the weak points of train track insulation. At the same time, this paper provides a combined stray current control scheme for two different systems of power grid and urban rail transit, which have been achieved remarkable results in Changsha area.

articleTitle: Research on Ice Disaster Risk of Transmission Line Based on Annual Ice Extremum
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the phenomena of transmission line faults caused by ice damage, an annual fault rate model of regional transmission lines is constructed based on the theory of extreme ice cover and metal deformation. The distribution of icing extreme value belongs to the probability analysis of Climatic Extreme value. Pearson III distribution is used to fit the data sample of icing extreme value, and the distribution of icing extreme value is obtained. Combining with the theory of metal deformation, the probability model of line failure under the condition of icing thickness is constructed. The annual distribution of transmission line failure rate is synthetically obtained, and the genetic algorithm is used to analyze the distribution of icing extreme value. Its parameters are estimated. The results show that the distribution of extreme value of icing fitted by Pearson III distribution is close to the reality, the probability of line failure under certain icing thickness can be accurately analyzed by metal deformation theory, and the comprehensive annual distribution of transmission line failure rate can be applied to the prevention of icing damage and bone construction of trunk truss.

articleTitle: Study on the Improvement of Commutation Failure by Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large capacity synchronous condenser has excellent reactive power and voltage regulation capability. And it is one of the most important measures to improve the commutation failure characteristics of LCC-HVDC by deploying large capacity synchronous condensers in HVDC inverter stations. In this paper, the principle of configuring synchronous in condenser of reducing the risk of commutation failure, is discussed preliminarily, based on short-circuit current calculation of synchronous condenser. On this basis, combined with the actual power system simulation results, some factors which affect the effect of the synchronous condenser, such as fault location and multi-HVDC interaction, are studied.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control Strategy for Wind Power Grid-connected Power Systems Considering Wind Power Forecast
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the strong random of wind power, the much higher request is put forward for the power system load frequency control. Taking the interconnected power grid with wind power as the research object, the load frequency control strategy based on the wind power prediction by Kalman filter is proposed to reduce the influence in the system frequency caused by wind power. The Kalman filter algorithm is used to predict the wind power at first. Then, the forecasted wind power is employed for the load frequency controller design. Furthermore, the load frequency control model interconnected power system is established. This control scheme is applied to a four-area power system considering three areas integrated wind power. The simulation results which are carried on MATLAB/Simulink, show that the proposed load frequency control strategy based on Kalman filter wind power prediction can effectively reduce the frequency fluctuation and keep the system frequency fluctuation in a small range. Simulation results also show its outperformances when compared with the conventional PID based load frequency control.

articleTitle: Research on Power Modulation Strategy for MMC-HVDC and LCC-HVDC in Parallel HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the difference between MMC-HVDC and LCC-HVDC control characteristics and the mutual influence of parallel connection, its power modulation strategy is different from that of LCC-HVDC. Coordinated control strategy of parallel system of MMC-HVDC and LCC-HVDC is analyzed. The methods of power distribution, rate distribution and reactive power control of power limit function are described. Combined with RTDS simulation research of modulation function of Luxi back-to-back HVDC system, the control characteristics of power limitation function of the parallel system under the condition of AC fault at the rectifier side are analyzed in view of the exposed defects. The coordination method of the power limit function, the high voltage crossing control function and the rate distribution optimization is proposed. The simulation results show that the optimized parallel system can perform the power limiting function according to the correct timing and rate.

articleTitle: Tripping Characteristics of Residual Current Devices Under Different Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Residual current devices (RCDs) can be used to protect people and electric equipment against electric leakage and shocks in low-voltage power systems. However, action failures and nuisance tripping of RCDs can cause a lot of casualties and financial losses. Thus, in order to improve the safety and reliability of low-voltage power systems, it is necessary to study the tripping characteristics of RCDs to find out the reason of nuisance tripping and action failures of RCDs. In this paper, experiments were carried out to investigate the tripping characteristics of RCDs under different working conditions. The experimental results show that, for a sinusoidal residual current, the minimum tripping current rises with the increase of current frequency. When a sinusoidal current with low-order harmonic is applied, RCD tripping is decided by the residual current amplitude. What's more, for a surge current, the minimum tripping current decreases sensitively with the increase of current duration while the front time of the surge current has little influence on the minimum tripping current. Based on these test results, the reasons of action failures and nuisance tripping under actual working conditions have been analyzed and discussed, which can give help to the optimization and improvement of the existing RCDs.

articleTitle: Hybrid Microgrid Load Distribution and DC Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid microgrid is able to supply AC load and DC load. In order to distribute DC power evenly among interlinking converters and improve the DC power quality, a hierarchical control strategy for the interlinking converters is introduced. The first layer of the control strategy is to use the voltage-power droop control method, which can distribute load evenly. Because the droop control may cause DC voltage fall, the DC voltage reference value is compensated according to the second layer control method, which can recover the bus voltage , guarantee the voltage quality.Analyze this control strategy by root-locus method. A microgrid model is based on DIgSILENT. The control strategy is validated by simulation.

articleTitle: An Early Warning Model for Damage of Power Grid under Typhoon Disaster
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power transmission and transformation equipment in the developed areas such as the southeast coast of China is vulnerable to the impact of summer typhoons. However, few people combine typhoon wind speed and precipitation with information of power grid equipment, and give early warning of damage to power grid equipmentin. In this paper, an early warning model for damage of power transmission and transformation equipment under typhoon disasters is established based on Support Vector Machine (SVM). The influencing factors most closely related to damage of power transmission and transformation equipment in typhoon disasters are screened by Partial Mutual Information (PMI). The selected factors are taken as input variables of SVM, and the warning information of damage of power transmission and transformation equipment in typhoon disasters is finally obtained. The results show that the model has an accuracy rate of more than 95% when predicting the damage of power transmission and transformation equipment in typhoon disaster. And the application of the early-warning model can provide accurate, efficient prediction and decision-making information for the safety of power transmission and transformation equipment in power grid.

articleTitle: Distribution High Impedance Fault Detection Using the Fault Signal Reconstruction Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high impedance fault has always been difficult to be detected for distribution grids due to the uncertainty of the weak fault signature. The fault signal reconstruction method is proposed and applied to detect the high impedance fault in the distribution grid. The key innovative feature of the proposed method is essential to the fault signal reconstruction with less prior knowledge and eliminate the effect of the scale decomposition algorithm on signal scale-level feature analysis to some extent. The fault signal is decomposed into multiple scale signals by the fast ensemble empirical mode decomposition. The feature extraction algorithm is proposed to extract scales with the essential fault features, and determine the coefficient of the selected scale signal. The signal reconstruction algorithm is proposed to reconstruct the coefficient of each scale signal for reconstructing signals detected for the sake of highlighting the fault characteristics within the raw fault signals. The signal reconstructed is detected by the principal component analysis. The feasibility and reliability of the method and the accuracy of the high impedance fault detection are verified by simulation results from PSCAD and Matlab with IEEE 34-node test system.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Business Model for Power Demand Response Business
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper firstly gives the definition and status quo of the demand response, and then, points out the lack of business model that restricts the sustainable development of demand response business. Secondly, it analyzes the development status and main application scenarios of domestic demand response business. Then, for each type of application scenario, the direct benefit subject and indirect beneficiary subject of the demand response service are analyzed, which leads to the customer of the demand response service and the solution to the problem. Finally, based on how to solve the customer problem, the business model of demand response business under the three scenarios of peak-cutting, emergency load-cutting and auxiliary service transactions are designed. We also analyze the sellers, purchasers, and sources of purchase funds involved in each type of service.

articleTitle: An Improved Vector Control Strategy of VSC-HVDC Connected to Weak Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage-sourced converter (VSC) based high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system has been widely employed in recent years. However, the transmission power of VSC-HVDC is limited when connected to a weak power grid. The mechanism and solution of this phenomenon are still the focus of current research. In this paper, the linear mathematical model of outer loop control of VSC including phase-locked loop is firstly established, then instability of VSC-HVDC connection in weak current network is proved by small signal model, and the interaction between active and reactive power rings is analyzed. It is concluded that the increase of the reactive loop response speed is beneficial to improve the stability of the system, and therefore an improved control strategy is proposed in this paper. Effectiveness of the method to improve the power transmission limit and the correctness of the analysis are verified in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Model for Controlling Risk Optimization Using Energy Storage and Distributed Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual establishment of the monthly bidding market, the spot market and the auxiliary service market, China's power retail industry has shown a rapid development trend, but there are big differences in the risk factors of different types of power sales companies. The risk management of power sales companies is a research point with important practical significance. This paper builds a power-selling company to bundle the electricity demand of power users, and considers the power-supply system purchase model of energy storage system and distributed renewable energy optimization to reduce the overall deviation of power and assessment costs, and increase total profit. The economic loss is affected by the control deviation assessment policy and the load forecast deviation risk.

articleTitle: Maximum PV Access Capacity Planning Method for Rural Power Grid Considering Overload Risk
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of PV capacity in rural power grid, it is of great practical significance to carry out the preliminary planning for the maximum PV access capacity in rural power grid to master the PV energy consumption capacity and to make reasonable PV grid-connected layout. In this paper, overload risk is taken as the restriction of PV access capacity, combined with the operation characteristics of single-radiation and hand-in-hand power supply structure. A maximum PV access capacity planning method for the two power supply modes is proposed. Finally, a village distribution network is taken as an example to explain the proposed PV capacity planning method.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Back Propagation neural networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Network reconfiguration, which is of great significance to improve the nodal voltage profiles and reduce the active power losses, can be considered as a pattern recognition problem. A pattern construction method based on structural simplification of distribution network is proposed, where the distribution network structure is simplified by branch grouping and pattern of network structure. MILP model is used to describe the network reconfiguration patterns, which is resolved by Harmony Search Algorithm (HSA). The network reconfiguration patterns can be carried out by BP neural networks when the loads data is collected. 33-node system have been introduced to prove the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Infrared Anomaly Detection for Power Equipment Based on YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power equipment is an important part of the power system and the focus of power system operation and maintenance. Infrared anomaly detection technology is an effective means to detect abnormalities of power equipment because of its safety, simplicity and intuitiveness. Through training the YOLOv3 network by infrared images collected in the field, this work can achieve real-time detection of power equipment and fault points on the Jetson Nano, and determines which areas of the power equipment are abnormal. The trained YOLOv3 model is tested. The mAP value of the model is 34.63%, the recall rate is 21%, and the temperature anomaly area and power equipment could be marked. The running time on the Jetson Nano was 0.7-0.9 s (the recognition time was less than 1s), which satisfies the requirements for power equipment testing.

articleTitle: Edge-Computing-Driven Autonomous Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity: Architecture and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network is developing towards the direction of Internet of Things in Electricity(IoTE). As an emerging technology of the Internet of Things(IoT), edge computing has great application potential in the future IoTE. This paper presents an architecture of edge computing-driven IoTE, whose physical layer is an electrical network containing a high proportion of power electronic devices, and its information layer is a 5G-oriented power communication network containing a large amount of power terminal and mass communication data generated by the power terminal. For the physical layer, the virtual synchronous machine(VSM) algorithm are adopted to control the large number of power electronic components so as to guarantee the dynamic stability of physical power network. For the information layer, a new layered distributed information processing architecture, the Edge Computing Architecture, is introduced to address the needs of information monitoring and protection control in the smart distribution network. The architecture of the edge computing, and the applications that may be deployed in the edge computing gateways are introduced, and the challenges may be faced by the IoTE in the future development are further discussed.

Author Keywords: Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Energy Routing System Considering Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy routing system can use DC bus to connect multiple input and output converters. The structure of the system is complex, and the flow of energy is changeable. Therefore, a detailed and effective design is necessary. This paper takes impedance analysis method to analyze the smallsignal stability of the energy routing system which uses a DC bus structure with constant power load considering the droop control strategy of multiple converters. Firstly, a small-signal model is established for the converter module by combining control strategy. Secondly, based on the control of the bus side port voltage converter (BVCC) and the control of the bus side port current converter (BCCC) classification, derivation and summary of the application steps of unified impedance criterion in the energy routing system are obtained. Finally, the energy routing system under constant power load is simulated and analyzed. The result shows that the oscillation frequency at the time of system instability is consistent with the frequency of the intercept point of the impedance curve. Meanwhile, the increasing of the inductance value of the constant power load converter can improve the system stability. The result is identical to the theoretical analysis as well as verifying the applicability and accuracy of the unified impedance criterion applied in the energy router.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Model of Insulation Failure Rate of Power Transformer Considering Real-time Aging State
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The failure rate is a reliability evaluation parameter based on probability in the power system. It is very important to calculate the reliability index and the equipment fault loss through the failure rate for the planning and operation of the power system. A failure model of large transformer failure rate is proposed. Firstly, the failure rate model of the transformer is established, and the current failure rate and running state of the transformer are obtained. Secondly, a multi-state Markov failure rate prediction model is established to predict the real-time failure rate of the transformer. Finally, the proportional failure rate model of aging failure process to correct the current state of the transfer rate of transformer, and then on the basis of a more accurate transformer real-time prediction failure rate. Example analysis results show that the multi-state Markov failure rate prediction model can be modified by the aging failure model, and the real - time failure rate can be predicted more accurately.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Wind and Photovoltaic Power Based on Mixed Copula Theory and Its Application into Optimum Capacity Allocation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to better realize the rational utilization of renewable energy and reduce the large-scale and multi-type renewable energy's output for the stable operation of power grid, an optimum capacity allocation method which is based on the correlation between wind and photovoltaic (PV) power output, is proposed. In this paper, the historical data of actual wind speed and PV power output in northern Hebei are analyzed. Based on this, a mathematical model of correlation analysis using mixed copula function is established by combining original least square method. Moreover, the Spearman rank correlation coefficient is selected to quantitatively measure the generation characteristics of the two kinds of fluctuating energy output, and the correlation calculation based on wind and PV power output is performed to obtain the optimum capacity allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation for Wind-Solar Station Considering Power Response of Pumped Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale renewable energy access with randomness and volatility poses severe challenges to power grid security dispatch. In order to reduce the adverse impact of wind power and solar power on the grid, the fluctuation of wind power and solar power should be considered in the construction of wind-photovoltaic power plants. Therefore, considering the regulation ability of pumped storage units to suppress wind and solar fluctuations quickly, the power response model of pumped storage units under the conditions of pumping and hydroelectric power generation is established in this paper. Aiming at the economy and the proportion of wind energy and solar energy absorption, an optimal allocation method of wind energy and solar power capacity considering the power response of pumped storage units is proposed. Under the condition of positive and negative peak regulation of wind power output, the simulation results show that the optimal installed capacity allocation scheme of wind power and solar power plants is obtained. The simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Arc-Suppression Method of Grounding Fault for Distribution Network Based on Controlled Voltage Source Access
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the effect of fault arc- suppression and restore the normal operation of the system, a controlled voltage source is installed with adjustable value and phase at the beginning of a specific phase of the distribution network line. Three-phase voltage and zero-sequence voltage is continuously measured of the distribution network, and the ground fault and judge the fault phase is detected. When a fault is detected and the fault phase is determined, the output voltage of the controlled voltage source is adjusted to a specific value Ui , forcing the fault phase voltage to zero, destroying the re-ignition condition of the fault phase arc. After the personnel insolation of the fault, the controlled voltage source is taken out of the distribution network. Based on the above methods, the electrical distance between the access position of the controlled power source and the fault point is closer, and the voltage source is used to directly control the fault phase voltage, effectively avoiding the current and voltage conversion process. The effective grounding system's energy distribution is adjusted more quickly, enabling instantaneous fault arc-suppression.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Wind Turbine on Short Circuit Capacity of System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale grid-connection of wind turbines, it is of great significance to study the influence of the grid-connection of wind turbines on the system short-circuit capacity. In this paper, the different positions of short-circuit faults are considered, and the short-circuit currents of the double-fed induction generator (DFIG) and the permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) in the event of a short-circuit fault are analyzed. As a result, the expression and influencing factors of the short-circuit current of two different types of wind turbines at the time of failure are obtained. Meanwhile, the simulation results show that different types of wind turbines of the same capacity have different effects on the short-circuit capacity of the system, and the operation of the low-voltage through-protection device of the wind turbines also has a large impact on the short-circuit capacity of the system.

articleTitle: Signal Recognition Method of Power Cable Oscillating Wave Partial Discharge Detection Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Oscillating wave partial discharge detection technology has been widely used because of its powerful applicability. However, the detection process will produce short duration, burst, non-stationary impulse noise, whose characteristics are similar to partial discharge signals, and it is difficult to denoise by traditional methods such as filtering. In accordance with the above problems, this paper presents a method of recognition and noise reduction of oscillating partial discharge signal based on support vector machine. A classifier of noise pulse and partial discharge signal is established to eliminate impulse noise in partial discharge signal. Aiming at the difference of time-frequency characteristics between oscillating partial discharge signal and impulse noise, support vector machine classifier is used to identify partial discharge signal and impulse noise. It can overcome the defect that the traditional filtering method is difficult to suppress impulse noise. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional empirical threshold method, the accuracy of partial discharge defect location is improved by more than 7.5%, which can effectively improve the accuracy of partial discharge location detection.

articleTitle: A Start-up Inrush Current Suppression Method Based on Dual Parameters Soft-start for PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At the start-up moment, three-phase PWM rectifier generates a large inrush current on the AC side generally, which may cause electromagnetic interference and overcurrent protection, even damage to the switching device. In order to suppress the inrush current at start-up moment, the reference soft-start methods based DC Voltage and AC current are proposed respectively. However, suppression effects of such method are imperfect, and existing methods can hardly suppress the inrush current in the first few switching cycles after the rectifier is started. To solve the problem, the generation mechanism of inrush current is analyzed deeply in this paper from the perspective of switching mode and modulation ratio of the PWM rectifier, and mathematical model of three-phase PWM rectifier on each switching mode is derived. The impact of initial modulation ratio on amplitude of inrush current is obtained. Therefore, in this paper, a start-up inrush current suppression method based dual parameters soft-start, which are modulation ratio and DC voltage reference respectively, is proposed. Finally, the simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively eliminate the inrush current during the whole start-up procedure of the PWM rectifier.

articleTitle: Novel Traveling Wave Detection Method based on VMD-S Transform in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the complex operation environment in distribution network and the problem existing in Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) and S-transform methods of traveling wave detection, a traveling wave detection scheme based on variational mode decomposition (VMD)-S transform is proposed in this paper. It solves the problem of mode mixing and endpoint effect in empirical mode decomposition (EMD) process, and the problem that the detection ability of traveling wave signal decreases when S-transform is disturbed by strong noise. It can accurately identify the arrival time of the initial traveling wave head. The simulation is built in ATP/EMTP, and the results show that, compared with HHT and S-transform, the proposed detection method has better anti-jamming effect under strong noise conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Hydrogen Oxygen Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydrogen oxygen fuel cell will be the most widely used and commercialized fuel cell in the future. For further study of hydrogen oxygen fuel cell, a simulation model of hydrogen oxygen fuel cell is built up in this paper according to the theory of dynamic model and static model. It is verified that the static and dynamic characteristics of the simulation model are in good coincidence with the hydrogen oxygen fuel cell, which enhance the accuracy and reliability of the simulation model.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Model for PMU Placement Considering Redundancy in the Presence of Line Outages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Optimal PMU placement (OPP) was developed to determine the number and locations of PMUs on the premise of full observability of whole network. In order to enhance reliability under contingencies, redundancy should also be considered besides the number of PMUs in the OPP problem. Thus, in this paper, a multi-objective model is established to minimize the number of PMUs and maximize the redundancy simultaneously. The redundancy here is formulated as average possibility of observability (APO) considering random component outages, and full possibility formula is applied to calculate the APO value in the case of single line outage. Finally, the model is employed to IEEE-24 bus system, and the results verify that the developed model can provide a placement scheme with higher reliability.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Study of Traveling Wave Positioning System Based on TMR
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional fault traveling wave positioning method requires the installation of traveling wave positioning devices at both ends of the line. The installation cost is high, and the reliability of the device also has a great influence on the positioning accuracy. The system is proposed by replacing the power distribution transformer core grounding wire with the capacitor at the end of the line in this paper. The fault traveling wave signal is extracted at specific collection points. The problems of small signal and interference caused by the multi-branch topology of the distribution network is effectively solved by the TMR magnetic sensor module. The traveling wave positioning system combined by the TMR magnetic sensor is used for matching. The detection and location of the lightning strike fault of the grid overhead line is improved by the optimized signal extraction unit and the signal recognition algorithm which has obvious significance in engineering.

articleTitle: Distribution Locational Marginal Pricing for Active Network Management Considering High Penetration of Distributed Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a distribution locational marginal pricing (DLMP) approach for integrating high penetration of distributed energy resources (DER) in a competitive market environment. A hierarchical market structure at distribution-level is proposed for facilitating the market penetration of DERs. The DLMP method is implemented to incentivize DERs to provide services in active network management. The market clearing problem and the calculation of DLMP are based on an AC optimal power flow (ACOPF) model. Then, we propose a scenario analysis to evaluate the contribution of DLMP in hosting DERs. A numerical simulation is conducted to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Information Value Based on the Scenario of Wind Power Trading in Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a newly-emerged intangible asset, information plays an important role in more and more fields and environments, and its value is increasingly analyzed and explored. In the power industry, there are severe uncertainties in electric load, output power and electricity market price, which may lead to economic loss of corresponding market entities. Therefore, accurate information is necessary for market entities to eliminate uncertainties and improve their economic benefits. To clarify information value, the scenario of wind power trading is selected in electricity markets, and information gap decision theory (IGDT) is used for theoretical analysis. This paper introduces the decision model of independent system operators (ISOs) in electricity markets, describes the information value in the scenario through IGDT, and finally formulates a universal information value evaluation model. Both theoretical results and case studies verify the existence of information value and the validity of its evaluation model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Commutation failure Risk for HVDC Caused by Harmonic Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The commutation failure is one of the most common faults in high voltage direct current transmission (HVDC) systems. The research on the HVDC commutation failure has made some achievements at home and abroad. However, the influence of harmonic on the commutation failure of HVDC has not been studied thoroughly. Based on the commutation process of HVDC and the commutation voltage-time area analysis, a harmonic influence factor is derived, and the influence of harmonics on the commutation process in HVDC is quantitatively analyzed. The evaluation index of the risk of commutation failure due to harmonics, which is defined as the harmonic influence superposition E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sup</inf>, is proposed, and a method using E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sup</inf> to evaluate the risk of commutation failure caused by harmonic voltage is given consequently. Finally, based on the PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic transient simulation platform, the proposed evaluation indicators are simulated and verified.

articleTitle: Research on Leakage Current Filtering Method of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the low-voltage distribution network of the Internet of Things, leakage current detection is developed rapidly. But the accuracy of leakage detection is decreased due to the zero-sequence harmonics caused by the nonlinear load in the wireless region. A single-phase d-q transforming filtering method is proposed to effectively reduce the interference of zero-sequence harmonics in the radio zone circuit for detecting leakage current. The proposed method can deal with the detection of instantaneous leakage current of the line comparing with the frequency domain filtering method. Based on the Internet of Things technology, the leakage current collection and data analysis are realized, the fault point is accurately located and the fault is eliminated in time. The feasibility of the method is verified by MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Research on External Partial Discharge of Transformer Bushing Based on UHF Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The main function of the transformer bushing is to support and connect the transformer lead-out line. In recent years, bushing faults have occurred frequently but there is not good online monitoring method for bushing. The ultra-high frequency (UHF) detection method has the characteristics of strong anti-interference ability and no influence on equipment operation while achieving non-contact measurement. This paper has studied the phenomenon of the bushing by artificially setting the partial discharge fault on the 35kV bushing, and the improved time difference algorithm is used to locate the partial discharge source, forming a preliminary analysis method and research ideas for the bushing. The UHF signals of Phase Resolved Pluse Sequence (PRPD) of the bushing corona discharge is mainly concentrated between 30°~80° and 210°~260°, and the amplitude is relatively dispersed, and the stable discharge in one cycle with the tap suspended discharge has a wider distribution range and a smaller relative amplitude, since the tap is closed to the flange, partial discharge occurs at a lower voltage, and the signals are distributed between 0° and 100°, 170°~250° and 330°~360°, but the discharge charge is relatively small. The analysis of the received signal of the UHF sensors can determine the time difference of the signal reaching different sensors, and the specific position of the PD source can be calculated by the time difference with a few centimeters error from the actual position.

articleTitle: The DC Bias Risk Assessment of Transformer Based on Nonlinear Magnetic Circuit Equations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
