abstract: In the study of DC bias threshold of transformer, there are different opinions at home and abroad. It is of great significance to study a simplified and fast method for transformer DC bias risk assessment. Firstly, the magnetic motive force (MMF) model of single-phase transformer is established, and the concept of equivalent field current and DC bias current is put forward. Secondly, comparing current to magnetic flux based on the correlation of transformer electrical and magnetic, a nonlinear reluctance model is established and a nonlinear magnetic circuit model is built. The DC bias current is calculated by using the linear relation between the magnetic field intensity and the field current. Finally, the simulation model is built according to the magnetic circuit equation. The waveform distortion of the equivalent field current is analyzed under the DC bias state, and the nonlinear function between the bias magnetic flux and the DC bias current is discussed. It is found that the bias magnetic flux reaches saturation, and the DC bias current surges. The transformer has DC bias risk.

articleTitle: Research on Speed Expansion Capability of Hybrid Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is widely used in the field of electric vehicles. The equivalent air gap of traditional permanent magnet induction motor is larger, the amount of permanent magnet is larger, the excitation potential of permanent magnet is larger, and the extension range of motor speed is smaller. The excitation potential of hybrid permanent magnet synchronous motor is small, and the ratio of short circuit current to rated current is small. Therefore, the weak magnetic performance of hybrid structure is better than that of traditional permanent magnet synchronous motor. The experiment of flux-weakening control using additional voltage feedback method shows that the flux-weakening multiple of hybrid permanent magnet synchronous motor can reach 4 times. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the hybrid structure can effectively improve the flux-weakening speed expansion ability of permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Dispatch of AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid Based on Consensus Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy in the microgrid increasing, alternating current/direct current (AC/DC) hybrid microgrid is becoming an effective way to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy. Distributed control makes the distributed generation mode of microgrid more flexible and robust. The communication network topology of AC/DC hybrid microgrid is considered, and a dynamic economic dispatch method based on consensus algorithm and quadratic adjustment plan is proposed. In this method, a dispatch cycle of optimization problem is decoupled into 24 single-period problems. In each period, the goal is to minimize the generation costs of microgrid. The marginal operation costs of each distributed generation unit is selected as the consensus variable. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the validity of the developed results.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy Trading Platform for Distribution Network Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the obvious peak-valley period in the current electricity trading and the inadequate effect of peak-cutting and valley-filling in the traditional electricity trading, this paper proposes a new type of distribution network trading platform based on the edge computing. Firstly, the edge computing gateway is deployed in multiple distribution terminals to form a virtual electric field. Then, the users who can generate electricity by themselves can sell the surplus power to other users through the edge computing gateway under the background of satisfying their own power consumption. Finally, the demander user can choose to purchase electricity according to the demand. The trading platform will adjust the selling price of electric power according to the real-time peak and valley value of electric power, so as to help power grid to cut peak and fill valley. The test in the laboratory shows that the user data security performance is good and the security factor is high, effectively solving the limitations of the existing single electricity sales mode.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Power Spot Market Mechanism to Promote Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Spot market plays a key role in putting forward the construction of electricity market and improving operation efficiency and security. A low-consumption and high-efficiency electricity market is proposed to fulfill geographical representation, energy saving and environmental protection. Construction of the spot market is described to consider the main features of the local region and solve the prominent problems of electricity market. Based on the experience of domestic and international power market, the framework of spot market is proposed to promote the renewable energy consumption for the power grid with high proportion of renewable energy.

Author Keywords: high proportion of renewable energy power grid

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Residual Current Operated Protective Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the fact that the residual current operated protective device used in China's low-voltage power grid is low rate of commissioning, rejecting the action frequently, and the operation rate is low, and the operation characteristics of the residual current operated protective device are investigated. It is found that the traditional protection device cannot eliminate the interference of higher harmonics in the power grid. The number of intelligent electrical equipment increases, and the malfunction of the protection device caused by the inrush current of the switching power supply frequently occurs. Based on this, the wavelet transform is used to realize the accurate detection of the electric shock signal. At the same time, the soft start circuit design of the switching power supply achieves a good suppression effect on the inrush current generated at the moment of starting, and realizes the rapid identification of the electric shock current and the interference current in the future. Effective separation provides theoretical support for the development of high-reliability residual current action protection devices.

articleTitle: Individual blade pitch control for floating wind turbine based on RBF-SMC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the aerodynamic model, hydrodynamic model and mooring system model are established and coupled in time domain to obtain the effective wind speed under the disturbance of wind, wave and mooring load. On this basis, the online learning ability of Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network is used to adjust the gain of sliding mode variable structure controller in real time so that the sliding mode function tends to the switching surface, and the chattering of sliding mode variable structure controller can be effectively reduced. The RBF-SMC individual blade pitch control method which is more suitable for floating wind turbine is obtained. Based on the simulation model of floating wind turbine composed of NREL-5MW wind turbine and OC3-Hywind foundation, the traditional PI control and the control method proposed in this paper are compared and analyzed. The results show that the individual blade pitch control based on RBF-SMC can effectively reduce the sway of floating foundation, restrain the fluctuation of effective wind speed of wind turbine, and ensure the stability of output power.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for a Wind-Hydrogen-Fuel Cell Multi-Vector Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Efficient applications of renewable energy (e.g. wind, solar, bio-energy etc.) is high on the Chinese governmental agenda. Multi-vector energy system is one of the solutions to cope with this issue. Moreover, a safe and resilient operational method is required for such complicated energy systems. This paper proposes a multi-vector energy system including wind, hydrogen and fuel cells as a supplement part to the main grid. Electricity is firstly converted by wind energy while certain percent of electricity is used for water electrolysis where hydrogen as energy storage is generated. Fuel cells consume hydrogen when electrical energy demand peaks. To evaluate the performance of the energy system, an analytical model is developed to coordinate the operation of the system involving energy conversion between hydrogen, electrical and mechanical forms. Genetic Algorithm (GA) as optimal strategy is used to determine the operational scheme for the system. In the study, different load scenarios are used on the basis of real-world measurement data. The results have confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed methodology where wind energy is consumed in maximum locally. As a consequence, this study provides a demonstration of an integrated renewable energy system w can be widely that can be used in wind-rich rural areas.

articleTitle: Short-Circuit Fault Analysis of Energy Storage System Converter with Different Control in DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage system plays an important role to operate the DC microgrid stably and improve power quality. When it is connected to the DC system through the bidirectional DC/DC converter, the energy storage system is of great significance to study fault characteristics of the energy storage converter for the rational design of relay protection. This paper investigates system response characteristics of energy storage systems in different fault stages under constant voltage control and droop control when short-circuit faults occur in DC microgrid, and compares effects of the two control methods on short-circuit fault characteristics. The results show that different control modes have a certain restraining effect on the fault behavior of DC microgrid, but the inrush current is too large at instantaneous failure. Therefore, the latching control should be carried out in time; meanwhile, a reliable and effective protection device should be added. In addition, the research shows that the capacitance and line parameters at the dc grid side also have influences on fault response characteristics of the energy storage converter. Finally, the simulation model of DC microgrid connected to the energy storage system is built on PSCAD / EMTDC to verify correctness of the theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Energy Storage System Based on LCC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fast charging and discharging characteristics of energy storage technology provides an effective way to solve the problems of peak clipping and valley filling on the grid side, large-scale access to renewable energy on the power generation side, and stable operation of isolated networks. In view of the economics of current energy storage equipment, there is still no good evaluation method. The life cycle cost is proposed as an indicator to evaluate the economics of energy storage equipment. The dynamic and static model of the energy storage system is established. Taking a demonstration work as an example, the calculation is carried out. It correctly displays the long-term cost advantage and efficiency advantage of the equipment in the whole operation process and provides a decision-making basis for the comprehensive evaluation of the economics of energy storage equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Capture by Particle Trap in 1100 kV Gas Insulated Transmission Line for Metal Particles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The 1100 kV gas insulated transmission line (GIL) is applied to the Sutong high-voltage transmission project in China, and its rated voltage level is the highest in the world. In order to ensure the insulation reliability, when designing the product, a particle trap is arranged near the insulator to capture nearby metal particles and reduce the chance of flashover on the surface of the insulator. The internal insulation structure and geometric size of GIL determine the potential gradient distribution. The particle motion is affected by its own gravity, coulomb force, electric field gradient force, gas resistance and friction. The motion law is complicated and difficult to measure. In this paper, the numerical modeling method is used to establish the motion model of metal particles near the trap of 1100 kV GIL. The trajectories of particles for different sizes at different voltages and initial positions are obtained. By analyzing the law of particle motion, the GIL product pre-conditioning test program is guided, and the different sizes of particles that may exist in the GIL are classified and captured by the step-by-step voltage applying voltage method, thereby increasing the trapping effect of the particle trap and improving the insulation reliability of on-site operation in the product. Finally, the feasibility of the preconditioning test scheme design using this numerical method is verified by the particle motion observed by the camera.

articleTitle: Precise Dispatch Control of Energy Storage to Enhance Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to resolve the problem that the power industry is with a rigid expectation of energy storage, higher requirement is put forward for intelligent and precise dispatch control of energy storage. The historical abandonment scenarios of power grids is analyzed to explore the pain points of current renewable energy consumption, where the principle and technical scheme is proposed of precise control of energy storage power stations. The precise control system of pumped storage power stations is applied to the actual grid data of a province. From the perspective of "source-network-loadstorage", the precise regulation of energy storage is used to promote the effect of renewable energy consumption. Through the intelligent and precise energy storage precision control system, the energy storage up and down adjustment flexibility is fully utilized to help the power system reach a balance, which not only promotes the consumption of renewable energy, but also makes the system more flexible and resilient.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network with Dynamic Computer-visualised Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power flow distribution of the grid changes after fault. This paper proposes a method for transforming the pre-fault and post-fault power flow into a dynamic computer-visualised power flow image (dynamic CVPFI) and using the convolutional neural network (CNN) for fault diagnosis. Firstly, the technical approaches of using CVPFI to identify grid faults are introduced. After that, based on the original CVPFI concept proposed by the author in the early stage, the time-varying characteristics of power flow are added, and the concept of dynamic CVPFI and the method of generating massive dynamic CVPFI sample set are given. Finally, a CNN which conforms to the dimensions of dynamic CVPFI is designed. The case shows that the CNN structure designed in this paper can extract the spatiotemporal features in dynamic CVPFI samples. Compared to the original method, the accuracy of using the dynamic CVPFI for grid fault diagnosis is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power prediction plays an important role in the stable and safe operation of power systems with large-scale wind power. In this paper, two mathematical models are constructed to predict wind power. One of them is designed for the condition of available numerical weather prediction information, and the other is for the opposite. An auto regressive moving average model is constructed based on the time-sequence change characteristics of wind power. It can directly predict the wind power without numerical weather prediction information. Moreover, a linear regression model is built to deal with numerical weather prediction information from different systems, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of wind power forecasting according to numerical weather prediction information.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Strategy of EV Charging Load Agent in Residential Areas Considering Peak-Shifting and Valley-Filling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The disorderly charging of large-scale electric vehicles (EVs) in residential areas will have a negative impact on peak load, so it is very important to guide the charging behavior of electric vehicles reasonably. Firstly, a pricing mechanism of a residential district agent based on time-of-use (TOU) price is proposed, and the market structure of EV charging and the pricing strategy of the agent are analyzed. Secondly, a multi-objective optimization model is established to minimize the peak-valley difference, maximize the profit of the agent and minimize the charging cost of EV users. The multi-objective model is transformed into a game model between the agent and the users considering the incentives from the power grid company. By using KKT conditions and duality theorem, the game problem is transformed into mixed integer linear programming problem, which is solved by YALMIP. Finally, taking a residential district as an example, electric vehicle users can charge the EVs orderly by responding to the electricity price to provide valley filling load for the grid. Considering the incentive of grid company for the agent, it has a certain effect on the realization of peak load shifting and valley filling, the improvement of agent's income and the reduction of charging cost of EV users.

articleTitle: Study on Droop Frequency Modulation of Micro-Grid Based on Variable Domain Fuzzy PI
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of frequency dynamic response difference based on conventional PI droop control, a droop frequency modulation method for micro-grid based on variable domain fuzzy PI is proposed by introducing an expandable & shrinkable factor. In Matlab/Simulink, the droop control based on conventional PI is simulated and verified. The results show that the droop frequency modulation method based on variable universe fuzzy PI not only solves the problem of frequency static error in traditional droop control, but also has faster frequency response and smaller dynamic deviation.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Control Requirement and Strategy of Large Scale Renewable Energy VSC-HVDC Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Although domestic and foreign research institutions have obtained some research results in related fields, they have not conducted in-depth research on the interaction between VSC DC grid and renewable energy, and on the fault rid though and coordinated control technology of VSC DC grid and renewable energy joint system. Most studies have focused on the fault ride though of the system in the case of AC power grid short-circuit faults in renewable energy power plants and peer-to-peer VSC DC grid systems. Basically, the impact of VSC DC grid system faults on the grid connection of renewable energy is not considered. Although the above research results can suppress the rise of DC voltage and provide technical support as a joint fault ride though of renewable energy and DC grid, the system can achieve fault ride though. However, various fault ride though methods will inevitably have a certain impact on the renewable energy generators, and even have an impact on the regulations and standards for renewable energy connected to the DC power system. Therefore, from the perspective of the safety protection of renewable energy, it is necessary to consider the fault ride though method when the AC grid fails in the VSC DC transmission mode. The transmission of Zhangbei renewable energy through the VSC grid is a complex system with multiple wind farms and multi-terminal DC. It is necessary to carry out detailed research in different working conditions and sub-modes. This paper provides the study on fault control requirement and strategy of large scale renewable energy connected to VSC DC grid, and tries to explore potential challenge caused by the integration of renewable energy generation into VSC DC grid.

articleTitle: Identification of Power Angle Instability and Transient Voltage Instability Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of modern power grid and the increasingly complex modes of operation, the issues of power system stability become prominent. Transient stability and dynamic stability have always been serious problems that threaten the safe and stable operation of the power grid, and it is very difficult to distinguish between transient power angle stability and transient voltage stability in actual analysis. In recent years, the third generation of artificial intelligence technology represented by deep learning has developed rapidly, and it has achieved remarkable results in the fields of classification and aggregation. It provides technical support for identifying the type of instability and discriminating power oscillations of different mechanisms. This paper proposes a method for identifying the modes of power angle instability and voltage instability based on Deep Belief Network. By constructing the deep learning model, it is applied to feature extraction of power angle stability and voltage stability.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Integrated System Design of Smart Substation Secondary System Based on SCD/CAD File Mapping Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The physical part of the secondary system design in the smart substation is completed by the design institute, and the conventional CAD drawings are issued. The part of the virtual circuit design is usually completed by the integrator, which is reflected in the SCD file. The main problem is that the design of the physical circuit of the smart substation and the design of the logical circuit are separated, both in terms of the unit and the embodiment of the result, which affects the construction process of the smart substation and the subsequent operation and maintenance. In this paper, an integrated design scheme of secondary system of smart substation is proposed. Based on the standardized definition of secondary equipment of smart substation, a standard wired expert database is constructed to realize the automatic design of secondary virtual circuit. Based on the standardized port definition and explicit port connection mode of secondary equipment, a design method of automatic fiber loop connection through the connected virtual loop is proposed. By studying the physical circuit drawings and the mapping relationship between logical circuit design documents, the intelligent substation physical mapping between circuits and logic circuit principle and the SVG file which can be used as intelligent substation drawing one with virtual terminal intelligent substation design results reflect tool are put forward, effectively solving the problem of physical circuits and logic circuit split. The method described in this paper has been applied in engineering. Through the application, the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme have been verified and the design level, construction quality and reliability of intelligent substation have been practically improved.

articleTitle: Research on Combination of Partial Discharge Inspection of Cable and Accurate Position Detection of Oscillating Wave
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of defects left by the poor quality of the cable accessories and poor process are the main causes of the failure. Cable oscillation wave detection can accurately locate the position and discharge of partial discharge defects. However, due to the planned power outage, the complex detection system, and tedious preparations, it is not suitable for the inspection personnel to carry out large-scale and rapid inspection work. This paper proposes and studies a diagnostic combining hand-held fast inspection of partial discharge in cable with accurate location detection of oscillation wave test system. Practical application cases show that the method is more effective and efficient, because extensive live partial discharge detection can be carried out to pick the suspected cable without power interruption, and the cable with oscillation wave detection is more targeted, thus significantly improving the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Fractional Order PID Controller in Servo Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The applications of servo control technology in industry, transportation, astronautics, medical treatment, military and other fields are becoming more and more popular, which requires higher performance in response speed, tracking accuracy and adaptability to complex environment. The control algorithm has a vital impact on the performance of the whole servo system. Fractional-order PID (FOPID) controller is an advanced control strategy which has emerged in recent years. It has better control performance and wider application prospects than traditional PID controller. The parameter tuning of FOPID controller using genetic algorithm based on the state-space (GABS) is proposed, which is to achieve global search to obtain the optimal parameters, and then the design of optimal FOPID controller is completed. Compared with FOPID controller optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) and integer order PID (IOPID), FOPID controller by GABS has better tuning results. And the system has better performance in response performance, anti-interference ability and robustness.

Author Keywords: genetic algorithm based on the State-space

articleTitle: Urban user and grid supply and demand friendly interaction system based on two-layer optimization model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-layer optimization model to optimize the demand response between grid companies and urban users, which is used for the grid company to realize its expected demand response load with the minimum cost and meanwhile make sure the user to achieve the maximum economic compensation. Particularly, in this model, the urban users participating in the response are divided into two categories, i.e., the resident users and the large users, where resident users and large users respectively participate in demand response through self-quoting and signing contracts. With the model, the power grid company iteratively adjusts the electricity price, leading to the dynamic change of the proportion of resident users participating in the procedure of demand response. When the demand response cost achieves the minimal value, the final optimal price is determined. In this way, the benefits of both grid and residential users are balanced and their demands are satisfied.

articleTitle: A New Measurement Technology of Grounded Capacitance Parameters of the Distribution Network Lines Based on Resonance Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Precise measurement of distribution capacitance to ground is always a hot topics discussed by distribution system researchers. Under the certain circumstances, the value of the arc suppression coil value is unknown in distribution network and the grounded parameters cannot be effectively measured by the existing methods. Based on the production of our research group, a new method for grounded capacitance measurement of the distribution network is proposed when the value of arc suppression coil is unknown. In medium and low-voltage distribution network systems of China, the neutral point is commonly used as the arc suppression coil grounding method. Therefore, the accurate and rapid measurement of the grounded capacitance is necessary. After PSCAD and MATLAB joint simulation analysis, experimental verification and the reliability of this method are proved. The measuring process is performed on the secondary side and it does not affect the normal operation of the primary side.

articleTitle: Novel Indices for Voltage Stability Evaluation of Wind-penetrated Power System with Complex Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage stability is a challenging issue for a power system with high penetration level. Two voltage stability indices are proposed in this paper to quantitatively evaluate the steady-state voltage stability and the short-term voltage stability respectively. The steady-state voltage stability metric is based on voltage collapse proximity indicator (VCPI) and considers the priorities of different transmission lines. The short-term voltage stability index evaluates not only the extent of the voltage deviation, but also the voltage recovery time, which is critical to the wind-penetrated power system. Complex load model is also considered in this paper to address the adverse impact of the induction motor loads on the power system. The New England 39-bus test system is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed indices in PSSE.

articleTitle: Islanding Detection Method for Inverter Cluster Based on Interharmonic Impedance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the number of grid-connected inverters in distributed generation systems increases, the detection signal of the active method will interfere with each other. According to the reason, it is necessary to study the islanding detection technology applicable to the inverter clusters with different control strategies. In this paper, the islanding detection method of inverter clusters based on interharmonic impedance measurement is studied. The detection principle of the method is that the impedance of the system increases when islanding operation state is enabled. This method connects the interharmonic disturbance device at the point of common coupling, and collects the interharmonic voltage and current at the output terminals of the disturbance device by FFT. Then, the interharmonic impedance change between systems and judge is calculated whether the system is in the islanding operation state. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is confirmed by MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting for Industrial Enterprises Based on Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In China, industrial enterprises develop rapidly, and industrial electricity consumption account for 70% of social electricity consumption. However, the charging mode of industrial electricity is very complicated which can be divided into two basic modes, one mode is to pay according to transformer capacity and other mode is to pay according to maximum demand. In both modes, the complex charging type involving seasonal factors and national economic growth. Once a company chooses the wrong mode to buy electricity, it has to change it three months later. In this case, it not only increases the cost of electricity but also wastes resources. Therefore, it is important to predict the future load data according to the energy consumption characteristics of enterprises. In the context of big data, the electricity data of Chinese enterprises will be developed and utilized gradually. In this paper, the long short-term memory (LSTM) model is built to carry out load forecasting of the international dairy companies which called Ausnutria. The simulation results show that LSTM network is feasible in the field of load prediction, and the method can ensure the accuracy.

articleTitle: Advanced Intelligent Micro Inverter Control in the Distributed Solar Generation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the solar energy system is an effective alternative to the conventional fossil fuel-based generation, research and development of its intelligent control in the distributed smart grid is an inevitable trend in the power and energy system. Although many grid-support functionalities was proposed in the literature, the integration of different functionalities is still lack of consideration in the previous research. To address it, this paper proposes an advanced intelligent solar photovoltaic (PV) micro-inverter control scheme that simultaneously contains Volt-Var control, low voltage ride through (LVRT), and system frequency response. It is worthy to mention that the proposed control demands no additional devices but makes the micro inverter more self-sustaining and reliable. A two-stage single-phase grid-forming PV inverter is simulated with various transient voltage/frequency issues in the MATLAB. The effectiveness of the proposed intelligent control can be verified in the simulation results.

Author Keywords: low voltage ride through smart inverter

articleTitle: A Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition Method Based on Optimal Setting of characteristic Parameters and Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas Insulated Switchgear has been widely used in electrical power system because of its compact structure, small area, maintenance-free, reliable operation and other significant advantages. However, in the manufacture, transportation, installation, maintenance and long-term operation of GIS equipment, internal insulation defects and partial discharge will inevitably occur, and the hazards of different discharge types and corresponding treatment measures are different. In order to realize the effective and accurate diagnosis of the discharge type for UHF partial discharge ,the high-order moments and histogram entropy are proposed based on the traditional waveform features, moment features, typing features, statistical features and wavelet methods. And the support vector machine and BP neural network are used as classifiers for comparative study. The typical discharges such as tip discharge, surface discharge, internal air gap discharge and suspension discharge were simulated on the GIS in the laboratory, and 50 groups of data were collected for analysis. The results show that the recognition accuracy can be improved to 90% by adding higher-order moment and histogram entropy to the statistical operator. Compared with the traditional method, the recognition accuracy is improved by 1.25%. In addition, the combination of vector machine and BP neural network as classifier can effectively improve the accuracy of partial discharge defect recognition. Compared with using SVM and BP as classifiers alone, the recognition accuracy is improved by 8.75% and 10% respectively.

articleTitle: Stockbridge Damper Identification Of Overhead Power Lines Based On HOG Feature And GWO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stockbridge damper identification is of the great significance of the overhead power line inspection. To improve inspection efficiency, this paper proposes an identification method based on Gray Wolf Optimization (GWO), histogram of oriented gradient (HOG) feature and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Firstly, the HOG feature of the data set is extracted as input. GWO is used to optimize parameters c and g. Then, SVM is trained by the optimal parameters to realize the automatic identification of stockbridge damper. Besides, this paper proposes a slide window detection method based on the position of the power line for detection in large scenes. The position is determined by pre-processed methods, and the identification speed is improved. The results show that GWO-SVM can identify the stockbridge damper effectively, and furthermore this method has higher recognition accuracy than the SVM optimized by Grid Search (GS) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).

articleTitle: A cooperative energy trading model for multi-energy microgrid cluster in an active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In active distribution network (ADN), energy trading is beneficial to improve the operational efficiency of a microgrid (MG) cluster. However, multiple energy resources, different power generation capacity of MG, and dynamic electricity price of ADN will lead to the complexity of trading. This paper proposes an energy trading model for this problem and focuses on the efficiency and fairness of the model. A cooperative game based model is designed to maximize the total gains of cluster, and a Shapley value based method is adopted to fairly allocate the cooperative gains among MGs. The simulation results show that the proposed model is efficient and fair to improve both the total gains and individual gains of the MGs, and thus to keep their long-term incentives to participate in trading.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Community Plan from System Arrangement of Renewable Energy Resources and Load Management
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient-utilization planning method for community buildings, which considers supply-side and demand-side factors comprehensively. The method consists of three key aspects. The first is the goal orientation of renewable energy utilization planning boundary condition optimization. The second is community building function optimization based on load leveling, and the third is building morphology optimization based on the energy control. The method is an important reference for community energy planning in China.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy Efficiency Evaluation of Distributed Energy System Model Based on Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the indicators affecting the comprehensive energy efficiency of distributed energy systems deeply and ranks the importance of indicators. Based on the relationship among different indicators, a four-level comprehensive evaluation index system is established with the cascade energy conversion rate, energy saving rate and ripple effect as the first-level indicators. The calculation formulas for the four levels of indicators are given combined with the data collected and synthesized by many documents. The data of five groups of first-level indicators are obtained, and the entropy weight evaluation model is established. The corresponding entropy weight of each level of indicators is solved: the energy conversion rate of the step is 0. 3149, the weight of the energy saving rate is 0. 3452, and the weight of the energy efficiency is 0. 3399; and the comprehensive energy efficiency calculation formula of distributed energy system is given on this basis.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Load Regulation Value for Consumers in the Orderly Power Utilization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In China, the orderly power utilization (OPU) mechanism has become one of the most significant ways to stable the power grid. Under this background, this paper proposes an evaluation model of load regulation value for industrial users managed by the OPU. Firstly, considering the load movable characteristics, including the short-term movability, peak load shifting and sequential rest planning, the index system of OPU load regulation value is established. Then, the user scheduling value is successfully quantified on the basis of the projection pursuit dynamic clustering model (PPDCM). Besides, the matter-element extension theory is introduced to calculate the users' level of load adjustment value. Finally, a case study with six industrial users is included for model variation. It is shown that the regulation value of industry users under OPU is well evaluated by considering various movable characteristics of users' load. The proposed model constructs a theory fundamental for the OPU.

articleTitle: Economic Optimization of Gas-steam Combined Cycle Energy Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas-steam combined cycle can greatly improve energy efficiency when it is used in cogeneration, and its combustion products are pollution-free. Therefore gas-steam combined cycle has been widely used in recent years. In the present paper, the nonlinear mathematical models of different equipment in an energy station are established, including gas turbines, waste heat boilers, steam turbines and gas boilers. Then the objective function and constraints of economic optimization model are proposed. In order to solve the nonlinear optimization model more efficiently, equipment models are linearized. Finally, the commercial solver CPLEX is used to solve the optimization problem. A case study is given based on an real energy station to illustrate the economic operation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Harmonic Interactions Among Current-controlled and Voltage-controlled Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Harmonic resonance often causes high harmonic voltages and currents in power systems with serious damage. This paper investigates harmonic interactions among current-controlled inverters (CCI) and voltage-controlled inverters (VCI). The impedance models of CCI and VCI are studied, based on which the model of the microgrid with a VCI and n-paralleled CCIs is established. And then the harmonic interactions among these inverters are analyzed, where the influences of control parameters on harmonic resonances of inverters are investigated. It shows that resonances derived from interactions among VCI and CCIs will cause harmonic amplifications, and larger proportional gain of controllers of CCIs will make harmonic amplifications more serious, whereas proportional gains of controllers of VCI have dampening effects on harmonic amplifications. The correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by simulations in PSCAD.

articleTitle: Comparison of Transient Angle Stability Between Different Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is a control method that mimics the rotor inertia and damping effect of synchronous generator (SG), which enhances inertia of microgrid in the one hand. However, the inverter using VSG may experience transient angle instability like SGs when the grid voltage dip occurs. In this paper, the angle stability of three VSGs using different control schemes (no inner loops, inner voltage and current loop, current-voltage model of SG) are compared. The reduced models of VSGs using different VSG strategies are developed for transient angle stability analysis. Based on the developed model, the angel stability are compared by using the power-angle curve and equal area criterion (EAC). Several analysis results are concluded and verified by the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Stabilizing the Output Power of Wind Farms by Electric Vehicles Based on Robust Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the randomness and intermittent of wind power, the output power of the wind farms is with large fluctuations. A robust optimization model is proposed to stabilize the wind power output fluctuation by electric vehicles. Based on the requirements of "active power change" in wind power in national standards, the change of wind power output rate is expressed. After that, the robust optimization method is used to deal with the uncertainty of wind power output, and a double-layer optimization model for the coordinated control of wind farm and electric vehicles is established. The upper layer model decision maker is the wind farm, with the objective of maximizing the income of selling electricity of wind farm as the objective function. The lower layer model decision makers are electric vehicle owners, with the objective of minimizing the cost of electric vehicle electricity expenses. In addition, the robust optimization model is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming problem by linear programming dual theorem and KKT optimality condition. Ultimately, the simulation results verify that the electric vehicle is used as a movable energy storage device to stabilize the fluctuation of wind power output, which can effectively reduce the amount of waste wind power and mitigate the impact of wind power output uncertainty on the safe operation of the grid.

articleTitle: Ultimate Wind-Resistant Capacity Assessment of a Transmission Line Tower and a New Decouple Idea
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A reliable and stable transmission circuit is an important part of the Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things (UPIOT) construction. For in-service transmission towers, it is necessary to assess their wind induced responses at the aim of effective optimizing. In this paper, a three towers and two-span wires coupling system was assessed with dynamic time history method to acquire the ultimate wind speed of wind resistant capacity and the failure mode of the target tower. Afterwards, the nonlinear buckling analysis of the target tower was carried out and the static results were compared with those of the dynamic analysis. The comparison shows that the ultimate wind speed obtained by nonlinear buckling analysis is higher than that obtained by dynamic analysis. Although the failure area of the target tower is same but the failure elements acquired by the two analysis methods are different with each other. Finally, a new decouple idea was proposed and its validity is verified by an analysis example. The new idea used virtual stiffness-damping pairs to consider the constraint effect of the transmission wires on the transmission tower, as a supplement of the terminal dynamic tension theory, so as to obtain a more complete decoupling model.

articleTitle: Research on Arrester Interference Compensation Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to effectively compensate for the difference effect caused by the interference between phases of Metal Oxide Arresters (MOA) and reduce the misjudgment events in the actual resistive current measurement, the arrester interference compensation was studied in this paper. Firstly, a three-dimensional model of MOA was established by finite element method in this paper. Next, the potential distribution under the model was compared and analyzed, and the correctness of the model was verified. Then, based on the model, the distribution calculation of coupling capacitance was carried out, and the main capacitance of each phase and the coupling capacitance between phases were calculated. Finally, the simulation calculation models of the coupling current of the resistance valve plates in the adjacent and relative measurement phase were built respectively, and the action forms of the coupling capacitance currents of each layer were compared and analyzed, which provided the basis for eliminating the interference between phases.

articleTitle: Integrated Analysis and Monitoring for Large-scale Wind Farm Connected with Large Capacity Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power in China, large-scale wind power transmission is inevitable. Wind energy is volatile and intermittent, and can not be transported separately over long distances. The bundling of wind power and thermal power has become a research direction of widespread concern. This paper firstly introduces a large-scale wind power plant connected with large capacity thermal power plant in North China, and establishes an equivalent model through PSCAD/EMTDC. Then, for the equivalent model, the risk of sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) is analyzed by using time-domain simulation. The results indicate that the SSO is possible if the wind turbine converter control parameters are unreasonable and the transmission system is connected to a weak AC system, which can increase the oscillation of the thermal generator. Furthermore, a monitoring method of SSO for large-scale wind power connected with large capacity thermal power plant is proposed. The effectiveness of the method is verified by electromagnetic transient simulation.

articleTitle: A New Method of BLDCM Commutation Error Compensation Based on Line Voltage Difference
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large error in position sensorless commutation position detection of brushless DC motor, a compensation strategy based on (90°-α) commutation signal is proposed. Using the line voltage detection method as the feedback amount, the compensation angle β is determined by the PI regulator, so the final delay angle is determined, and finally the purpose of accurate commutation is achieved. The simulation verifies that the method can effectively compensate the rotor position error in real time, and improve the performance of the motor.

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Rise of Solid Insulated Energy Transfer Equipment under Harmonic Actions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Dry-type transformer adopts solid insulation structure, which is widely used in residential areas, basements and other densely populated areas. Compared with oilimmersed transformer, dry-type transformer has a higher security. With the adjustment of power grid structure, a large number of non-linear loads are connected to the power grid. Harmonic pollution has become an important factor affecting the normal operation of power equipment. In this paper, the temperature rise of solid insulated energy transfer equipment under harmonic actions is studied. Firstly, the load losses calculation model of dry-type transformer is established by analyzing the action mechanism of harmonic interference on each component. Secondly, the simulation model of temperature field distribution of dry-type transformer is established. Finally, combined with load loss calculation model and temperature field distribution simulation model, the actual operation of transformer is calculated and analyzed. The results show that the additional temperature rise caused by harmonic losses is mainly concentrated on windings and insulating resins. Moreover, if the dry-type transformer operates under the condition of serious current distortion for a long time, the aging of insulation material will accelerate and the insulation performance of transformer will be reduced.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis and Control Optimization of Distributed Control System of 300 Mvar Dualwater Internal Cooling Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: 300 Mvar synchronous condensers have played an important role in restraining commutation failure and maintaining voltage stability for the UHV converter station. The reliability of the distributed control system of synchronous condensers is analyzed. From the aspects of I/O signal configuration, grounding, power supply, emergency shutdown button setting and network configuration, the difference between distributed control system of synchronous condenser and conventional thermal power unit is compared. The logical configuration of the important auxiliary system of the synchronous condenser is optimized, which improves the operational stability of the synchronous condensers.

articleTitle: The Interface Effect in X-ray Testing of Concentric Multi-layer Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the interface effect is firstly found in X-ray images of compound insulator. In order to eliminate the interface effect, this paper have carried out its related research. Firstly, based on the X-ray attenuation characteristics, a concentric multi-layer material model is established, and the conditions for the interface effect of X-ray penetration of the concentric multilayer material are theoretically analyzed. Then, X-DR (X-ray with Director Digital Panel Radiography) experiments verify the existence of interface effect of X-ray penetration, and the experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis. Finally, the computed tomography (CT) detection technology is adopted to eliminate this interface effect of X-ray penetration in this paper. The experimental results show that the system with CT detection can eliminate the interface effect of X-ray penetration. The system is beneficial for the inspectors to make correct fault detection on the equipment and avoid the consequences of false detection. This study provides an available NDT detection method for concentric multi-layer material structure equipment.

articleTitle: Power Purchasing Decision of Grid Company Considering Power Deviation under Renewable Energy Quota
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Consumption of renewable energy and complexity and difficulty of power purchase decision-making for power grid companies are ensured and increased by the formal implementation of renewables portfolio standards. From the standpoint of grid companies, this paper constructs a multi-type power purchase model of grid companies after the implementation of the renewables portfolio standards. Firstly, the electricity market is classified according to different types of electricity, and the power purchase cost function of different types of electricity is established. Considering the error of load forecasting, a conditional value at risk model for evaluating deviated electricity quantity is established to describe the influence of deviated electricity quantity on power purchase risk. Finally, an example is given to analyze the influence of different quotas in different scenarios on the power purchase decisions of power grid companies, which provides theoretical reference for the actual market transactions of power grid companies.

articleTitle: Study on SVG Reactive Power Compensation Based on Sliding Mode Variable Structure and Internal Model Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the static reactive power generator (SVG) is unstable and the reactive power compensation effect is not obvious when the load is abrupt, a SVG reactive power compensation control method based on sliding mode variable structure internal model control is proposed. The method combines the advantages of sliding mode variable structure control and internal mode control. The sliding mode variable structure control is adopted for the DC side capacitor voltage to ensure the stability of the DC side capacitor voltage during the operation of the SVG. The internal mode control is used to achieve the accurate tracking performance of the signal. The simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control method and have certain engineering practicability.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual Axis Photoelectric Tracking System Based on Four Quadrant Photoelectric Detector
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the energy and the increasingly serious environmental problems, making full use of solar energy has become the trend of development. As an important way of solar energy utilization, the normal operation of solar pumped lasers depends on the ability of the pumping source to accurately track the direction of the sun. However, the existing tracking system has poor stability and low tracking accuracy. In view of the above problems, an embedded two-axis photoelectric tracking system is proposed. The system is proposed based on a unique four-quadrant photoelectric detector, and adopts the control scheme of the solar orbital tracking method combined with the fine tuning of the four-quadrant photoelectric detector, which effectively improves the performance of the system. The precise positioning and tracking ability of the pump source to the solar azimuth ensures the stable operation of the pump source.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Difference Analysis Model for Distribution Network Mesh Planning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important basis for power grid decision-making, power grid planning plays a vital role in the process of power grid development with the increasing scale of China's power grid. Providing decision-making basis for power grid planning, power grid evaluation ensures the optimal allocation of power resources, and promotes the rapid and sound development of power grid. Based on GIS, the grid division of power supply area is realized, and the corresponding equipment is brought into the grid. On this basis, the multidimensional difference analysis between the current power grid and the planning power grid is carried out. In order to analyze and compare the horizontal and vertical differences between the current power grid and the planning power grid, the multi-dimensional difference analysis model between the current power grid and the planning power grid is proposed, In addition, it has guiding significance for the construction and design of each distribution network grid.

articleTitle: Generalized Synthesis Load Model Considering Lithium-Ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the model of lithium-ion battery (LB) was established, and the generalized synthesis load model (GSLM) of power system containing LB was proposed and verified. In GSLM, the model of LB, which can be used in power grid simulation, and an equivalent model of the first-order inertial system of LB energy storage system were established. The proposed model is with highly feasibility, because the structure of the model is simple, and the parameters of the model are few and easier to be identified. The model is able to fit the external characteristics of the energy storage system in the grid effectively in the case of large voltage disturbance. Considering distribution network parameters and reactive power compensation, GSLM consists of the LB load model and the classic load model (CLM). Based on the measurement-based approach, the CLM is the constituted by induction motor and ZIP (constant impedance, constant current and constant power) These two models are connected in parallel with each other. As illustrated in cases, the description and generalization of the model are effective.

articleTitle: Compression algorithm for relay protection equipment data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the relay protection device, the HMI module generally directly drives the display through the CPU plus the liquid crystal driving chip. Due to the harsh EMC in the substation, the actual project found that this method is likely to cause abnormal screen display. To overcome this situation, we install the screen on a dedicated panel and connect to the HMI via the Ethernet port. At this time, the HMI needs to send the LCD dot matrix data to the panel to display. When the original LCD dot matrix data is directly transmitted, the amount of data transmitted is large, occupying a large amount of bandwidth. This paper proposes a FF0 lossless compression algorithm, which is specifically used for compression of such black and white lattice data. After compression by this algorithm, the average data transfer of black and white screens is reduced by 35% in actual engineering applications. In the best case, when using all black or all white screens, the amount of data transferred is only 0.78%.

Author Keywords: black and white dot matrix compression

articleTitle: Strategy and Mechanism of Time and Sampling Synchronization of digital Substation in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, nearly all the new-build substations in China are digital substations with the fully digitalized process level devices, implemented with the conventional ITs and the associated stand-alone merging units. All the related process and bay level devices are connected to the time synchronization network and achieved the sampling synchronization which is essential for the differential relay and etc. The paper firstly introduced the basic principle and architecture of the time synchronization system in digital substation in China. Two master time devices are used simultaneously to track the sources (GPS from USA and Beidou from China),and the redundant maters are synchronized to each other to acquire the higher reliability. The paper then introduces the requirements on time synchronization of the merging unit in China. Analysing the possible pseudo-synchronous caused by the inconsistent synchronization between the merging units, and analysing the hold-over behaviour of the merging unit in case of lost connection with the clock, merging unit with higher hold-over capability is introduced and implemented with the application of OCXO.The mechanism of the adjustment of merging unit during the re-connection is also illustrated, fast adjustment and slow adjustment methods are introduced to eliminate the jitter during the re-connection between the merging unit and the clock. The conclusion is drawn and some suggestions are also made in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis and Countermeasure of Oil Leakage Caused by Cable Terminal Belt Expansion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compared with the cross-linked cable, the oil-filled cable has the advantage of stable and reliable operation, and it also has certain advantages in facilitating to detect the insulation performance of the cable through non-destructive means. However, there may be leakage of insulating oil during the operation of the oil-filled cable, which has become an obstacle to the development and application of oil-filled cables. Recently, during the construction of a 110kV cable line, it was found that the A-phase cable terminal sealing strip and the insulating oil swelled, causing the top sealing strip to crack. This paper will make a detailed introduction about the leakage of cable insulation and then carry out the control experiment analysis of the defective cable insulation accessories after the initial determination of the causes of defects. It is verified through experiments that the incompatibility between the insulating self-adhesive tape and the polyisobutylene insulating oil is the terminal cause of the cable defect. In order to avoid the operation risk of the cable terminal with the same batch of self-adhesive tape, several construction and monitoring measures is proposed to help eliminate potential safety hazards in time and ensure the stable operation of the cable line.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Intelligent Evaluation Method for Power Grid Dispatching and Control Training
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of automatic scoring in power grid accident handling, a comprehensive intelligent evaluation method combining index evaluation and rule evaluation is proposed. Firstly, according to the operating characteristics of the power grid, an evaluation index system with operational safety, grid safety and power supply reliability is established, which realizes the evaluation of operation results and operation quality. Then, based on the operation task, a hierarchical operation step evaluation rule model is established, which realizes the evaluation of the operation process. Finally, the evaluation results of the above two evaluations are comprehensively weighted to achieve a comprehensive intelligent evaluation of the entire assessment process. The practical application shows that the method can achieve automatic scoring of grid operation and accident handling process, and it can better meet the needs of training and assessment of grid operators such as Substation operator and dispatcher.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Economic Dispatch Based on Hierarchical Group Consensus Algorithm in Combined Heat and Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a novel distributed hierarchical group consensus algorithm is proposed to solve the combined heat and power economic dispatch problem (CHPEDP). The whole system is divided into two groups: electricity group and heat group. By information exchange among neighbour units, the incremental cost of electricity and heat reach consensus respectively to minimize the total operation cost. In addition, the hierarchical control strategy is designed to ensure the supply-demand balance effectively. The leader level contains the feedback information of power mismatch and plays a dominant role while the follower level receives information from the leader level and realizes self-adjustment based on the received information. Finally, simulation results verify the proposed algorithm is suitable and efficient to solve the CHPEDP in a distributed manner.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability Analysis of AC/DC System Considering Static Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid construction of UHV AC-DC interconnected power grids, it is increasingly important to ensure the voltage stability of interconnected systems. In this paper, a continuous power flow algorithm for voltage-source converter (VSC) AC-DC system considering static load characteristics is proposed. It establishes an index for evaluating voltage stability based on the load margin and identified the weak region of the system. The effects of load model changes on voltage stability (VS) are analyzed in various scenarios. The relationship between DC control mode and system VS is further considered. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an improved 10-node example.

articleTitle: Dynamic pricing model for direct power purchase by large consumers based on risk factors of transmission network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity price method is a key factor that affects the development of the power market. Existing power transmission and distributed annual costing method cannot reflect the influence of a user on transmission costs when various power stations are selected to purchase electricity across periods. This study proposes a dynamic price model based on a time-space risk factor, which can be used to purchase electricity directly for large users and reflect different risks of environments encountered in power grids. To determine the monthly calculations for a dynamic tariff method, the power transmission and distribution costs are split into two categories. In this study, the dynamic electricity price model is constructed. Thus, users can select low-risk multiple energy consumption months in accordance with customers themselves' characteristics and reduce transmission pressure during the high-risk period of the network. Therefore, the reliability of the power grid can be improved. The proposed method is tested using an example. Results show that the proposed model is effective and practical and can provide a reference for the government's estimation of transmission and distribution prices.

articleTitle: Research of Multi-source Perception and Intelligent Diagnosis Technology of Outdoor Installation Protection Based on Data Syncretism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, summarizing the problems in the operation and maintenance, and based on data syncretism, research which is on the outdoor installation protection of multi-source perception and intelligent diagnosis technology, designs an outdoor installation protection perception and operational maintenance platform that highly integrated protection on-line monitoring and diagnosis, protection information sub-station, power system dynamic recording equipment and network message recording and analysis device as one system, and expounds in detail the system architecture of the platform, software framework, realization principle and key technology. The platform through the multi-source data acquisition, and the data sharing between each module and system integration, implements the outdoor installation protection multi-source perception and intelligent diagnosis, improving the efficiency and convenience of field operation and maintenance work, for outdoor installation protection of the safe and stable operation is of great significance. The platform has been successfully carried out in substation pilot application, achieving good results.

articleTitle: Study on Frequency Emergency Coordination and Optimal Control with Multitype Measures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: System moment of inertia and frequency regulation ability is decreasing with the increasing scale of UHVDC and new energy integration in China. Therefore, the frequency stability of the system is becoming increasingly prominent. The cost of traditional security control measures such as generator tripping and load-shedding is high, the low-cost DC emergency power support, the new energy frequency modulation, load control and other continuous regulation control measures get more attention in daily operation. Aiming at different types of control measures, this paper puts forward a frequency security margin measurement index, which takes multi-type control measures into account. On the premise of ensuring frequency security and stability of power grid, the cost of frequency control after power grid failure can be reduced and the requirement of lean frequency stability control of modern power grid can be met by coordinating the continuous and discrete control measures. Based on the actual planning of UHVDC transmission network, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Multiple Attribute Decision Model for Interval Number Sequence Correlation Analysis of Grid Investment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the analysis of ambiguous and uncertain decision-making problem of power grid investment, the comparison of schemes based on interval number is more accurate in existing methods. However, the interaction of evaluation indexes is neglected. . In this paper, the interaction of indexes was taken into consideration and a new model was proposed to rank the schemes whose evaluation indexes were expressed by interval number. Based on the interval number, the sequence operation theory was used to discretize the evaluation indexes, and obtain a comprehensive evaluation sequence that took the interaction of indexes into consideration. Based on the acquired sequence, the gray correlation degree was used to rank the schemes by calculating the relative closeness between each scheme and ideal solutions. The effectiveness of model was proved in the decision making application of grid investment projects by an example.

articleTitle: Research on the dispatch proportion of battery capacity in photovoltaic primary frequency control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is an inevitable problem of frequency control with the increasing capacity of PV connected into large-scale grid. In order to resolve the problem of the contradiction between the increasing demand and dressing supply capacity of frequency control, the requirement of relevant technical for PV to take part in primary frequency control is put forward. The battery-assisted frequency control system is introduced, and the primary frequency control effect can be improved by using its fast response characteristic. In this paper, the ratio of battery output to all power output is used to analyze the primary frequency control gain of the battery participating in the frequency control of the PV plant. The simulation results show that the larger proportion of energy storage system output can bring better frequency control capacity, reduce frequency fluctuations and improve system stability.

articleTitle: Parameter Sensitivity Analysis of the Combined Cooling Heating and Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Combination of Cooling Heating and Power System (CCHP) system has become an important way of raising the system efficiency by cascade utilization. Aiming at the impacts of the parameter on the CCHP system performance, a parameter sensitivity analysis method is studied. Firstly, the energy flow is analyzed with a typical CCHP system model. Secondly, the evaluation criteria are proposed. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the parameters such as capacity, technology, economy and emission under basic operation modes are ana-lyzed to estimate potential impacts of each parameter. According to the simulation, the proposed method shows the impacts of different parameters on CCHP system performance under different modes to instruct parameter designing.

Author Keywords: Combined cooling heating and power system

articleTitle: Modeling and Characteristics Analysis of Solar Cell-Supercapacitor Device Under Variable Illumination
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Output power of photovoltaic array is directly affected by the illumination intensity. In the actual operation, clouds, trees and other obstructions will form partial shading on the photovoltaic array, resulting in multiple peaks in the power output curve of the photovoltaic array. So this paper provides a solar cell supercapacitor device (SCSD) to reduce the influence of the shadow. First, the paper presents the structural framework of SCSD, and then analyzes the mathematical model and working characteristics of ordinary photovoltaic cells and SCSD under normal and variable illumination. Lastly, it is verified that the SCSD proposed in this paper has stronger shadow adaptation ability than ordinary solar cells, and can solve the problem of multiple peaks of photovoltaic array under shadow based on Matlab simulation.

articleTitle: Wide-Area Protection of AC/DC Distribution Network Based on Fault Degree Correlation Matrix
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of the distributed generations and DC network has aggravated the complexity of fault characteristics of distribution systems, and the traditional protection strategy cannot meet the security and stability requirements of distribution systems under new conditions. In this paper, a centralized backup protection strategy which is suitable for AC/DC hybrid power grid is proposed. The scheme extracts the direction of fault current component of each IED (Intelligent Electronic Device) in the grid and obtains the corresponding fault correlation coefficient based on the fault current value. A matrix that can evaluate the severity of the fault can be obtained by combining the information above, helping the protection strategy to realize fault location and isolation. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify that the protection scheme can effectively adapt to the changes of the operation conditions with high-permeability DGs, being able to identify the fault quickly and accurately, which is of great significance for the secure and reliable operation of AC/DC hybrid system.

articleTitle: Battery Energy Storage Power Station Based Suppression Method for Power System Broadband Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the integration of large-scale wind power/photovoltaic generations, the applying of high-voltage direct current transmission in the power grid and the growth of power electronic interfaced load, the characteristics of power systems tend to become more power-electronized, and the characteristics of power electronic equipment make the system oscillations cover a wider frequency band. To suppress the broadband oscillation becomes a new challenge for the safe and stable operation of the power system. The battery energy storage power station has flexible regulation characteristics, and by optimizing its dynamic characteristics, it can improve the safe and stable operation capability of power systems.
