In this paper, an adaptive control branch which is based on the phase-locking principle is added to the current control loop of the energy converter to optimize the dynamic characteristics of energy storage power station. By optimizing the dynamic characteristics of the energy storage converter, the broadband oscillation in power system can be effective suppressed. Timedomain simulation results of a case system implemented in MATLAB/Simulink validate the correctness of analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Effect of External Insulation Environment on Electric Field Distribution of 500kV Porcelain Bushing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric field distribution in porcelain bushing for 500kV SF6 tank breaker is of great significance for safe and stable operation of breaker. There are many factors affecting the distribution of electric field inside the bushing. From the point of view of safe and stable operation of the equipment, the environmental conditions such as rain and snow contamination outside the bushing are fully taken into account in this paper. The electric field distribution inside the bushing is simulated and analyzed. The highest local electric field which may occur inside the bushing is obtained, compared with the breakdown field strength of SF6 and assess the reliability of bushing insulation structure. The results show that the external environment has little influence on the electric field distribution in the bushing. In the operation of the equipment, the change of the external environment and the overvoltage can hardly make the internal insulation failure.

articleTitle: DC Power Supply Control System Based On Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the paper, in order to solve the problem that the response speed of DC power supply of lead-acid batteries for high-frequency devices is slow. Based on a thorough study of the structure and operation mechanism of DC operating power supply, this paper proposes a new hybrid storage power supply system composed of lithium batteries and super-capacitors instead of lead-acid batteries. The advantages of hybrid storage technology applied in DC operating power supply system are introduced in details. At the same time, the energy optimization management of new DC operating power supply is also discussed. The dynamic power sharing between lithium batteries and super-capacitors is realized. At the same time, the dynamic power limitation method of lithium batteries based on Super-capacitor SOC is adopted to dynamically limit the charging and discharging power of batteries and improve the life of batteries. At the last, the superior performance of the proposed new DC operating power supply is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research and application on the resonance suppression for parallel T-type three-level PCS based on capacitor voltage active dampling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the power level and efficiency, combined with the advantages of T-type three-level converter, a parallel T-type three-level PCS topology is proposed. In order to solve the resonance problem, the system impedance model of LCL filter is established and the mathematical expression is set up. Then, the infulence of the current oscillation is analyzed from the excitation. The relationship between the number of parallel stations and the number and frequency of the resonace points is obtained with the spectrum charts simulated by Matlab. A coordinated control strategy of parallel T-type three-level PCS based on capacitor voltage active dampling is proposed to suppress the resonace of the system. Finally, a 500 kW PCS prototype is developed. The Matlab simulation comparison and the experimental results show the correctness of the theoretical analysis, and the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring and Optimization Method for Power Oscillation Control of Steam Turbine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reasonable setup of valve discharge characteristics function of steam turbine's governing valves is the basis of linear load control for thermal power unit. Power oscillation could occur when undesired nonlinearity of the valve discharge characteristics degrades steam turbine's control performance. Then steam turbine's valve discharge characteristics function should be re-optimized. Currently, optimization for valve discharge characteristics function is based on valve discharge characteristics test. In the paper, an online monitoring and optimization method for valve discharge characteristics is proposed. Without valve discharge characteristics test, the method can also determine valve discharge characteristics and optimize valve discharge characteristics function. Furthermore, the method makes state-monitoring of valve discharge characteristics possible. Through the method, valve discharge characteristics function can be pre-optimized to avoid completely power oscillation caused by nonlinearity of valve discharge characteristics.

articleTitle: Evaluation and management model of distribution network grid planning based on the analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the concept of distribution network grid planning, a model for evaluation and management of distribution network grid planning using analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and Delphi method is proposed. Firstly, the first and the second level evaluation index system are constructed from three dimensions. Secondly, the index weight is determined by combining the curve fitting method, analytic hierarchy process and Delphi method. Finally, the distribution network grid planning is evaluated according to the evaluation model and the management level model. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by evaluating the grid planning of an area.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Transformer Water Mist Fire Extinguishing Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The effective fire-extinguishing on the transformer is of critical significance for the power grid. The current transformer fire extinguishing technologies, including foam spray technique, oil drain nitrogen filling technique and water spray filling the fire-extinguishing technique, will induce the operating transformers to trip once they mis-operate. From the data of previous tests, it is assumed that water mist fire extinguishing technique has better insulation reliability than those referred to above. But the insulating theory related to water mist in long air gap (d>0.2m) has not been figured out. To prove the assumption before, a series of relating experiments were conducted in this paper. Finally, the test result shows that the assumption is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Autonomous Control Technology for Low-Voltage Multi-terminal DC Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The low-voltage multi-terminal DC power distribution system is an important form of distribution network in the future. However, the negative impedance characteristic of devices such as constant power load (CPL) will reduce the stability boundary of the whole system. In this paper, the analytical solution of the stable boundary of the low-voltage multi-terminal DC power distribution system is obtained by using the mixed potential function. Furthermore, an intelligent autonomous control method based on Lyapunov theory is proposed, and the feedback law and trigger time for each terminal are designed. Finally, the proposed method is tested and verified, and the results show that it can maintain the stable DC voltages when the system is subjected to large disturbances, and overstep the power limitation of the stable boundary only by local information.

articleTitle: Dynamic Equivalent Model for Wind Farms with Doubly Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of wind power, the impact of wind farms (WFs) on power systems is growing. In this paper, a dynamic equivalent modeling (DEM) method is proposed for wind farms with doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG), to improve the accuracy of the WF model. First, grouping indicators which can distinguish different operating states of the DFIGs are researched. Second, WF with DFIG is divided into some groups with k-means algorithm. Meanwhile, the parameter calculation method of the equivalent model is given. Finally, the DEM method proposed in this paper is verified by comparing the simulation results of single-machine equivalent model (SEM) and detailed model (DM).

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Distribution Network Considering Multiple Source Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The deep integration of living production, intelligent public service and electric power in today’s society makes higher demands on the safety and reliability of the distribution network. This paper presents a fault diagnosis method for distribution network considering multiple information sources. It can take advantages of timing information and logic characteristics at the time of failure. Also, it can better reflect the intrinsic relationship between the information of the measuring device, the protection and the circuit breaker. Finally, it comprehensively utilizes information measuring protective relay, circuit breaker, Feeder Terminal Units (FTU) and other available sources. The chained logic makes use of these information as a result and the status of the primary equipment in the fault circumstance as the cause. Then, the maximum likelihood function is employed to determine the best inference chain, and the accurate diagnosis result is obtained. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified by information collected from industry filed.

articleTitle: Application of Physical ID in Asset Management of Secondary Equipment in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of physical ID in asset management of secondary equipment in power grid is studied in this paper. Firstly, this paper analyzes the background and significance of the construction of unified identity (ID) coding for physical assets of power grid. Then, the business logic of physical ID in the whole process management of power grid assets, constructs the logical flow of physical ID through the whole business are systematically analyzed. Moreover, the idea of data traceability in the construction of physical ID of stock power grid equipment, as well as the positive and reverse traceability schemes are put forward. Lastly, this paper presents the basic framework and specific methods of data traceability, and shows the results of data traceability.

articleTitle: A High-efficiency air-cooling and waste heat utilization system for 100Mvar STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-power STATCOM has been widely used in the power grid, and its rating can reach 100 MVA. Owing to the switching loss and conduction loss caused by the inherent characteristics of the power device, it generates MW-class heat during operation. Currently, these heats are discharged into the air by air-cooling or water-cooling. This will not only bring thermal pollution to the environment, but also result in high operation cost of high the cooling system. To solve the problem, a high-efficiency air-cooling and waste heat utilization system for STATCOM is proposed in this paper. It consists of high-efficiency heat pipe radiator, closed circulation air duct, heat pump unit, and waste heat recovery unit, etc. Based on a heat pump unit, it gets a closed-loop air-cooling heat dissipation for the valves of STATCOM, meanwhile recycles the waste heat from STATCOM to produce sanitary hot water around 60°C. Then, it provide this hot water to external hot water users. The program is practically applied in 500kV Chuanshan substation, and the field test confirms its feasibility.

articleTitle: Intelligent community stratification optimization scheduling strategy based on demand-responsive energy cells
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the energy Internet, research on regional energy management is of great significance. Focusing on this topic, this paper proposes a model of demand-responsive(DR)energy cells, and establishes a hierarchical optimization scheduling model. The upper layer takes the total cost of the smart community as the objective function, and the lower layer, considering the DR management, takes the lowest comprehensive cost of each energy cells as the objective function. This study is aimed at presenting a two-layer optimization model for the smart community based on the DR energy cell. In this paper, the optimization strategy of maximizing economic benefits is obtained through the iteration of the upper and lower models. The model can improve the economics of the smart community.

articleTitle: Dormitory Non-intrusive Load Identification Algorithm Based on Penalty Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load identification technology can provide household electricity data for power companies without installing indoor measuring equipment, and its modification design is more acceptable to users. A non-intrusive load identification algorithm which is specifically designed for dormitory electrical equipment has not yet been proposed. An identification algorithm based on penalty function is proposed in this paper. First, the working characteristic indicators of electrical equipment is selected. Next, whether the current signal is in a steady state is judged. If it is, a matrix equation for multiple power equipment which is working in the system at the same time is established. Then the least norm generalized squares solution is used to judge the working condition of the electrical equipment in the dormitory. Finally, a large number is introduced into the penalty function to improve the accuracy of identification. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has good recognition accuracy and stability, and can be applied in the dormitory electricity environment.

articleTitle: A VMD-based Parameter Identification Method for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The study of mathematical models and parameters of synchronous machines is of great significance to machine design, operation and control. To identify the transient parameters of the permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM), variational mode decomposition (VMD) is introduced in this paper. Meanwhile, utilizing the ability of VMD to divide the signal's frequency band, the effective separation of each harmonic mode in the short-circuit current of the PMSM is realized. Therefore, combined with the characteristics of different harmonic components in the short-circuit current, the exponential function curve fitting of the fundamental frequency and the double-frequency component envelope decomposed by VMD is performed. What's more, the transient parameters, such as sub-transient reactance and time constant, are obtained. All in all, comparing the original short-circuit current waveform and the waveform obtained by the identification parameters, the high degree of coincidence proves the validity and feasibility of the identification method.

articleTitle: Space distance intelligent perception device based on stereoscopic visual recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation of power construction and maintenance is dangerous. Every year, there are personal injury and death, line power failure and equipment damage accidents due to power construction maintenance accident and wrong operation, which causes great losses. The device described in this paper can automatically identify the vehicles and personnel targets of the power construction maintenance site, and based on the two-eye stereo vision detection technology, and it can achieve the timely monitoring and tracking of the safe distance of the crane in the process of moving around the scene. So as to avoid safety accidents caused by the failure to alarm in time, this device can realize the sense connection, and can be deployed in large numbers, forming a power construction maintenance operation sense terminal under the power Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Charging Load Modeling of Large-scale Electric Vehicles in a Wider Time Scale
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Ignored by existing charging load models of electric vehicles, the multi-day spaced charging mode can improve the utilization rate of on-board batteries of electric vehicles, and it conforms to the actual charging habits of users. Based on the assumption that the daily travel mileage of a single user is a constant, the electric vehicle users are classified according to the daily travel mileage, and the calculation method of the expected charging load of each user at a specified time is proposed in this paper. Therefore, based on the law of large numbers and the principle of superposition, the charging load model of all user clusters charged within a specified working day and the total load level of each working day in a week are constructed.

articleTitle: Robust Optimization for Power Consumption Strategy of Commercial building Considering Uncertainty of Environmental Factors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy and techniques of smart grid, a robust optimization model for electricity consumption of commercial buildings is established considering distributed photovoltaic units. In the modeling process, the models of distributed photovoltaic units, the energy storage system, the air conditioning energy consumption and the lighting system energy consumption are analyzed first. Then, considering the uncertain factors such as outdoor temperature, illumination intensity and the operating cost of an energy storage system, the minimum energy consumption cost of commercial buildings is taken as the objective function. The robustness index method is utilized to deal with the uncertainty factors, and then the robust optimization model is formulated for commercial buildings with distributed photovoltaic units. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed robust optimization model is verified by numerical simulation using CPLEX. The result shows that users of commercial building set different weight coefficients or comprehensive robustness indexes, leading to different electricity consumption optimization schemes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parameter Imbalance Influence on DC Voltage of SVG Type DC De-icer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The SVG type DC de-icer has the functions of DC ice-melting and reactive power compensation. In winter, DC ice-melting can be applied to the ice-covered transmission line. In the remaining time, the internal SVG component can realize the reactive power compensation function. DC-side voltage stability is the key factor for reliable operation of the SVG type DC de-icer in reactive power compensation mode. However, due to the imbalance of the loop parameters, the DC-side voltage will fluctuate to different degrees. In severe cases, the device will be out of operation due to DC under-voltage. In this paper, the causes and development process of the DC-side voltage fluctuation of SVG type DC de-icer under the condition of unbalanced loop parameters are analyzed theoretically. And the simulation studies on DC-side voltage fluctuations are carried out by PSCAD. The results show that when the SVG three-phase loop resistance is unbalanced, the active power balance of the SVG and the power grid is destroyed, causing a serious deviation of the SVG DC-side voltage, eventually leading to the device exiting operation.

articleTitle: Wideband Frequency Harmonic Resonance Analysis and Suppression Method of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distributed capacitances of the high-voltage transmission lines are easily coupled with the inductive components in the power grid to generate harmonic resonances, which amplifies the voltage and current harmonics and reduces the power quality of the power grid. Taking a 220kV substation system in Guangxi as an example, this paper analyzes the mechanism of harmonic resonance of power grid by establishing grid impedance equivalent model and singular value analysis method firstly. Then a harmonic suppression method based on SiC MOSFET is proposed. Correctness of the theoretical analysis of harmonic resonance and effectiveness of the harmonic suppression method are verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Frequency response enhance control method based on two-step MPC for VSG
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology is ideal for inverter friendly access to the power grid. With the large-scale connection of grid-connected inverters to the grid, the frequency response of the power system has attracted more and more attention in recent years. In this paper, a two-step predictive control method based on model predictive control (MPC) is proposed, which can accurately predict the data of the next two sampling moments. The frequency response and dynamic mechanism of the system are studied by establishing a micro-grid system with VSG grid-connected inverter. In this method, the current system frequency is sampled to establish the reference frequency trajectory of VSG and realizes the accurate tracking of system frequency. Compared with traditional predictive control, two-step predictive control method can effectively reduce the adverse effects caused by system feedback error or external interference. Simulation results demonstrate that the frequency response of the proposed method has good dynamic characteristics, which verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the presented method.

articleTitle: Peak Load Regulation Method Considering Wind Power Accommodation Based on Source-load Coordination
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When large-scale wind energy is integrated to the power grid, the demand of system reserve capacity will rise, but the equivalent inertia of the system will decrease, which brings great pressure to the peak load regulation of the power system. In this paper, interactive load as a schedulable resource is integrated into the traditional day-ahead scheduling of the system. The scheduling method of source-load coordination is used to inhibit the random and intermittent output characteristics of wind power. A solution of unit commitment and interactive load switching is conducted by using Gurobi Optimizer. The results show that the scheduling method of source-load coordination is beneficial to the utilization of large-scale wind energy.

articleTitle: Estimation of Grid Operating State Based on Mixed Data from Multiple Information Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the upgrading of power grid measurement devices and the increase of various types of non-electrical data, the large data of power grid can’t be fully and effectively utilized. It is impossible to describe the operation state of power grid more accurately by physical modeling based solely on electrical data. Therefore, through the analysis and utilization of electrical data and non-electrical data, this paper uses the information physical fusion model constructed by multi-information sources to replace the traditional electrical model. The improved in formation physics fusion model realizes more comprehensive and accurate monitoring and estimation of power grid operation state. The example in this paper realizes the monitoring of the operation state of the power grid through the parameter fusion model of transformer and transmission line, and identifies the small operation faults of the power grid. Besides, the dynamic parameters derived from the fusion model are used to estimate the operation state, and the overall estimation of power grid with missing measurements is realized.

articleTitle: Research on Substation Intelligent Diagnosis Technology Based on Secondary Cable Circuit Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because of the lack of secondary cable circuit model, the information model of the intelligent substation is incomplete. It is not only unfavorable to the comprehensive on-line monitoring and operational diagnosis in the elligent substation, but also hindered the information development of intelligent substation. In this paper, for the secondary cable circuits, a modeling method is proposed. At the same time, the configuration process is designed. Through the secondary cable circuit model file and visualization tools, the multidimensional visualization of the secondary cable circuit of intelligent substation is carried out. The secondary cable circuit information model is associated by mapping the information model with the communication model in the SCD file to the secondary cable circuit model. Based on this, the online monitoring and intelligent diagnosis of the secondary cable circuit can be achieved in the intelligent substation.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology Based Decentralized Energy Trading for Multiple-Microgrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the emerging technology for distributed generation and urge of improving quality of service of power supply for energy users, more and more Microgrids (MGs) are integrated into the distributed networks to serve the energy users. These Microgrids are gradually formulating a Multi-Microgrid System (MMGS, Multi-Microgrid System), which will play an important role for the future energy supply. Building a centralized control center not only increases the expense of investment, but also brings the issues of maintaining fairness among energy users. To address these problems, this paper proposes a peer-to-peer method for energy trading of MMGS, based on the idea of decentralized trading. An auction-based trading mechanism suitable for peer-to-peer energy trading is proposed first. For this mechanism, the MGs firstly declare their energy buying bids or selling quotations. Then, the market-clearing price is determined by using a unified weight clearing algorithm in a decentralized manner. By applying the edge technology of Blockchain, the implementation of the proposed peer-to-peer energy trading method, including the architecture, procedures, security check, etc., is also discussed. The proposed Blockchain-based energy trading platform can realize the decentralized and autonomous energy trading of MGs within an MMGS. A case study with an MMGS with 10 MG units is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Blade Inspection Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) Visual Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is known that blade failures can cause expensive repairs for long down time. Therefore, wind turbine blade inspection for wind turbines can decrease both cost and cost-uncertainty for wind farm operators. In this paper, a Beidou satellite navigation method, a UAV autonomous visual navigation algorithm and image processing methods are presented to autonomously detect blade failures of wind turbines. An experimental platform is described, which is established to explore the feasibility of the proposed detecting method of blade failures. MATLAB results of using image processing techniques are also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal Power-Gas Flow of Integrated Electricity and Natural Gas System: A Sequential MISOCP Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to their environmental and economic benefits, interdependencies between power and gas systems have been enhanced. However, they provide new challenges in the optimal power-gas flow (OPGF) problem, especially at distribution-level. This paper proposes a sequential mixed-integer second-order cone programming (S-MISOCP) algorithm to define the OPGF for integrated electricity and gas system. The nonconvex power flow and gas flow equations are decomposed as difference-of-convex functions which are reformulated as MISOCP constraints. Starting with an initial point, a sequence of penalized MISOCP problems are solved to find a feasible OPGF close to, if not equal to, the optimal one. The feasibility and quick convergence are guaranteed by designing an adaptive penalty growth rate and suggesting a high-quality initial point, respectively. Moreover, bidirectional gas flow inside pipelines is considered to incorporate meshed gas networks. Numerical simulations have been conducted to validate the algorithm performance.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Health Indicators of Li-ion Battery for Online State of Health Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have been widely used in various applications, especially in electric vehicles and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Reliable and accurate estimation of battery online state of health (SOH) becomes increasingly important. To realize this task, a variety of approaches have been proposed and several review papers have been addressed to summarize and classify these approaches. To the best of our knowledge, all current works concentrate on classifying estimation methods while no work has been done to review the health indicators (HIs) that are used for estimation. Classifying the HIs by how they are extracted, however, is of great importance because each HI is only effective in specific application situations. This paper, therefore, is to comprehensively review the existing HIs and make a classification based on how they are extracted and where they can be effectively used.

articleTitle: Research on Terminal Security Technology of Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things Based on PUF and SM3
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Many constrained devices of Internet of Things (IoT) are operating under low power, and with limited computational and network resources. The devices cannot use standard security protocols to protect end-to-end security because they become the weakness of IoT. Narrow Band Internet of Things (NB-IoT) is of broad application prospects in production management, life-cycle asset management and smart power utilization of smart grid. Its characteristics and security demands of application domain present a challenge for the security of electric power business. In order to improve the high security of power network data transmission, a security encryption method for ubiquitous power Internet of things terminal based on physical unclonable function (PUF) and state secret algorithm SM3 is proposed in this paper. A self-controllable NB-IoT application layer security architecture is designed by introducing the domestic cryptographic algorithm SM3, extending the existing key derivation structure of LTE, and combining the physical unclonable function to ensure the generation of encryption keys between NB-IoT terminals and power grid business platforms. The developed IoT security transmission module is applied in the intelligent inspection robot of substation to realize transparent and encrypted transmission of video and thermal sensing data. The scheme of this paper realizes secure data transmission and bidirectional identity authentication between IoT devices and terminals. Experimental results validate its features, including lightweight, low communication costs and flexible key update.

articleTitle: Decentralized identity authentication and key management scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SM9 is an identity-based cryptography and constitutes an important part of Chinese commercial cryptography system. It can avoid the complicated PKI system certificate management problems and provides new solution for IoT (Internet of Things) security applications. But SM9 needs the trusted third party KGC (Key Generator Center) to generate and manage the key for the user. So, key update is very troublesome. In order to solve the problem of SM9 key update, this paper proposes a decentralized identity authentication and key management scheme using block chain technology. In the scenario, the user only needs the IGC (Identity Generator Center) to generate its identifier and the key for the first time. Then, the user can automatically update the key. In the process, identifier remains the same as public key and only the private key and parameters update, so it is quite convenient for identity authentication. This paper redefines data structure of the transaction and each key update process is recorded in the chain blocks in the form of transaction. The block chain can guarantee the security and reliability of key update process since it can't be tampered with. The research in this paper is quite valuable for the identity authentication and key management in decentralized IoT application scenarios.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on Bayesian Optimized LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In case of dealing with large-scale and high dimension data samples, one of the key challenges for the artificial intelligence (AI) based transient stability assessment, is to guarantee the offline training speed and quickly determine the optimal parameters of the adopted algorithm. To cope with this issue, a transient stability assessment method based on Bayesian optimized Light GBM is proposed in this paper. This approach uses gradient-based one side sampling (GOSS), histogram algorithm and leaf-wise with depth restrictions to accelerate the model training process, during that the optimal parameters are quickly determined leveraging the Bayesian optimization. To ease the model complexity, the importance of the input data’s features is explicitly determined during the process of generating the decision tree. Combined with the correlation analysis, the relationship between the input data and the transient stability of considered contingency sets can be excavated more intuitively to select the necessary features. Test results on the New England 39-bus system show that the proposed approach has higher accuracy and speed, as well as a higher recognition rate for unstable samples compared with other machine learning based methods.

articleTitle: A Review on Virtual Power Plants Interactive Resource Characteristics and Scheduling Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a high penetration of distributed energy resources (DER) connected to the power grid, the reliability and safety of the power grid compromised by the uncertainty of energy output. Many utilities adopted strategies to abandon excessive wind and solar energy generation to ensure reliable operations of the power grid. The virtual power plant (VPP) is a way of aggregating various types of energy resources and optimizing resources utilization. It participates in the electricity market and improves the utilization of energy resources within the VPP. VPP provides services such as peak shaving, frequency regulation, and emergency power support for the power grid. It intends to prevent the negative impact caused by the uncertainty of power generation of the distributed energy resources. In this paper, three kinds of typical VPP interactive resource are introduced, which differ in characteristics, control modes, and output characteristics. In addition, the VPP achieves improved energy efficiency through rational optimized resource allocation and optimized scheduling, including internal and external scheduling optimization.

articleTitle: Energy Internet System Research Based on Development Trend of Urban Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the large-scale industry-based economy and the constant acceleration of the urbanization process, issues of coordinated development among economy, energy and environment in the urban development process have been standing out increasingly. The ultimate solution is to speed up the construction of urban energy internet. This paper firstly sets up the relation of urban development and urban energy system through the improved LEAP model. Then it analyzes the interaction of above two aspects. By combing the index system of urban development and urban energy system, this paper further proposes a correlation analysis model for urban development and energy development so as to predict the trend of development of clean, low-carbon, electrified and highly efficient energy in cities. Meanwhile, the paper also puts forward to the key indexes which is representing urban development and energy development in different dimensions. Finally, based on the development tendency of urban energy system, it indicates the connotation, composition and Framework of urban energy internet.

articleTitle: Multi-level non-intrusive load identification based on k-NN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), which is an important part of intelligent power system, has great research significance. In this paper, a two-layer classification method based on k-nearest neighbor(k-NN) algorithm for nonintrusive load identification and disaggregation is proposed. The active power and reactive power of the load are taken as the load characteristics identified in the first layer, and then the third and fifth harmonics of the current are taken as the load characteristics identified in the second layer. By k-NN algorithm, the load to be disaggregated is compared with the data in the training set to realize the identification and disaggregation of the load.

articleTitle: Role of Power Electronics in Primary Frequency Control and Power Quality in an Industrial Micro-grid Considering V2G Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Over the most recent two decades, developing utilization of sustainable and dispersed vitality sources has made fresh difficulties in power framework for the utility in regards to the voltage regulation, frequency regulation power quality and effective vitality use. Power electronic gadgets (inverters /Converters) are broadly used to interface the developing vitality frameworks (without and with vitality stockpiling, for example, Batteries and EVs) in distribution frameworks. A useful case of such a three phase, an industrial micro-grid tied power converters framework would be quick charging stations for electric vehicles. In this research article, it has been noticed that the EVs outfitted with the ability of a vehicle to grid (V2G) technology, propose various constraints like essential recurrence control dynamic power guideline, primary frequency control, load stabilizing, purification of harmonic distortions in current wave form and active power regulation etcetera. Also, this exploration paper builds up a way to deal with improve the power quality dependent on dead time (DT) pay strategy for power converters in a modern smaller scale matrix. For example, torque pulsation, harmonic distortion and sinusoidal load current decreases. Additionally, control converters assume a significant job in refine the power quality, energy usage, upgrading the power factor, and guaranteeing productive energy use and vitality the executives in a modern industrial micro-grid with renewable power source.

articleTitle: Two-stage optimal dispatching based on wind-photovoltaic - pumped storage-thermal power combined power generation system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power output of wind farm and photovoltaic power station possess randomness, interval and volatility, causes influence for power generation planning and scheduling when they are connected to the power grid at a large scale. So, a two-stage optimal dispatching strategy is given for wind- photovoltaic -pumped storage-thermal power combined power generation system. By pumping characteristics of pumped-storage, transfer the power output of the wind farm and photovoltaic power station to the pumped storage plant to hold water during the peak load period, the joint power output of wind- photovoltaic -pumped storage can be converted into a stable schedulable power supply with peaking shaving, which makes it participates in the optimal scheduling with thermal power units. The paper establishes the two-stage optimal scheduling model, one is wind-solar- pumped storage combined schedule and cutting peak model of aiming at the fluctuation minimum of generalized load and the power output maximum of wind-photovoltaic-pumped storage, the other is the economic dispatch model of aiming at the operating costs at the minimum of thermal power units, then, separately using mixed integer programming method and unit commitment optimization to solve it. Taking the 10-machine test system as an example, by analyzing the simulation outcomes the follow conclusion can be obtained: The dispatching strategy can improve the utilization rate of wind energy and solar energy, And relieve the peak pressure of thermal power units, significantly reducing the anti-peaking characteristics of wind power. Thereby, the strategy can also ensure the power system to be safe, stable and economical operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Bidding Strategy for Electricity Sales Company Considering Contract for Difference and Risk
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the existence of contract for difference (CFD) in the electricity market, the market rules require all the entities of the market to participate in spot market bidding. This study develops a step-wise planning model to determine the bidding curves on day-ahead market for electricity sales companies. Due to the deviation between the actual electricity consumption and the bidding amount in the day-ahead market, both punishment of electricity deviation and risk are taken into account, and the relationship between them is weighed by different coefficients. Because the competitor's bidding curve is unknown, and it is assumed that their bidding coefficients obey the normal probability distribution, then a stochastic optimization method based on Monte Carlo simulation is developed. A numerical example serves to illustrate the impacts of different factors on the electricity sales companies' profit expectation and variance. The results show that electricity sales companies can benefit from optimizing the coefficients of each factor in different market environments.

articleTitle: A Security Model of SCADA System Based on Attack Tree
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, attacks against SCADA systems have emerged in endlessly. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the security issues of SCADA systems. Although many scholars have studied the security of SCADA systems, their research tends to focus on one aspect of security analysis or security protection design, lacking the organic combination of the two. Therefore, this paper proposes a security model of SCADA system based on attack tree—BPATSM, which contains two modules: security analysis model and security protection scheme. For the security analysis of SCADA systems, there are a lot of methods. Attack trees are a common method for security analysis. However, the traditional attack tree model can only analyze the structure of the attack, but cannot analyze the characteristics of the attack, nor it can analyze the bias of the attack that has occurred and predicted the possibility of the attack that will occurred, so its analysis efficiency is not high. Therefore, this paper proposes a preference attack tree (PAT) model based on the attack tree model, that is, adding the attributes of the number of attacks on the nodes of the attack tree to represent the preference, which can improve the efficiency of attack tree model analysis. Based on PAT analysis, this paper also proposes a security protection scheme for SCADA system, which can switch three levels of security protection according to different protect requirements. Finally, the BPATSM model is implemented in a semi-simulation system and tested its security.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization of Resident Load Based on Cloud-edge-terminal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a collaborative optimization method based on cloud edge terminal, and establishes a residential edge load coordination optimization technology architecture based on cloud edge terminal, and designs a load collaborative optimization algorithm based on cloud edge terminal. The architecture includes a power and demand interaction platform (cloud), a home smart energy gateway (edge) and a range of smart home appliances and energy storage devices (terminals). The results show that the proposed method has a good optimization effect on energy economy and stability.

articleTitle: Single Algorithm Mpso Depend Solar And Wind Mppt Control And Integrated With Fuzzy Controller For Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A specific technique in this paper is fuzzy logic controller and modifies PSO integrated with Fuzzy controller depend advanced algorithm for solar and wind power Maximum Power Point Tracking and integration with the power grid. The aim of this technique is to Achieve MPP at very early stage and maintain that MPP. In this technique we also focus on the reduction of Total Harmonic Distortion and improve the system stability. The whole design has five major blocks which are photovoltaic module, MPPT module, DC-AC converter, utility grid and potential source converter. To accomplish this role, the study evaluates the background of PV and wind-systems and also their integration with the grid. The basic goal is to maximize the utilization of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) for matching the load demand by selection of optimal configurations of proposed work. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is utilized for efficiently regulate the pulse width of the controlled signal of the boost converter for maintaining the potential level of DC bus at exclusive value. Load on demand at all times, the output of solar and wind energy is integrated suitably. In this work, modified Fuzzy-PSO depend control technique of the MPPT has been discussed under different conditions. This proposed method lowers the steady state oscillation (to practically zero), after the maximum power point (MPP) is located. The modified particle swarm optimization depends on MPPT for PV and wind system is accessible which is interconnected with other control schemes for example synchronization with current control and grid. The MPP alters with changing in solar irradiation and temperature. It also changes with the change in the wind Speed. Subsequently, a detailed literature review is conducted to highlight on various technologies that are used in the integration of hybrid-systems to the grid. The technologies discussed include: isolated technologies, incremental conductance and Perturb and Observe (P&O), MPPT algorithms. Finally, the literature review elaborates on aspects of the fuzzy-logic MPPT algorithm and how it handles variations in potentials, current and power from Hybrid-systems that are integrated with the grid. The methodology section shows the system configuration along with the results. For the powerful integration, a phase locked loop (PLL) block is used for providing output phase signal same as input. In fuzzy logic controller, the error signal of potentials and currents are controlled by adding the input signal of `E' and `CE' which is actually the error rate added to the controller based on fuzzy logic. A model which is proposed also validated in MATLAB/SIMULINK by using different modules.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Source-load-energy storage Coordination Dispatch Model with Highly Penetrated Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power, the randomness, volatility and uncertainty of its output increases the regulation pressure of conventional units. Based on the prediction error characteristics of wind power at different time scales, combined with the advantages of transferable load optimization load curve and the flexible power regulation ability of energy storage, a multi-time scale source-load-energy storage coordination dispatch model is established. In this model, transferable load, battery energy storage, and conventional units are combined for modeling, and the transferable load scheduling cost, the energy storage life loss cost, the unit output plan change penalty cost and the wind power consumption benefit are comprehensively considered to realize efficient use of resources. According to the different operation characteristics of source-load-energy storage, the transferable load is used for shaving the peak and filling the valley in the day-ahead scheduling, and the battery energy storage is used for compensating the prediction error in the intra-day rolling scheduling. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified based on a ten-machine system.

articleTitle: A Review of the Application of Locational Marginal Price Theory in The New Situation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Locational marginal price (LMP) is a method to measure the price of electricity. It reflects the space-time economy of electricity, and in the meantime, it is one of the means to deal with congestion management in the power market. This paper describes LMP from three aspects. Firstly, the basic model and solution method of LMP are sorted out; secondly, the main factors affecting LMP are analyzed; thirdly, the settlement model of LMP is summarized in three electricity markets from the time scale: day-ahead, real-time and afterwards. With the development and application of a high proportion of renewable energy, energy storage system (ESS) and energy Internet, the LMP model and algorithm are facing new challenges. On the basis of sorting out the latest research and application results, the current key problems faced by LMP research field are summarized in this paper.

articleTitle: High-risk Problem of Penetration Testing of Power Grid Rainstorm Disaster Artificial Intelligence Prediction System and Its Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: System penetration testing is an important measure of discovering information system security issues. This paper summarizes and analyzes the high-risk problems found in the penetration testing of the artificial storm prediction system for power grid storm disasters from four aspects: application security, middleware security, host security and network security. In particular, in order to overcome the blindness of PGRDAIPS current SQL injection penetration test, this paper proposes a SQL blind bug based on improved second-order fragmentation reorganization. By modeling the SQL injection attack behavior and comparing the SQL injection vulnerability test in PGRDAIPS, this method can effectively reduce the blindness of SQL injection penetration test and improve its accuracy. With the prevalence of ubiquitous power internet of things, the electric power information system security defense work has to be taken seriously. This paper can not only guide the design, development and maintenance of disaster prediction information systems, but also provide security for the Energy Internet disaster safety and power meteorological service technology support.

articleTitle: A Framework for Assessing the Inertia Distribution of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In a modern power system with high penetration of renewable generation, the system inertia decreases dramatically and will show nonnegligible spatial-temporal distribution characteristics. In this paper, we propose an integrated framework for assessing and revealing the spatial-temporal distribution characteristics of the inertia, i.e., the overall inertia level at each time period and the spatial distribution of the inertia within the system. This framework incorporates two novel metrics, i.e., rate of change of inertia (RoCoI) and the improved inertia distribution index (IDI), for quantitative evaluation of the system inertia. The RoCoI index is derived from the generation scheduling tool, while the IDI is calculated based on the frequency data measured by PMUs. Case studies on the IEEE RTS-96 system demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, and indicate the time-varying as well as locational impacts of inertia distribution on the system's frequency response.

articleTitle: The Quantitative Assessment Method for Flexibility Adjustment of Self-supplied Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to explore and promote the ability of self-supplied power plant to inteact with the power grid, this paper proposes a quantitative assessment method for the flexibility adjustment of self-provided power plants on the premise of considering energy efficiency and environmental protection. According to the power consumption of transferable load in each process, the production process of the enterprise to which the self-supplied power plant belongs is classified into multiple operating modes, and each mode corresponds to a source-load conversion matrix for characterizing the power flow relationship. Under the premise of considering energy efficiency and environmental protection, the adjustable load permeability and energy consumption function are used to construct a characteristic function describing each operating mode, so each mode tends to switch to a high-permeability and low-energy consumption operating mode. Furthermore, the state transition matrix is formed by solving the switching probability of the operating mode through the softmax algorithm. Taking the lowest cost of electricity as the goal, the optimal operating mode switching process is selected according to the state transition matrix. The flexibility evaluation index called integrated climbing rate in the switching process is solved by source-load conversion matrix, and the index changes in the same time scale are compared to conduct a flexibility assessment. The simulations done in Matlab verify that the flexibility assessment method based on state transition matrix can effectively explore the adjustment potential of multi-type self-supplied power plants.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization Configuration of Wind Farm Energy Storage System Based on Life Cycle Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind farms have large fluctuations in grid connection, imbalance between supply and demand, etc. In order to solve the above problems, this paper studies the capacity optimization configuration of wind farm energy storage system based on full life cycle economic analysis. Firstly, the optimization model of energy storage capacity is established in this paper for computing wind farms require minimal storage capacity for load shifting, reducing peak and valley fluctuation; considering the loss cost of wind discarded, the fixed costs of energy storage device and equipment maintenance, the cost of the battery is analyzed in the whole life cycle by the point of view of economics; multi-objective optimization of the minimized ratio of peak-valley fluctuations around peak load shifting volatility and maximized economic benefits, by the global particle swarm algorithm for getting the optimal solution, the system capacity optimization control scheme is proposed. By analyzing the actual data, it is proved that the rational capacity allocation of the energy storage system can effectively reduce the ratio of peak-valley fluctuations around peak load shifting volatility, improve the economic benefit of the wind power plant, and improve the economic benefits of wind power plant storage.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Measurement Tampering Detection Considering Spatial-Temporal Correlations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyber-attackers could stealthily interfere with the normal operation of power systems by maliciously tampering the measurements transmitted from field devices to control centers. Although some data-driven methods capable of identifying abnormal measurements have been proposed, there are some remaining shortcomings such as low accuracy and slow convergence rate. This paper devises a novel framework by combining convolutional neural networks (CNN) and long-short-term memory (LSTM) networks for detecting tampering attacks based on recognizing spatial-temporal correlations between measurements. Besides, optimization such as the attention mechanism, Dropout layers and SVM are applied to improve the performance of the proposed framework. This paper also introduces how to implement the proposed framework in practical cyber-physical systems and expounds the synergistic relationships between the data-driven detector and the traditional bad data detection module. Case studies prove that the proposed framework has better learning performance than existing ones.

articleTitle: Optimal planning and sizing of BESS for wind energy ramp rate control through DES initiated large data clustering and PSO technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents optimal sizing and planning of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) through Dynamic Exponential Smoothing (DES) initiated Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique for wind energy ramp rate control. In a power system with high proportion of variable wind energy generation, power producers participate in a bid should meet the standards set by grid owners and/or transmission system operators, one of which is ramp rate limit. A onetime sizing and planning of BESS for ramp rate control requires analysis of long period recorded data. Application of dynamic smoothing process together with large data clustering technique and PSO based optimization algorithm is applied for the sizing of BESS to limit the ramp rate of Zhangjiakou wind power plant in China. Results indicate that the BESS improves the RR characteristics of the wind farm. Besides, the joint DES initiated clustering and PSO based optimization significantly reduced the computation time compared to the time required if only PSO is used.

articleTitle: Impact of Charging Station Operator (CSO) on V2G Method for Primary Frequency Control (PFC) in an Industrial Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) due to their portentous capabilities like fast regulating capabilities are providing regulation of primary frequency services. However, contribution of electric vehicles (EVs) in primary frequency control (PFC), come up with challenges like simultaneously achieving the industrial microgrid operator dispatch and the estimated EVs batteries of state of charge (SOC) levels. As a solution to this issue, we recommend operative and dominating role of charging station operator (CSO) and control scheme of vehicle to grid, in which an indeterminate task is executed in the industrial microgrid operator (IMGO) without meticulous electric vehicles (EVs) charging/discharging statistics. The charging station operator (CSO) regulation can be attained by assigning the regulation job within the primary frequency regulation capability of electric vehicles (EVs). The anticipated SOC amount of electric vehicles (EVs) are assured by the real time rectification of their programmed/planned vehicles to grid power. Our previous research was based on decentralized vehicle-to-grid (V2G) control methods for EVs to participate in primary frequency control. In this research article, a strategy has been formulated for bringing a lot of EVs fleets into the centralized system for primary frequency control (PFC) in an industrial microgrid (IMG).

articleTitle: Research and Application of FTU Distribution Network Automation Security Protection Scheme Based on Embedded Security Chip
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In power system, information transmission pays more attention to security, stability and reliability. In order to meet the requirement of safety protection of smart grid automation control, a safety protection scheme of distribution automation based on FTU is proposed. Without changing the current operation of distribution terminals, the characteristics of distribution automation system are provided, such as wide range of points, wide distribution and outdoor operation. And due to industrial-level hardware design encryption chip, secure operating system , SM1, SM2, SM3, SM4 national secret algorithm and PKI system (public key infrastructure) are adopted. Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) power digital dispatch certificate uses digital certificate authentication technology and encryption technology based on domestic commercial cryptographic algorithm. Its aim is to realize bidirectional identity authentication between distribution master station and distribution terminal. In the future distribution network business, hardware definition platform, software definition products, management and business separation are the development trend, distribution terminals support plug and play, and great challenges are faced by information security The implementation of the security protection scheme is of great significance to system security, which can effectively prevent hackers from malicious attacks on distribution network equipment and ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of distribution network data.

articleTitle: Policy Analysis and Recommendation for Self-Supply Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Self-supply power stations in China have been built and developed under a specific historical and institutional background, with relevant policies constantly evolving. At present, the supply-side structural reform, the new round of reforms in power market, and renewable energy have put forward new demands for the development of self-supply power stations. Firstly, this paper analyzes the evolution process of the policies on self-supply power stations, and then, it analyzes the charging policy, supervision policy and clean development policy of the self-supply power stations in details. Secondly, due to the local differences in the development of self-supply power stations, the policies on self-supply power stations in typical provinces are analyzed. Finally, on the basis of historical and existing policy analysis and according to the needs of the new situation, the recommendations on future policies are proposed from two aspects: the design of the self-supply power station supervision and management mechanism and the contents of self-supply power station supervision and management.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Load Flow Calculation Method Based on Polynomial Normal Transformation and Extended Latin hypercube
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of distributed photo-voltaic access distribution networks, the probabilistic power flow calculation method that combines the strong correlation of multi-dimensional photovoltaic output and the improvement of computational efficiency is of great significance for the power quality assessment of high-ratio renewable energy power systems. In view of the low fitting accuracy of the assumed PV output obeying the Beta distribution in photovoltaic power generation, this paper uses the cubic spline function to reconstruct the PV output, uses the polynomial normal trans-formation technique to process the correlation of the PV output, and uses the slice sampling algorithm to generate the initial sample. Applying the extended Latin hypercube sampling to slice sampling techniques, the proposed method in this paper effectively reduces the error caused by traditional Latin hypercube sampling and improves the computational efficiency. The IEEE-34 standard node system is used as an example to simulate in Matlab. The results verify the validity and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Many-to-many Energy Trading Decision Based on Intelligent Contract and Auction Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the multi-to-multiple energy trading mode and quotation strategy based on Block-chain intelligent contract and continuous auction mechanism. When distributed power generation entities and power consumers exist in Many-to-many form, buyers and sellers can be in the trading cycle at any time. The quotation is submitted to the smart contract address, and the quotation is continuously adjusted according to the transaction result disclosed by the smart contract. Once the price is matched, the transaction can be completed, and the transaction settlement is realized through the Block-chain intelligent contract. The IEEE13 node power distribution system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Forecasting with Evolutionary Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is essential for economic dispatching and secure operation of power system with large-scale wind power integrated. The traditional prediction model performs poorly on the feature extraction of high dimensional non-linear wind power data, hence, a prediction model based on evolutionary deep-learning feature extraction which is used to improve the wind power forecasting accuracy was proposed in this paper. Using the global optimization characteristics of evolutionary algorithms, the deep-learning optimization reconstruction error function constructed a feature extraction prediction model with good performance, and reduced the hidden layer structure. The real-world data collected from a wind farm in Liaoning Province was applied to verify the conclusions. Results show that the proposed method outperform BP neural network, support vector machine and DBN with respect to forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Summary of Energy Storage Systems and Renewable Energy Participation in AGC Research
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the scarcity of fossil energy, the development of renewable energy is becoming more and more rapid. However, when new energy is integrated into the power grid, the inertia of the system is reduced and the stability of the system is lowered. This also poses a new challenge to frequency control, and energy storage as a technology that can quickly respond to system frequency changes is now widely concerned. This paper summarizes the domestic and international research status of energy storage and AGG capacity allocation and coordinated control through the influence of renewable energy on AGC. Finally, the development prospects of energy storage and participation in new energy integration into the power grid are prospected.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Control and Evaluation of Various Power Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Frequency control is one of concerning issues for interconnected power grid. In accordance with new demand of frequency control under UHV transmission system, the frequency control thought, which is combined with the five level dispatching management model of "Unified Dispatch, Hierarchical Management" in China power grid, is divided based on the dimensions of disturbance severity. The performance evaluation method of disturbance control is suitable to integral frequency control under high-power loss fault as well as the three level scheduling schemes for state grid. Regional grid and provincial grid are designed on the basis of in-depth analysis of North America reliability standard set. The simulation results show that the frequency control performance evaluation method of interconnected power grid oriented to various power disturbances is with better effectivity than the North American disturbance control method, which can effectively improve the anti-disturbance capability of the system.

articleTitle: Optimal Grid-Connected Storage Planning in Distribution Network Integrated with Renewable Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As uncertain renewable distributed generations (DG) challenge conventional distribution network operation and planning, the application of energy storage system (ESS) is becoming popular nowadays. In this paper, optimal planning for grid-connected ESS in distribution networks is presented. The optimal planning determines the location and capacity of ESS while minimizing the total cost of distribution network. A chance-constrained problem is formulated to represent the uncertainties result from DG fluctuations and load fluctuations in distribution networks. The optimal long-term planning is based on a short-term optimal power flow process considering uncertainties in practical systems. A hybrid particle swarm optimization-Tabu search (PSO-TS) algorithm is used to solve the problem. Probabilistic load flow calculation based on maximum entropy method is used in short-term planning to check the chance constraints satisfactions. Also, islanding mode analysis considering ESS and DGs is developed to evaluate the reliability cost from failure events. A numerical study of IEEE case 33 shows the advantages of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Operation of Generalized Demand Response and Multi-Energy Storage for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the energy internet, the technologies of multi-energy storage (MES) and generalized demand response (GDR) have been widely applied, which make a great contribution to meet development needs of modern power systems. In order to analyze the effect of adequate cooperation style between GDR and MES, a joint optimal operation strategy of GDR-MES is proposed in integrated electricity-gas system (IEGS) in this paper. According to the actual operation characteristics of MES equipment and GDR implementation in the IEGS, GDR models based on energy prices and MES models including battery stations and gas storage tanks are respectively established to maximize operation benefits of IEGS operators. The validity of the presented model is verified by an example of regional IEGS operators, and the results show that the joint optimal operation strategy of GDR-MES can increase the benefits of IEGS operators and create a better energy-consumption fashion for the whole system.

articleTitle: The Comparative Study of Instantaneous Power Theory in Three-Phase Three-Wire Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to investigate the compensation features of switching compensator in three-phase three-wire systems as instantaneous real oscillating power, which is defined in p-q theory as the compensation goal. This compensation goal should be paid special attention when involving torque oscillation or frequency variation in week systems. The relationship between compensator current and the original supply current is highlighted by employing Current’s Physical Components (CPC) power theory as the analytic tool. This paper demonstrates that in three-phase three-wire systems, there are numerous kinds of compensator currents to reach this compensation goal, including the compensator current derived from p-q theory or CPC theory. The former uses the minimum size of energy storage elements than any other kinds of current. While the latter improves the quality of the load by reducing its unbalanced current and harmonics.

articleTitle: Development and Tests of a 220 kV Novel Composite Insulator with Lightning Protection and Icing Flashover Prevention
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Metal-oxide surge arresters and anti-icing insulators are widely used in transmission lines to prevent lightning and icing flashover, respectively. However, these two technologies have the disadvantage of single function, and sometimes surge arresters could be difficult to install because of their structural size mismatch with the tower cross arms. In this study, a 220 kV novel composite insulator with lightning protection and icing flashover prevention (CI/LP&IFP) is developed. By experimental research, the air gap distance between grading rings are obtained, the specification and number of zinc oxide (ZnO) varistors, the creepage distance and the sheds configuration of the 220 kV CI/LP&IFP are designed. Lighting and switching impulse discharge characteristics, and icing flashover characteristics are studied using experimental methods to validate the lightning protection and icing prevention performance. Test results indicate that, the designed air gap distance of 880±10 mm can ensure that the 220 kV CI/LP&IFP is discharged under a lightning over-voltage of more than 900 kV and would not be discharged under switching and power frequency overvoltages. When the icing thickness is 12.8 mm, the icing flashover voltage gradient of the 220 kV CI/LP&IFP is 14.57% more than that of the 220 kV conventional composite insulators. Results in this study can give help to the flashover performances improvement of transmission lines in heavy lightning and icing regions.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Key Technology of New Generation Multi-MCUs Smart Meter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to the growing contradiction between the growing demand for grid business and the backwardness of smart meter functions, the International Organization for Legal Metrology (OIML) has redefined the International Recommendation IR46 for electric power meter. In this context, multi-MCUs smart meter design and key technology are researched. Firstly, from the business scenario, business application and business model, the application requirements of smart meter in the new situation are systematically analyzed. On this basis, the function design and hardware design of multi-MCUs smart meter are carried out. Aiming at the key technology of hardware design, the hardware architecture adopts loosely coupled modular structure, including four modules: metering MCU, management MCU, identification MCU and negative control MCU; based on the measurement SOC, the data sampling promotion technology such as high-frequency sampling and self-checking are analyzed; the multi-mode heterogeneous communication technology is analyzed for the application requirements of ubiquitous Federation of things (UFO). In view of the key technologies of software development, the lightweight embedded operating system is analyzed in detail, and two advanced application technologies of non-intrusive load identification technology and ordered charging technology are introduced, and a unified information interaction model is constructed. Finally, the development of smart meter prototype is developed, and the performance and function of multi-MCUs smart meter are tested based on the experimental environment.

articleTitle: Design of Energy Acquisition System for Overhead Ground Wire of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The on-line monitoring device installed on the transmission line tower runs instability due to lack reliable power supply, and there is a continuous source of inductive power in the overhead ground wire. The ground wire energy acquisition device can effectively solve these problems. In this paper, a multi-level combined lightning protection strategy for ground-based energy acquisition system is proposed. A wide input and high-stability DC/DC voltage regulator control circuit are designed. The isolation transformer of the energy acquisition system is also designed. The overhead ground line energy acquisition system is developed, and the dual ground line energy acquisition test platform is built. The energy acquisition test is also conducted.
