Test results demonstrate that the device meets the design requirements and verifies the feasibility of the energy acquisition for overhead ground wire.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Electricity Plans for Active Demand Response of Power Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power demand response is an effective method to deal with the problems of continuous increasing of the peakvalley difference, grid connection of the large-scale intermittent renewable energy, and the transition of energy structure. Under the background, a novel type of DR program referred to as the electricity plans is proposed, and the design of electricity plans is optimized. The electricity plans are established by the power companies and targeted at motivating changes in electrical use by customers. A utility function of customers is developed, taking account of the customers’ satisfaction with the electricity bills and energy consumption patterns. Accordingly, a decision-making model for customers to choose among electricity plans is proposed based on the multinomial logic model. Then, the energy consumption behavior of customers in response to the selected electricity plan is analyzed and compared with the original consumption patterns. On this basis, the optimization model for the design of the electricity plans is proposed to minimize the peak-valley difference of the power system. Simulation results show that the optimized electricity plans have significant benefits in improving the load curve and inducing the demand side to participate in load management actively.

articleTitle: Real-Time Simulation Modeling Study of the HVDC Circuit Breaker Based on Nodal Dynamic Equation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage-sourced converter based high voltage direct current system is expected to play a vital role in the future power transmission system. As one of the key equipment to ensure safe and reliable operation of the VSC-HVDC systems, HVDC circuit breakers play a critical role in establishing DC grids, improving grid operation flexibility and enhancing power supply reliability. In order to save the computational resources and accurately simulate the characteristics of each part of the circuit breaker during the fault isolation process, with the help of nodal dynamic equation and the transmission line decouple modeling method, this paper proposes a simplified equivalent modeling method for the DC circuit breaker and establishes a hybrid DC circuit breaker model in Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) to realize real-time simulation. By using the method proposed in this paper to conduct DC breaker real-time simulation, there is no need to implement any kind of delay compensation algorithm, which simplifies the DC breaker modeling studies and makes this method become easy to implement. Detailed comparisons have been made between this FPGA model and the detaild DC circuit breaker model in PSCAD. Results show a good match between these two models, which verify the proposed DC breaker model and the solving method, which is based on the nodal dynamic equation.

articleTitle: Stabilizing Frequency of Microgrid Integrated With Electric Vehicles by Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Emergence of Microgrid (MG) has changed the structure of power system. On one hand, it opened opportunities to integrate renewable energy sources in islanding mode; on the other hand, the power and frequency have become the main hurdles during its islanding operation. In this paper, the droop control technique is used to counter the effect of frequency fluctuation at MG. Wind energy and Photovoltaics are the two renewable energy sources (RES) studied in work. Diesel generator is used to cater the frequency deviations due to intermittent nature of these RES. Microgrid Operator (MGO) is used as a centralized controller to look after all generating units and loads. The MGO sends a reference signal based upon the frequency deviation, which is calculated by the droop controller. This reference signal is sent to all generating units as well Electric Vehicles Operator (EVsO). All the generators and EVsO respond to that reference signal and adjust their generating power accordingly. Electric Vehicles (EV), operated by EVsO, remains in continuous contact with the MGO through communication link. In this work, a centralized approach for the operation of EVsO is employed. There are two main tasks of the EVsO. One is to calculate the cumulative power of all the EVs connected with the MG, by calculating their initial state of charge; and another is, to change the charging and discharging rate of EVs by stratifying the energy needs of both MG and EVs.

articleTitle: The Portable DC De-icer with Emergency Power Supply Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network has many branch lines, and usually pass through micro-topography and micro-meteorology areas. In winter, it is easy to collapse the tower and break the line due to over-icing, which affects the reliability of power supply. The large-capacity DC de-icer of the 220kV and above main network is limited by road transportation and power acquisition, which is difficult to effectively cope with ice disaster of distribution network. Manual de-icing is the main anti-ice method for distribution network, with low efficiency and high risk. This paper develops a portable DC de-icer with emergency power supply function for distribution network, and the key parameters of the device are designed and simulation model is established. The simulation results are consistent with the actual output. The device is small and light. And it can realize the rapid ice-melting of distribution network lines within 400m, significantly improving the anti-ice level capability level and ensuring the reliability of power supply. The device also has the function of 3kW power frequency emergency power supply, which solves the problem of low utilization rate and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Single-ended Protection Scheme for Multi-terminal VSC-based DC Distribution System Based on the Transient energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Limited by the system architecture, line length and cost, the protection principle of traditional AC distribution systems and HVDC transmission systems cannot be directly applied to multi-terminal flexible DC distribution systems. This paper proposes a new method for line protection of multiterminal flexible DC distribution systems. Based on the boundary characteristics of the current limiting reactor installed on the line, the transient current energy difference between the fault in the protected area and outside the protected area is extracted to realize the fault identification. In order to avoid mal-operation of the non-faulty pole caused by overvoltage during unipolar grounding fault, the faulty current is firstly decoupled by phase-to-mode matrix and the decoupled 1 mode current parameters is used to calculate the transient energy. A fault direction criterion is constructed to avoid the impact of reverse faults on protection. The proposed scheme can identify faults quickly without communication, which can satisfy the speed, reliability and selectivity requirements of the DC distribution system. Simulation cases are carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment Planning of Distribution Network Considering Customers’ Reliability Requirements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, with the comprehensive promotion of distribution network construction, the demand of reliability for electricity is getting higher and higher. Therefore, the investment planning model for distribution network, which focuses on the overall load growth within the region, is not applicable. In this paper, a distribution network planning model that considering different customers’ reliability requirements is proposed. Firstly, the fuzzy binary contrast strategy is adopted to quantify the reliability requirements of different customers in the region. The neural network is used to mine the correlation model between reliability indices of the different power supply requirements and corresponding reconstruction measures. Then, the optimal model of distribution network planning with the target of reliability indices and the constraint of investment cost is established. As a result, the proposed model fully meets the reliability requirements of customers and forms the optimal investment planning scheme of the distribution network. Finally, the results of the IEEE 33 test system verify the rationality and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Approach to Identifying Behind-The-Meter Wind Power: A Case Study in Northern Ireland
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more electricity users install private renewable energy generators on the demand side, electricity demand changes into the difference between load and generation. The specific variation of generation and load cannot be directly obtained via prosumer meters, which challenges economic dispatch, emergency recovery, forecasting accuracy, etc. To address the data deficiency, this paper proposed an approach for separating out load and wind power generation from the user demand data. Specifically, separation processes firstly utilize discrete wavelet transform to decompose signals into several representative scales. Then, the operating capacity of wind turbines can be solved by matching the demand variation on a wavelet scale where disturbances like random behaviors and weather interaction are reduced. Consequently, generation data can be constructed by wind turbine models with capacity parameter and weather information. In Northern Ireland cases, behind-the-meter wind power is successfully separated out from user demand. The separated data of load and wind power better present the network status. Utilizing the data in demand forecasting, the forecasting errors of three general methods was effectively decreased by an average of 18.78%.

articleTitle: Review of Micro-grid Site Selection and Operation Mode Considering Economic Applicability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The economic benefit of the microgrid is an important factor for its large-scale popularization. Reasonable site selection, suitable control strategy and operation mode are the key means to achieve economic operation. At present, the research on the economic operation mode of micro-grid at home and abroad is still insufficient, and commercial operation of the microgrid is still very few. This paper analyzes the location of the microgrid, the scene selection and its independent economic operation mode and the operation mode of the multi-microgrid, and points out that the appropriate operation mode and control strategy should be selected according to the corresponding scenario. At the same time, it is proposed that the interconnection of microgrid groups and the rational allocation of energy and economic operation should be considered.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation of Active Distribution Network Considering Customers' Reliability Requirements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of distributed energy and the increased flexibility of active distribution networks (ADN), the interactive operation of ADNs has been widely concerned. Moreover, in some economically developed regions, the demand for customer diversification and personalized power consumption is increasing, which puts new requirements on the operation of active power distribution networks. In this paper, based on the coordinated multi-agents of active distribution network, fuzzy decision theory is adapted to implement the coordinated optimization operation of ADNs, and achieves the cascade utilization of adjustable resources by considering distinct power supply requirements of customers. The ADN agent will interact with actively assigned network participants based on the system's real-time unbalanced power to reduce power imbalances in ADN operations. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively realize the optimal operation of ADN under the premise of satisfying the power supply requirements of customers.

articleTitle: A Consensus-based Distributed Environmental-Economic Multi-objective Dispatch Strategy for Combined Heat and Power Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the view of the non-flexibility of the conventional centralized optimization algorithms, in this text, a consensus-based distributed algorithm is adopted to solve the environmental-economic scheduling problems for the combined heat and power (CHP) generation systems. The relationship between fuel consumption and pollution emissions of a generation unit is modeled using the equivalence performance coefficient of heat supply to characterize the equivalent conversion between heat and power. The environmental-economic multi-objective optimal dispatch model is established for the CHP systems. To realize the optimization dispatch problem of CHP systems in a distributed way, the consensus-based distributed algorithm is adopted to solve the multi-objective optimal dispatch model. The simulation and analysis of the cases are used to verify the feasibility of the strategy for the environmental-economic dispatch of CHP systems.

articleTitle: MRIO modelling of small-scale trigeneration systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-regional input- output modelling method for small-scale trigeneration systems. Compared with other methods, a total quantity array which is used in this paper rather than an input array, has two advantages. Firstly, it is an elegant format with modular assembling convenience. Secondly, it is innate from thermodynamics with coefficients well physically interpreted.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Oscillation Pattern Recognition Based on Wavelet Packet and SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional low-frequency oscillation mode identification methods have complex calculation processes and poor real-time performance, which make it difficult to meet the computational requirements of pattern classification of low-frequency oscillation in complex power system. Based on wavelet packet and support vector machine (SVM), a more simple and convenient method of identification and classification is proposed in this paper. The low-frequency oscillation signal is selected as the research object, and the wavelet packet decomposition of the signal in different modes is used to extract the energy eigenvector samples in this method. To achieve low-frequency oscillation mode identification classification, the principal component analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the energy eigenvectors and construct the SVM pattern recognition classifier. The simulation results show that this method can realize the classification of low-frequency oscillation modes in power system more quickly and accurately. The method proposed in this paper has good application prospects.

articleTitle: Interpretation of Stability Assessment Machine Learning Models Based on Shapley Value
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Machine learning is a promising method to solve the stability assessment problems of modern complex power systems. The interpretability of machine learning models is fundamental for trusting the prediction and deploying the models on engineering application. In this paper, a model-agnostic interpretation method for machine learning power system stability assessment models is proposed based on Shapley value. Shapley values represent the contribution of each state variable to the stability evaluation result. By constructing kernel function and simplifying the form of training data, Shapley values are efficiently calculated based on the weighted linear regression. The resulting additive feature contribution model can be used to explain the internal logic of the prediction and verify the credibility of the model. The experiment results on voltage margin estimation model in the New England 39-bus system demonstrate the correctness and comprehensibility of the interpretations generated by the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Design of The Passive Micro Sensor for SF6 Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming to explore the passive micro sensor for SF6 detection, the proposed method is about designation and structure of SF6 detection micro sensor with high signal-to-noise ratio, miniaturization and passivity. Advanced micro-machining technology is presented to sharply reduce the volume of the sensor, where the volume can be reduced by more than 50% compared with the existing sensor with discrete combination. The cost and volume reduction does not only make the new detection equipment possible, but the energy consumption of the whole system will also be greatly reduced. The application and promotion of the passive micro sensor in ring network cabinet, GIS, GIL and cable channel can bring considerable economic benefits.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Protection of Distribution Automation System Based on Hybrid Encryption Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A dual protection scheme is designed to realize the bidirectional identity authentication and business data encryption between distribution master station and terminal. An once two-way password authentication protocol based on the symmetric SM4 and asymmetric SM2 encryption algorithm and message authentication code(MAC)combination is proposed. This protocol can resist malicious illegal attacks, prevent the distribution network system from being maliciously destroyed and paralyzed. The integrity and confidentiality of the data in distribution network automation system is ensured.

articleTitle: A numerical analysis of power consumption differences between planning and operation stages using mutual information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building energy system that includes renewable energy is often considered as an effective method of saving energy and reducing emission. However, the energy consumption of the building energy system during the operational stage usually deviates from the expectation of the planning stage. The deviation causes the energy system to fail to play its role in energy conservation and emission reduction. Due to the intermittent and volatility of renewable energy optimization of supply side and demand side matching are often considered an effective way to reduce system energy consumption. This paper uses mutual information as a quantitative indicator to analyze the fluctuation of the energy consumption difference between the planning stage and operation stage. Firstly, a building energy system containing renewable energy and its control strategy is constructed as a planning model. Then, generated uniform distribution errors are used to simulate the mismatch of power consumption of supply and demand in the simulation control phase. Moreover, the mutual information is used for analysis. The final results show that as the mutual information increasing the deviation of the power consumption data in the planning and operation phases will be significantly reduced and tend to be planned value.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of Gas-steam Combined Cycle Energy Station Base on Nash Negotiation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The gas and steam combined cycle uses natural gas and realizes the supply of cold, heat and power based on the principle of energy cascade utilization. It has the advantages of high energy efficiency and less pollutant emission, so its application scale is extending. In this paper, the mathematical models of equipment in the energy station, which consists of gas and steam combined cycle, are established. Then the objective function and constraint conditions for multi-objective optimization considering economic and environmental benefits are proposed. The Nash negotiation method is used to find the solution to this multi-objective optimization problem on the Pareto frontier. Since the device models are properly linearized, each sub-problem on the Pareto front becomes a MILP problem, which can be solved by commercial solvers. Finally, a case study based on an actual energy station is carried out and the results of single-objective optimization and multi-objective optimization are compared to illustrate the Pareto effectiveness of the Nash Bargain solution.

articleTitle: PM10 Concentration Forecasting Based on CEEMDAN, SE and LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the predicting accuracy of PM10 concentration prediction, this paper presents a combined prediction model of PM10 concentration based on complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN), sample entropy (SE) and long short-term memory (LSTM). The PM10 concentration time series is decomposed into a series of restructured subsequences with obvious complexity differences by CEEMDAN-SE firstly. Then, by adding meteorological parameters to each different restrictured subsequence, the LSTM prediction model is built. By adding the prediction results, the final results are got. Meanwhile, the data of four monitoring stations in Tangshan city is used to implement simulation experiment. Experiment results confirm that the proposed prediction model compares with other prediction models to show high prediction precision, and good universality.

articleTitle: Dispatch strategies of distributed tri-generation system in the context of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Over the last few decades, tri-generation systems are playing roles of rising importance across the world. However, due to the complexities of different energy carriers and uncertainties in the residential energy consumption, it has been challenging to match heating, cooling, and electric demand and supply in the temporal dimension and efficiency. These mismatches typically cause wasted heat or electric energy. Considering the recent advances in the communication and information technologies as well as electric energy storage technologies, which enable demand response in the residential sector, a new of a residential distributed tri-generation system is proposed in the present study. In the current version of the design, heat and electric energy storage are incorporated. Four schemes along with multi-energy dispatch strategies to enable the design in the context of energy internet are proposed and compared vis-à-vis based on a case study of a university campus in Hangzhou, China. The schemes are evaluated in terms of the wasted heat and electric energy in four typical months, including one in summer and another one in winter.

articleTitle: Study on the Mechanical Performance of Anti-thunder Composite Insulator for Distribution Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the anti-thunder composite insulator combining surge arrester and insulator are developed. The analysis of mechanical performance of the anti-thunder composite insulator is carried out, which shows that the overall mechanical strength needs to be greater than 2.38 kN. A 3D finite model is built up to simulate the behavior of the anti-thunder composite insulator in the distribution line. The simulation results indicate that the stress on the varistor and the core rod decreases with the increase of the size of the core rod. The core rod of 20 mm or more can meet the operation requirements. The simulation indicates that the stress of the varistor determines the force limit of the anti-thunder composite insulator. Therefore, it should pay attention to the performance stability of the varistor of anti-thunder composite insulator under the force.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Reconfiguration Method Based on the Representative Daily Load Curve
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a quarterly reconfiguring method, which can address the impact of multiple switching actions on the operation of distribution network. Firstly, according to the characteristics of seasonal fluctuation of power loads, the K-means clustering algorithm is used to extract representative load scenarios for each quarter. Then, aiming at the minimum the comprehensive cost including the cost of distribution network losses and the compensation cost of flexible load, the mathematical model of quarterly distribution network reconfiguration is established. Finally, the validity of the proposed reconfiguration model is tested on the IEEE 33 node system.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Load Imbalance on Current Carrying Capacity of Power Transmission Equipment in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution network undertakes the important task of safe and stable transmission of electric energy to users. Among them, distribution transformer is the indispensable main equipment. However, with the vigorous development of industry and commerce, a large number of non-uniform random loads are connected to the power grid, thus bringing the three-phase unbalance in distribution network. The increase of additional loss and hot spot temperature of transformer are caused by three-phase unbalance. High winding hot spot temperature can accelerate the thermal aging speed of insulating materials and reduce insulation performance, thereby reduce transformer output and load capacity. In this paper, the influence of three-phase unbalance on load carrying capacity of distribution transformer is studied. The relationship between relative load factor and hot spot temperature is established under normal periodic load, long term emergency load and short term emergency load. The results show that three-phase unbalance has a great direct impact on transformer load capacity.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimization method of reactive power of synchronous condenser considering transient constraint
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC commutation failure is an important issue especially for multi-infeed DC receiving-network in China. Numbers of synchronous condensers in converter stations have been allocated to reduce commutation failure. This paper discusses the possibility of synchronous condenser operating on steady state firstly, and then researches the control aim of steady and transient states of reactive power output of synchronous condenser. It is proposed that the coordinated optimization method of reactive power configuration considering transient reactive power support constraint, and the coordination with AC filters in DC converter stations is also considered. The effectiveness of the method in this paper is verified based on the real grid simulation.

articleTitle: Capacities Optimizing of Region-Level Integrated Energy Systems Based on Random Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Whether energy equipment can be fully utilized in the integrated energy system and how to improve the utilization rate of energy equipment is one of the issues to be considered in the planning stage of the integrated energy system. In this paper, the annual utilization hours of equipment is used as an indicator to measure the utilization rate of equipment life cycle. A long-term scale planning method for regional integrated energy system is proposed, which establishes random models of annual utilization hours of wind turbines, photovoltaics, annual demand for cooling, heating and electricity due to their uncertainty. The planning model aims to minimize the annualized cost containing investment cost and operation cost of system. Then, an improved enhanced firework algorithm based Monte Carlo simulation method is adopted to solve the proposed planning model. Finally, the optimized results show that the proposed model based on long time scale is effective in solving the capacity allocation problem of regional integrated energy system.

articleTitle: A Real Time Monitoring Method for Single-line Break Fault Based on Dual-terminal Information of Distribution Network With Fault Tolerant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the complex structure and the changeable operation mode, the distribution network frequently suffers from various types of damage (such as line break faults). Among them, the single-line break fault feature is not obvious, and the conventional detection method is difficult to monitor effectively and low reliability. In order to solve this problem, a real time monitoring method for single-line break fault based on dual-terminal information of distribution network is proposed in this paper. By monitoring the relevant voltage and current signals on the power supply side and the load side in real time, and extracting the single-line break fault feature information, a real-time monitoring of single-line break fault is realized. It can greatly improve the recognition accuracy of single-line break fault. The simulation analysis was carried out in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the analysis results show that the method is not affected by the distribution line parameters and the mode of operation, and common faults can be accurately identified and distinguished. The identification process is accurate and fast, meets the real-time monitoring requirements for distribution network single-line break fault, and has certain value for engineering applications.

articleTitle: A Construction Method of Power Grid Abnormal State KPI Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the requirement of displaying power grid abnormal state in power system operation cockpit (POC), this paper proposes a construction method of power grid abnormal state KPI base on AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process). In this method, the 7 indicators and their sub-indicators which affect the grid abnormal state are layered and quantified. Moreover, all of the indicators are calculated. Experiments show that according to quantified indicators and real-time health status, the results calculated can objectively reflect the abnormal state of the grid operation. Through these result data which are sent to POC in real-time, the dispatcher can know the latest situation of grid abnormal comprehensively and objectively.

articleTitle: Electricity consumption patterns analysis using a shape-based clustering method based on seasonal decomposition and parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is a significant difference in the electricity consumption patterns of different users. Recognizing and extracting the electricity consumption patterns can help analyze the user behaviors and support the market decision-makings. Clustering algorithms have proven to be an effective technique to identify the load patterns. In this work, we propose a shape-based clustering method based on seasonal decomposition and parallel computing to identify the electricity consumption patterns in Changsha residential areas. The seasonal decomposition is first used to extract the representative curve which serves as the inputs of the clustering. A shape-based clustering algorithm, which better considers the shape characteristics of load curves and requires less computational cost, is introduced to partition the load data into different groups with different electricity consumption patterns. In addition, the parallel computing is employed to further accelerate the computing time. The experimental results demonstrate that our method can identify different electricity consumption patterns effectively. Moreover, our method surpasses the traditional DTW-based and fuzzy clustering algorithm and is 30 times faster than the DTW-based clustering algorithm. At last, we analyze the electricity consumption patterns in the Chinese Spring Festival in Changsha residential area that further validate the efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Low Harmonic DC Ice Melting Device Capable of Reactive Power Compensation with SVG
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The transmission line' ice melting device is widely used in the field of power grid ice melting due to its advantages of high ice melting efficiency and small power supply capacity. However, reactive power needs to be consumed during DC ice melting. When the demand for reactive power capacity is large, the voltage fluctuation of substation may be caused, which affects the reliability of power supply. In addition, a large number of 5th and 7th harmonics will be generated during ice melting rectification, and a large filtering device needs to be installed. In this paper, a low harmonic DC ice melting device which can compensate reactive power simultaneously is studied. The ice melting and reactive power compensation function can operate at the same time to meet the dynamic reactive power demand of ice melting. At the same time, the main and sub harmonics injected into the grid by the ice melting rectifier are eliminated. The experimental and simulation research on the device are carried out which is installed in the 500 kV Chuanshan substation. The actual ice -melting is carried out on the 500 kV Chuansu I line which takes only 68 minutes to melt the ice. The results prove the feasibility of the proposed DC ice-melting device in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on Off-design Characteristics of Energy Hub
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy hub has been widely used in modeling of multi-energy system and energy Internet since it is put forward, and the general model of energy hub is developed and improved in this paper. The existing energy hub model used in previous studies is established based on the steady-state operation model of the energy conversion equipment, which only considers the factors of energy distribution and conversion efficiency in energy hub, but does not consider the off-design properties of energy conversion equipment. Therefore, this paper studies the off-design characteristics of gas turbine and heat recovery steam generator in the cogeneration energy hub, and brings the off-design characteristics of equipment into the energy hub model, so as to obtain off-design analysis model of energy hub. This work has important implications for the comprehensive energy efficiency assessment of multi-energy systems and energy Internet.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distribution Network Planning System Based on GIS Automatic Drawing Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distribution network, how to plan the distribution network scientifically and reasonably becomes an urgent problem. In this paper, a design and implementation method of power network planning system based on Geographic Information System (GIS) automatic mapping technology is presented. The visualization of distribution network source-network-load total topology graph is realized through single-line graphic layout and network topology analysis. Through layered design of power network planning system, scientific and reasonable guidance and evaluation of distribution network planning can be achieved. The rationality of the proposed method and design system is verified by system design, simulation and operation.

articleTitle: Incremental Distribution Network Planning by Considering Electric Vehicle Charging Stations and Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the convenience of charging for users, the p-median and maximum coverage model were established to select the charging station. On this basis, this paper establishes a model with the lowest annual comprehensive cost to plan the capacity of the charging station, the location capacity of the distributed generation (DG) and the line selection, where the annual cost of line, distributed power supply, electric vehicle charging station, electricity purchase and government subsidies are taken into account. The immune algorithm is also used to solve the problem. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the model are verified by a case study of a 13-node distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Development of Energy Storage Frequency Auxiliary Service in Hybrid Delivery Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage technology is realized large-scale application in the field of power system frequency modulation with its sensitive and accurate output characteristics. In most countries, energy storage is an important energy aid, which has enabled the rapid development and application of energy storage. The main domestic frequency regulation service market rules are proposed to analyze the effect of energy storage participation in frequency regulation in combination with the application status of domestic and international energy storage frequency regulation projects. A positive impact is proved by the simulation which is about the energy storage involved in frequency modulation in the AC-DC hybrid grid.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Wild Fire on Electric Grid Transmission Lines Considering Cascading Failure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wild fire is one of the most serious natural disasters threatening the electric grid. This article analyzes the risk of wild fire on electric grid transmission lines considering cascading failure. In order to meet the timeliness requirement of on-line analysis of power grid under wild fire disaster, an improved sampling method considering the sequence of fire tripping is proposed. Thus, the risk ranking of transmission lines considering cascading failures of wild fire can be obtained, according to that, the optimal emergency strategy can be formulated for the electric grid. The effectiveness and validity of the proposed framework and method are demonstrated by application examples.

articleTitle: Charging Harmonic Characteristic Analysis of Electric Vehicles Based on Simulation and Analytical Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electric vehicle charger will produce a lot of harmonics. In this paper, the harmonic characteristics of chargers are analyzed by simulation and analysis. The main contents are as follows: the harmonic current characteristics of single charger, synchronous charger and asynchronous charger are deeply excavated; the harmonic current of synchronous charger of multiple chargers is analyzed based on superposition principle; and based on simulation and analysis results, the harmonic current of synchronous charger of multiple chargers is proposed. An approximate method for calculating harmonic current with harmonic cancellation effect in mind is presented. A large number of simulation results and conclusions provide experimental and theoretical basis for practical engineering analysis of harmonic characteristics and research of harmonic suppression methods.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Using Broad Learning System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) is of great value in power system operation. This paper proposes an STLF method based on the broad learning system (BLS). First, factors that have major impacts on load demands are selected as input variables of STLF. Then, the construction of BLS is discussed. The original input is mapped into feature nodes using the sparse autoencoder, and the network expands in width through the enhancement nodes which are generated from the mapped features. Both the feature and enhancement nodes are directly connected to the output layer. Such a flat structure is exploited to implement incremental learning, which updates BLS dynamically without retraining. Finally, the proposed model is tested on the ISO New England dataset. Test results indicate that BLS is accurate and efficient compared with the existing machine learning techniques. Moreover, the incremental learning capability improves the efficiency of the update of STLF models remarkably.

articleTitle: Harmonic Current Detection and Reactive Power Compensation Method for Photovoltaic System Based on FBD Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the equipment utilization of distributed photovoltaic power generation system, the harmonic and reactive currents generated by grid-connected photovoltaic system can be accurately detected and compensated. A phase-locked loop based on second-order generalized integrator (SOGI-PLL) is introduced into the traditional FBD current detection method to separate the positive and negative sequence components of unbalanced voltage and detect the phase and frequency of reference voltage more accurately. The simulation results show that the algorithm can reduce the computational complexity and increase the detection accuracy and steady-state performance.

articleTitle: Malicious Code Detection Scheme Based on CWRNN for Microgrid Controllers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of power terminal devices and IoT devices which are accessed to the power grid, their security issues are becoming more and more important. While the microgrid controllers are served as the central core of the entire microgrid, the attacks on microgrid controllers and other power end devices have been launched in recent years. It's obvious that the current safety protection measures for power end devices are insufficient. However, microgrid controllers cannot be protected by traditional intrusion detection systems or anti-virus software. Motivated by these concerns, this paper proposes a non-intrusive malicious code security monitoring scheme based on a power side channel. The core idea is to measure the power consumption data of the microgrid controller, to extract the power consumption feature, and to identify the abnormality sample through CWRNN neural network to determine whether the microgrid controller is attacked or not. The advantage of this method is that it can effectively detect unknown attacks without modifying the original software system. What's more, the method is evaluated in the experimental test, and the detection accuracy can reach to 92%.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-energy Power Flow Calculation of Thermoelectric Coupling Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) is an important technology for energy efficiency improving, energy conservation and emission reduction. The electrothermal coupling system with combined heat and power (CHP) as the core is one of the widely used IES at present. The power flow calculation of the electrothermal coupling system can provide the necessary data for the safe and stable operation of the IES and improve economic benefits. In this paper, the basic structure of the electrothermal coupling system is analyzed, and the joint solving process of multi-energy flow is proposed and verified by the simulation example.

articleTitle: Load Flow Analysis of District Heating Systems by a Newton-Raphson Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a Newton-Raphson (NR) based method for solving the steady-state load flow model of a district heating network which has two physical processes interacting with each other, i.e., the hydraulic and thermal processes. In this method, the flow directions in the hydraulic and thermal models are determined systematically. The outflow (direction) indication variables are introduced and updated in each step (iteration) of the NR method. As such, the formulation of the hydraulic and thermal models can be integrated as a hydraulic-thermal model and be solved together, which previously were considered separately and solved in sequence with less efficiency. Case studies are performed and the results show that the hydraulic-thermal model can handle the changes of flow directions during the iterative steps of the NR method and correctly obtain the steady-state load flow analysis results of a district heating network.

articleTitle: Research on the Privacy-Preserving Energy Management in Power Grid Based on Information Masking
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the application of new communication facilities and the development of information and communication technology, remote terminal unit and phasor measurement unit can obtain comprehensive and detailed information of power grid in real time, the demand of power system energy management has been increasingly improved. Meanwhile, the advantages of cloud computing prompt relevant researchers to consider the implementation of energy management system in the form of cloud services. However, privacy information of agents under the framework of cloud energy management may be exposed to third parties, such as cloud servers, or data attackers. To ensure the privacy preservation in cloud energy management problem in the form of linear programming, the information masking algorithm as well as its implementation mechanism in cloud are proposed. A case study on a smart home with electrical devices is conducted to demonstrate the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: The Framework of Residential and Commercial User-side Intelligent Power Management Framework Considering Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of intelligent home has promoted the residents' attention to intelligent power management, the electric load of its mainly includes electric vehicles, electric lights, televisions, computers, air conditioners, water heaters, washing machines etc., while, this urbanization has led to the continuous emergence of commercial buildings, and the proportion of energy consumption in commercial buildings has continued to rise, the electric load of its mainly includes electric vehicles, lighting load and fixed electric load. The charging and discharging characteristics of electric vehicles have also made their role in the optimal management of intelligent power management for residential and commercial users. After plug-in electric vehicle grid, the power consumption characteristics of different users show significant differences. Therefore, this paper studies the intelligent power management framework considering electric vehicles for different users. For residential users, this paper studies the intelligent power management problem of electric vehicles, establishes the electric vehicle model of residential users, and proposes an intelligent power management framework for residential users considering electric vehicles. For commercial users, the model of electric vehicle for commercial users is established and the framework of intelligent power management system for commercial users considering electric vehicles is proposed. The framework of different user intelligent power management systems considering electric vehicles proposed in this paper lays a theoretical foundation for the study of intelligent power optimization strategies.

articleTitle: Airborne Defects Auxiliary Identification Technology of Transmission Line Inspection based on Edge Calculation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the data of unmanned aerial aehicle (UAV) transmission line inspection cannot be fully utilized on the data source side, the defect data also have to be processed repeatedly. In response to these challenges, a way to increase calculation resources on the data source side is present in this paper. First, the on-chip identification core is developed for the UAV. Then, the identification model that based on SSD-Mobilenet-FPN is built for the micro-terminal, and the method of monitoring the flight attitude and camera angle linkage mechanism are also developed, moreover the ground-based video source switching method is studied. Finally, the UAV, which can assist the ground inspectors to judge the transmission line defects in an all-round way, can realize the collection, analysis and diagnosis of the data during the inspection.

Author Keywords: flight attitude and camera angle linkage

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Distance Protection in Power Grid with New Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reliability of the protection for the tie line of wind farm is of great significance for the safety of the power grid and wind farm. Nevertheless, the complicated fault current characteristics of wind turbine generators deteriorate the performance of traditional protection schemes (like distance protection), or even result in fail-to-trip of traditional protection schemes. The fault characteristics of the new energy source under the crowbar action and no action are analyzed firstly. Then, the influence of the doubly-fed wind farm on the distance protection under different operating modes is analyzed. The correctness of the analysis conclusion is verified by simulation. The research results have important guiding significance for the grid relay protection configuration after the new energy.

articleTitle: Smooth Control Strategy for Fuel Cell-Battery Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the energy crisis and environmental problems are increasingly serious, fuel cell is adopted in many applications as green energy. In order to improve the dynamic performance of fuel cell, auxiliary power storage elements should be added. In our paper, the main power supply-fuel cell and auxiliary power supply-battery are in parallel to generate, which improve the performance of bus voltage. Firstly, the simulation models of the main and auxiliary power supply are set up. Then, a simple and feasible system control strategy is proposed for fuel cell discharging regulator and bus voltage regulator. Finally, a simulation platform is built up to verify that the control strategy proposed in this paper can realize smooth switching among different working modes and reasonable energy flow between the main and auxiliary power supply. Bus voltage has excellent steady-state and dynamic characteristics under all working conditions, which is suitable for the high-precision dc load.

articleTitle: Fault Early Warning, Fault Diagnosis and Intelligent Decision Platform Construction Technology for Condenser Based on Ubiquitous Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the detailed analysis and study of the advantages and disadvantages of the existing system, this paper develops a set of relatively perfect fault early warning, fault diagnosis and intelligent decision-making platform for the condenser based on the ubiquitous internet of things. The platform can realize the following functions. First is remote centralized monitoring of the operation state of the condenser. Second is intelligent early warning of the condenser. Third is remote fault diagnosis of the phase modulator. Forth is three-dimensional display and maintenance training of the condenser. The core technologies include data acquisition based on ubiquitous power internet of things, coordination governance among different databases and establishment of large data analysis platform, information mining technology based on large data analysis, cross-area data transmission and network security control technology, the remote on-line monitoring technology of the phase modulator. The system design mainly applies sensor technology, Internet technology, cloud computing technology, visualized intelligent diagnosis technology and reliability management technology to realize remote monitoring of the power network converter station’s phase modulator, including the monitoring of phase modulator operation parameters, reactive power remote control, remote monitoring of equipment operation status, coordinated operation status of the network and the machine. The results show that the platform of fault early warning, fault diagnosis and intelligent decision-making can apply sensor technology, Internet technology, cloud computing technology, visualized intelligent diagnosis technology and reliability management technology to realize remote monitoring of the phase modulator in power grid converter station, including the monitoring of the operation parameters of the phase modulator and the remote monitoring of reactive power, control and remote monitoring of equipment operation status, coordinated monitoring of machine network operation status, reliability management of electrical equipment, lubrication system and cooling system.

articleTitle: Multiscale Information Fusion-based Extreme Learning Machine for Power Transformer Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power transformer fault diagnosis is one of the most important techniques in smart grid. Recently, extreme learning machine (ELM) has been proved effective in analyzing dissolved gas to diagnose transformer faults. However, due to the complexity and variability of dissolved gas data, it is challenging to choose an optimal number of hidden layer node in ELM. For previous ELM methods, the number of hidden layer node is fixed. It means that these methods may fail to exploit dissolved gas information to diagnose effectively. To tackle this problem, this paper introduces a novel multiscale information fusion-based extreme learning machine (MIF-ELM) technique for power transformer fault diagnosis. The proposed method contains two main steps. First, multiple ELM models with different node numbers are employed to produce initial diagnosis results. Different diagnosis results can reflect various statistics information of dissolved gas, which can provide complementary information for power transformer fault diagnosis. Then, an effective information fusion method is developed to fuse diagnosis results with different scales, so as to generate a fused diagnosis result. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach can outperform some classical and outstanding methods including support vector machine (SVM) and back propagation (BP) neural network.

articleTitle: Commutation Torque Ripple Suppression of BLDCM Based on Quasi-Y-Source Net
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel control strategy based on quasi-Y-source net is proposed for the high commutation torque ripple of brushless direct current motors (BLDCM). The quasi-Y-source net is connected to the input of the inverting bridge and the output voltage of the quasi-Y-source net after boosting is used as direct current (DC) link voltage to drive the BLDCM during commutation, which can ensure the stability of the constant incoming phase current amplitude and effectively reduce the commutation torque ripple. Through the analysis of the principle in commutation torque ripple, a control system regulated by power conversion module is introduced. The simulation results show that this method can reduce the commutation torque ripple to 3.5% of the average torque, improving the average output torque of the motor and effectively reducing the commutation torque ripple of the BLDCM.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Characteristics of Cascaded Multilevel SVG
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current tracking control method is an important indicator of the effectiveness of static var generator (SVG) in compensating the ineffective effect. New current control methods are constantly proposed and improved. Deadbeat control has good steady-state performance, but its dynamic response is slow. Combining deadbeat control with PI control can effectively improve the accuracy of reactive power compensation and improve the dynamic response speed of the system. On this basis, simulation modeling and experimental research are carried out. The effectiveness and reliability of the proposed control strategy are verified on the simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Static Voltage Stability Assessment Considering Harmonic Effects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the degree of power electronics in power systems continues increasing, the harmonic content of the system continues to increase as well. In order to study the influence of harmonics on the static voltage stability of power system, a static voltage stability analysis method considering the influence of harmonics is proposed. Firstly, by the decoupling method considering the influence of harmonicsˈ the harmonic current of the system is solved. Secondly, based on weak nodes, safety domain and sensitive nodesˈa static voltage stability analysis method are proposed. Thirdly, Latin Hypercube sampling is used in uncertain harmonic tidal current analysis. Finally, the IEEE 33-nodes system in a certain area are used. Therefore, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified when the system contains both single harmonic source and multiple harmonic sources.

articleTitle: An Overview on Large-Scale Source-Grid-Load Friendly Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale source-grid-load friendly interaction system, especially the precise load shedding system was developed and applied in State Grid of China. The method can be used to enable the fast and accurate control interruptible load. A good solution for the power grid frequency problem specifically the UHV DC line fault issue and the resulting large power shortage were also provided. It can enhance the power grid stability margin, minimizes the impact to the user caused by the power outage. In this paper, the operation mode of the system is firstly compared with the traditional scheduled power dispatch system. Then, the interruptible load classification method the load characteristics are comprehensively introduced; the load control strategy for the interaction system is briefly summarized. Furthermore, the implementation the test and the key technology of the system, especially the communication design between the central control station and the control terminal are presented.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Strategy and Test Technology of Photovoltaic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increase of photovoltaic (PV) generations, the current power system is under extraordinary pressure of the frequency regulation for the frequency adjustment device is reduced. In this paper, in view of the grid-connected PV generations, the frequency control strategy, modification method and testing method are proposed. After quantitative analysis of the frequency regulation performance of the PV generations and compared with synchronous generator primary frequency performance, the simulation results shows that the PV generations could participate in power system frequency control with a good technical performance.

articleTitle: Research on Factory Simulation and Debugging Technology of Smart Substation Expansion with Multi-system Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the smart substation is expanded, or the protection equipment is replaced in the field, the amount of on-site commissioning is large, and the frequency and time of primary equipment power outage is significantly increased. In view of the problems, a factory simulation debugging technology of relay protection equipment with multi-system interconnection for smart substation expansion is proposed. Taking the smart substation expansion factory simulation debugging system as the core, the smart debugging system interconnects with SCD control system, protection fixed value management system and big data platform, realizing the automatic test and test operation control for smart substation expansion or on-site replacing protection equipment. The factory simulation debugging platform is built based on theoretical research. The test results show that the platform can effectively avoid the power outage of running line in the expansion project, and reduce power outage time of smart substation.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Fault Recognition and Diagnosis Technology Based on Synchronized Two-Terminal Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault Recognition and Diagnosis are the precondition for service restoration of out-of-service area. Hence, correct and effective diagnosis of the distribution network fault is especially important for judging whether the power equipment is available and recovering the service quickly. Based on the decision table of rough set theory, fault diagnose method of the transmission lines is presented. The action information of the stage current protection device and the circuit breaker obtained by the Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition (SCADA) system is used as the characteristic attribute of the decision, and the synchronous phasor information obtained by the Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) is introduced to improve the fault tolerance of the decision table. The proposed method is verified on a 13-node neutral point ungrounded distribution network model, which can diagnose which line the fault is located on and the moment when the fault occurs. When the information transmitted by the terminal information collection system is faulty, the fault can still be correctly diagnosed.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Calculating Ground Return Impedance of Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the electromagnetic transient analysis of the power system, the frequency-dependent characteristics of the overhead line model parameters will have a significant impact on the calculation results. A novel method for calculating the ground return impedance of overhead transmission lines with the frequency-dependent characteristics is proposed in this paper. In this method, the non-integrable part of Carson formula is converted into integrable function by function substitution method, and the closed-form solution of ground return impedance is obtained, which is close to the calculation result of Carson formula. The accuracy of this method is much better than that of other approximation formulas. It can be used to improve the accuracy of ground return impedance calculation.

articleTitle: Research on Laser Deicing Technology for Overhead Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, there are many deicing methods for power transmission lines, including direct current deicing and AC deicing. Under certain conditions, ice bridge flashover may occur under these icing conditions. It is necessary to study the deicing and deicing methods for power transmission lines, but there is no better deicing method for substation equipment at present. Laser deicing has certain feasibility in substation equipment deicing. According to the nature and mechanism of laser and the three characteristics of laser (high power, high beam quality and high stability), there are two methods that can be used in ice melting at present. The first one is to use the high energy, high intensity and high brightness of laser, and we can use the energy of laser to deicing. On the ice. The second is to use the laser pulse and stress wave to irradiate the ice. Laser shock can produce strong stress wave in the ice, so as to achieve the purpose of melting ice. Laser deicing device has the characteristics of small size, light weight, easy to carry, simple operation and so on. It can carry out deicing operation in harsh environment. With the development of technology and industrialization, the performances of lens and laser with high transmittance and collimation have been improved and the price has been declining, which will promote the further development and application of high power laser de-icing technology.

articleTitle: Maximum Traveling-Wave-Based Fault Location For Meshed MTDC Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a maximum traveling-wave-based fault location method for multi-terminal HVDC systems. The traditional traveling wave method based first-arrival-time cannot deal with the blind zones in MTDCs when a part of transmission paths are much longer than the others. The propagating features of traveling waves are studied, and the maximum traveling wave is proved to directly propagate from fault point and can be used in fault locations. With the arriving time of maximum traveling waves, all paths in MTDC are assumed to be faulted and the true faulted line is selected. A four-terminal meshed HVDC system is modeled, and faults with various parameters are simulated. The results demonstrate that the proposed method is effective in locating faults and has better performance than the traditional first-arrival-time methods.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Simulation for Electric Vehicle Aggregators’ Bidding and Pricing Strategy Considering Reserve Provision and EV Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Emergence of electric vehicle aggregators (EVAs) could significantly improve the interaction between power grid and massive electrical vehicles. The market behavior of EVA is studied, and an agent-based simulation model is proposed for EVAs' bidding and pricing strategy considering reserve provision. The EVA optimizes its bidding prices, charging prices and incentive prices with the objective to maximize total profits gained from charging service and reserve service. The EV agents can adjust their charging schedules in response to the time-of-use charging prices in order to decrease their charging cost. Based on the energyreserve combined market clearing model, the interaction between EVA and EV owners are modelled as a Stackelberg game and simulated using agent-based approach. The numerical analysis proves the feasibility and effectiveness of model proposed.

articleTitle: Index systems for analysis and evaluation of clean energy development based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Clean energies and intelligent grids are principle characteristics of novel electrical systems, and coordinating their developments is critical. We propose an evaluation system for clean energy and intelligent grid comprehensive development in "3 layers, 4 parts, 15 objectives" considering the four major energy processes in the electrical industry, namely generation, transmission and distribution, consumption, and dispatchment. Such evaluation is essential to the establishment of priorities and principle areas of intelligent grids and clean energies. Using the developed system, we evaluate the status of the clean energy and intelligent grid developments and the extent of their coordination in China through an analytic hierarchy process. The results show that the extent of collaboration of transmission and dispatchment is higher than that of consumption. Accordingly, we suggest that the development in the consumption part should be given priority of China.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Hybrid AC/DC Distribution Network based on DC Conversion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid AC/DC distribution networks will play an important role in the future, in which the influences of existing AC distribution network need to be considered during planning. Thus, the reliability evaluation of hybrid AC/DC distribution network is essential, because the influences of AC/DC conversions are not considered in traditional methods. Therefore, this paper firstly introduces the basic structure of the existing AC/DC hybrid distribution network. And then, the reliability evaluation method is proposed and the failure mode consequence analysis table is established according to the protection strategy. Finally, a reliability index for AC/DC hybrid distribution network is proposed and tested based on a modified RBTS system.

articleTitle: On-line Resonance Measurement of Generator Stator Insulation Considering Damping Coefficient of Arc Suppression Coil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Generator insulation faults account for a high proportion of generator faults. It is difficult to meet the requirements of fast and accurate real-time monitoring of generator stator insulation state. In this paper, the on-line monitoring method of generator stator winding insulation state based on resonance measurement is proposed. By injecting zero-sequence current with constant amplitude and frequency variation into arc suppression coil, the phase angle difference between zero-sequence voltage of stator winding neutral point and injection current is monitored in real time, the resonance frequency of zero-sequence circuit is searched, the capacitance current and leakage resistance current of generator to ground are calculated, and the insulation state of generator stator winding is measured online. Considering the influence of damping resistance and excitation branch of voltage transformer, the accuracy of on-line insulation monitoring is improved. Through PSCAD/EMTDC simulation analysis, the method is not affected by arc suppression coil damping resistance and generator operation mode, which can effectively overcome the interference of excitation branch of voltage transformer to measurement, and meet the requirement of accurate on-line real-time monitoring of generator stator windings. It has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Optimal Planning of Battery Energy Storage Systems in Radial Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an optimal planning model of battery energy storage systems (BESS) in radial distribution networks is proposed to regulate bus voltage and reduce energy cost. The optimal number, locations and capacity for BESS is obtained by a hierarchical optimal planning model. The model firstly determines the BESS number. Then the most effective locations can be selected based on voltage sensitivity analysis. Given the number and location, the BESS capacity can be determined by a constrained mixed-integer nonlinear programming problem solved by natural aggregation algorithm (NAA). The final configuration of BESS is determined by voltage regulation constrained minimizing the total life cycle cost, which includes the system operation cost, investment cost, residual value of BESS, and, etc. A case study conducted on a modified IEEE 15-bus distribution system shows the performance and outcome of the optimal planning model.

articleTitle: Distribution Line Fault Location Method Based on Multi Terminal Information Fusion and Filtering Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to isolate the fault area accurately and restore the power supply of the non-fault area in distribution network which has complex and profuse branches, a novel line fault location method is proposed based on multi-terminal information fusion and filtering estimation. The traveling wave collection devices are installed in every terminal distribution transformer for arrival time measuring of the initial wave head. A reference point is selected to get all the main lines that contains the fault point. According to the principle of two-terminal fault location method, the Kalman filtering algorithm and the least square method are used to deal with the measurement distance of all the main lines so as to obtain fault distance. The simulation example shows that this method can realize accurate location of the fault section.

articleTitle: Integrated Droop Control Strategy for Parallel Operation of Solid State Transformers in Intelligent Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solid state transformer is a new type of power equipment which is expected to replace the traditional distribution transformer. It can satisfy the custom power demand of the renewable energy utilization and the high reliability of power supply. In intelligent distribution network with a large number of flexible equipment and impact load, the parallel operation of solid state transformers not only needs to consider the power distribution problem, but also needs to consider the power quality problems caused by these harmonic sources. An integrated droop control method is proposed in this paper, which not only realizes the active and reactive power distributed according to the capacity ratio, but also effectively suppress the harmonic current caused by the nonlinear load and ensure the power quality of the low-voltage AC bus. Matlab/Simulink simulation results show the validity and advantage of the proposed method, compared with the classic droop control method.

articleTitle: Policy Development and Market Mechanism for Self-Supply Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents the development history of China’s self-supply power station enterprise (SSPE) and discusses the classification of SSPE with respect to their economic roles and operational characteristics. During the current energy transition, development requirements of regulation and pricing policy for SSPE are analyzed to sort out the main challenges with respect to SSPE, and the issues need to be studied further in the future.

articleTitle: Distribution characteristics of transmission line galloping events and the analysis of key meteorological factors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission line galloping is one of the most important disasters of power grid in winter. Based on the galloping observations and loss records obtained from the State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC), the distribution characteristics and the key meteorological factors of galloping events are analyzed. The results show that the galloping events appear in most of the plains area of central and north China, there are obvious differences in the occurrence areas of galloping in different months. For North China, the combination of temperature and precipitation is the most important meteorological affecting the occurrence of galloping, and for the central China, temperature and wind speed are the most important factors which affect the occurrence of galloping. The result of the study has an important significance in galloping prediction.

articleTitle: Online Ambient Temperature Monitoring of Electronic Transducer Based on Thermocouple
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the evolution of electronic transducer and remarkable deployment of practical application, the issues of stability and reliability are gradually exposed. To obtain accurate ambient temperature data at a relatively low cost and evaluate the influence of ambient temperature to output signal from electronic transducer, an online ambient temperature monitoring system based on thermocouple is inplemented. The electromotive force is sampled by ADC with high resolution, and then fed to corresponding NIST functions for nonlinearity error correction according to specific thermocouple type. The corrected data is refined by Kalman filter to exclude system perturbation and measure noise and finally transfer to merged unit through fiber by concentrator for storage and further analysis. Cyclic temperature experiment is done in the chamber and the influence of temperature to transducer output signal accuracy is qualitatively analyzed using the recorded data.

articleTitle: Comparison of connection modes of 10kV switch station in Shanghai Fengxian New Town
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The key to the landing of Energy Internet lies in the link of distribution network. Switch station is gradually taken as the core node in 10 kV cable network.
