In order to meet the load check of overhaul state "N-1" in spring and autumn of the distribution network to ensure efficiency, interworking and self-healing of Energy Internet, suitable connection mode of 10 kV switch station should be planned. In this paper, the connection mode of 10 kV switch station in Fengxian New Town is introduced. The connection mode of the target 10 kV switch station is demonstrated, and the malfunction situation is analyzed, and the processing logic is proposed. The 07 unit of Fengxian New town is selected to simulate the quantitative analysis and the comparison conclusion of two connecting methods is given.

Author Keywords: overhaul state "N-1" In spring and autumn

articleTitle: A New Generator Control Device Level Disturbance Source Location Method of Power Oscillation Based on PMU
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale interconnection of the power grid not only increases the economic and reliability of power generation and transmission, but also increases the possibility of low frequency oscillations in the system. Therefore, it has a great significance for accurate localization and identification of the oscillation source which can improve system stability. With the help of phasor measurement unit's (PMU) high-precision acquisition capability of grid data, the location of generator control device level power oscillation disturbance source is discussed in this paper. Based on the physical meaning of the phasor diagram of synchronous generator, a new method for calculating the oscillation energy of excitation system and governor system is proposed. Take a forced power oscillation accident caused by excessive primary frequency modulation for example, the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Distributed GenHrators Access System Evaluation and Software Design Supporting Integrated Energy Services
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of distributed generators is connected to the distribution network, and the simulation calculation work is enormous. In order to meet the requirement of fast, simple and accurate electrical calculation of distributed generators access system, the simplified algorithm of electrical calculation is presented in this paper. And the simplified calculation formulas of power flow, short circuit and power quality index are given. On this basis, the software design of DG accessed to distribution network evaluation is carried out. The software can give the distribution network indicators before and after DG access, and then reflects the grid adaptability. The software has been applied in Jiangsu Power Grid, and the efficiency of distributed generators access system evaluation has been improved greatly.

articleTitle: Harmonics Analysis of Grid Tied Solar System by Employing FFT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Solar systems are great examples for increasingly becoming popular solutions in renewable energy. As is known, maximizing power output from a solar system is desirable to increase efficiency. In order to maximize heat output from the solar systems, one needs to keep the system aligned with the sun. Intrinsically, the sun is required for tracking. It’s a far more costing effectively solution, than purchasing additional solar system placed in different angles. This research develops a hybrid tracking system which will keep the solar system aligned with the sun in order to maximize heat efficiency. Subsequently generation, utilization and its grid penetration in electrical grid are growing worldwide. However, this integration has its own limitations. Solar energy is in form of dc and converted to ac with the help of inverter, which introduces distortion in sinusoidal wave and causes harmonics. Harmonics increase losses in power system. In addition, with harmonics due to fluctuating nature of energy from renewable sources and variation in load, to reduce the power factor and consequences are increasing in losses, it affects the transmission system and reduces the receiving power. Therefore, this project compacts with the analysis of the problems mentioned above and propose the feasible solutions to make the solar system more reliable and efficient.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Energy Storage Buffer System for Charging Station Based on V2G
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Bidirectional energy interaction between grid and electric vehicles is supported by electric vehicle (EV) charging stations based on the V2G (Vehicle to Grid) technology. The energy flow from the grid will be injected into the battery when the battery needs to be charged. While the electric vehicle is in a suspended state, the energy will flow from electric vehicles to grid so as to improving the energy utilization. By using energy storage buffer system, the pulse power of EV's fast charging can be compensated, and the adverse effects of fast charging station on distribution network can be reduced. The topology structure of fast charging station with energy storage buffer system and the fast charging power characteristics of different types of batteries are studied. Then, considering the limitation of real power variation in distribution network, the operation mode and current control strategy of energy storage and buffer system of fast charging station are proposed. Finally, when designing the storage buffer system module and its control parameters, combined with the configuration of fast charging station, the operation parameters of the storage buffer system are derived.

articleTitle: Review on Technologies of Compressed Air Energy Storage in Aquifers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the fluctuation and instability of renewable energy, a large-scale energy storage technology is considered to be an effective way. Due to the merits of large energy storage scale and long storage period, compressed air energy storage has attracted extensive attention and research. The working principle and advantages as well as research status of compressed air energy storage in aquifers are discussed. The key problems of economic cost, reservoir property, wellbore structure design, caprock safety and injection-production scheme design of compressed air energy storage in aquifers are also analyzed. Furthermore, the shortcomings in the current research of compressed air energy storage in aquifers at the present stage are summarized. Finally, proposed more indoor experiments and pilot tests of actual sites are needed in future research.

articleTitle: Pillar Industry Judgment Based On Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compared with the traditional economic analysis of the industry, data analysis in the context of big data has more intuitive advantages. As to get the industrial feature attributes, the analysis of industry is segmented to three aspects, including comprehensive energy efficiency, economic contribution as well as energy conservation and environmental protection. After screening by gray correlation analysis, more influential feature attributes are finally obtained. The improved k-means clustering algorithm with adaptive weights is used to cluster industrial data. Through the example simulation, it is found that the objective display of the feature attribute data makes the advantages and disadvantages of pillar industry more intuitive, and can provide some guidance for the regional industrial construction.

articleTitle: Research on Discrimination of Wide-Area Backup Protection Faults Based on Stacked Auto-Encoder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To deal with the problems including complex setting and coordination, a new method for wide-area backup fault identification with the use of Stacked Auto-encoder (SAE) is put forward in this paper. The directional elements of line fault, the measurement elements of distance protection section II and action state of main protection are taken as SAE network’s input, and state information matrix for all certain fault is made as the training sample to train SAE. Then, the element state information vector under random failures is used as the test sample, and a lot of fault identification results under inaccurate state are simulated. The results of experiment prove that the wide-area backup protection based on SAE has good ability of fault tolerance and high accuracy.

articleTitle: An Expandable Interline DC Power-Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC power flow controller can effectively solve the problem of insufficient freedom of power flow control in the DC grids, which is important for maintaining the safe and stable operation of the AC/DC hybrid system. Firstly, the working principle of the existing power flow controllers are briefly analyzed, and their shortcomings in practical applications are pointed out. Aiming at the shortcomings of existing power flow controllers, a novel circuit topology of interline DC power flow controller (IDCPFC) is proposed in this paper, which is easy to be extended for modularization design. Secondly, operating principles and control strategies are analyzed. Finally, two meshed dc grids are simulated in PSCAD to validate IDCPFC with cases of steady state and power change state. Simulation results show that IDCPFC can realize accurate power flow control.

articleTitle: A Reactive Power Optimization Strategy Considering Relevance of Random Variables
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reactive power optimization of distribution network with wind power is studied at the operational level considering relevant scenarios. This paper studies the uncertainty of wind speed and load and gives the construction process of relevant scenarios. Then, the paper establishes the objective function considering static voltage stability, network loss, voltage excursion, and gives the corresponding constraints. The rationality of the proposed model is analyzed by numerical simulation. The results show that the method of constructing relevant scenarios at the operational level can improve the performance of reactive power optimization in the distribution network, and the priority-based multi-objective decision-making method can adjust the target bias adaptively according to the actual operation status of the system. The system runs stably, economically and provides high-quality power supply by using the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Research of Intrinsic Mode Function Illusive Component Recognition and Adaptive Threshold Denoising Method Based on Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Empirical mode decomposition (EMD) has been widely used since it was proposed. However, there are illusive component in intrinsic mode function (IMF) obtained by EMD. In addition, the demarcation point K of signal and noise modal function in traditional EMD denoising method are difficult to select accurately. In order to solve the above problems, the normalized energy distribution characteristics of IMF components are used to identify and eliminate illusive components firstly. Then, an adaptive threshold optimization method to denoise IMF components is presented in this paper. Finally, the IMF components after noise reduction are superimposed and merged to obtain the true value of the signal. Through the analysis of examples, it is found that comparing with wavelet transform and traditional EMD denoising methods, this method has a great improvement in signal-to-noise ratio and noise suppression ratio.

articleTitle: Analysis of temporal-spatial characteristics of wildfire in Hunan province during Qingming Festival
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-source of wildfire events and transmission line wildfire alarm data are used to analyze temporal-spatial characteristics of wildfire of Qingming Festival (Tomb-sweeping festival) period Hunan province, which is located in Hunan province of China. Fires caused by human activities such as burning paper or firecrackers when sweeping their ancestors' tombs are the main reason for the high-incidence of wildfires during Qingming Festival period. The quasi-bimodal character of the occurrence time of wildfire events near the transmission lines is mostly induced by ashes reburning when people left the tombs for dinner without extinguish the fire thoroughly. The southern part of Hunan province suffers from wildfire more seriously than the northern part spatially speaking. Three regions with high risk of wildfire hazards are found. Different wildfire patterns are analyzed which mainly caused by different local folk customs of each region. This work lay solid foundation of the decision-making as to the prevention and reduction of wildfire hazards near transmission lines.

articleTitle: A Station Domain Protection Scheme Based on Logical Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of highly networked intelligent substation, this paper proposes a protection scheme of station domain based on logical information fusion. Firstly, transformer-centered protection zones are established, and the overall composition of the protection scheme based on logic information is expounded, and fault-tolerant strategies are put forward. The matching criterion between logic value and fault condition is established according to the logic information in the station, such as the direction, action and type of protection. When a fault occurs, the fault state is determined quickly by using logic criterion, the fault area is identified, and the reliability test is carried out through the distribution of logical values. When different faults, signal transmission errors and rejection occur in the station domain, the fault can be located and isolated selectively and quickly through the coordination of logic values in the protection station domain. Finally, a typical fault of transformer protection is taken as an example to verify the correctness of the proposed protection scheme in the station domain.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Safety Supervision System in Electric Power Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The workload of inspection and maintenance continues increasing as the power grid expands, which has necessitated the development of intelligent supervision methodologies employing advanced information technology that is superior to the traditional ones in terms of efficiency, timeliness, cost and so forth. Therefore, in this paper, an intelligent safety supervision system is developed for substation inspection and maintenance. Based on big data and artificial intelligence technology, the proposed system can comprehensively analyze the data collected by smart wearable devices and other intelligent equipment to realize personnel certification, smart warning, risk analysis and all-around protection for maintenance personnel. In particular, the functions including on-line guidance, approach-electric alarm and healthy analysis can be achieved by virtue of the customized wearable devices.

articleTitle: Combination and Application of Virtual Power Plant, Microgrid and Demand Response Technology in Multi-court Distribution Network for Energy Use Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy use optimization can effectively improve the comprehensive operational benefit of the distribution court. Nowadays, the energy use optimization in distribution court is facing serious challenges under the background of large scale DG coupling. The global optimization of the energy use in distribution network with multiple distribution courts is more difficult. In order to solve this problem, a comprehensive solution is proposed in this paper. The goals for energy use optimization in the distribution court are firstly discussed. The virtual power plant technology, microgrid technology and demand response technology are introduced and compared. By combining and applying the three key supporting technologies, an idea is proposed for the energy use optimization in the multi-court distribution network. The structural composition, functional framework and optimal control of the multi-court distribution network for the idea implementation are illustrated. Finally, a conclusion and an outlook is given.

articleTitle: Research of Crucial Technologies on Dispatcher’s Behavior Pattern Mining Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power grid dispatching is a complex system engineering, and its working pattern and operation principle are implicit in the operation behavior of the dispatcher's daily work. This paper proposes a method which applies the big data technology to mine the operation patterns of grid dispatching. Firstly, data preprocessing is performed on a large number of historical operational records through session division, routine distinguishing and page hierarchy division, where a method of dynamically determining session division threshold and routine distinguishing reference value based on statistical indicators is proposed. Then, the clustering model based on session similarity and affinity propagation algorithm is adopted. This algorithm clusters the operation records after data preprocessing to find the daily operation behavior pattern of the dispatcher. The operation log data of a regional dispatching center in China is taken as an example to verify the algorithm. The results show that the method can effectively identify the operational behavior pattern in power grid dispatching, which provides strong support for the application of auxiliary decision based on the operating mode.

articleTitle: Research on Model-based Condition-based Maintenance Technology of Process-Layer Smart Switch in smart substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the smart substation, switches account for a high proportion of the secondary equipment. Problems and difficulties in the traditional patrol inspection and regular maintenance are gradually emerging, which brings hidden dangers such as periodic maintenance, mechanical maintenance, over maintenance, early maintenance, delayed maintenance and blind maintenance Therefore, in this paper, a method based on process layer smart switch modeling technology is proposed, which obtains on-line monitoring data of the smart switch. The data collected are analyzed synthetically by combining measurement condition maintenance judgment model, traceability comparison model and homology comparison model. The online evaluation of the operation status of process layer smart switch is realized, and furthermore some suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Analysis and Control of Isolated Modular Multilevel DC-DC Converter Under Asymmetric Arm Parameter Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a key device of the energy Internet, the power router can realize efficient allocation and management of electric energy. The DC transformer is an important part of the power router and is the core equipment for energy control. In this paper, the operating status and balance control of the isolated modular multilevel dc-dc converter (IMMDCC) in the case of asymmetric bridge arm inductance are studied. Firstly, the working principle of IMMDCC and the model of transmission power are analyzed. The common mode current loop and differential mode current loop of the IMMDCC are established by analyzing the arm current. On this basis, the working principle of IMMDCC and the imbalance of capacitor voltage caused by the asymmetry of arm inductance are analyzed. A control method for changing the duty ratio is proposed to solve the problem of capacitor voltage imbalance.

articleTitle: Defect Rating for Different Production Models of Line Protection Devices Based on Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Relay protection is the first line guarding the power systems. Defect rating, timely and accurate play an important role in improving the operation and maintenance efficiency of relay protection devices. However, the current defect rating is mainly artificial, lack of intelligent assistant decision-making, thus engages a risk of erroneous rating. This paper studies the defect rating method based on decision tree for line protection devices. Specifically, the defect rating requirements of relay protection and data characteristics of line protection defects in a certain power grid is analyzed firstly. Secondly, the decision tree method applied to defect rating with the ordinary defect attributes is introduced. Finally, the defect record data of different production models of line protection devices from the same manufacturer is used to model the decision tree and discusses the results. The results show that the proposed method has the preliminary capability of defect rating and can be severed as an assist in field device defect rating.

articleTitle: Active Power Optimal Damping Control Strategy for Units Based on Deep Q-Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual establishment of UHVAC/DC hybrid power grid in China, the structure of the power grid is becoming increasingly complex and the number of interval oscillation modes is increasing. Power oscillation has become a prominent problem which troubles the safe and stable operation of the modern power grid. In most papers, the oscillation frequency, damping ratio and sensitivity of electromechanical oscillation mode are selected as the analysis basis to suppress the low-frequency oscillation of power system and improve the system stability by installing PSS (power system stabilization). In this paper, the objective function of the weakest damping ratio of interval modes is used to establish the unit output optimization model, and a method of unit output optimization based on deep Q network is proposed. Simulations on 4-unit-2-zone system and 10-unit-39-bus system in New England show that changing the output of units can significantly improve the damping ratio of the weakest oscillation mode. The feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified by the comparison with the genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Status Detection System for Power Plugs Based on Data Sampling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power supply system is the basis for the healthy operation of microcomputer protection. This paper presents a new method to detect the health status of power plugs and design corresponding detection device, including data acquisition, data processing and data analysis. Using pointer ammeter, pointer voltmeter, disc high-power disk adjustable resistance, switching switch, micro oscilloscope and epoxy resin board, the detection device was built to measure the output voltage, current, ripple and start-up time of power plug with different voltage levels under different load current conditions. According to raw data, the `voltage/power curves' and `start voltage timing diagrams' are drawn. Compared with `standard curves' acquired from test results of a large number for new power plugs in the same type, the health status of power plugs can be determined.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Operation and Maintenance Matching of PMSG for Wind Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper discusses the common fault diagnosis methods of wind power generation. The fault diagnosis of permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) is discussed in detail. Through the cognitive measurement model, the ability test of wind power maintenance personnel can be carried out, and the success rate of solving a specific fault can be obtained. the fault diagnosis results match the capacity of wind power maintenance personnel, consider the number of personnel dispatch, and carries out personnel dispatch. Caused by the lack of operation and maintenance, the downtime of fan failure will be greatly reduced. What's more, the management efficiency of operation and maintenance personnel and the efficiency of removing defects in work order will be improved. Meanwhile, the power generation will be increased by 1%, and the cost of operation and maintenance will be reduced by 20%.

articleTitle: A Parameter Optimization Method for Commutation Failure Prevention in LCC-HVDC system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCC-HVDC has been playing an important role in long distance power transmission. As a principle problem of HVDC with traditional thyristor, commutation failure becomes more serious in modern large power grid. Firstly, this paper analyzed the commutation process and mechanism of commutation failure in details. Then the effective controller is presented to prevent commutation failure under symmetric and asymmetric faults. The key parameter "gain" of the controller is optimized by the nonlinear method Hooke-Jeeves of which the objective function is the inverter bus voltage deviation. Finally, the simulation result shows that the proposed method not only improves the immunity of commutation failure, but also reduces the fluctuations of system state variables.

articleTitle: Application Prospects of Compressed Sensing in Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of Compressed Sensing (CS) in smart grids has become a trend. With the proposal of Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity (UIoTE), CS will have a broader application prospect in this field. However, the research of CS in UIoTE has not yet been carried out while many key technologies in its application need to be explored, which should be based on application research of CS in smart grid. To this end, this paper studies the future application prospects and its methods of CS in UIoTE. Firstly, the application necessity of CS in UIoTE is analyzed in detail, and then, the research advances of CS in smart grid is summarized. On this basis, this paper focuses on the application of CS in UIoTE, proposing the application fields and research directions of CS in UIoTE as well as the application model of CS for information collection in UIoTE. Finally, this paper looks forward to the future design ideas of the three elements of CS in UIoTE. The work done in this paper aims to provide reference and guidance for research on CS in UIoTE.

Author Keywords: Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity

articleTitle: Research on Video Monitoring Method for Switching Status of Switch Cabinet Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the method for judging the separation and closing state of the switch of the switchgear based on video measurement technology, which implements the corresponding observing system. The method obtains the position information by collecting and analyzing the image during the movement of the handcart, and then judges the opening and closing state of the switch of the switchgear circuit breaker. This method eliminates the need to install any sensors on the handcart/contact, which is safe, reliable and easy to operate. At the same time, the high-performance hardware circuit image analysis algorithm can obtain the position information of the handcart in real time, and assist the operator to understand the working state of the switch cabinet at the first time. The technology can reliably improve the comprehensive technology of device status verification and judgment, improve the reliability of the existing switchgear sequence control operation technology, and make it possible to apply one-button sequence control operation. It also can reduce the workload of on-site operation, improve operation and maintenance efficiency, and reduce personal safety risk.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Microgrid Reconfiguration Model With Mobile Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Mobile energy storage (MES) including truck-mounted mobile emergency generators have been extensively considered as the most efficient back-up resource that enhances the resilience of the power grid (PG) under extreme situations such as natural disasters and artificial damages. Motivated by the recent progress in MES-based reconfiguration, this paper proposes a novel two-stage reconfiguration model, minimizing the outage duration of loads according to their proportional priorities, consists of pre-positioning and dynamic allocation using stochastic optimization sequentially from the perspective of resilience optimization. The proposed framework and the applied algorithm are validated with the modified IEEE 30-bus radial distribution network test, and the numerical results confirm that the proposed reconfiguration model can promote resilience of the power grid effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Microgrid Relay Protection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of the distributed power source makes the microgrid have the characteristics of complex topology and two-way flow of the power flow, and the fault output current of the power electronic interface power supply is different from the traditional synchronous power supply, which makes it difficult for the conventional distribution network relay protection to operate reliably and quickly. In this paper, the equivalent output model of different types of power supplies in microgrid under normal operation and fault conditions is analyzed. According to the difference of electrical quantity characteristics before and after the fault, a microgrid relay protection scheme including multiple principles is formed, which can occur in different lines. It has a good practicability to accurately determine the occurrence of faults and identify faults inside and outside the line segment when different types of faults occur. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: Tolerance Evaluation of Typical Building Energy Systems with Imprecise Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The design of building energy systems is derived by load prediction data. Though many kinds of load forecasting methods have been developed over the decades, accurate load data cannot be acquired before heating/cooling demand happens in the energy system. Therefore, the ability of a building energy system to maintain good performance even when the heating/cooling demand curves diverge from the forecasted load curve is very important. In this discussion, such ability is defined as building energy system’s tolerance. The tolerances of three typical building cooling systems have been calculated and discussed combined with case studies. Eight cooling load curves are proposed from stochastic disturbances to simulate uncertainty and fluctuating cooling demand. The fluctuation ratio of each energy system’s annual return on investment is used as an evaluation indicator. The variation of the yearly economic efficiency of three cooling energy systems is compared, and the main influencing factors that affect the system’s tolerance are analyzed when the load curve changed. Combined with the tolerance evaluation of three typical building cooling energy systems, a simplified equation for tolerance evaluation of building energy systems is proposed and verified.

articleTitle: Influence of Filter Reactance on Input and Output Characteristics of DC De-Icer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Direct current (DC) de-icer has been widely used in China since the 2008 ice disaster. In the existing analysis and calculation of the characteristics for DC de-icer, the influence of filter reactance is generally neglected to simplify, thus the results are greatly deviated from actual situation. In this paper, the input and output characteristics of DC de-icer are well studied considering the influence of the filter reactance. The equivalent circuit model of DC-side and alternating current (AC) side fundamental frequency equivalent models in DC deicer is established, and the filter reactance size and ice melting device are obtained. The quantitative relationship between the filter reactance and the key parameters of the DC de-icer is obtained, which provides a basis for the characteristic analysis of the ice melting system and the fine design of the device parameters.

articleTitle: The Influence of Overhead Collector Feeder on the Stability of Grid-connected Renewable Energy Multi-Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution parameters of overhead collector feeders in wind farm and photovoltaic power converters have a great influence on the resonance of LCL filters, where the new challenges are brought to the design of converter control system. In order to investigate the impact of the renewable energy power plant collector system on the stability of grid-connected multi-converters, a mathematical model for multi-converters system is developed. The network admittance matrix is presented in the complex frequency domain to analyze the frequency characteristics. It is shown that the influence on the stability of converters varies with topological form and feeder length in the overhead collector system. The validity of the relevant conclusion is verified by simulation results based on MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Method for Improving the Dynamic Stability of Grid based on PSS Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Dynamical stability of power system is the periodical divergence caused by insufficient damping in the dynamical process. The dynamical stability level which is affected largely by the parameter change of power system stabilizer (PSS) is found in the actual power grid operation. Influence of PSS parameter optimization on dynamic stability level and its influencing factors is introduced to optimize the PSS parameter. The effectiveness and correctness of the method are verified by the application of the proposed method in regional power network.

articleTitle: LowFrequency Oscillation Mode Source Identification with Wide-Area Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It can avoid low frequency oscillation in power grid if we can detect the oscillation mode with low damping ratio and identify the source in early stage. This paper presents the Frequency Domain Decomposition (FDD) method, which can extract the low frequency oscillation modes from measurements of Phasor Measurement Units (PMU) in normal operation condition. The damping ratio, modal frequency and the mode shape of poorly damped oscillatory modes can be directly determined from ambient PMU measurements. After the oscillation modes are identified by FCC method, the next step is to identify the source of oscillation modes and the Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) method is proposed. Combined with FDD and PCC from status data in energy management system (EMS) and the oscillation mode results, we can identify the source of oscillation mode with high correlations. The case study shows that the combination of FDD and PCC is a very efficient way to process large volume of WAMS data and EMS data, identifying low frequency oscillation mode source, and provide possible way to take early actions preventing low frequency oscillation in power system.

articleTitle: Development of Non-contact Traveling Wave Sensor Based on Tunnel Magnetoresistance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Sensitivity of traveling wave detection plays a decisive role in the accuracy of traveling wave positioning. This paper firstly analyzes the tunnel magnetoresistance as a quantum effect, and illustrates the tunnel magnetoresistance effect based on Slonczewski theory. Mechanism of tunnel magnetoresistance measurement for traveling wave signal is analyzed. The amplification and filtering circuit is designed and the TMR2701 chip is designed. High-precision traveling wave sensor has been developed. Simulation and experiments show that the non-contact sensor can correctly transmit signals up to 50MHz, and the detection sensitivity reaches mA level. Based on theoretical calculation, the transition resistance of the distribution network can be detected up to 8kΩ, and ground fault location is better than the current fault location indicator of the distribution network.

articleTitle: A cooperative game based fair-efficient trading model in global green energy market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper considers that many countries are connected in a global green energy market. The purpose of the work is to propose a trading model that guarantees the efficiency to maximize total system gains and the fairness of cooperative gain allocation to ensure trading stability. A cooperative game based trading model is designed for the market. In the model, a dynamic pricing rule is proposed to decide which countries are allowed to participate in trading, so as to maximize the cooperative gains. A Shapley value based method is used to fairly allocate the cooperative gains based on the marginal contributions of countries. Experimental results show that the proposed model can achieve both efficiency and fairness, which encourages countries to participate in trading more actively.

articleTitle: A Transformer Winding Deformation Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Improved Directed Acyclic Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transformer winding is an important component of transformer. The faults caused by mechanical deformation of windings is about 15% of the total transformer.This paper presents a transformer winding deformation fault diagnosis method based on improved directed acyclic graph support vector machine (DAG-SVM). The most easily distinguished types are arranged in the upper layer of digraph to reduce the cumulative error and make up for the fault tolerance ability of digraph. In this paper, three-phase transformer is selected to carry out tests to verify the effectiveness of this method. Firstly, the vibration signals of windings under normal and fault conditions are obtained through experiments. Secondly, feature extraction of vibration signal is carried out by energy entropy decomposition of wavelet packet. Thirdly, the improved DAG-SVM is constructed by using the distance measure between classes. Finally, the improved DAG-SVM is used for transformer winding deformation fault diagnosis. The results show that this method is superior to traditional methods in accuracy and time-consuming diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Household Energy Consumption Based on Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of household living conditions in China, energy consumption has increased rapidly. However, it is still nearly blank in the study of estimating the comprehensive energy consumption directing at household. This paper researches the method of comprehensive energy consumption estimation for community and household under the influence of multiple factors. It is proposed that the adjusted energy consumption calculating by least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) method. In order to prove the superiority of this way, the data of comprehensive energy consumption in Changzhou City is analyzed as an example. Finally, it is found that LASSO method has higher fitting degree, smaller annual average error and smaller monthly average error. It is proved that the LASSO method is feasible.

articleTitle: Effect of SF6 Liquid Droplets on Electric Field Distribution of Porcelain Bushing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The liquefaction of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is of great significance for the safe and stable operation of equipment. The effect of liquefying SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas droplets on the bushing inner wall to the internal electric field distribution of porcelain bushing is considered from the viewpoint of safety and stability operation of the equipment. The liquid drops model of porcelain bushing for 500 kV SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> tank breaker is simulated and calculated, and the maximum electric field in the bushing is in the position of the ground shield, and corresponding guide rod is obtained. At the place of ground shield guide rod, the inner electric field of bushing formed a structure similar to the needle plate electrode structure in which the maximum field strength value and position are determined, and the presence of the liquid drops has little effect on the electric field distribution that inside and outside the porcelain bushing.

articleTitle: Applicability evaluation of wind power aggregation models for bulk system dynamic analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Generic wind turbine generator models for electrical simulation have been published successively in recent years by international joint task forces. However, owning to the rapid increase of both onshore and offshore large-scale centralized Wind Power Plant (WPP) comprising up to hundreds of individual wind turbines, a detailed modeling approach of presenting all relevant components of each individual Wind Turbine (WT) in the WPP leads to unbearable computation complexity. In this context, aggregated modeling approaches of large-scale WPP are more appropriate for bulk system analysis, particularly for the transient stability studies. This paper aims at evaluating the applicability of different methodologies of aggregating WPP models as reviewed in literature. Computation complexity, accuracy of power load- flow calculation and transient simulation results are chosen as the main evaluation criteria. According to the test results, the aggregated WPP models investigated in this paper has a significant advantage on computation burden and a satisfying tradeoff on simulation accuracy compared to the detailed modeling approach, and the suggested aggregation model could be easily replicated in further system planning and operation with high renewable penetration.

articleTitle: Dynamic Optimization for Generator Start-up in Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: After blackouts, successful generator start-up is the premise of load recovery and foundation of power system restoration. The purpose of generator start-up optimization is to obtain the generator start-up sequence and the corresponding restoration paths. During generator start-up, the status of power system is constantly changing and unpredictable. Considering the uncertain situation, a dynamic optimization strategy for generator start-up in network reconfiguration is proposed in this paper. Moreover, considering the high discreteness of the optimization model, a modified Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed to solve the generator start-up problem. Based on the algorithm, the generator start-up scheme is modified through rolling optimization during the generator start-up. The New England 10-unit and 39-bus system is used to demonstrate that the proposed strategy can modify the generator start-up scheme effectively and obtain the better optimization results.

articleTitle: Accurate Modeling and Simulation of Distribution Network Engineering Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The simulation model for study on grounding faults of distribution network is often too simple, such as the problems of the incomplete access devices, the oversimplified network structure and the incorrect components parameters, which may lead to incorrect understanding of electrical characteristics of grounding fault. Aiming at single-phase grounding fault analysis, on basis of extensive investigation of typical network structure and access equipment, equipment selection and parameter calculation are carried out according to the design standard and specification. Then the system simulation model of system reflecting the engineering practice is established by adopting the accurate element and the network model. What's more, the influence of access equipment on grounding fault is defined.

articleTitle: An Approach for Resistance Parameter Identification of Transmission Line Based on Electric Energy Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of power grid and the massive access of renewable energy sources, the operation characteristics of large power grid are becoming more and more complex. Meanwhile requirements for lean dispatching of power grid are also increasing. Lean operation of power grid with minimum network loss as target is based on the resistance parameter of transmission line. However, the identification of lines is easily affected by the amplitude of voltage, so the results are low in reliability. Considering the comprehensive errors of corona losses and electric energy meter data of high-voltage transmission lines, this paper proposes a method of resistance parameter identification based on monthly electric energy data. The measurement error equations are constructed by using multi historical monthly electric energy data and supervisory control and data acquisition current data. Practical system examples prove the validity and correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Secondary Circuit Monitoring Method for High Voltage Metering System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage and current loss have a serious impact on the safe and stable operation of high-voltage metering system. For high voltage power metering system, a secondary circuit fault diagnosis method based on particle filter and deep belief network classifier is proposed. The common voltage loss and current loss faults of voltage loops and current loops are studied and the zero sequence components of voltage and current signals are taken as the fault feature according to the three-phase unbalance caused by the loss of voltage and current loss fault. In order to remove a large amount of harmonics, white noise contained in the original zero sequence signal, it is proposed that using the important sample adjustment particle filter algorithm of neural network to extract the amplitude and phase of the fundamental zero-order component, which is used as training samples and input signals. Deep belief network classifier is used to classify and identity secondary circuit faults in high voltage power metering system. The experimental results show that the proposed secondary loop fault diagnosis method for high-voltage power metering system can achieve accurate judgment of the fault.

articleTitle: State Assessment of Relay Protection Device Based on Defect Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the state assessment of relay protection device gray and fuzzy, an analytical method based on the combination of grey correlation analysis and apriori correlation analysis is proposed in this paper. Defect information data from the operation and maintenance of actual substations are used to assess and predict the status of relay protection devices which are affected by different manufacturers, different equipment types, operation time and maintenance records. Seven types of correlation rules are obtained in the research, and the analytical results can provide a strong scientific basis for targeted maintenance and operation plans based on the specific results in the correlation rules. The results provide a software package for the evaluation of relay protection devices in a regional substation of Shanghai power supply company of the State Grid.

articleTitle: Research Framework of the Human-Cyber-Energy Coupled Urban Energy Internet Catastrophe Analysis and Its Dynamic Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the Urban Energy Internet (UEI), any partial and weak faults may be transmitted to other subsystems through cyber and energy spaces, which may increase the risk of system catastrophe, ranging from small scale to large scale, from single system to multi-system, and from minor accidents to system crashed. Therefore, the analysis of the catastrophe in UEI is urgently needed. In this paper, a research framework of UEI catastrophe analysis and its dynamic early warning mechanism are constructed, based on the integration of human, cyber and energy in UEI, which aims at quantifying the potential catastrophic risks of the human-cyber-energy coupling system. First, the interaction mechanism among human, cyber and energy are analyzed. Secondly, the hybrid model of UEI calculation of probabilistic energy flow based on the dynamic probability method is developed. Furthermore, based on the analysis of catastrophe propagation and evolution mechanism of the human-cyber-energy space, the catastrophe analysis method for coupling system is analyzed, and indicators and assessment methods for characterizing the local and overall disaster-resistant status of UEI. On this foundation, the dynamic early warning mechanism of catastrophe based on artificial immune system is constructed. Finally, the comprehensive simulation architecture of catastrophe analysis and early warning mechanism for UEI are developed to verify the validity of the theoretical methods. The expected achievements of this framework proposed in this paper can provide theoretical support for the planning and operation of UEI.

articleTitle: A Semi-smooth Projected Levenberg-Marquardt Power Flow Method to Cope With the Constraints Exchange Issue
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the conventional power flow (PF) calculation, when using the PV-PQ bus switching to deal with the problem of the generator buses reactive power limits violation for power systems, this method may cause the power flow calculation to fail. If using the Fischer-Burmeister (FB) function to handle constraint exchange issues, then using the Newton-Raphson (NR) method to solve PF, this operation will lead to a slow convergence. In this paper, a semi-smooth projected Levenberg-Marquardt (PLM) power flow method based on the FB function to deal with the constraints exchange issues is proposed. This method can change the search direction when the constraint exchange positions are at sharp corners, and adjust the size of the trust region to prevent the power flow from divergence due to excessive step size in the iterative process, thus improving convergence and reliability. Furthermore, the traditional power flow calculation method is sensitive to the initial value, which may cause the PF divergence, however the method of PLM proposed in this paper is globally convergent, which is not sensitive to the initial value. Numerical tests implemented on a small 3-bus network and a modified IEEE 118-bus system show that the proposed method is more efficient and robust than existing methods.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Joint Operation Risk Control of Virtual Power Plant Power Selling Company
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In China's current power market, traditional energy companies generally do not enjoy preferential policies, and need to face fierce competition. However, the industrial background and marketization policies of renewable energy and traditional power supply are different, so the risk factors of traditional power generation enterprises for different markets and the risk control optimization model constructed are not applicable to renewable energy power selling companies. At present, policies on the entry of distributed power supply into the power market was issued, and the government gradually reduce the subsidy price to encourage distributed power supply to participate in the power market transactions as power selling companies, so it is necessary to study and optimize the risk control of distributed power supply companies. Virtual power plant is an effective form for distributed power supply to participate in market transactions as a power selling company. This paper studies from the perspective of risk operation control, a virtual power plant operation risk optimization model is constructed, and industry development trend analysis is combined to help power selling companies control the impact of policy risk.

articleTitle: Emergency Power Control Technology for Wind Power and Photovoltaic Power to Improve New Energy Consumption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A cluster of renewable energy is formed in China based on UHVDC transmission systems. The renewable energy accommodation is constrained by DC power transmission and grid-connected power of renewable energy. In order to improve the absorption capacity of renewable energy, the fast control characteristics of renewable energy (wind power, photovoltaic) inverters and the necessity of incorporating renewable energy power control into emergency are analyzed. Aiming at the energy equipment control, communication status and active and reactive power control capabilities, the technical requirements of integrating the renewable energy into the communication delay of the emergency control and the real-time sensing of the controllable power are studied. Moreover, based on the actual grid, the effectiveness of the proposed control architecture and control method are verified via the simulation, which can effectively improve the consumption of new energy and maintain grid-connected operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment of Mobile Energy Storage Based on Life Cycle Cost-benefit Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently with the broadening of the electricity sales market and the growing development of energy storage technology, the issues of mobile energy storage investment planning have become imperative. The function and operation mode of multi-investors mobile energy storage will no longer be single. Based on life cycle cost-benefit analysis, this paper proposes different operating modes for various investment entities of mobile energy storage. Also, the feasibility of the business model is evaluated by case study, and the impact of the investment recovery period and transaction price of mobile energy storage under different application scenarios is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Distribution Network CPS Security Impact
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The improvement of communication and information technology has greatly enhanced the observability and controllability of distribution network. It is necessary to further study the operation characteristics of distribution network from the perspective of CPS. This paper mainly studies the security impact mechanism of distribution network based on CPS. Firstly, the method of CPS network attack in distribution network is proposed. Secondly, the coupling mechanism and transmission mechanism of risk between information space and power space are studied. Finally, how power system faults react on information space and form information security threat is analyzed, and the mechanism of reverse transmission is simulated. Furthermore, the validity of the model is verified.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation System and Evaluation Method For Anti-birds Damage Technical Transformation Projects of Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Implementation of technical reform measures for anti-birds damage of overhead lines can effectively reduce the occurrence of power grid accidents, which is an important means to ensure the safety and stability of power grid operation and improve the level of equipment operation. Firstly, this paper sorts out the mechanism of bird damage on overhead lines and common protective measures. Then, an evaluation index system is put forward from four aspects: bird tripping, bird damage outage, damage of bird pecking equipment and reducing unit investment loss. The weight index is introduced into AHP-TOPSIS which is a new method to evaluate the effects of the technical transformation project comprehensively.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism and Benefits of Frequency Regulation of Energy Storage Combined with Thermal Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage has fast response characteristics and precise regulation performance, and has unique advantages in power system frequency regulation. Taking the US PJM and the British National Grid as examples, the application of foreign energy storage devices in the frequency regulation service market is analyzed. This paper studies the frequency regulation performance of comprehensive adjustment rate, adjustment precision and response time, and proposes a two-part frequency regulation price mechanism that considers the adjustment effect of "mileage compensation and capacity compensation". On this basis, it analyzes the basic situation of frequency regulation of combined thermal power units in China's energy storage facilities. Taking the province's frequency regulation auxiliary service market as an example, the investment benefit analysis of the energy storage combined thermal power unit under different mileage quotations is carried out. The case results show that the energy storage can greatly improve the overall frequency regulation performance parameters of the project, improve the quotation ranking in the frequency regulation market, and increase the economic benefits of the project.

articleTitle: Automatic generation control of power system using Deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, deep neural network predictive controller (DNNPC) is used to control the load frequency of interconnected distribution networks. The proposed algorithm can ensure that the steady-state error of the load frequency and the connection power are maintained within a given range. The performance of the controller is verified by the MATLAB/SIMULINK toolkit. The simulation results show that the algorithm can be effectively applied to automatic generation control (AGC) study of power system with different degrees of complexity and nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Medium and Long Term Trading Portfolio Optimizing Decision of Power Grid Company under Renewable Energy Quota
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Strategic choices for energy conservation, emission reduction and a low carbon society can be achieved when the renewable energy portfolio standards are implemented. It is an urgent problem that how to maximize the revenue of grid companies in medium and long-term transactions based on the renewable energy portfolio standards. The medium- and long-term trading model of grid companies based on contract transactions and centralized bidding transactions is established in this paper. The completion of renewable energy portfolio standards could be guaranteed by grid companies in accordance with green certificate transactions. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to resolve the problem on case study. The simulation results show that grid companies should shift their power purchase strategies in the context of renewable portfolio standard.

articleTitle: A Detection Method of Harmonic and Interharmonic Using Window Interpolation and Complex Modulation Refinement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When there is interharmonics in the vicinity of the fundamental or harmonics, the serious spectral interference will affect the detection accuracy of harmonics and interharmonics. In this paper, a comprehensive analysis method combined window interpolation with multiple modulation zoom spectrum is proposed. Based on the phase difference between the maximum and the second largest lines in the mainlobe of the windowed signal, the method determines whether the peak line has mainlobe interference. If mainlobe interference exists, the multiple modulation zoom spectrum is refined in a certain frequency range with the maximum spectrum as the center frequency, and the harmonic and interharmonics parameters near the frequency band are obtained. If there is no mainlobe interference, the harmonic and inter-harmonic parameters at the frequency band are obtained directly by windowed interpolation. The other harmonics and interharmonic components of the signal are obtained by repeating the above steps. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively dispose the complex signals of harmonics and interharmonics with closing frequencies.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Stochastic Scheduling Optimization Model for Virtual Power Plants with Carbon Emission Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, wind power plant, photovoltaic generation, biomass power generation, energy storage, convention gas turbine and flexible load are defined as virtual power plant (VPP). In order to further reduce the risk of wind/solar uncertainty, the objective function of minimizing operational risk is constructed by conditional risk at value (CVaR), and the constraints of uncertain variables are transformed by robust stochastic optimization theory. The multi-objective risk aversion optimization model of VPP is constructed by choosing the maximum operating income and minimizing total carbon emissions. Finally, an improved IEEE30-bus system is selected to carry out an example analysis. The results show that: (1) The risk aversion model can take into account the multiple demands of benefits, risks and carbon emissions; in particular, when the robustness coefficient is less than 0.85, smaller uncertainties will bring greater risks, indicating that decision makers'risk attitudes will affect the VPP scheduling scheme; (2) When the prediction error E is high, the same growth rate will bring the higher growth rate of CVaR, which indicates that the lower prediction accuracy will magnify the uncertainty risk. Decision makers need to improve the prediction accuracy to reduce the operational risk of VPP; (3) Maximum total emission allocation (MTEA) can highlight the environmental friendliness of clean energy and realize the optimal balanced operation of VPP as a whole. In conclusion, the model can provide decision support for decision-making to formulate optimal VPP scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Classification of Consumer Behavior Analysis in Transformer Areas Under the Integrated Energy Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of the integrated energy market, the potential value of power big data is being excavated. Based on power big data, firstly, this paper classifies the transformer areas in accordance with the characteristics of the typical distribution areas. Then, the power users in the integrated energy environment are classified, and the typical power consumption mode is defined. According to the user’s power consumption index system, the preference strategy of user’s power consumption is formulated. In accordance with the characteristics of the strategy, redundant information in power consumption data can be removed, analysis performance can be improved, and analysis process can be simplified. The improved FCM is used to classify and analyze the power consumption behavior of different users. Finally, simulations on MATLAB show the effectivity of the users classification.

articleTitle: Power Supply Recovery Strategy of Distribution Network Based on Weak Voltage Area Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault recovery of the distribution network is actually the transfer of load in the power loss area to the contact reserve with the remaining capacity through the operation of the switch or the DG running on the island, which is a multi-objective and multi-constrained optimization problem. This paper introduces the recognition method of the weak voltage area, and then the recoverable areas are formed by eliminating nodes in the weak voltage areas. The importance of the outage load in the recovery process is ranked, and the model of the load recovery is built considering income, risks and costs. The heuristic search algorithm is used as the solution method, which optimizes the target nodes and recovery paths in the recovery process. Finally, a test system is developed to verify the rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Multi-temporal Anomaly Analysis Wildfire Detection Method for Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fengyun 4A (FY-4A), the first of China's second-generation geostationary orbiting weather satellites carries a novel optical instrument named Advanced Geosynchronous Radiation Imager (AGRI). An active wildfire detection method based on the AGRI data was developed and tested in this paper. Most of the existing wildfire detection methods were developed on the spectral features of pixels while the temporal characteristics of observed values were ignored. In the proposed method, multi-temporal AGRI data were used to construct time series for each pixel and the fire pixel detection problem is transferred into an anomaly analysis problem. Wildfire pixels can be detected by analyzing characteristics of variation trend value and contextual tests confirmation. To assess the performance of proposed method, the corridor areas within 3 km of electrical transmission lines in China were selected as study areas. Wildfire detection results demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed method with higher sensitivity to detect even small fires and a low wildfire omission error rate.

articleTitle: Feedforward Control Strategy of LCC-HVDC Receiving End Based on Synchronous Condenser Excitation Current
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCC-HVDC receiving end system based on ABB's strategy increases the fixed extinction angle γ after voltage drop, and over-compensation may exist. Meanwhile, the strategy based on SIEMENS uses PI regulation when system occurs fault, and the speed is slow. Aiming at the shortcomings of the above strategies, this paper establishes the relationship between the bus voltage and the synchronous condenser (SC) excitation current If during the fault, and then proposes the feedforward control strategy of receiving terminal based on the SC excitation current. Realizing that when the fault occurs, the bus voltage drops, in the meantime, If suddenly increases, the feedforward control amount Δβ that changes with If is immediately added to the SIEMENS control link, and the firing angle α is decreased to increase the commutation margin, thereby suppressing the commutation failure or continuous commutation failure. Based on the ±800kV QISHAO UHVDC engineering parameters, the model was built in PSCAD, and the effectiveness of the proposed feedforward control strategy was verified under the single-phase grounding fault with different severity on the AC side. The results show that the proposed strategy can significantly improve the ability of LCC-HVDC to resist commutation failure and improve DC system fault recovery characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Indices and Assessment Methods of Offshore Multi-platform Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Offshore multi-platform integrated energy system (IES) is multi-energy coupling oriented to meet the various load needs of users for power, gas, cold and heat. Firstly, the basic structure of offshore multi-platform IES is analyzed and divided into five links: energy coupling, transmission, conversion, consumption and storage. Focusing on the five evaluation criteria of economy, efficiency, safety, flexibility and adaptability, more micro-indicators are proposed for IES evaluation, and the definition and evaluation standard of each index are elaborated in detail. Furthermore, the index value is standardized and the index weight is determined by the improved analytic hierarchy processentropy weight method, by which IES can be evaluated. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed evaluation indices and assessment methods are verified in practical cases.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Data Pool and the Management Model of Data Pool Integrating Block Chain Concept for Ubiquitous Electric Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve the development goal of the power grid company to build a ubiquitous electric power Internet of things in 2024, the Development Department needs to speed up the construction. However, due to the lack of a unified data management platform in Development Department, there are many problems in data application and management, such as heavy workload, high repeatability and poor consistency. Improvements of distribution network informatization can standardize the data management of business development, and realize the construction of network platform. This paper introduces the application of routine business, data management and information system of the Development Department to carry out data demand analysis based on the results of business work, build a data platform of distribution network supporting the development of business needs, and integrate the concept of block chain to formulate the accounting, storage, consensus and incentive of distribution network data pool. The mechanism provides support guarantee for promoting the implementation and application of distribution network data pool.

Author Keywords: the data pool of distribution network
ubiquitous electric power internet of things

articleTitle: Business Evaluation Model using the Modified Analytic Hierarchy Process and Grey Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The challenges that utility companies have to face is the traditional business model in the reform of domestic power system. Therefore, innovative business models are required to promote the development of the utility companies. The most important issue is that the utility companies should establish evaluation models fitting to their new requirements. The combination of modified analytic hierarchy process and grey evaluation method is proposed to evaluate the new business model. A new structure of the index system is presented for the new business model evaluation, and the traditional analytic hierarchy process is modified to compute the index weights. Moreover, scores of each business model is provided by experts in accordance with the index system. The grey whitening weight function method is used for each business model to compute the grey evaluation coefficient and grey evaluation weight. Finally, the comprehensive benefit value of the business model is obtained by multiplying the index weight vector and the grey evaluation weight vector. Simulation studies on three business models shows the proposed method can be used to help the utility companies to evaluate business models.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Commutation Failure Caused by Inrush Current Based on Multi-Principal Elements Modal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The inrush current generated in the process of no-load closing of transformer is not only prone to misoperation of transformer relay protection, but also has adverse effects on transformer equipment and power grid. This includes adverse effects on the commutation process of the High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission system. The main manifestation is the influence of harmonic voltage and fundamental voltage changes caused by inrush current on the commutation process of inverter's AC bus. In serious cases, it may lead to commutation failure of the HVDC system or even the continuous commutation failure. In this paper, at first, the influence mechanism of commutation failure of HVDC system caused by inrush current is discussed. On this basis, multi-principal elements model analysis method is proposed to analyze the distortion of the inverter's AC bus voltage when the no-load transformer is closed at different positions. In this paper, the DC system model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. For the built model, the no-load closing operation is carried out at different positions of the AC grid, and the influence degree of the bus voltage of the converter station caused by each harmonic wave is calculated, and is characterized the risk of commutation failure. In addition, the relevant measurements to suppress the inrush current are simulated and analyzed. It is of great significance to further ensure the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Virtual Inertia and Damping for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high share of renewable energy sources and retirement of conventional synchronous generators make that rotational inertia and damping in power system is much less than before. The frequency may experience higher magnititude of oscillations when the contingency happens. Some inverter-interfaced power electronic devices such as energy storage can emulate virtual inertia and damping to respond to the frequency deviation in power system. However, there is still a problem that where and how much virtual inertia and damping is emulated to have the desired transient frequency performance such as desired damping ratio and frequency overshoot for a small disturbance in power system. Authors in this work employ mix-integer differential algorithm to solve this nonlinear optimization problem, and the appropriate energy storage in power system can be selected and the corresponding virtual inertia and damping can be determined.

articleTitle: Candidate Bus Selection Method for VAR planning of Wind-penetrated Power System based on Morris Screening Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Candidate bus is a critical determinant of an effective and economical VAR planning. This paper proposes a novel candidate bus selection method based on Latin hypercube Sampling based Morris Screening Method, aiming to identifying the most efficient and effective buses as the candidate buses for VAR planning. Wind power uncertainties and the load dynamics are considered in this method, which makes the proposed method more practical. Complex load model is also considered in this paper to address the adverse impact of the induction motor loads on the power system. Cases studies are carried out on the New England 39-bus test system. Time- domain simulation results obtained from PSS®E demonstrate that the proposed method is effective with acceptable computation complexity.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electric Vehicles Dispatching Potential Considering Multiple Travel Needs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the explosive growth of electric vehicles (EVs), disordered charging behaviors of household EVs may have a significant effect on the smart grid operation. To evaluate the dispatching potential of massive EVs' charging load precisely can help system operators make rational market mechanism to call EV resources for economic and secure planning and operation. A relatively accurate method to evaluate dispatching potential of EVs is proposed here, offsetting the shortcomings of previous research, neglecting the correlation of different travel parameters and user's multiple travel needs. From the angle of household EV users' daily trip behaviors, especially traveling several times a day, the probability distribution models of random travel parameters (i.e. trip start-time, end-time and distance of trips, etc.) are fitted according to an industrial survey.
