Considering the charging characteristics of EV battery and the coupling characteristics of multiple parameters, random values are generated based on copula function, to simulate the expectation of EVs disordered charging load within a residential community. Considering the multi-period load shifting ratio and willingness of users under electricity price mechanism, the dispatching potential of EVs under certain willingness is quantitatively evaluated. The simulation shows that reasonable and meticulous evaluation of EVs dispatching potential considering multiple travel needs is significant for effectively guiding the orderly charging of EVs and suppressing the peak-valley load difference.

articleTitle: Tech-economic Evaluation of Typical Distribution Network Structures for Planning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distribution network is an important part of the power grid and bears an important responsibility for supplying power to end users. In the investment and planning of distribution network, economy and reliability are always opposite. In order to provide a basis for rapid primary selection of the network structure in the future distribution network investment and planning process, this paper makes a reasonable evaluation of several typical distribution network structures. Firstly, several typical distribution network structures are introduced, including single radiation network, single-ring network, double-ring network and petal network. Then, the relevant indexes for evaluating the network structure, the reliability and the economics are introduced respectively, including the typical tech-economic evaluation indexes such as network transfer capability (TC), average service availability index (ASAI) and unit load cost, etc. Finally, based on these indexes, several network structures are compared and analyzed. The economic and reliability changes of various networks under different load conditions are evaluated. Finally, the applicable range of various networks is obtained based on the results of sensitivity analysis.

articleTitle: Research on State Evolution of Power Grid Based on Random Matrix Theory Indicators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With fast development of the ubiquitous power internet of things, the limitations of model-based methods of power grid state evolution are gradually revealed, which are always of high time complexity and highly depend on expert experience. By mining the evolution characteristics of the grid operation data, this paper proposes three random matrix theory indicators considering three perspectives to evaluate the operation state of the power grid. Firstly, the nodal voltage is used instead of the line load ratio to construct a high-dimensional data matrix; with the use of random matrix theory, the evaluating indicators are constructed to correctly map the factors affecting the evolution of the grid state to data changes. Finally, through the simulation example of the IEEE39-bus system, the proposed random matrix indicators and the evaluation method can effectively characterize the state of the grid, which can meet the requirements of real-time dynamic monitoring of power grid.

articleTitle: Risk Control Optimization Models of Different Power Market Purchasing Combinations of Power Selling Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the basis of risk control in each market, power selling companies comprehensively consider the costs and benefits of all levels of power market, as well as getting the risk and benefit balance strategy by coordinating the proportion of electricity distribution in different markets. In the early stage of the development of the electricity market, the risk and return can be considered to be unequal. In this paper, the definition of skewness in the financial field is introduced. Based on the typical portfolio optimization models of different power market cost, income analysis and risk-return, the optimal model of power purchase risk control with portfolio skewness constraint or maximum skewness is constructed. An example is given to verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Online Diagnosis for Transformer Winding Deformation Based on Information Entropy and SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transformer winding may be deformed after suffering short circuit, which brings hidden danger to the operation and control of power system. Existing offline diagnosis methods for winding deformation not only reduce operation efficiency but also impact residents' life. To improve the accuracy and efficiency of winding deformation diagnosis, an intelligent online diagnosis method for winding deformation based on information entropy and support vector machine is proposed. This method uses permutation entropy, wavelet energy entropy, and expert knowledge to extract the fault feature from online monitoring signals and then uses support vector machine to learn the diagnosis rules from the fault features, thereby reducing the labor cost and improving the diagnosis efficiency. In the experiment part, the real operation data of 29 transformers is used to train and test the online winding deformation diagnosis model. The results show that the diagnosis accuracy of whether the transformer has been deformed is 93.10%, and the diagnosis accuracy of the deformation position is 88.89%, which proves its validity and practicability.

articleTitle: Modeling of aggregated wind power generation’s active participation to system frequency regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to today’s system planning approach and grid codes regarding power system’s secure operation, the system’s primary frequency reserve is sized to cover the most critical instantaneous incident, i.e., the loss of the largest online power plant. Along with the process of low-carbon energy transition worldwide, however, the increasing renewable share in power system is displacing those conventional generation fleets, leading to the reduction on system inertia and spinning reserve quantity. Certain transmission system operators (TSOs) and market regulators in different countries have requested the newly connected wind turbine generations (WTGs) to have the ability of providing primary frequency support in order to ensure system security in the case of lacking system reserve capacity, particularly during the periods with very high renewable penetration level. This paper presents a methodology of modeling aggregated active behaviors of wind power generation’s primary frequency response, which could be applied in further planning and operation studies regarding bulk power system dynamic analysis.

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Detecting Method for Wind Turbine Blade by Using Robots
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a non-destructive method that uses robots with suitable sensing technologies to detect faults on blades of wind turbines. In this paper, common types of defects on blades are introduced for better understanding of the detecting method; the path planning method of wheeled mobile robots is studied for implementing effective inspection on blades commonly used non-destructive testing methods are described to find out how the methods can be combined with robots for faults detection on blades. Finally, from the material point of view, the infrared thermal imaging technology is chosen for the static detection and the acoustic emission signal detection technology is considered for the dynamic detection of wind turbine blades.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Based on R-SDBN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a self-organizing deep belief network with robust locally weighted scatterplot smoothing method (R-SDBN) for short-term load forecasting, which can not only organize the structure of short-term load forecasting automatically but also denoise the input load data. The deep belief network (DBN) integrates deep learning and feature learning. It can quickly analyze a large number of data and has a strong data fitting ability. And the robust locally weighted scatterplot smoothing (RLWSS) method is introduced to weaken the noise and correct the outlies of load data. However, the optimal structure of DBN and the optimal span of RLWSS are different given specific applications. In the proposed model, the structure of DBN and the span of RLWSS are selforganized with minimum root mean square error as objective, not selected by experience, during the training process, and they are modified after each forecasting. Taking the actual load of a certain city in China as an example, the root mean square error (RMSE), the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and the maximum absolute error (MAE) of the 24hour forecasting is 4.38MW, 6.54%, and 12.48MW respectively. Compared with the backward propagation neural network, support vector machine (SVM), and DBN, R-SDBN has remarkable advantages.

articleTitle: Overall Optimization and Design of Combined Cooling Heating and Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Today, global energy shortages and environmental pollution are getting worse. The global energy conservation and emission reduction situation is extremely severe, the combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system not only improves primary energy utilization, but also has great economic benefits. Therefore, it is considered to be an important trend in the development of future energy technologies. However, CCHP has significant features such as complex structure, varied working conditions, diverse modes, and mixed disturbances. There are many serious challenges to its optimal control. In response to this problem, this paper presents a collaborative optimization model for maximizing primary energy utilization and minimizing energy costs for CCHP systems. The discrete immune parallel evolutionary algorithm (DIPEA) was introduced to solve the optimal equipment selection and optimal operating parameters by establishing MATLAB simulation platform. And the optimization results of discrete immune parallel evolutionary algorithm (DIPEA) are compared with the optimization results of ant colony optimization (ACO) and genetic algorithm (GA). As simulation experiments show the DIPEA optimized CCHP system has higher primary energy utilization rate and greater economic benefits.

articleTitle: Technical Analysis of Intelligent Measurement Technology Innovation Under the Environment of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The smart metering infrastructure of comprehensive energy supply is the key to achieving high- quality energy measurement of "fairness, safety and efficiency" and creating a customer-centered enterprise customer community. Focusing on the realization of intelligent measurement targets in the energy Internet environment, this paper combs the innovative technologies from the four aspects of "measurement and terminals, communication network, acquisition master stations and business application" according to the characteristics of smart metering infrastructure, and forms total requirements through demand identification. On this basis, this paper gives implementation measures such as `lean measurement guarantee towards verification quality', `communication network and safety protection', `operation management for acquisition master stations towards massive data', and `demand-oriented business application' to meet the requirements `sufficiency, suitability and effectiveness' of the future design of smart metering. Through the research on the smart metering infrastructure of comprehensive energy supply dominated by electricity, this paper promotes the future energy network to meet the measurement needs of multiple energy sources (electricity, gas, water, heat, etc.), and realizes the coordinated operation of multiple energy types and the interconnection of multiple energy sources in energy internet.

articleTitle: Response Characteristics of the UHV Supporting Capacitor Subjected to Bidirectional Earthquakes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Supporting capacitors are the basic components of the filters in the UHV substation. However, this type of capacitor is vulnerable during the past earthquakes, for its dozens of tons mass, and relatively brittle insulators. In this study, modal properties and seismic responses of a typical UHV supporting capacitor were analyzed, based on a finite element model. Results indicate that seismic responses of the first translational mode of the capacitor in the two horizontal orthogonal directions are predominant, and the torsion effect can be ignored during the bidirectional earthquake. To further investigate the effect of the bidirectional earthquake, 7 ground motions with different field properties were adopted to calculate the unidirectional and bidirectional responses of the capacitor. Comparison between these two types of responses suggests the combined effect of the bidirectional earthquake can be fully considered by calculating the maximum unidirectional responses of the first translational mode based on a simplified response spectrum method, and multiplying the responses by an amplification factor. Taking both the calculation results and current seismic code in consideration, it is recommended that the amplification factors of the displacement responses and the stress responses related to the insulators are recommended as 1.15 and 1.20 respectively.

articleTitle: Study on Synthesis Load Modeling for North China Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly surveyed and classified all the 220kV substations of North China power grid, selected some typical substations for load characteristics investigation, and built the SLM (synthesis load modeling) of each class load using investigation on Component based method. At last, the SLM was popularized to the North China power grid. In addition, the impact of new load model to the security level of North China power grid was studied.

articleTitle: Coordinated Planning of Distribution Network of Source-Grid-Load Considering Multi-party Interaction and Demand-side Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of distributed generation access and the gradual implementation of various demand-side response projects, distribution network planning has been challenged to a certain extent. A coordinated planning method of the distribution network of source-grid-load considering multi-party interaction and demand-side response is proposed. In this paper, firstly, the planning and decision-making models of the DG (Distributed Generation) investment operator, the grid investment operator, and power users participating in DSR (Demand-side Response) are constructed separately. Then, the bi-level programming model is solved by combining the improved adaptive genetic algorithm. An IEEE33-bus example system verifies the correctness of the model and algorithm. The coordinated planning method reasonably determines the response plan of power users participating in DSR, realizing win-win benefits of "source-network-load" and promoting the optimal utilization of resources.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study of Data Flow Time Domain Feature in Power Internet of Things based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Functions of supervising and controlling for electrical elements and devices are well revealed on the basis of data flow, which is ubiquitous in widespread power internet of things. Although the data flow types are of great variety, different application scenarios are considered to classify them appropriately according to their features. In this paper, the mass data of widespread power internet of things are divided into three types, which are cyclic data, stochastic data, and burst data. The mathematical models are established based on their way of generating. Moreover, the time domain characteristics are studied thoroughly based on OPNET Modeler. The simulation results are helpful for the researchers to evaluate characteristics of various information systems, which are beneficial for system design and upgrade.

articleTitle: Study on the P2P Sharing Mode Operating Scheme of Consumer-side Distributed Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the popularization and application of consumer-side energy storage (ES) still have some problems, such as high cost, slow development of consumer-side energy storage technology and lack of business model for consumer- side distributed energy storage (DES). In this paper, a new distributed operation service model of peer to peer (P2P) is proposed. Users can share idle energy storage resources to gain profits. P2P sharing energy storage system (ESS) adopts a decentralized and flat transaction model. The concept and registration, publication, demand submission and contract signing, charge and discharge control, billing and settlement are studied. The rights and responsibilities of interest subjects are divided. Finally, this paper studies the billing and settlement mechanism, and carries out the benefit analysis of the sharing mode according to the actual case.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Electricity-Natural Gas Coupled System Considering Uncertainty of Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development and application of multienergy system, different energy sources can be converted and consumed alternatively, and the concept of integrated demand response (IDR) emerges accordingly. However, in the electricity-natural gas (ENG) coupled system, different energy users have various behavioral preferences that give rise to a high uncertainty of IDR. In order to formulate the optimal scheduling strategy more effectively, an optimal operation model for ENG system considering uncertainty of IDR is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to the actual characteristics of IDR implementation based on energy prices, the models of different IDR types under uncertainties are established by using fuzzy method and probabilistic method. Then, the optimal operation model is deployed by maximizing operation benefits of ENG system and taking the calculation results of the probabilistic energy flow by the point estimation method as the chance constraints. Finally, the validity of the proposed model and method is verified by an ENG system consisted of a modified IEEE-13 electricity system and 6-nodes natural gas system. The results show that considering the uncertainty of IDR, both economy and security will be boosted during system operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation and Investment Analysis of Energy Storage System Considering Multi-investors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As enterprises, institutions, communities and households continue building distributed power sources, the application market for energy storage is expanding, which is driving the rapid development of energy storage technology. At the same time, due to the implementation of the new power system reform plan, the power grid will enter into a new era of power sales, the monopoly of the power grid is broken, and different power sellers continue to emerge, providing a unique opportunity for the development of energy storage. Firstly, the typical energy storage modes of multi-investors are analyzed to meet their satisfaction. Also, the energy storage benefits obtained by different investment entities are analyzed. Finally, based on the full life cycle cost of energy storage, the investment boundaries of different energy storage capacities are calculated. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Substation Communication Traffic Prediction Based on QAPSO-RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an early warning mechanism of network traffic based on quantum adaptive particle swarm optimization-radial basis function (QAPSO-RBF) neural network. The QAPSO-RBF neural network prediction model predicts the range of traffic threshold in order to detect abnormal traffic firstly. Then an intelligent substation operating state evaluation model is proposed. By analyzing the real-time traffic, a stable state of the current intelligent substation communication network is obtained. The early warning mechanism of intelligent substation abnormal traffic can effectively detect abnormal traffic and warn in the intelligent substation communication network. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the warning mechanism in intelligent substation traffic and high accuracy of the QAPSO-RBF model.

articleTitle: Online Adaptive Learning Framework for Personalized Remaining Useful Life Prediction in a Heterogeneous Population
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Remaining useful life prediction techniques are of practical and theoretical interest in recent years because of its significance in enhancing the safety and reliability of equipment. The degradation process of equipment is generally personalized due to its specific operating context. This behavior is commonly defined as individual variability or heterogeneous, which brings two difficulties in RUL prediction: one is lack of enough historical examples, and the other is the absence of personalized characteristics of the equipment in its fault prognostics. This paper proposes an online adaptive learning framework to resolve those difficulties. Considering the impact of equipment's personalized characteristics on fault prognostics, the similarity-based and the regression-based RUL prediction approaches are respectively presented in the prognostics framework. The similarity-based approach selects similar historical examples to predict the RUL, and the regression-based approach predicts the RUL with only current health monitoring of the equipment to be prognosticated. Those approaches are adaptively integrated with an online learning process to resolve the difficulty of lacking enough historical examples. Theoretical and experimental results both verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Calibration System for Merging Unit Test Equipments
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Today the problem of lacking effective calibration means for two key test function Indicators(delay characteristics and precision) of substation merging unit (MU) performance test equipment still exists. Under the background, this paper presents a calibration method for MU performance test equipment, develops a relevant calibration system and introduces the structure and technical indicators of the calibration system. The calibration system is based on the hardware system of high performance ARM processor, field programmable gate array (FPGA) and high precision AD chip. Then, a pre-circuit for quick sampling of voltage and current is designed to reduce sampling delay error, a high precision amplitude and phase algorithm of fixed frequency sampling is applied to realize high precision measurement of sampling signals, and a precise and flexible test strategy for delay characteristics is adopted. Finally, the comparative test of MU test equipment is carried out by using this calibration system, which basically solves the practical problem that the core performance of substation MU test equipment cannot be detected.

articleTitle: A Study on Energy Management Research for Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things is an effective way to solve the problem of large-scale distributed renewable energy, but it also faces many difficulties and challenges in theoretical exploration and application practice. This paper summarizes the research status of energy management of energy internet system from different aspects such as energy management architecture, modeling, algorithm and management strategy. The research results can be used as reference for relevant managers.

articleTitle: Design of Power Dispatching Post-evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the light of the traditional dispatching system which mainly serves the pre-event and in-event links of power dispatching, a post-evaluation scheme is proposed in this paper. The post-evaluation focuses on the post-event link of the power dispatching, quantitative post-evaluation and deep post-evaluation is included. The main objective of post-evaluation is to quantify the dispatch effectiveness and feedback in closed loop. The design ideas, software implementation and key technologies are concluded, and the typical application modes of post-operation are proposed.

articleTitle: Environmental/Economic Power Dispatch Based on Multi-objective Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A new multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) technique for environmental/economic dispatch (EED) is proposed. Infeasible solutions can be revised to feasible ones by designing specific constraints correction factor. And on the basis of that, a new fitness function model for multi-objective particle swarm is built based on the penalty function method. The historical set and global set for non-dominated solutions are formed, according to the Pareto dominant conditions. A crowding distance-based approach is introduced to assign the global leader. Moreover, a new technique called slope method is proposed to further filter the non-dominated solutions based on the slope characteristics of the Pareto optimal front (POF). Then, fuzzy mathematical method for satisfaction evaluation is employed to extract the best compromise solution over the POF. Finally, several optimization runs of the proposed algorithm are carried out on the standard IEEE 30-bus test system, the results validate that the proposed method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Method of Selecting Charging Station Location of Electric Vehicle Based on Prospect Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the small scale of private electric vehicles in relatively backward cities in China at present, in order to avoid the problems of low utilization rate and insufficient demand of charging stations, this paper synthesizes the idea of promoting charging stations in these cities at the present stage and constructs a planning and evaluation system of charging stations for social service vehicles in relatively backward cities in China. Based on the Prospect Theory, this paper puts forward a kind of charging station for social service vehicles. The index quantification method of grey targetprospect theory evaluates the level of station construction in all aspects of candidate points, and uses VIKOR, a multi-criteria decision-making method, to determine the final decision-making scheme, so as to avoid the problem that traditional linear weighting method uses superior index to make up for inferior index. Finally, a relatively backward charging station planning project is taken as an example to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Data Pool Construction of Distribution Network Oriented Ubiquitous Electric Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the level of business informatization in distribution network development department, standardize the data management of business development, and enhance the level of business management, this paper introduces the development of routine business, data management and the application of information system in the development department. According to the requirements of business results, it carries out data demand analysis, gives the principles of data index formulation, classifies data pool tables, designs data table indicators, and constructs the data pool to support the development of power supply companies.

Author Keywords: Ubiquitous Electric Power Internet of Things

articleTitle: Identifying Fridge Consumption Non-intrusively Based On Temporal Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) is a technique of inferring the power consumption of each appliance from an aggregate power data gathered from a single metering point. Fridges and freezers occupy the central part of total power consumption. In this paper, an unsupervised approach based on DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) is proposed for identifying the temporal characteristic of fridges and freezes,and decomposing them from the aggregate data. Validation results on the publicly available ECO dataset have shown that the proposed approach is a promising solution to extract the pattern of fridges and that the approach can effectively disaggregate the consumption with more than 80% accuracy. Furthermore, the remaining parts of aggregate data after decomposition can be used for further NILM studies.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Double TEC Air Conditioning for Outdoor Intelligent Control Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Indoor temperature and humidity of the outdoor intelligent control cabinet are of great influence on the safe and stable operation of intelligent electronic devices in the control cabinet. Influence of atmospheric environment factors on components in intelligent control cabinet is analyzed in this paper, and working principle and characteristics of TEC air conditioning are introduced. On the basis of these, a new temperature control scheme of the air conditioning is proposed to meet the long-term safety and stable operation requirements of outdoor intelligent control cabinets, in which the conditioning is divided into two parts and the linkage rotation system is adopted. Moreover, double TEC air conditioning control method of intelligent control cabinet is studied. The effectiveness of TEC air conditioning outdoor control cabinet in heat dissipation and dehumidification in high temperature are verified by test results.

articleTitle: Continuation Power Flow Considering Generation/Voltage Regulation:  A Versatile Framework and Its Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Continuation power flow (CPF) is a frequently-used tool for determining the maximum loading point (MLP) of power systems. In order to meet the need for assessing voltage security with presence of different regulations and enhance the practicality of CPF, a versatile CPF framework capable of admitting various generation and voltage regulation schemes is proposed in this paper. The framework is designed as two-level structure. The upper interface level provides versatile interfaces for incorporating various kinds of generation regulations and voltage regulations, which makes CPF calculation independent of detailed regulation realizations. In the lower computation level, an event guided step-size control (EG-SC) strategy is derived to enhance the calculating efficiency and the CPF predictor-corrector scheme is improved to adapt to take the effects of regulations into account. The proposed methodology is tested with simulations with the benchmark institute of electrical and electronics engineers (IEEE) 118-bus system.

Author Keywords: Combined cooling heating and power system

articleTitle: Generalized Inverse Optimal Power Flow Calculation of Electrothermal Coupled Multi-energy Flow System Contained Ground Source Heat Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Regional energy Internet is the main trend of energy development in the future. Ground source heat pump (GSHP) is a new hot technology for building energy conservation and environmental protection, and is also an important form of energy supply in regional energy Internet system. In this paper, the electrothermal coupled regional integrated energy system with GSHP is taken as the research object. The detailed modeling and analysis of the GSHP operating in the thermal system are carried out from the operational mechanism. The steady-state model of the electrothermal coupled energy network is established. Based on the generalized inverse matrix theory, the multi-target optimal power flow model and algorithm for regional energy Internet including energy cost minimization and distribution system loss minimization are studied and verified in the coupling case of IEEE 14-node power system and 5-node thermal system simulating. The model and algorithm presented in this paper accurately reflect the operation status of regional integrated energy system, which can take into account multiple operational optimization objectives. The algorithm has good numerical stability and convergence, and the optimization process is a process of optimization of feasible solutions, and each step obtains a more optimal feasible solution of objective function value, which is suitable for real-time system optimization scheduling applications.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Security Constrained Dynamic Optimal Dispatch With Regenerative Clean Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A dynamically optimal dispatch model for power systems with regenerative clean energy (wind farms and PS stations) is proposed, and fuel consumption, emission of atmospheric pollutants and power purchase cost are taken as objectives. The network security constraints under basic status and N-1 outage and operation dispatch of pumped storage (PS) stations are considered. Moreover, the idea of checking-adding loop is used to handle network security constraints and improve the computational efficiency was enhanced. The normal boundary intersection (NBI) algorithm and interior point method are adopted to solve this model and a series of evenly distributed Pareto optimal sets are obtained. Because of the role of PS stations in peak load shifting load and coping with randomness of wind farm output, this complex model converges smoothly. Test results on a real provincial power system show that the proposed method can comprehensively consider the optimal compromise among security, economy and environmental protection of generation schedule, and can develop the functions of PS stations in shifting load and coping with randomness of wind farm output.

articleTitle: Comparison for development of Demand Response between China and American along with Situation Analysis in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to summarize the development achievements of demand response (DR) in domestic in recent years and to promote the sustainable development of demand response business, the implementation modes of DR between China and American are compared based on the comparative analysis of relevant policies, documents, work reports and demonstration projects. The implementation modes of DR between China and American are compared around the types, time scales of America, as well as the start-up conditions, advanced notification time at home. The implementation scale between China and America is compared by analyzing the number of participant users, implementation effects such as load reduction, the scale of subsidies or incentives. The policy advantages and urgent technical requirements of developing DR business at present is analyzed, and the key problem to be solved about development of DR in the future is pointed out. We hope to provide some references for the development of domestic DR business, especially for the research of key t.

articleTitle: The Mixed Reality Modeling and Application Oriented at the Operation and Maintenance of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve world-class distribution network construction, efficient operation and maintenance of distribution network is needed. A mixed reality modeling method oriented at the operation and maintenance of distribution network is proposed. The method can reduce the physical resource occupation of the operation and maintenance staff. Through introducing mixed reality technology into the daily operation and maintenance process of distribution network, the convenience of retrieving equipment information, historical data and technological support can be increased. The modeling process of environment and equipment based on typical scene of distribution network operation and maintenance is illustrated and the mixed reality function is realized. According to the research, mixed reality can integrate into each step of the distribution network operation and maintenance seamlessly, assist routing inspection of distribution network, and provide informationalized instruction and support from experts, which is of great significance to improve closed-loop management and control level of distribution network.

articleTitle: Remote Fault Diagnosis and Intelligent Decision-making System for Condenser Based on Pattern Recognition and Reliability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Paper presented a common fault diagnosis method based on pattern recognition and reliability evaluation, and made intelligent decision according to the diagnosis results. Firstly, the fault model library of the phase modulator was established, and the instantaneous value and the change rate of the sampled signal were calculated by using the time domain and frequency domain signal analysis methods to determine the type and reliability of the fault. Then, through the comparative analysis of historical data and relevant standards, the severity of the fault was determined, and the severity and trend of the fault of the condenser were obtained. Finally, according to the fault and severity of the unit, visual display and intelligent decision-making were carried out and timely pushed. The intelligent decision-making system established in this paper could help operators make scientific operation and maintenance decisions, reduce the probability of equipment failure, improve the service life of the condenser, and provide the strongest technical support for improving power transmission and security and stability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Model Construction of the Electric Methane Generation Based on Biocatalyst
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are rich renewable solar and wind sources in China, but large amounts of carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) emissions are urgent at the same time. Electromethanogenesis (EMG) can convert electricity and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> into methane by using the biocatalyst of methanogen, which can provide an effective solution for electricity storage and reduction of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The advantages are as follows. (i)It can achieve the long-term and large-capacity electricity consumption to avoid large power curtailment in the distributed generation system. (ii) CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is applied as the reactant, which can mitigate the greenhouse effect caused by CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> . (iii) The self-propagated biocatalysts are superior to the chemical catalysts in the cost and stable performance. (iv) EMG can be considered as the junction among electricity energy, chemical energy and heat energy, which can promote research on the Integrated Energy Internet. In this paper, a well-designed electrolytic cell structure and methane-generated principle in the EMG system are introduced firstly. The author try to analyze the influence and the growth of cathode methanogens in this new area based on Nyquist diagram of the electrochemical impedance. Finally, the EMG electrical model is constructed firstly by recording working current and methane production with the terminal voltage change.

articleTitle: Dispatch Strategy of Energy Trading Platform with Distributed Energy Storage System for Multiple Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Development of renewable energy is motivated by policy priorities. However, the policy incentives have begun to be reduced, renewable energy can't depend on policies once more. To stimulate the further development of renewable energy and the completed renewable generators, this paper proposes an energy bank system (EBS) - an energy trading platform with distributed energy storage system (DESS) for multiple microgrids. EBS can be compared with general bank system, the money is the electrical energy, the kinds of hybrid energy storage are similar with the kinds of deposit money, renewable distributed generation (RDG) becomes a kind of investment. To maximize the utilization efficiency of RDG, power customers of EBS can trade electricity energy with each other and obtain revenue. Finally, based on the practical data, the simulation results prove advanced economic advantages and high effectiveness of EBS.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Resource Allocation Model in Provincial Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to alleviate the contradiction between the gradual expansion of power supply and demand and realize the optimal allocation of power resources in a wider range, this paper focuses on an integrated scheduling scheme that is formulated as a decentralized energy management problem to obtain the optimal solution by means of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm. Firstly, a two-level electricity market framework including provincial electricity market (PEM) and regional electricity market (REM) is proposed. Secondly, the constraints to be satisfied in the power trading plan of PEM and REMs are constructed, and the centralized dispatching model of the whole network is established. Moreover, the centralized scheduling model is reconstructed by using ADMM algorithm, and a completely decentralized scheduling model is established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method is verified by a practical example.

articleTitle: Laboratory Investigation on Phase Selection Closing Approach for Suppression of Inrush Current
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the no-load closing process, transformer will produce a magnetizing inrush current which will make the transformer relay malfunction and make adversely affect to the transformer equipment and power grid. Relative to a variety of external measures limiting the inrush current, the phase selection switch technology is more effective to reduce inrush current. The author analyzed inrush current by theory and dynamic simulation experiment. By controlling the closing angle to be less than 0° to 72° of the opening angle, inrush current is well suppressed.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of a Multi-energy Microgrid with Multiple Demand Response Programs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An optimally coordinated operation strategy for a multi-energy microgrid (MEMG) with the participation of multiple demand response programs (MDRPs) is proposed in this paper. The MEMG is comprised of the combined heat and power (CHP) plant, renewable energy generators (wind turbines and photovoltaic cells), electric boilers as well as heterogeneous energy storage. To verify the effectiveness of the cogeneration of heat and power in MEMG, the coupling property of the electric thermal energy is investigated. Besides, MDRPs are considered to enhance the multi-energy coordination and lower the system operating cost. The proposed operation model is formulated as a mixed integer linear problem (MILP) which can be efficiently worked out by some powerful solvers and the simulations are conducted to illustrate the potential advantages of our proposed method in enhancing economic benefits.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of UHVDC Project in Some Special Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Control system is the 'brain' of UHVDC, which is based on the closed loop limiting matching mechanism of the GAMMA controller, voltage controller and current controller. Control characteristics and analysis method of UHVDC are studied in depth, which is under such special conditions as starting and stopping a pole, on-line exiting a valve group, AC voltage fluctuation and electromagnetic interface between the two poles. The analysis method and research results of this paper are helpful to analyze the control characteristics of UHVDC System under complex operating conditions, and have rich practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Misoperation of Line Differential Protection Mixed with Different CT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the in-depth advancement of the ubiquitous power Internet of Things, a large number of power electronic devices have entered the power grid, and the types and quantities of devices which are connected to the power grid have also increased, making the shape of the power grid gradually change. In the current operation of the substation, intelligent substations and traditional substations are often present at both ends of the line. They use electronic current transformers and electromagnetic current transformers respectively in the differential protection. The malfunction of the line differential protection is caused by the difference between two transformers in characteristics. This paper proposes a method to detect the saturation point of electromagnetic current transformer by B-spline wavelet method to avoid the occurrence of protection malfunction.

articleTitle: Synergetic Controller Design for The LFC in Interconnected Hydraulic-Thermal Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load frequency control is the core function of the auto generation control in power grid, which maintains the frequency and power stability and regulates the exchange power between different areas. In this paper, synergetic control theory is introduced to improve the regulating ability of load frequency control of interconnected hydraulic-thermal power system. For the purpose of verifying the validity of the synergetic control method, several experiments are conducted under different conditions. The simulation results indicate that the proposed synergetic controller is an effective alternative compared with traditional PI controller.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for the Multiple Single Phase Converters in the Series Side of Distributed Power Flow Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a simulation model of the distributed power flow controller is established by PSCAD/EMTDC, where the shunt converter is equivalent to the current source when the interaction between the shunt and series converters is ignored. The coordinated control strategy for the multiple single phase converters in the series side is proposed. The interaction of the series of converters through the line is studied from the three aspects: switching on/off at the same time, switching on/off at the same interval, and being installed in different electrical distance. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy is the best switching on/off at the equal interval, and there is a short negative interaction among the converters. The increase of the electrical distance will weaken the interaction of converters.

articleTitle: Study on Construction Scheme of Power Grid Side Storage Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid-side energy storage system can alleviate the pressure of the power grid at peak load, and make full use of the idle resources of the power grid at low load, so as to improve the overall utilization rate of the power grid. In this paper, the application scenario, access system, and operation management of grid-side energy storage system are studied. And a typical grid-side energy storage power station construction scheme is proposed. This scheme can be mainly used in suburban junction substations with rapid economic development, providing a new solution for areas with seasonal power gap.

articleTitle: Dynamic Harmonic Modeling and Characteristics Analysis of Photovoltaic Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic converters whose dynamic characteristics determine the behavior of grid-connected device are important equipment for new energy generation. Therefore, to analyze the harmonic characteristics generated by grid-connected photovoltaic devices, it is necessary to firstly study the mechanism of harmonic generation, then build the dynamic harmonic model of photovoltaic power generation unit, and discuss the influencing factors. In this paper, based on the deep comprehension of harmonic characteristics, a Norton equivalent circuit that described the harmonic characteristics of grid-connected converter of photovoltaic power generation unit is established. Besides, the effects of the power output of photovoltaic power generation unit and the filter structure on converter's harmonic output are investigated. The accuracy of the proposed model is verified by comparing the results between the theoretical calculation and simulation.

articleTitle: Coordination Degree Evaluation of Energy-Economy-Environment System Based on P-S-R Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The energy, economy, and environment systems are interacted, and the whole of the three systems is called the energy-economy-environment (3E) system. Energy is limited, and the expectations of human economic and social development are infinite while the two constitute a contradiction. At the same time, the irrational use of energy system will also trigger a series of environmental problems which will restrict economic and energy system development. Therefore, the pressure-state-response (P-S-R) model can better reflect the interaction between energy system, economy system and environment system. Based on this, the TOPSIS (technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution) method is used to comprehensively evaluate the coordination degree of 3E system.

articleTitle: A Retrieval Method of Transformer Fault Case Based on Set Pair Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Case-based reasoning is one of the important means of equipment fault diagnosis. When the traditional case retrieval technology is applied to the transformer failure analysis, the retrieval result is not always correct due to the lack of data. A retrieval method of transformer fault case based on set pair analysis is proposed in this paper. The method set contact number in the set pair analysis as the similarity between cases, with the case-level weight of the index, to solve this problem. On the one hand, it takes into account the changes of indicator weight under different failure modes. On the other hand, the problem that the case similarity is comparable under the insufficient data, and non-uniform weights is solved. Some cases studies are performed to verify the proposed model. The proposed method is more effective in the diagnosis of transformer fault diagnosis, which is showed in the simulation results.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Hot Spot Temperature of Distribution Power Transmission Equipment Insulation Winding Based on Eddy Current Loss Density Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasement of power load year by year, the number of distribution transformers is increasing. At the same time, the impact of harmonic disturbance on power system is also growing in recent years. In order to study the influence of harmonic current on hot-spot temperature of oil-immersed distribution transformer windings, the influence of uneven distribution of eddy current loss density on hot-spot temperature of windings is comprehensively analyzed based on the load loss calculation model under harmonic current established in previous studies. The results show that harmonic current can cause additional temperature rise of transformer. When the harmonic distortion rate is 40%, the hot-spot temperature rise of transformer reaches 102.7 K, far exceeding the limit of hot-spot temperature rise of 78 K. When the harmonic distortion rate is 60%, the temperature rise of the top oil exceeds its limit of 60 K. At this time, the temperature of the top oil reaches 112.2 °C, which is close to the flash point of mineral insulating oil, and has a great impact on the safe operation of the equipment.

articleTitle: DC Grid Protection and Post-fault Restoration Scheme Using AC Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the lack of commercialized high voltage DC circuit breaker (DCCB), the protection of voltage source converter-based (VSC) multi-terminal HVDC (MTDC) grid is still a main obstacle hinders the development of MTDC grid. In this paper, the DC grid protection and post-fault restoration schemes using AC circuit breakers (ACCBs) are proposed. The contributions of this paper are: 1) analyses the post-fault restoration process if ACCB is used for DC grid protection; 2) analyses the difference between starting a MTDC grid from a zero-state and post-fault state; 3) DC voltage slope control is used to limit the overvoltage and overcurrent during the restart-up process. The proposed protection and restart-up control scheme will be tested in an offshore wind farm (OWF) integrated 4-terminal DC grid established in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show the effectiveness and good dynamic performance of the proposed scheme. The voltage oscillation and current surges are mitigated largely during the restart-process.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Structure Simulation of Strong Oil Air-cooled Transformer and Finite Element Analysis of Internal Temperature Fluid Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power transformers are the main components of power transmission networks. The operating parameters of transformers are essential for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In this paper, 220 kV oil-immersed air-cooled transformers are taken as the research objective, and three-dimensional simulation of transformer is carried out under different heat dissipation modes. Then, the qualitative analysis of the temperature rise of the transformer winding, the internal fluid field and the temperature field distribution of the transformer is emphatically calculated, which proves that the calculation method mentioned in this paper is of great correctness.

articleTitle: Distributed Predictive Control for Cyber-Physical Systems with Probabilistic Input Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a distributed model predictive control (MPC) for Cyber-physical systems (CPSs) subject to probabilistic input constraints. The input saturation constraint is described by a Bernoulli-distribution white sequence. Probabilistic input constraints are transformed into a convex hull of linear feedback laws, therefore can reduce the inherent conservatism of distributed MPC controller design. Then, the optimization of distributed MPC problem is designed and transformed into solving an optimization problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the presented distributed MPC method is validated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Lightning Protection of New 500 kV Lightning-proof Line Insulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Line arrester is an important lightning protection method for 500kV extra-high voltage (EHV) transmission lines. The current Zinc Oxide Arresters have shortcomings in performance, installation, in this paper, lightning-proof insulators with excellent lightning protection characteristics are adopted. The ATP-EMTP simulation is used to analyze the transmission line when it was subjected to the most serious conditions of counter-attack and lightning shielding failure, including energy releasing condition of the lightning-proof insulator, and the maximum withstanding lightning current after the lightning-proof insulator replaces the ordinary insulator. The simulation results show that the lightning protection insulator circuit can avoid the grounding fault of the transmission line, especially in the terrain where the grounding resistance is difficult to reduce; In the case of 800A 2ms square wave flow capacity is 1237kJ, the influence of lightning counterattack on the operation of the lightning protection type insulator is negligible with respect to the lightning shielding failure current and the maximum tolerated lightning shielding failure current amplitude of the 500kV line is -84kA ,which meets line lightning protection requirements.

Author Keywords: Maximum lightning shielding failure current amplitude

articleTitle: Challenges and Countermeasures of Security Analysis in the Mid Long Term Development of Qinghai Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale access of renewable energy, the current security analysis of the power grid lacks of the consideration of the grid structure and overall characteristics. The factors involved in the security analysis of power grid planning have increased substantially. Meanwhile, numerous computations are faced in the mid long term simulation. In this study, the Qinghai power grid is taken as the simulation object. The changes in the structure and characteristics of the power grid after large-scale access to renewable energy are systematically researched. The main challenges of security analysis are discussed and the relevant countermeasures are also put forward.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Regularity of Overhead Transmission Line nearby Wildfires
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale wildfires can easily cause multiple overhead transmission lines to trip at the same time, which seriously threatens the safe and stable operation of large power grids and power consumption. This paper studies the distribution law of wildfires on overhead transmission lines in China, and provides guidance for wildfire prevention in various provinces. A method of drawing the grid fire distribution map based on the fire spot density distribution layer, the vegetation burning hazard level distribution layer and the fire risk distribution layer is proposed, which can provide reference for the wildfire distribution map drawing of overhead transmission lines. Based on the research results of this paper, the distribution map of overhead transmission line wildfires in typical areas is drawn. The high-incidence sections of wildfires and their hazard levels in the above areas are pointed out, which is consistent with the actual operation. It provides targeted guidance for wildfire prevention and control.

articleTitle: A Calculation Method of Distribution Power Transmission Equipment Hot Spot Temperature Based on Relative Load Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of power load year by year, the number of low-voltage users is increasing. Affected by factors such as uneven distribution of power load, three-phase unbalance is becoming more and more serious. Three-phase unbalance can easily lead to single-phase overload of distribution transformer, thus increasing the hot-spot temperature of winding. Especially in the peak period of power consumption, it is easy to cause burnout of heavy overload distribution transformer. According to the relative load factor, the calculation model of winding hot spot temperature of distribution transformer under three-phase unbalanced operation is constructed in this paper. Based on this model, the relationship between winding hot spot temperature and three-phase unbalance is analyzed. The results show that the three-phase unbalance has a great influence on the winding hot spot temperature. With the increase of unbalance, the hot spot temperature of transformer rises sharply.

articleTitle: An Internet Hosted Website Detection Method Based on Network Behavior Analysis for Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Internet hosted websites are big threats to power grid enterprises because they may contain sensitive user data and business secrete while its information security is unregulated. Traditional technique to find Internet hosted websites is to set up web crawler and match key words in webpages, which is expensive and inefficient. In this paper, an Internet hosted website detection method based on network behavior analysis is introduced. Instead of parsing whole webpages, this method only analyzes network packet head information to get visit behavior features such as degree dispersion of source IP addresses and source departments visiting an Internet website. All behavior features of a destination website are integrated to get its probability of being an Internet hosted website. According to testing results on real data, Internet hosted websites are found in over 93 percent of the conducted tests.

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser Vibration Signal Acquisition and Storage Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A data acquisition and storage method with high availability and expansibility is adopted to solve the problems of large scale and poor timeliness of synchronous condenser data processing. By reasonably setting the length of data and determining whether the data needs to be stored according to the change of equipment status, a data storage system can support the all kinds of structure data, unstructured data, the storage and access requirements of massive real-time data. This method can realize real-time computation of high-speed sensing data stream with large-scale real-time sensory data, which can be widely used in online monitoring.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance Analysis of ±800kV UHV Delta-connection Converter Transformer System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Convert transformers are important components in the ultra-high voltage (UHV) converter substation, serving to convert the AC voltage into the commutation voltage for the converter. In general, the converter transformer group have two connection forms, the delta connection and the star connection, which can realize twelve-pulse commutation. However, if the connections are not sufficiently flexible, significant dynamic interaction may occur between the interconnected bushings during the earthquake, which can result in great damage of the converter transformers. In order to investigate the seismic performance of the ±800kV UHV delta-connection converter transformer system, three earthquake records are adopted as the input ground motions, and dynamic time-history is analyzed on two finite element models of a single transformer and the delta-connected converter transformer system were performed in this paper. Results of the numerical study show that the connection can reduce the fundamental frequency of the lower valve-side bushing and increase its displacement response during the earthquake. Moreover, the connection can increase the top acceleration, top displacement, and root stress response of the upper valve-side bushing, with displacement and stress response increased by more than 40%.

articleTitle: Impact of DC-DC Converters for DC Grid Voltage Support
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modern power system is undergoing a gradual change from conventional sources of energy to renewable sources. This change requires restructuring of the power system so as to support the integration without compromising the security and stability. The power system itself is divided into smaller subsystems and the operation of these subsystems which are critical for the successful operation of the entire grid. Power electronics is the center of attraction for the change from typical AC grid to DC grids and microgrids. Much research is being carried out to develop high accuracy and low loss converters such as DC to DC and DC to AC. This paper presents a kind of DC-DC converter which is employed with a DC grid for voltage support. A photovoltaic system is linked to the DC/DC converter and the converter modeled in a way to support the grid voltage in case the demand varies. The simulations are obtained in PSCAD-EMTDC. The results show the DC to DC converter supports the grid in peak demands.

articleTitle: Extended-range Forecasts of Power Grid Ice Accretion in Southern China: Case Studies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The acceleration of wide-spread ice on transmission linescan cause a large number of tower collapse and line breakage, which threatens the essential security of power grid. The forecast of transmission line ice accretion could guide the deployment of anti-icing equipment in advance and reduce the economic losses caused by ice disasters. In this paper, the relationship between five ice storm events over southern China and Stratospheric planetary wave (PW) anomalies was studied by synthetic analysis. It is found that planetary wave activities will abruptly increase within 10 – 15 days before the ice storm events. Furthermore, a method of forecasting ice storm events over southern China by using such planetary wave anomalies is proposed.

articleTitle: Influences of Control Parameters on Harmonic Characteristics of Current-controlled Inverters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since a large number of inverters with LCL filters are widely used, harmonic disturbances of power systems are easily amplified by harmonic resonance. In order to study the influence of control parameters on the harmonic characteristics of current-type inverters, the Norton equivalent model of the current-controlled inverter with LCL filter is studied, where the influences of control parameters on two transfer functions, i.e., N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eq</sub>, are investigated. It shows that the performance of harmonic suppressing of inverters could be improved by choosing appropriate parameters of proportional resonance controller of the inverter. The correctness of theoretical analysis is verified by the simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Study of Interruptible Load Utility Model for Building Users
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Effective utilization of interruptible load in buildings can not only improve the flexibility of power grid and enhance the reliability of power grid, but also alleviate the imbalance between supply and demand. According to interruptible load contract, building users can benefit from participating in dispatching. However, it deviates from the original load profile, and user comfort will also be affected. Therefore, in order to utilize interruptible load flexibility of buildings, a utility model including benefits and comfort is proposed in this paper, wherein the calculation of benefits considers users' psychological activities through prospect theory. On this basis, the optimal model of interruptible load of building users with the goal of maximum utility is established. Finally, by an example of a real commercial building, the validity of the proposed model is verified. Meanwhile, the results show that the utility model can effectively evaluate the load characteristics of buildings and guide them to participate in the optimal dispatch of power grid demand response.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Control of Low-Voltage Multi-terminal DC Distribution System Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-terminal flexible structure can interconnect multiple AC systems through DC network, which can fundamentally change the original structure of traditional power grid. However, with the increasing penetration of distributed generation (DG), the quality of DC voltage has been widely concerned. In this paper, the equivalent model of DC load group is analyzed, and the complete model of multi-terminal DC (MTDC) system is constructed, and as a result the discrete state equation is deduced. On this basis, considering the effect of voltage control and the capacity of voltage source converter (VSC), a centralized coordinated control method of variable droop gains based on model predictive control (MPC) is designed. The problem of voltage fluctuation is solved by minimizing the deviation between the predicted voltage and the rated voltage of each VSC. According to the different power margin of the converter station, the droop gains is adjusted in real time without changing the operation mode of the converter station, so that the converter station can participate in the power regulation flexibly according to its power distribution ability to achieve the optimal power distribution.

articleTitle: New energy short-term prediction system based on measured weather and network weather error correction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The new energy forecast will guide the adjustment of the future capacity plan in the new energy system. The stability of the macro-control of the power grid is highly dependent on the accuracy of energy generation power forecasting. Meanwhile, the trend of the source-source power of the system is highly dependent on a variety of weather conditions. The accuracy of the forecasting of the weather greatly affects the prediction accuracy of the system. The forecasting system uses the labview development platform visual programming method and the powerful storage capacity of the MYSQL database. To set up weather information in the region, it collects and stores multiple weather data in the weather information of the region and the system with adapting fuzzy processing method to analyze and extract data. The paper also uses numerical weight adjustment method to combine historical data, real-time data, and future data to obtain correction error for achieving corrections to future weather data. Therefore, the corrected weather data can be used as input data in combination with the final model for prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Partial Discharge Location Method Based on Self-Constructing Mother Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to locate the partial discharge (PD) accurately in power cables, an improved wavelet Laplace function method is proposed. Based on the signal sparse representation theory, the parameters of the base function in this method are determined by fast Fourier transform and correlation filtering firstly. Then, the occurrence time and center frequency of partial discharge signal are extracted by Laplace wavelet matching pursuit algorithm. Finally, according to the wave velocity corresponding to the center frequency point, the exact location of the fault point is determined. What's more, caused by velocity ambiguity, the location errors are reduced. Meanwhile, the analysis results of simulation and experiments show that the PD location error of the proposed method is less than 1%, which fully meets the needs of engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Benefit of Power Grid Enterprises Based on Projection Pursuit and Grey Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of power reform, power grid construction faces new challenges. To further improve grid investment efficiency, it is urgent to establish a more effective benefit-oriented grid benefit evaluation mechanism. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation method for the benefits of power grid enterprise is proposed which could avoid the interference of decision-makers' subjective factors. Firstly, an evaluation index system is constructed, and the projection pursuit model is used to analyze the sample data. And then, based on the linear decreasing weight particle swarm optimization algorithm, the projection index optimization model with the best projection direction as the objective function is constructed to determine the index weight. Combined with the grey relational theory, the projection value is used as a metric to obtain the comprehensive benefit evaluation value of the grid enterprises in each region. Finally, the effectiveness and reasonableness of the evaluation method is illustrated by an actual case.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of Energy Storage System Considering Time Sequence Matching Degree Between Photovoltaic and Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation, the variation of PV power generation power will cause unwished voltage fluctuation. In the meantime, load also varies constantly. Energy storage system (ESS), such as battery, is a flexible system that can decrease the variation of power flow effectively. A reasonable control strategy of ESS is important to reduce investment and cost. In this paper, considering time sequence matching degree (TSMD) between photovoltaic and load, a TSMD control strategy of ESS is studied. Firstly, the definition of TSMD is introduced. Secondly, the TSMD control scheme of ESS is analyzed. Finally, the effects of traditional low pass filter (LPF) method and TSMD strategy are compared. The simulation results show that TSMD control scheme is not only effective but also low in the cost.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influence of Three-phase Unbalance of AC Side Voltage on the Operating Characteristics of VSC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the AC three-phase voltage unbalance problem in the low-voltage distribution network on the operating characteristics of the VSC is studied. This paper deduces the expression of the negative sequence components of the three-phase unbalanced voltages after park transformation and develops the simulation model of the low-voltage DC distribution network. The correctness of the theoretical derivation is verified by simulation. In order to study the effects of different degrees of three-phase voltage imbalance on the DC voltage, the simulations of the three-phase unbalance levels of 5%, 10%, and 15% are performed separately. The results show that the three-phase voltage imbalance on the AC side will introduce a double-frequency voltage component on the DC side. The greater the voltage imbalance, the larger the amplitude of the introduced double-frequency voltage component, and the more serious the impact on the DC voltage quality.

articleTitle: R&D and field test analysis of fault traveling wave positioning system for distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the theory of traveling wave positioning in distribution network, this paper designs and develops a fault traveling wave positioning system for distribution network. Combined with the self-developed tunnel magnetic to resistance traveling wave sensor, the typical design of fault traveling wave acquisition in distribution network is designed and tested in the real distribution network laboratory, which can effectively detect traveling wave signals. Furthermore, the artificial short circuit experiment is carried out in the demonstration project 10kV distribution network. The test results show that the positioning error is less than 150m.
