The traveling wave positioning system based on non-contact sensor has the conditions for popularization and application in engineering.

articleTitle: Consistent Cooperative Control of Multi-energy Storage in DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC microgrid contains a large number of distributed power generation units, and energy storage devices with appropriate capacity can smooth the power output of the distributed power supply and provide power support for the microgrid. A distributed cooperative control strategy based on consistency is proposed for multi-energy storage system in DC microgrid. The control strategy consists of two modules: virtual inertial control and consistency control. The virtual inertial control module can realize the power interaction between the energy storage device and the microgrid, and make the energy storage provide the inertial support of voltage for the grid. Consistency control module realizes information exchange between energy storage devices through low-bandwidth communication, and achieves the purpose of compensating grid voltage and reasonably distributing reactive power of energy storage devices. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified in PSCAD/EMTDC software.

articleTitle: The evaluation method for power information system’s topology planning against cyber-attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Conventionally, the planning guidelines for power communication systems are existed for providing the best ancillary services to the power system. However, to provide the best ancillary services, this criterion considers the ability of power communication systems while less considering the ability to withstand cyber-attacks. Meanwhile, there're many papers focus on the decision-making of real-time defense against cyber-attacks but few work from the perspective of topology optimization and planning. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a method for power information system's planning against cyber-attacks. Firstly, analyzing the planning requirements of the topology network of power information systems, this paper proposes a planning framework. Secondly, based on the defense ability of the topology network to the cyber-attacks, the concept of the reachable probability of the cyber-attacks and an evaluation method of the reachable probability are proposed. Then, the performance requirements of the data transmission in power information system under normal operating conditions are analyzed. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Solution Strategy for Alleviating Line Overloads Based on Transmission Switching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A two-stage solution strategy for alleviating line overloads based on transmission switching is proposed in this paper. This stage solution strategy mainly includes screening and ranking stage, detailed analysis stage, aiming to provide a group of high-quality solutions to deal with the line overload problems and can be applied to the online application of a large power grid. Based on the accurate AC power flow calculation results, the calculation accuracy of the two-stage solution strategy is compared. In addition, this paper compared with methods in other literature to analyze its computational efficiency. The effectiveness of the two-stage solution strategy proposed in this paper is verified based on the IEEE 39-bus system. The simulation results show that it has fast calculation speed and high solution accuracy, and can be extended to large power grids.

articleTitle: Fault Modeling and Characteristic Analysis of Offshore Wind Turbines with Doubly Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the power systems computer aided design (PSCAD) model of offshore wind turbines with doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) is completed, and the fault ride-through characteristics of DFIG for wind turbine during grid fault are analyzed. A method of changing the reactive current compensation of the grid-side converter control strategy is proposed. The detailed DFIG for wind turbine and its fault ride-through model were built in the PSCAD/EMTDC, an electromagnetic transient simulation software. The simulation results prove the correctness of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed reactive current compensation method.

articleTitle: Petri Net Based Intelligent Substation Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to further improve the effectiveness and comprehensiveness of substation fault diagnosis, this paper proposes a substation fault diagnosis method to effectively use the secondary system to monitor alarm information online. First, the original fault information received by the intelligent substation from each monitoring system is denoised. Then, the analytical model and Petri net model for the primary and the secondary system in the substation are established respectively, which are able to accurately locate the fault that may occur and obtain the reasons for the protection and switch misoperation with the secondary system diagnosis results. The case studies show that the method can identify fault elements and give detailed fault reasons under the mis-operations of protection and switch, and therefore can further optimize the substation fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Combined Optimization Schedule Model of Wind Power, Thermal Power and Pumped Storage Considering N-1 Safety Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to alleviate the impact of wind power randomness on the safe operation of the system, the wind power penalty cost is introduced, and the joint scheduling optimization model of wind power and pumped storage power station is established. The minimum total power generation cost is taken as the objective function in the proposed model with considering the network security constraints under N-1 conditions and a series of constraints such as wind power, thermal power, and pumped storage. The simplified N-1 safety verification method is adopted to improve the efficiency of the solution. The improved IEEE30 node system is used as the simulation system to analyze the system scheduling results under different scenarios. The simulation results show that the model can prevent the problem of line over-limit caused by the untimely adjustment of the unit's output. Under the condition of meeting the corresponding safety constraints, the operating cost of the system is reduced.

articleTitle: Research on influence factors of primary frequency regulation contribution electric energy of hydropower unit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The primary frequency regulation contribution electric energy (PFRCEE) is an important index for evaluating primary frequency regulation (PFR) performance of hydropower units. Due to the random frequency fluctuation of power grid, non-linear characteristics of hydraulic turbines and water inertia, there are many uncertainties in PFRCEE of hydropower units, which makes it difficult to analyze PFRCEE accurately and comprehensively through field tests. In this paper, the influence factors of PFRCEE of hydropower units are researched by numerical simulation, and the mathematical model of PFR simulation of hydropower units is established. The actual frequency fluctuation of grid is used as input of hydro turbine governor. The calculation results show that: the greater the governor parameters K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</sub> and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sub> are, the greater the PFRCEE is, and with the increase of b<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> or e<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, the PFRCEE significantly reduces. The PFRCEE increases linearly with the increasement of turbine head in governor opening mode. In power mode, the PFRCEE of different heads is basically the same except that the PFRCEE of the minimum head is obviously low. There are differences in the PFRCEE of different loads. Compared with the power mode, the difference in the opening mode of governor is more obvious. In opening mode, the larger the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub> is, the smaller the PFRCEE is. In power mode, when the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub> is large, the larger the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub> is, the smaller the PFRCEE is. When the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub> is small, the influence of changing the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</sub> on the PFRCEE is limited.

articleTitle: Study on Optimized Integrated Energy-Use Modes of Hospitals Considering TOU Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hospitals are high energy-use consumers. With the rapid development of combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) and distributed photovoltaic technology, the application of them makes hospitals become energy pro-consumers. Based on analyzing the equipment of energy supply and consumption system, an operational optimization model for a hospital is proposed aiming at minimum energy consumption cost, considering time-of-use (TOU) price. With the proposed model, day-ahead energy optimization is carried out based on the two typical scenarios: typical days of cooling season and heating season. The simulation results show different energy-use modes for the hospitals in different seasons. In this case, there is no need to turn on the gas turbine when the electricity price is low, while the power load is supplied by purchasing electricity from the power grid, and the heating load is satisfied by the gas boiler. When the heating demand is low in the cooling season while the electricity price is high, the waste heat of the gas turbine can meet the heating demand of the absorption chiller for cooling. Although the gas turbine is on in heating season when the electricity price is high, the turbine cannot provide all the heat energy and the gas boiler starts up to provide most of the heat energy.

articleTitle: Research on Thermoelectric Power Flow of Distributed Integrated Energy System Based on Model of Heat Network and Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed integrated energy system with combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) develops rapidly, because of its high energy efficiency, economy, environmental protection and safety. Meanwhile, steady-state power flow calculation is the basis of integrated energy system design planning and optimal scheduling. Therefore, this paper presents a calculation method of power flow considering thermoelectric coupling. Based on the coupled steady-state model of equipment and the hydraulic and thermal models of heat supply network, a heat supply network solving algorithm is proposed. Compared with the traditional nonlinear solving method, this method simplifies the solving process of thermoelectric power flow. What's more, an improved ieee33-node and 14-node heating network system is used for simulation calculation. The results show that the actual model of power loss of hot water when it flows at the side of pipe network.

articleTitle: Operation Strategy of a Combined System Consists of Multi-Type Hydropower and Wind-Solar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integration of renewable energy generation has a significant influence on distribution systems security due to the variability and uncertainty of renewable energy generation. Natural complementary characteristics of wind and solar power generation are considered and the frank-copula function is selected to establish the probability distribution of windsolar combined power generation in this paper. Based on the regulation and water storage characteristics of cascade hydropower stations pumped storage hydropower stations and other types of hydropower, the combined operation strategy of multi-type hydropower stations participating in the utilization of wind power and solar energy is Proposed. Simulation results on a practical example which is about a certain area of Qinghai province show that the proposed strategy is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Evaluation Index of Demand Response Based on Stationary Measure of Time series
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response is introduced to the practice of power peak load shifting and the stability of load curves. However, conventional indexes of load characteristics can hardly characterize the stability of load curves. Thus, the evaluation index of demand response based on stationarity measure of time series is developed. Compared with conventional indexes of load characteristics, this new evaluation index is more rational, which can be verified by a range of new indexes of load characteristics like the absolute value of load margin, the weighted path length, and the information entropy along with some conventional indexes of load characteristics, such as peak-valley ratio and the standard deviation. Case studies show that these indexes can relatively evaluate the stability of load curves in a more efficient way.

articleTitle: Study on Frequency Dynamic of Power System Based on Continuum Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity in the parameter distribution in continuum modeling of the power system, a new approach of distributing parameters of generator based on shortest route was proposed. The traditional discrete system was computed through the swing equation at first, and the routes from generator in disturbance to other generators were computed through the proposed method in the paper. Then, the shortest route was chosen to distribute the inertia parameter on average, and the distributed parameter of every shortest route was distributed by Gaussian smooth method. The accurate parameter distribution formula was given in the paper. And the standard data set of 10 generators and 39 nodes system of New England was computed through the proposed method. The results indicated that there are huge amount of routes form the disturbing source to other generators, which increased the difficulty of parameter distribution. The 9 shortest routes were chosen to distribute the parameter, which greatly reduced the difficulty of parameter distribution and made the analysis of power system more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on System Dynamics and Agent Hybrid Modeling Method for Multi-Energy Collaborative Control Under Ubiquitous Power Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the study of system dynamics (SD) and multi-agent theory and its wide application in the field of renewable energy, a hybrid modeling method of SD and Agent is proposed in this paper, which is suitable for the multi-energy collaborative management and control of regional cooling, heating and power under the background of the ubiquitous Internet of Things. Based on the detailed analysis of the lack of single modeling paradigm of system dynamics and the necessity and feasibility of mixed modeling of SD and Agent, the basic types of hybrid modeling of SD and Agent for regional multi-energy cooperative management and control are defined, and the application forms, simulation platforms, problems and ideas of hybrid modeling of SD and Agent in regional multi-energy cooperative management are discussed and analyzed, which can deepen the innovative application of SD and Agent hybrid modeling in multiple fields and assist relevant managers in scientific decision-making.

articleTitle: Study on Carbon Emissions and Generation Right Trading Joint With Wind Power Consumption Considered
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the background of electric market reform, carbon emission right is used as an incentive method to introduce traditional generation rights trade. With the maximum overall profit of power generator taken as the objective function, a joint trade of carbon and generation rights in power system including wind power was modeled. Under the existing market mechanism of centralized matchmaking transaction, the trading price of generation rights quoted by units is corrected after considering carbon emission of thermal power units and the credibility of wind power forecast. Simulation results confirm that, after adopting the joint trading model, the total profits of generation company and the wind power consumption will increase, and meanwhile the regional carbon emission will decrease, which achieve the goals of energy conservation and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Simulation Framework of Non-Technical Losses Detection in Micro Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid increase of modern grid research, Automatic Meter Reading (AMR) is used for automatically and numerically collecting data from smart meter transferring it to a required place for processing. The data is formerly processed for billing and analysis of diverse tenacity depending on the requisite. The parameters for analysis include voltage, current etc. Besides, by using such a system, the billing of the consumers will be on actual values obtained from smart meter afore on estimated values that are based on previous 3-4 months’ consumption which are predicated without taking actual values in the field. The most important concern related to smart grid implementation is energy theft. The core objective of this paper is to develop an environment which depicts automatic metering infrastructure (AMI) and implement the required structure in that environment in order to obtain the required result. The result can be obtained with the help of smart meter deployed on the consumer end.

articleTitle: A Cable Partial Discharge Signal Extraction Method Based on Improved Wavelet-Laplace Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to extract the partial discharge pluses accurately in power cables, an improved wavelet Laplace function method is proposed. The method is based on the characteristics of partial discharge pulse propagation in power cables. Firstly, the Laplace wavelet oscillation frequency and damping rate at different frequencies are determined by simulation of cable transmission characteristics. Then, the occurrence time and center frequency of partial discharge signal are extracted by Laplace wavelet matching pursuit algorithm. The extraction results of experiment data reveal that the effect of extracting PD pulses is satisfied with the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Loading Capacity of Solid Insulated Energy Transfer Equipment under Harmonic Actions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The external insulation performance of the winding of dry-type transformer is an important determinant of its service life. Caused by harmonic current on dry-type transformer, the additional loss causes additional temperature rise of its internal components. Meanwhile, additional temperature rise will lead to accelerated thermal aging of insulation materials, which further damages the external insulation performance of dry-type transformer windings. Firstly, the harmonic losses of dry-type transformers under different distortion rates are calculated by using the harmonic loss factor. Secondly, calculated by using harmonic loss value, the load capacity of dry-type transformer is under different total harmonic distortion rate. Therefore, based on the above analysis, this paper proposes to reduce the additional temperature rise caused by harmonic loss by reducing the load capacity of dry-type transformer. What's more, this method can effectively control the temperature rise of the components in the dry-type transformer within the limits. Finally, the relationship between current distortion rate and load capacity of dry-type transformer is obtained by calculation. The results show that harmonic current can increase various loss values of dry-type transformer and reduce load capacity.

articleTitle: Study on the Wind Power Capacity Credibility Considering the Convergence Effect of Wind Farm Cluster
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Chinese wind resources have obvious regional concentration and a unique intensive development method is formed as known as the wind farm cluster. The effect of convergence to capacity credibility is often ignored when the capacity credibility of wind farm cluster is assessed. Under this background, this paper studies the relationship between convergence effect and wind power in order to quantify the contribution of convergence effect to capacity credibility. Firstly, the wind power duration curve is used to describe the correlation between the low power duration and lost of load probability (LOLP). Secondly, the selection of optimal peakload period is determined in the calculation of peak-load rate method. Then, the increment caused by the convergence effect is taken into account and an evaluation method is proposed for wind farm cluster capacity credibility. Finally, this method is applied to evaluate an actual power system for the verification of effectiveness. This result is an important reference in the calculation of electric power balance for wind farm clusters.

articleTitle: Study on Corona Aging of Room Temperature Vulcanized Silicone Rubber
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Negative polar DC and AC voltage artificial accelerated aging test of room temperature vulcanized (RTV) silicone rubber was carried out by needle-plate electrode device. The hydrophobic recovery, scanning electron microscopy, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy test were conducted. The effect of different corona forms on the aging degree of RTV antifouling flashover coatings were analyzed by observing the surface topography of the aged samples and comparing the microscopic characteristics. The result indicated that the effect of AC and DC corona on silicone rubber materials was different. The surface damage of the samples after AC corona aging was more serious, the peak area of internal characteristic groups became smaller, and the hydrophobic recovery was worse than that after DC corona aging. The sample after chemical treatment is poor. A large amount of substances containing C-O, -OH groups were formed after DC corona aging. Both AC and DC corona aging reduced the content of C element and increased the content of O element.

articleTitle: Zoning-Prediction-Response (ZPR) Monitoring and Early Warning Model for Thunderstorms in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Thunderstorm is a strong convective weather, and it is one of the main meteorological disasters leading to circuit failure. This paper builds a reliable model of distribution lines in thunderstorm weather, quantifying the influence of thunderstorms on power supply reliability of distribution grid, and forming a set of reasonable disaster pretreatment schemes. Based on the relationship between the characteristic variables of thunderstorms meteorological parameters and the risk of line lightning outage, we establish Zoning-Prediction-Response (ZPR) monitoring and early warning model to provide real-time operation risk of distribution grid. At the same time, a reasonable solution can be obtained through the interaction with the power system security and stability analysis software. Finally, in the evaluation experiment of early warning effect, the prediction accuracy rate of this model for thunderstorms is more than 60%, and the prediction accuracy rate of grid failure rate reaches 92.3%, indicating that this model has good accuracy in predicting grid thunderstorms disaster.

articleTitle: Study on Dispatching Decision Information of Power Flow Distribution Under Wildfire Disasters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The dispatching decision information of power flow distribution under the wildfire disaster needs to consider the disturbance of the internal fault of the power grid and the influence of external factors. Aiming at the current situation of current dispatching decision information disposition, combined with the mechanism of line faults caused by wildfire disasters, an event evaluation system based on grid state, equipment status and weather conditions is established, a treatment method of dispatching decision information for power flow distribution based on decision tree is proposed. The process of decision making of power flow allocation scheme is illustrated by an example. The results show that the method is effective and improves the comprehensive capability of power grid dispatching emergency.

articleTitle: Optimized design of renewable energy CCHP system combined with exergy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: RES-CCHP system can improve energy utilization rate and renewable energy consumption rate. It is an important way to solve the energy and environmental problems as well as having great potential for development. In this paper, a combined cooling and heating power system based on natural gas and solar energy is designed. On the basis of the traditional economic, energy and environmental indexes, the exergy efficiency improvement rate is innovatively added into the evaluation indexes, and the optimization design model for the above four objective functions is established. The optimization of equipment capacity and key operating parameters are realized by using genetic algorithm. Finally, a case simulation is carried out. The results show that the RES-CCHP system after optimized design can not only meet the demand of the load side, but also effectively realize energy saving, emission reduction and efficient utilization of thermal energy.

articleTitle: A Steady-state Alarm Analysis Approach Base on Finite Automata and Moving Window Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Owing to a great variety of unprocessed and unanalyzed signal in the power system operation, the dispatchers face challenges from the high-intensity work, meanwhile, which brings security risks. Aiming at this phenomenon, this paper proposes a power system steady-state Alarm Analysis Approach base on Finite automata and Moving window (A3FM). The A3FM model is designed to describe the transition of power network state, and real-time analysis of power system steady-state alarm. The practical application shows that A3FM can discriminate the target signal sequence, analyze the grid operation in real time and have the certain capacity of fault tolerance. It provides the basis for real-time power grid status monitor and operation decision. On this basis, it improves the security of power grid by reducing the risks of manual operation mistakes in high pressure.

articleTitle: Wildfire Early Warning of Power Grid Failure Rate Based on Modified Ellipse Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To give early warning of the transmission line, outage rate is essential due to adverse impact on power grid of forest fire. In this paper, a modified ellipse forecast model is adopted to divide the spreading area of the fire into two semi-ellipses. After correcting puncture voltage with the result of the modified ellipse forecast model, the breakdown probability model is applied to give an early warning of the transmission line outage rate. The simulation result shows that the model has great accuracy in predicting the spread of forest fire and the rate of transmission line outage. With this model, the government can make scientific scheduling decisions and improve the resistance of grid to forest fire.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Hydrogeneration System with Doubly Fed Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With growing concerns about renewable energy consumption, pumped storage power plant is becoming a popular concept and thus the modeling of the doubly fed generator based hydrogeneration system becomes an interesting research topic. In this paper the power control strategy on the doubly fed generator based on pumped storage power plant with the aim of active power and slip control was studied. Multi-index control was employed to achieve the independent control of active power and slip of the machine. The machine was modeled in state equations in a synchronous reference frame. The complete simulation model was developed for such hydrogeneration system under variable speed operation using MATLAB & Simulink environment for obtaining the optimal parameters of multi-index control and the dynamic performance got further improved.

articleTitle: The Rmodynamic Analysis Of Integrated Energy System Based On Fuel Cell A Comparison Research
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The combination of the solid oxide fuel cell and gas turbine provides high-efficiency power generation solutions and is currently a popular field of research. In this study, a supercritical carbon dioxide Brayton cycle (SCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>BC) was incorporated into an SOFC-GT system as a bottom-layer subsystem to absorb the high-temperature exhaust of the GT, with the aim of fully realizing the cascade utilization of energy. Then, process simulation and sensitivity analysis of the SOFC-GT-SCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>BC hybrid system were conducted to investigate the effects of five parameters (fuel flow rate, fuel cell operating temperature, gas turbine pressure ratio, fuel utilization factor, and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> turbine inlet pressure) on the thermal efficiencies of the hybrid system and its SOFC-GT and SCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>BC subsystems.

articleTitle: Overvoltage Simulation Research of UHVDC Transmission Converter Caused by Upper Converter Midpoint Bus Grounding Fault
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the parameters of the equipment of Xiangjiaba-Shanghai ±800kV UHVDC transmission project, the power system simulation model is established in this paper. Generation mechanism and distribution law of operating overvoltage is analyzed, which is caused by upper converter unit midpoint bus grounding fault. On the basis of simulation results, the effects of protection delay and fault location on overvoltage are analyzed separately. This study has certain guiding significance for the following arrester configuration optimization in UHVDC project.

articleTitle: Prediction of Breaking Probability of Transmission Line Galloping Under Ice Storm Disaster
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of transmission line galloping breakage under ice storm, a probability prediction model of transmission line breaking based on improved particle swarm optimization is proposed. Firstly, the generalized extreme value (GEV) distribution parameters of wind load and ice load of transmission lines under ice storm disasters are determined by improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, then the excess distribution of the ice load and wind load of the transmission line is obtained according to the critical wind speed and critical icing density as the transmission line begins to gallop. And then, based on the binary t-Copula function, the joint probability distribution of ice load and wind load is obtained, and breaking probability of transmission line galloping under ice storm disaster is realized. Finally, using actual historical data of transmission line breaking in winter in Hunan Province, the superiority of the improved PSO algorithm and the accuracy of the proposed prediction model are verified, which can lay a foundation for transmission line galloping breakage prediction and provide a basis for pre-deployment of anti-galloping measures.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Ground - into Stray DC based on Multi - System Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper starts from the regular phenomenon of transformer DC magnetic bias caused by ground - into stray DC. The distribution mechanism of stray current in the soil is analyzed and the multi-system coupling mathematical model for corrosion evaluation and seismic source prediction is constructed. Then, the data of power grid, oil pipeline and geomagnetic intensity in Hunan Province are input into the model for simulation. Effective prevention and prediction programs are obtained. Moreover, this paper provides reference for the application of the calculation and analysis of ground-into stray DC to other industries besides power system.

articleTitle: Research on Zero-potential Live Working Method Based on Active Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reliability of the operation of the power system can be improved by live working, and the line or equipment can be repaired or maintained without affecting the normal transmission of electrical energy. The traditional live working method generally ensures the personal safety of the operator by increasing the loop impedance of the charged body to the operator and then to the earth. When the insulation capacity of the insulating equipment directly contacted by the operator is impaired, the personal safety of the operator will be unable to get protection. Aiming at this defect, this paper proposes a zero-potential non-stop power-on operation method based on active inverter. The zero-sequence current is injected into the first end of the line through the active inverter device, thereby regulating the zero-sequence voltage of the working phase. And the operating point voltage is clamped to 0V, ensuring the personal safety of the operator.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy System Evaluation Model Based on Secondary Energy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: New energy value is defined by combining three traditional energy values. The comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation model is established by studying the generation, transformation and transportation of secondary energy. The effect of demand conditions on energy efficiency is analyzed based on data. The application scope of the model is briefly described.

articleTitle: A New Transformer Protection Scheme based on the Numerical Characteristics of Equivalent Excitation Impedance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the analysis of the characteristics in equivalent excitation impedance for power transformers under different operating states, a transformer protection scheme based on the numerical characteristics of equivalent excitation impedance is proposed. The research shows that the equivalent excitation impedance of transformers has different characteristics under different states, while the equivalent excitation impedance can only maintain a stable small value when there is internal fault in the transformer. Therefore, an internal fault identification criterion of the transformer is constructed. Simulation result shows that the proposed scheme can identify the internal faults of the transformer quickly and accurately, and it is less affected by remanence and direct current (DC) bias.

articleTitle: Research on Time Serialization Simulation of Power SystemAccident Anticipated Plan
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The scenario of power system pre-scheduling can realize the simulation and validation of the accident anticipated plan. This paper realizes the automatic execution of accident anticipated plan. Firstly, starting with the key elements of accident anticipated plan text, this paper analyses and establishes a structured accident anticipated plan model. Based on natural language processing (NLP) technology, it matches the structured model and transforms the accident anticipated plan text into electronic structured model information. On basis of the dispatching rules, the quantitative calculation method of automatic reasoning for different operation instructions is proposed. Finally, the event time model is established to realize the fast sequential simulation.

articleTitle: Droop Based Power Programmable Algorithm in DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies a droop based control algorithm for DC microgrids which aims at tracking the power and stabling the bus voltage. The proposed algorithm consists of three different timescale control levels, that is, the primary control applies the traditional droop control to achieve the power share, the secondary control compensates the voltage deviation caused by droop control and the tertiary control adopts the PI controller to track the reference power. The proposed strategy implements the programmability of DG output power, which is compatible with various upper layer power scheduling algorithms, but also the sharing of power fluctuation due to contingencies and/or load variations. Simulation studies on several cases demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Electric Load Forecasting Based on CEEMDAN and LSSVM Optimized by Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the paper, short-term electric load forecasting (STLF) by optimization method is studied. First, the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) is used to decompose the short-term electric load data into some intrinsic mode functions (IMF): high frequency sequence (HF), the low frequency sequence (LF) and the trend term (T). Then, the least squares support vector machine model (LSSVM) optimized by the cuckoo search algorithm (CS) is utilized to predict electric load. Moreover, the final prediction value is obtained by the add integration method. Last but not least, the five benchmark models are added as the comparison model. The results show that the hybrid integrated model has higher horizontal precision and direction accuracy than other benchmark models. The results demonstrate that the accuracy of the model with decomposition method is higher than that without decomposition method.

Author Keywords: complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise

articleTitle: Comparison of Strategies for Operational Flexibility Enhancement of Combined Heat and Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper compares the strategies for improving the operational flexibility of combined heat and power (CHP) plants to support wind power integration. Four commonly used strategies, namely cutting off low pressure cylinder, installing heat accumulator, installing electric boiler, and utilizing by-pass device are discussed. An integrated model is proposed to quantify the performance of various strategies in improving the flexibility of CHP plants. A 350 MW subcritical extraction condensing turbine in China is used as an example, to compare the performance of the four strategies from the viewpoint of the operating cost of flexibility enhancement. The maximum flexibility and the scope of applicability can be enhanced.

articleTitle: Energy Internet Business Ecosystem Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As Internet and communication technologies are applied to energy system, the trend of traditional energy system is moving towards integration of multiple energy resources and coordinated development of energy production, delivery and utilization. Traditional monopolistic business model will be overturned by Energy Internet business ecosystem. This paper investigates the future Energy Internet business ecosystem in order to help traditional energy system in China accomplish strategic transformation to Energy Internet. Firstly, in the paper, the ecosystem concept is introduced and the participants of current energy ecosystem are analyzed. Then, the paper discusses the structures of the future Energy Internet business ecosystem and proposes development suggestions on political, economic, technological, social, legal and industrial aspects.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance and Aseismic Measures of ±800 kV EHV Wall Casing-Valve Hall System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The EHV(extra-high voltage) wall casing is a horizontally installed cantilever equipment with significant vulnerability under earthquake ground motions. In order to obtain the seismic responses of a ±800 kV EHV wall casing-valve hall system, a systematic finite element model was established. Sixteen earthquake records were selected from the PEER data base in the analysis, the stress at the root section and acceleration at the top of the bushing were regarded as critical position and corresponding responses were obtained. The results infers that the valve hall amplify the seismic responses of the electrical facility. To meet the standard requirement, two aseismic measures were proposed to retrofit the sidewall of the valve hall and validated to be effective to improve the seismic performance of the EHV wall bushing-valve hall system.

articleTitle: Effects of Pipeline Elevations on Load Flow of an Integrated Electricity-Gas Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load flow modeling and analysis is a basic problem for planning and operation of integrated electricity and gas system (IEGS). However, all the existing studies on load flow analysis of IEGS are implemented based on the modeling assumption of horizontal pipelines. This paper aims to provide an insight into the effect of pipeline elevations on load flow distribution of IEGS with a focus on the integrated electricity-gas distribution system (IEGDS) composed by the power distribution and low-pressure gas systems. The load flow formulation considering pipeline elevation correction and three-phase unbalanced power distribution is proposed, and the load flow method based on the co-simulation of MATLAB and OpenDSS is then developed to obtain a more realistic load flow solution. An IEGDS example composed by the IEEE 13-bus distribution system and a 9-node gas distribution network is used to investigate effects of pipeline elevations on IEGDS analysis.

articleTitle: New Energy Dispatching System Design
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper briefly describes the energy utilization in the complex areas of new energy types, the problems encounter in improving its utilization efficiency. It introduces the hardware architecture and software system framework of the new energy dispatching system, analyzing the main functions realized by the new energy dispatch system. That is, power forecasting, monitoring, information collection and dispatch management. It realizes the formulation of a reasonable energy consumption plan for the new energy. Finally, the new energy control zone is independently set up in the provincial electricity distribution control zone, and the new energy cluster is equivalent to a virtual unit to facilitate scheduling control.

articleTitle: A Non-artificial Setting Method for Fault Feeder Detection Systems Based on Data Fusion Used in Resonant Grounding Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault line detection timely and accurately when single-phase-to-earth fault occurs in resonant grounding system is paid attention by many researchers. A new approach for fault detection based on data fusion which has non-artificial setting is presented in this paper. First, the fault criterion for interphase difference energy ratio and time-frequency correlation coefficient of each line is proposed. Then, a coordinate system with the interphase difference energy ratio as X axis and the time-frequency correlation coefficient as Y axis is established, and it uses the Euclidean distance algorithm to get the characteristic distance of each line by fusing two-dimensional information. Eventually, the sound distance and the fault distance of each line is compared to discriminate the fault line. The results and adaptability analysis from Electro-Magnetic Transients Program (EMTP) simulation demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A New Switch Vector Scheme Control for Three-Level NPC Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Space vector PWM principle of neutral point clamped (Neutral Point Clamped, referred NPC) three-level inverter is introduced in this paper to propose three-level NPC inverter vector control method of a new switching vector graph. Based on the new switch vector diagram, it requires only a simple arithmetic to determine vector in which the role of the reference voltage range and output voltage space vector corresponding to the duration of action of the switching device solves the traditional method's shortcomings. The simulation is taken based on MATLAB. The results verify the correctness and validity of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the Over-voltage Suppression Strategy for HVDC with New-generation Synchronous Condensers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under isolated mode of the direct current (DC) transmission system, when bipolar blocking occurs in high voltage direct current(HVDC), the alternating current (AC) system will generate high power frequency over-voltage. Therefore, whether the over-voltage can be suppressed is the key to whether the DC system can operate on an island. The new-generation synchronous condensers can effectively change the grid voltage level. In particular, the AC over-voltage level can be effectively suppressed by a reasonable control strategy. In this paper, a reasonable control strategy is proposed.The new-generation synchronous condenser's reactive power output characteristics were analyzed. Then, the relationship between power frequency over-voltage and short circuit ratio is derived. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Time-Ahead Optimal Scheduling of Multiple Resources Under the Presence of IPS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents multi-stage time-ahead scheduling of multiple resources for a power system under higher percentage of Intermittent Power Sources (IPSs). Forecasting error is linearly related to the length of time ahead of the forecasting which is done, use of gas turbines and Automatic Generation Control (AGC) capability of conventional units to balance the forecast error for IPS integrated power systems is not technically and economically feasible. A four stage time ahead scheduling is proposed with consideration of hybrid storage technologies consisting of Pumped Hydro Energy Storage (PHES) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for the IEEE-30 bus power system with 30% wind power integration from Zhangjiakou wind power system in China. The overall result indicates that the use of hybrid storage technologies with the proposed four stage scheduling methodology results in a minimal power balance problem and smoother operating of storage technologies.

articleTitle: Observation and Analysis of Gas Temperature Characteristic in the Streamer-to-Leader Transition under Positive Impulse Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The discharge mechanisms in air gap discharge are very important to the research of arc caused by earth fault. The gas temperature characteristic in a long air gap is observed by a Schlieren system in this paoer. The gas temperature characteristics of the streamer-to-leader transition process in long air gap are obtained and the radial temperature of the stem is approximately Gauss distribution. After that, the Gallimberti thermodynamic mechanism model is modified, where the influence of the current density distribution was introduced to the calculation. At last, the effectiveness of the modified model is proved by the experiment results.

articleTitle: Determining Penetration of Distributed Generation in Distribution Networks Based on Quantification of Impacts
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study proposes a computationally less demanding yet comprehensive analytical model to quantify impacts of distributed generation (DG) in order to determine DG penetration in the electric power distribution networks. From the observations of the literature, voltage rises at load bus bars and current carrying capacity of conductors are considered a serious limiting factor when installing DG. In this work, the analytical models have been derived. In addition, this work made improvement to an existing model that was limited to a single bus distribution network with only one type of DG, i.e. photovoltaic distributed generation (PVDG). Thus, the suggested model in this work can be applied to very large distribution networks and can accommodate different DG types. The proposed model has been validated through power flow simulations in MATLAB with MATPOWER; and has been tested on 33-bus and 69-bus power distribution test networks with PVDG and wind turbine distributed generation (WTDG).

articleTitle: Prediction Approach for Hourly Output of the Energy Station in the District Energy System Based on the Attenuation and Delay of the Pipeline Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper establishes a heat-transfer model for pipeline networks, taking into account the attenuation and delay for district energy systems. The model can transform the hourly load of each building into the hourly output of the energy station to level the load. Furthermore, the hourly output of the energy station was calculated based on three scenarios that represent the locations of energy stations. The results indicate that there was a great difference between the superposition value of all the users and the output of the energy station.

articleTitle: An Optimal Customization and Operation Strategy of Reserve-oriented Virtual Power Plant Based on CVaR
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) integrates demand response (DR) resources to provide reserve service for power system. VPP's profit can be maximized by optimizing the internal DR portfolios. A day-ahead portfolio optimization-based customization strategy of reserve-oriented VPP is proposed in this paper according to the forecast data of power system's reserve demand. Multi-scenario method is used to describe uncertainties associated with calling up reserve capacity and conditional value at risk (CVaR) is used to evaluate risk of VPP's profit. DRs' operating points are optimally adjusted to minimize the cost of being called up based on those scheduled day ahead. Results of case study show that qualified DR portfolios of VPP can be selected not only subject to DRs' operating constraints, but also benefiting both VPP and DRs, which features excellent incentive compatibility.

articleTitle: Transmission Network Planning Considering Different Functional Attributes of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale in the power grid, the attributes and functional forms of the power grid become more diverse and the impact of different functional attributes on the grid structure, security and reliability requirements are different. Given the characteristics and development of the current power grid, four functional attributes, namely, new energy consumption, load center power supply, hydropower delivery, and channel interconnection, are proposed to reflect the basic morphological characteristics of the power grid in this paper. Firstly, the k-means++ clustering algorithm is used to construct different scenarios of new energy and load. Then, the transmission network planning model considering different functional attributes of the power grid is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed transmission network planning model is verified by the simulation of modified IEEE-18 node examples in MATLAB and PSD-BPA.

articleTitle: Research on the Quantitative Impact of Policies on Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the economy and electricity are developing rapidly, and the influence of policy factors on the economy and power consumption is also increasing. Based on the input-output model, this paper firstly predicts and identifies the production control policy. Then, the corresponding model is built. Finally, three typical scenarios are set up to analyze the impact of policy impact on the industrial structure and the development of key industries. The results show that the input-output model can quantify the impact of policy on power consumption. Industries with large output per unit of power consumption are greatly affected by production control policy. Industries with relatively high intermediate demand for high-power consumption products are also affected by production control policies.

articleTitle: Household Appliance Identification Based on a Novel Load Signature Processing Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-intrusive load identification is a promising candidate in providing energy consumption information of individual appliances, which can improve energy-using habits and save energy. The load signature has a huge impact on the performance of non-intrusive load identification systems. In this paper, a new household appliance load identification model based on a novel load signature processing framework is proposed. Based on the proposed framework, the original VI trajectory of the household appliance is mapped to the binary image. The LeNet trained on the MNIST dataset is utilized to extract the deep features from the binary VI image. After that, the ReliefF algorithm is adopted to select the most important information from the deep features. The SVM is utilized to identify household appliances based on the obtained load signature. Finally, the experimental results based on the measured dataset and the PLAID dataset indicate that the proposed load signature processing framework is effective in improving the household appliance identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Line Selection Method Based on Multi-terminal Information Fusion and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing line selection methods are affected by complex fault characteristics, such as transition resistance, line parameters and other factors, the accuracy is not high. The traveling wave line selection protection method is not affected by the grounding mode and the above factors. A traveling wave fault line selection method based on artificial intelligence and multi-terminal information fusion is proposed. The grounding fault traveling wave selection method chooses zero- mode voltage traveling wave as the basis of time detection. The classified relative fault time array samples are obtained through fault simulation, which are input into the neural network for training. And then, the result of line selection can be obtained by inputting the unclassified samples into the network. The simulation results show that the line selection method is feasible.

articleTitle: Multiple Time-scale Characteristics Analysis of Rainfall in Hunan Province Based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the mode mixing and end effects of empirical mode decomposition (EMD), the ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) method based on extreme learning machine (ELM) signal continuation is presented to analyze the rainfall time series with multiple time-scale, In this paper, the EEMD and the wavelet method were applied to analyze the annual rainfall sequence in Hunan province. The results show that the EEMD method, as a kind of new signal processing method, can obtain accurate characteristics of the annual rainfall series. Based on this, it can be found that the proposed method can be widely used for the multiple timescale characteristics analysis of rainfall time series.

articleTitle: Transformer Inrush Current Impact on Commutation Failure Prevention of UHVDC Transmission system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studied the influence of transformer inrush current on commutation failure prevention control of Ultra-high voltage DC (UHVDC) transmission system. An actual event occurred on Tianzhong UHVDC transmission project was analyzed with data from fault recorder. UHVDC transmission model with commutation failure prevention control was established in PSCAD/EMTDC, and then it was applied to replay the event. It is found that the frequent maloperation of commutation failure control and the fluctuation of DC power exist when inrush current occurred. An improved commutation failure prevention control strategy was proposed to avoid this phenomenon. Validity of the improved method was proved by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Influence of Water Film Over Sphere- Sphere Electrodes on Power Frequency Discharge Characteristics of Air Gap
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The water film on the surface of the electrode affects the breakdown voltage of the air gap, but the mechanism of the influence is not clear. Herein, the sphere-sphere air gap is taken as the investigated research models. The breakdown voltage of the both electrodes coated with water film is higher than the dry electrodes at the sphere-sphere air gap. However, when the gap distance increases from 1cm to 6cm, the amplification of breakdown voltage decreases from 27.2% to 4.44%. The increase of breakdown voltage is because that the streamer is negative in the sphere-sphere gap, the starting photoelectrons of the secondary electron collapse originate from the photoionization of the cathode, the water film leads to the increase of energy of initial photoelectron, and the decrease of amplification of breakdown voltage is caused by the field distortional and increasing of gap distance.

articleTitle: Framework of a Simplified Large-Scale Source-Grid-Load Friendly Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The framework of a simplified large-scale source-grid-load (SGL) friendly interaction system is proposed in this paper. In this simplified system, the control subordinate station (CSS) is merged into the control main station (CMS), eliminating the need to install a large number of CSS. The proposed method can not only save the cost, but also, more importantly, simplifies the control process and reduces the time required to cut off the interruptible load in the event of fault. Meanwhile, the corresponding load selection and shedding methods and processes must be also adjusted. A load shedding process for a precision load shedding system is introduced: on the basis of the classification of the load, different levels of load have been prescribed with different priorities, and the CMS formulates the corresponding load-shedding command according to the planned rules, and sends it to each load control terminal (LCT). The LCT immediately cuts off the corresponding load after receiving the command, in the shortest complete the load shedding task in time and minimizes the impact.

articleTitle: Research on high-energy light spot deicing method for substation insulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the laser deicing technology of substation equipment is systematically studied from the aspects of theoretical analysis, simulation test and so on. Deicing characteristics of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser on the porcelain pillar insulators are obtained. The heat thawing effect and thermal stress effect of the main components of the substation under the action of laser are studied, and the main installation of the substation is obtained. The heat conduction effect and laser energy consumption per unit area are required. Relationship between the surface temperature of the insulator, exposure time and type of damage is obtained. Design method of high energy laser spot is put forward and experiment is carried out. The results show that the laser can be used for deicing of the transformer, heat thawing effect, thermal stress effect, the balance between melting power and heat conduction efficiency, and deicing quickly and safely without damage to the equipment.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of AC/DC hybrid system with Renewable Generations: An Expansion Planning Modle
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flexible AC/DC hybrid system is seen as a favorable option for the next generation Energy Internet, giving an innovative solution to address the problem of accommodating large-scale renewable energy. This paper formulates a coordinated planning model to get the best system configuration while uncertainty of renewable energy generations and control strategy of converter are both taken into account. A scenario construction method using joint probability is proposed in this paper, which effectively solves the modeling problem of multiple uncertainties in both generation and load. The calculation results of testing AC/DC hybrid system which show the economy and robustness of the planning scheme, can be improved by using the flexible controlling resource of converter which further proves that the AC/DC hybrid system can promote the consumption of integrated energy in the future.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cyber-attacks Influence on the Identification of Critical Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deep integration of power and ICT(information and communication technology) systems, the potential security problems of new generation power system are not only confined to physical power system, but also become physical security problems of power networks. The SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system is easy to be attacked for its defects and leaks. Since it is closely linked to the observability of the power system state, whether the identification of critical measurements and critical measurement sets is robust under cyber-attacks should be focused on. Based on the properties of the critical measurement and the critical measurement set, the potential influences of various cyberattacks on them are analyzed. Whether the identification results of the critical measurement and the critical measurement group are impacted depends on the attacked measurements' type and location, as well as the attacker’s intention. Moreover, the IEEE-14 power system is applied as an example to verify the effectiveness of the analysis in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Power Material Bidding and Supplier Service Quality Evaluation Based on LCC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional procurement method of power equipment attaches importance to the price of equipment and ignores the large amount of expenses in the operation and maintenance stage of equipment, which cannot reflect the cost of equipment correctly. In view of the shortcomings of traditional procurement methods, a life cycle cost (LCC)-based procurement method is proposed, which considers the cost of the equipment throughout its life cycle, the application case of supplier service quality intelligent evaluation is calculated. The rationality of the new procurement method is verified in this paper.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of Verdet Constant Based on Refractive Index Dispersion of Optical Fiber Current Sensing Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of ubiquitous power internet of things, people put forward higher and higher requirements for the informationization level of power equipment. Optical fiber current sensor has a very high level of information technology, so it attracts the attention of scholars. However, the existence of linear birefringence in optical materials and its low sensitivity to current and magnetic fields have always been the main reasons that restrict optical current sensors. The Feldt constant of optical fiber current sensor material characterizes the responsiveness of optical material to Faraday effect, which is closely related to the measurement sensitivity of all-optical fiber current sensor. The traditional method of measuring the Feldt constant is to calculate the Feldt constant by measuring the Faraday magneto-optical deflection angle. This method will be affected by linear birefringence and other factors, so that the measurement results are lower than the actual values. Based on the principle of frequency dispersion in refractive index light, a spectrophotometric method is proposed to measure the Verdet constant of optical materials. Compared with the traditional methods, the results show that the proposed method can avoid the influence of linear birefringence and other factors, and has guiding significance for improving the measurement sensitivity of optical fiber current sensor.

articleTitle: Locational Marginal Price Model Considering Multi-Dimensional Characteristics of Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Locational marginal price (LMP) is dependent on the characteristics of the participants to a large extent. Based on Multi-Dimensional characteristics of generators, a locational marginal price modeling method is proposed in this paper. Three-dimensional characteristics of generators' bidding are extracted from the historical bidding data, including risk favor, degree of certainty, and the degree of optimism. Based on the expected value of forecasted LMP, the Three-dimensional characteristics are used to generate the forecasted bid price of individual generators, where the LMP clearing problem is solved and the forecasted LMP is obtained.

articleTitle: A Novel Reliability Assessment Method of Microgrid Based on Time Correlation Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the microgrid contains a large quantity of distributed power generation, the reliability assessment of microgrid is different from that of traditional distribution network. Therefore, a novel reliability assessment method for microgrid which considering time correlation is proposed in this paper and the corresponding reliability assessment process is designed. Firstly, based on time correlation, the microgrid model is established according to distributed power supply output model, load model and component fault model. Then, in order to improve the accuracy of data collection, an improved Latin Hypercube sampling method is proposed to sample the output of wind turbine and photovoltaic. Finally, the method is applied to the reliability evaluation of a case, and the experiment results show that the proposed method can give a more accurate reliability assessment to the microgrid.

articleTitle: Precise Load Curtailment Simulation United with Power System Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Precise load curtailment (PLC) is a verified technology to use demand side resources in pilot project in Jiangsu province, China. A simulation method of PLC is proposed in this paper and this module is united with a power system simulation module. Both of these two modules use the same power system model with a hierarchical database. In PLC simulation module, the power of two DC lines is the action condition variable for load curtailing. When load curtailment is triggered by DC blocking event which simulated in power system simulation module, the PLC simulation module will calculate the amount of loads that will be curtailed and the power of these loads will be modified in power system model. Then the power system simulation module will calculate the power flow and system frequency. The simulation framework and the load curtailment strategy are illustrated, as well as the PLC simulation modeling methods. At last, the simulation cases with different curtailment strategies are also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of Broken Lines at Overhead Ground Wire and Pre-twisted Wire Port Based on Skin Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Breakage and stock breaks are caused by the pre-twisted wire fittings of lightning protection lines in overhead transmission lines with power outages and even secondary disasters. In order to ensure the normal and stable operation of the power grid and reduce the wire breakage accident, it is studied that the heat generation of the overhead ground wire and the pre-twisted wire contact port in the paper. The ground wire and the pre-twisted wire contact point are equivalent to a uniform cylindrical conductive bridge, and the simulation model of the pre-twisted wire contact port is established. The radial and axial current density distribution curves of the grounding wire under the influence of the skin effect are analyzed, and the influence of current density on the contact resistance is studied. The key factor in influencing the contact resistance is the relative permeability of the material, and effective improvement measures are proposed accordingly.

articleTitle: Two-way listing distributed power trading mechanism research and platform development based on Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed power and the opening of the electricity-selling market, the state has introduced a series of policies to promote market-based trading of distributed power generation. The traditional trading mode is centralized bidding, which is not applicable to the characteristics of small, public and scattered distribution power trading. Blockchain technology has the advantages of open transaction, transparent information, and trustworthiness, which is very suitable for distributed transactions in P2P mode. Therefore, this paper studies the two-way listed distributed power trading mechanism, and combines the Ethereum blockchain to study its specific transaction process and mathematical model, and design and develop a two-way listing trading platform based on Ethereum. Finally, this paper uses a case to verify the trading model and test the trading platform.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of the Power Load Integration Platform for Auxiliary Peaking Service
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Most power retailers in China have shortcomings in high-quality user selection, bidding strategy formulation, value-added service participation and risk control and other aspects. The load integration platform developed by this project can seamlessly link the transaction, marketing and dispatching systems of provincial power companies, and integrate numerous decentralized power users to participate in power market trading. By using this platform, the market core competitiveness of power retailers is enhanced.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Maximum Leading Phase Operation Capability of Pumped Storage Units in Leading Power Factor Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the maximum leading phase operation capability assessing of pumped storage units, a novel calculation method considering three restrictive factors of power angle, stator current and terminal voltage is proposed. Under power generation and pumping work conditions, the maximum leading phase operation capability is analyzed, and the influence of transformer tap position on the maximum ability is studied as well. Taking a 300MW pumped storage unit as an example, the Q-PV three-dimensional surface of maximum leading phase operation ability changing with the system voltage and active power are shown in the picture. Under the typical working conditions, theoretical calculation results are basically consistent with the testing data, which validates the correctness and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Based Bad Metering Data Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: False data injection attacks aim at destroying integrity and availability of data in electric metering system. False data detection scheme is of great significance to the secure and stable operation of smart grid. In order to address many security problems caused by false data in smart grid, this paper proposes a collaborative detection model of false data injection attacks based on edge computing, which improves the network structures of traditional metering system and provides the capability of global monitoring and detection function for false data by edge servers in smart grid. The scheme proposes some rules to detect false data injection in electric metering system. Moreover, a reputation mechanism for data collectors is constructed in the paper. The simulation experiments show the validity of proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal Reconfiguration of PV Array under Mismatch Conditions using Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the photovoltaic (PV) generation systems, the mismatch loss problem may directly degrade power output of generation, and cause multiple peaks in the P-V profile as well as the stepped I-V profile. In this paper, a novel simulated annealing algorithm (SAA) based solution is proposed to carry out the PV array reconfiguration under necessary conditions, e.g., in the presence of partial shading and module defects. The proposed reconfiguration algorithmic solution is extensively evaluated through simulation experiments for a range of mismatch patterns and the P-V and I-V curves are analyzed. The effectiveness of the proposed solution in optimizing the overall generation of PV array is clearly confirmed through appropriate reconfiguration.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Calculating Power Transmission Equipment Loss and Hot Spot Temperature in Distribution Network under Harmonic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution transformer is widely used as an important energy transmission equipment. In recent years, with a large number of non-linear loads used in power grid, the impact of harmonic pollution on the power system has become more and more serious. Harmonic disturbance affects the no-load loss, load loss and hot spot temperature of distribution transformer, thus further shortening the service life of transformer. An improved method for calculating loss and hot spot temperature is presented in this paper. Firstly, the influence of harmonics on load loss is analyzed. The load loss calculation model of transformer under different connection groups is established. Secondly, the variation of core loss with harmonic frequency and flux density is analyzed.
