The load loss calculation model of transformer under different connection groups is established. Finally, the temperature rise calculation model proposed by IEEE C57.110 is revised. Considering the effects of stray loss and no-load loss, a more accurate method for calculating hot spot temperature is proposed.

articleTitle: Bilevel optimization strategy for interconnection of wind-photovoltaic power generation and EV charging and discharging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the cooperative absorption mechanism of wind-photovoltaic power generation and electric vehicle interconnection. Markov decision process is used to model the two random events of wind-photovoltaic generation and electric vehicle charging and discharging. Based on this, a multi-objective bilevel optimal charging and discharging scheduling model is proposed for the interconnection of wind-photovoltaic generation and electric vehicle based on cluster. The upper dispatching agency considers the consumption of wind-photovoltaic power generation and the economy of grid side operation, and EV group institution takes charge-discharge fees with battery internal losses into account. When solving the problem, making full use of the correlation between the structural features and variables between the upper and lower layers, the basic strategy of information exchange between the upper and lower layers is constructed, and based on the hierarchical features and future situation simulation, the double-layer optimal scheduling strategy is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed optimization strategy is simulated and analyzed in IEEE 30 nodes system.

articleTitle: Wildfire Monitoring Technology of Transmission Lines Based on Himawari-8 Geostationary Meteorological Satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Limited by the time intervals of passing territory of polar-orbiting satellites, it is impossible to uninterruptedly monitor wildfire occurrences in power transmission line corridors by using polar-orbiting satellites. In this paper, a monitoring technique based on the Himawari-8 geostationary meteorological satellite was proposed. Considering the influences of the solar elevation angle, the non-vegetation pixel and the cloud pixel on the identification precision, an adaptive dynamic method was proposed to identify fire-points. This monitoring technique has been applied in a provincial power grid in the southern of China, which realizes 24h uninterrupted monitoring of wildfire occurrences in power transmission line corridors.

articleTitle: Load characteristics and impacts of different electric heating equipment integrated into power grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the serious haze problem, the coal-to-electricity project is implemented and has become a national strategy in China. The characteristics and application scopes of different types of electric heating modes are analyzed in this paper. Then, the load characteristics of different types of electric heating modes are shown based on actual operation data, and influences and impacts of coal-to-electricity are introduced. Moreover, a power prediction model is introduced and typical characteristics of the power prediction are extracted, providing a useful reference for the power network planning considering coal-to-electricity.

articleTitle: A Fast and Stable Algorithm for Switching Treatment During EMTP-type Simulations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Simulation algorithm for switching treatment is essential for the electromagnetic transient simulation of the power electronic networks. A fast and stable switching treatment algorithm, which considers multiple switching events in the same time-step, is put forward in this paper. The proposed algorithm uses linear interpolation to estimate the accurate switching time instant for eliminating the switching delay. Combining the iterative switching status searching algorithm aims to obtain the accurate switch combination firstly. Then, the flexible multi-step backward Euler method with half time-step is employed to remove the numerical oscillations completely, and avoid costly recalculation and re-triangulation of the system admittance matrix. Finally, the variables are linearly interpolated back to the initial time-mesh, according to the second backward Euler integration step. Compared with the results of two typical cases from PSCAD/EMTDC, the proposed algorithm is proved to be more accurate and stable.

articleTitle: Investment Benefit Assessment for the Power Grid Considering the Optimization Strategy of Electric Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional evaluation methods do not accord with the objective facts due to the interference from human factors, in addition, it lacks the influence of the electricity price strategy on the evaluation results. Therefore, it is difficult for these methods to give a true evaluation result that reflects the original evaluation information. In response to the above problems, an evaluation method based on the graph model is proposed to evaluate the investment benefit considering the optimization strategy of electric price. From the perspective of technology, economy and society, the paper has constructed the evaluation index system about the transmission network projects, then, according to the characteristics of project's functions, all indices' weight are calculated by the graph model method. The example and rationality analysis both show that the graph model method not only can reflect the original evaluation information and get objective weights, but also can be used to evaluate investment efficiency in practical.

articleTitle: User Satisfaction and Responsivity Orderly Dispatching Strategies Application on Time-of-use Price of Electronic Vehicle Optimisation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Disorderly charging of large-scale electric vehicles is detrimental to the safe operation of distribution network. To solve this problem, this paper presents a system for orderly electric vehicle charging strategies based on time-of-use (TOU) price, considering the user responsivity, cost satisfaction and convenience satisfaction. The Monte Carlo method and particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) are used to simulate user charging behavior. The results show that this strategy helps to smooth the load fluctuations caused by charging operation, reduce cost and improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: The Distribution Network Digital-Analog Hybrid Simulation Technology of Distributed Power Access
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Digital physics hybrid simulation, which synthesizes the advantages of digital simulation and physical simulation, makes up for the shortcomings of both. In this way, a new idea for the simulation research of active intelligent distribution network is provided. In order to solve the problem of rough models of distributed power supply such as fan and photovoltaic connected in digital simulation of distribution network, a digital physical hybrid simulation scheme suitable for large-scale distribution network connected fan and photovoltaic is proposed. The interface unit design for digital simulation and physical simulation is discussed in detail, the advantages of hybrid interface scheme are demonstrated, and the concrete flow of hybrid simulation is given. Finally, an example is given to verify the feasibility of the proposed hybrid simulation scheme and the accuracy of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Post-disaster Power Supply Recovery Strategy Based on Path Description
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to restore the power service as much as possible, the circuit-breaker of distribution network is reorganized to change distribution network's operation mode. The topology of distribution network is firstly modeled by path description method. After that, all the possible service restoration paths are searched in the distribution network model by depth priority algorithm. Based on the principle of critical loads to be restored as much as possible, the optimization equations are established to solve the post-disaster reconstruction topology and power service recovery strategy of the distribution network. Moreover, the possible topology of power distribution network and critical load factors are fully considered in the process of service restoration after disaster. The proposed strategy can restore all the critical loads for the massive power outage after a disaster. Advantages are reflected compared with two typical algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Harmonic Load Loss Calculation Method of Oil-Paper Insulated Distribution Power Transmission Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, there are a large number of nonlinear electrical equipment in the power system, which leads to higher and higher harmonic components in the system. In addition, the large number of new energy access, such as photovoltaic, wind power and so on, also introduces large harmonic interference. Harmonic has a certain influence on the loss of distribution transformer in operation. Based on the principle of harmonic current acting on transformer, the winding resistance loss, winding eddy current loss and stray loss of distribution transformer under non-rated condition are analyzed in this paper. The load loss calculation model in the IEEE Std C57.110 is further revised. Based on the model established in this paper, the selected example transformer is calculated and analyzed. The accuracy of the calculation model established in this paper is verified by the analysis results. The larger the harmonic distortion rate and harmonic frequency, the faster the load loss of distribution transformer increases.

articleTitle: Minimum Startup Method of DC Near-field Thermal Power Unit Based on Unit Voltage Supporting Effect
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the centralized access of large-scale new energy sources, the voltage stability of the DC near-area in sending end power grid is closely related to the thermal power unit startup method. Firstly, the supporting effect of thermal power unit on static voltage of multi-circuit DC converter station is analyzed based on the UHVDC operating characteristics of sending end power grid. The dynamic voltage supporting effect of the DC predictive fault set is obtained by integrating the unit reactive power over time under the fault. Combined with the supporting effect of static and dynamic voltage, the optimal startup sequence of the DC supporting unit is determined, and the DC stable control tripping capacity is taken into consideration. Finally, the minimum startup method of the DC near-area is determined and verified by the actual grid example.

Author Keywords: Minimum startup method of thermal power unit

articleTitle: Intelligent Identification of Transmission Line Defects Based on Fast Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The hidden risk management and governance of the important crossing sections of overhead transmission lines is one of the key tasks of State Grid Corporation in recent years. With the wide application of new technologies such as unmanned aerial vehicles and visual online monitoring systems, massive inspection image data has been obtained. Most of the image data is identified and diagnosed manually at present, which is easy to cause misjudgment, and the recognition efficiency is extremely low. In this paper, the multi-source monitoring data of overhead transmission lines are collected and organized. Based on the fast neural network model, an intelligent fault identification method for transmission line visualization data is proposed for improving the utilization efficiency of transmission line monitoring data and helping to fully understand the running status of the equipment.

articleTitle: Synchronous Condenser Fault Diagnosis Method Based on RBF Neutral Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional synchronous condenser fault diagnosis algorithm is too dependent on experience, and it cannot accurately reflect the relationship between features and failure type, resulting in the low diagnostic accuracy. Aiming at this problem, the radial basis function (RBF) neural network algorithm is used to diagnose the synchronous condenser fault. The operating parameters of synchronous condenser are used for learning and training, and the corresponding fault type output is obtained. The simulation results show that the diagnosis algorithm has a high accuracy and a small calculation error, proving that the diagnosis method can be widely used for on-line monitoring of the synchronous condenser.

articleTitle: Electricity Consumption Forecast of Provincial Power Companies Based on VEC Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity demand forecasting is an important basis for planning power development and guiding power construction. Accurate electricity consumption prediction in the whole society can effectively avoid power waste. Based on the relationship between various industries and electricity consumption of provincial power companies, a power consumption prediction model based on VEC model was established. The actual electricity consumption data of each industry in each month was used as the model input quantity, and it is 3-12 in 2019 in Shanxi Province. Forecasting electricity consumption of industry in each month becomes crucial.

articleTitle: Modeling and Parameter Identification of Grid-Connected PV System during Asymmetrical Grid Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the asymmetric faults that take place in a power grid result in the grid current imbalance, and feed into the grid power inducing oscillation, which seriously affects the stability of power grid. For the asymmetric fault, the second-order generalized integrator(SOGI) is used to separate the positive and negative sequence components. The negative sequence voltage feedforward control method with notch filter is proposed. It can suppress the influence of the double frequency alternating components generated by the line side negative sequence components, and improve the low voltage ride through performance of the photovoltaic power generation system. Then, the key parameters of the inverter are identified by chaotic particle swarm optimization(CPSO) algorithm. The simulation model in Matlab/Simulink verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Scenario-based Unit Commitment Model Considering Stochastic Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the stochastic and fluctuated nature of wind energy, it is difficult to predict wind power accurately. Thus, the day-ahead optimal dispatching for power system integrated large-scale wind power has a significant challenge. Therefore, a unit commitment (UC) method considering stochastic wind power is proposed to mitigate the impact of inaccurate predicted error in this paper. Firstly, the improved Lagrange relaxation algorithm is used to obtain the dual problem of the generator unit model. Secondly, based on the prediction of wind power interval, the scenario method is used to deal with the fluctuation of wind power through the scene generation and improved fast backward reduction technology. Finally, the 10-unit system model is built, and the feasibility of the proposed UC model is proved by comparing the stochastic UC model and deterministic model.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis of Sent-in-Error Thyristor Protective Trigger on HVDC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On HVDC open-line, valve control monitoring forward voltage of thyristors is prone to send protective trigger in error and cause DC block. For this case, this paper analyses operating condition of open HVDC line and principle of protective trigger. Taking an actual 800kV HVDC as example, cause analysis is carried out. The causes and conditions of sent-in-error valve control protective trigger are proposed. Affected by waveform of actual voltage, near the point where thyristor voltage phase angle is 180°, valve electronics are prone to send built voltage pulse signal when receiving trigger pulse signal. And valve interface electronics would take this signal as protective trigger pulse signalin mistake. Because of the limit of trigger delay angle by converter unit control, the valve electronics would not receive the trigger pulse signal near the point where the thyristor voltage phase angle is 180° on non-open HVDC line. The case of sent-in-error valve control protective trigger would only happen on open HVDC line. Experimental test of the valve control was carried out. Fault phenomenon and experimental test result are consistent with the proposed causes and conditions.

articleTitle: Trading Decision for Multiple Virtual Power Plants Considering Power Sharing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continuous promotion and deepening of the electricity market reform, as well as the implementation of the pilot distributed power generation market, provide the policy support for power sharing, so the conditions for implementing the power sharing model will be increasingly adequate. In this paper, a power sharing mode of multiple virtual power plants (multi-VPP) is proposed, and the distributed trading decisionmaking model of multi-VPP is established. By coordinating the exchanged power among the VPPs within the multi-VPP, along with the exchanged power between the multi-VPP and the main grid, the total operating costs of the multi-VPP are minimized. Considering that each VPP is an independent entity with ability to make decision by themselves, the proposed model is transformed into a distributed optimization problem in which each VPP makes its own decision by using distributed optimization algorithm. To verify the validity of the proposed model, a multi-VPP formed by three VPPs are selected for simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Interturn Fault Detection Algorithm for Shunt Reactors Based on Leakage Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When a turn to turn fault takes place in a dry-type iron-core reactor, the circulating current in the shorted turns is ten times or tens of times larger than the rated phase current, which could cause insulation and structure damage of windings. However, the changes of terminal voltage and phase current are very small, thus they cannot be regarded as the reliable criterion of turn to turn fault protection. In this paper, the characteristics of the magnetic field distribution in the reactor are analyzed as a criterion for the detection of turn to turn fault and its detection algorithm is further proposed. To investigate the effects of different numbers of shorted turns and fault regions on the spatial magnetic field distribution of the iron-core reactor, various finite element analysis simulations were performed by Maxwell. It provides a theoretical basis for the study of turn to turn fault detection algorithm. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed detection algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: An Indirect Method for Measuring Transformer Residual Magnetism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of residual magnetism measurement of the transformer, and make the estimation of the core flux in the idle state of the transformer is made to have engineering practicability, the magnetic flux in the transformer core should be correlated with the current amplitude and the phase angle at the moment of the transformer in the non-operating state. In this paper, the change law of the residual magnetism of the transformer is verified by the dynamic simulation experiment. And a scheme for measuring the residual magnetism by using the first peak current of the magnetizing inrush current is proposed. The scheme combines the DC magnetic flux curve and the peak magnetization curve to indirectly find the residual magnetism before the transformer is put into operation.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Optimization Scheduling Method for Integrated Community Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread of combined heat and power plants (CHP) and micro turbines (MT) in the distribution network, electricity, heat and natural gas are coupled tightly in community areas. In order to determine the optimal day-ahead scheduling schemes of the integrated community energy system (ICES), a hierarchical optimization method is proposed, where the reconfigurable capability of an electric distribution network is considered. The proposed hierarchical framework designs a client---server structure to handle the opacity of information among energy service providers (ESP). The client level that includes heat, electricity and natural gas is modeled by energy center (EC). Taking into account the demand-side response (DR) of alternative energy, the connected power between clients, the natural gas and electric distribution network is determined with the objectives of lower energy consumption and higher energy efficiency. The natural gas and electric distribution network are regarded as two servers. In order to minimize the loss, the distribution system operator (DSO) utilizes remotely controlled switches (RCSs) to reconfigure hourly the electric distribution network. A hybrid optimization method is utilized to solve the model, on the basis of an improved particle swarm algorithm and a nonlinear interior point method (IPM). This paper demonstrates the regional integrated energy system is able to operate economically and efficiently .

articleTitle: Design Method of Modular Multilevel Real-time On-line Anti-icing and Ice-melting Equipment Based on Self-ice-melting Conductors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The equivalent circuit of self-ice-melting conductor contains large capacitance components and inductance components. When applying alternating current ice-melting power supply, capacitance components and inductance components will consume a large amount of reactive power. In order to avoid reactive power consumption, direct current ice-melting power supply is needed. While the aluminium strand of the self-ice-melting conductor conveys alternating current power, and the steel core voltage is the sum of aluminium strand voltage and a fixed voltage, the voltage difference between the steel core and the aluminium strand will be direct current. The secondary side of alternating current transmission transformer is designed with transmission winding and ice melting winding. The transmission winding is used to generate transmission power and connect to the aluminium strand. Two modular multi-level converters are connected with the ice-melting winding. The first modular multi-level converter converts the output voltage of the ice-melting winding to direct current, and the second modular multi-level converter converts direct current to the sum of the voltage of the aluminum strand and the fixed voltage. By the designed method of this paper, direct current power supply for ice melting can be generated between steel core and aluminium strand to restrain the reactive power consumption.

articleTitle: Optimization of SRM Direct Instantaneous Torque Control Strategy based on Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The direct instantaneous torque control has weak anti-interference ability and insufficient torque ripple optimization. In this paper, a method based on improved firefly algorithm to optimize SRM direct instantaneous torque control is proposed. On the basic of proportional integral control, the improved firefly algorithm is used to optimize the parameters which will help to find the optimal simulation parameters automatically. The method proposed in this paper has reduced torque ripple and improved dynamic response of the system. The experimental simulation verifies its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Galloping Early Warning Technology of Transmission Lines Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of strong nonlinear characteristics of transmission line galloping, firstly, the characteristics of historical dancing are analyzed, and the distribution areas and influencing factors of galloping are also revealed, which can be provided as the theoretical support for the establishment of galloping prediction model. Based on the characteristics of the galloping influence factors, several meteorological factors are selected for the galloping forecast, including surface temperature, rainfall, Upper air temperature, wind speed. Then the galloping forecast model based on Radial Basis Function neural network is built to predict whether galloping is happening. These essential meteorological factors are taken as the input parameters, while the output of the model is the galloping risk result. The galloping samples in the past five years of 2010-2014 has been taken as the training case, and the galloping samples in the November of 2015 in Liaoning Province has been taken as the testing case. The results show that it is feasible to use this artificial forecast model to predict the galloping risk of transmission line. The galloping prediction testing result using the proposed model shows that the forecast precision rate can reach as high as 91%, which can provide great technical support for the anti-galloping work for power grid. The research results can provide support for the transmission line galloping prediction and early warning technology, so as to improve the level of intelligent operation and maintenance of power grid.

Author Keywords: influencing factors of galloping; galloping forecast model

articleTitle: Industrial Control Intrusion Detection Model Based on S7 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proposal of the national industrial 4.0 strategy, the integration of industrial control network and Internet technology is getting higher and higher. At the same time, the closeness of industrial control networks has been broken to a certain extent, making the problem of industrial control network security increasingly serious. S7 protocol is a private protocol of Siemens Company in Germany, which is widely used in the communication process of industrial control network. In this paper, an industrial control intrusion detection model based on S7 protocol is proposed. Traditional protocol parsing technology cannot resolve private industrial control protocols, so, this model uses deep analysis algorithm to realize the analysis of S7 data packets. At the same time, in order to overcome the complexity and portability of static white list configuration, this model dynamically builds a white list through white list self-learning algorithm. Finally, a composite intrusion detection method combining white list detection and abnormal behavior detection is used to detect anomalies. The experiment proves that the method can effectively detect the abnormal S7 protocol packet in the industrial control network.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Ice-storage in Multiple Energy Systems: An Real-world Case Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrating multiple energy systems (MES) such as gas, power, heat, and cooling systems is an effective way to improve the overall efficiency of the whole energy systems. MES is viewed as an important component of the construction of Energy Internet. There have been various demonstration projects for MES all around China since the government called for the construction of Energy Internet. This paper conducts real-world case studies on an MES in one Energy Internet demonstration project in Zhuhai, China, especially for the economic analysis of the role of ice-storage in the MES. Four scenarios with/without ice-storage are compared. Results show that the introduction of ice-storage can reduce the overall cost and lower the capacity requirement of other energy conversions in the MES.

articleTitle: Fault Detection Technology and Analysis of 10 kV XLPE Power Cable
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of power infrastructure, cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) power cable plays an increasingly important role in urban distribution networks. Therefore, it is of great significance to test and diagnose the performance of XLPE cable insulation to ensure the reliability of cable operation. The field test of a cable line which has been running for 8 years using the technology of oscillating partial discharge combined with 0.1 Hz ultra-low frequency dielectric loss is introduced in this paper. The results show the abnormal partial discharge of the middle joint at 95m away from the outlet of the substation. Moreover, standard deviation and dielectric loss change rate under U0 voltage are all over the normal range, and the cable has water tree aging. The research results can provide direction for the physical and chemical analysis of cable and further analysis of aging degree.

articleTitle: A Circular Recursion Algorithm Power Load Forecasting Model and Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load forecasting is the basis and premise of safe and reliable economic operation and planning of power systems. This paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of various load forecasting models, including gray model (GM), support vector machine (SVM), back propagation (BP), neural network method (NNM), combination forecasting method (CFM) and expert system method (ESM). Based on the analysis of the traditional power load forecasting algorithm of the power grid, according to the characteristics of different forecasting time phases, a boolean recursive algorithm (BRA) for power load characteristic prediction is proposed. In this model, the whole year is divided into five feature prediction stages, the prediction algorithm formulas of different feature stages are different. Based on the new algorithm, a set of load forecasting software are designed. This paper introduces the main functions and features of the software and describes how the software is predicted. And the BRA uses the actual historical data values of the power supply company to predict the power load, the application shows the feasibility.

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of Wind Farm Considering Peak Load Regulation Capability of Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind curtailment caused by lack of peak load regulation capability invalidates the large-scale installed wind energy capacity and results in low economic efficiency. Based on the daily fluctuation and seasonal operation pattern of wind power and load, this paper introduces two extreme scenarios to describe the impact of wind power integration on peak load regulation of power system. A wind farm planning model considering the peak load regulation capability is proposed. The objective of the model is to maximize the total profit with the system operation constraints considered. After solving the proposed model, the optimal construction site and size of wind farm can be obtained. Case study on IEEE 24-node 38-bus test system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition Method of Distribution Cabinet Equipment Based on Higher Moment Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Switchgear, ring cabinet, cable branch box and other cabinet equipment are the important components for high voltage distribution network. Its stable operation can stabilize the distribution network system. Reliable power supply is of great significance. Partial discharge (PD) is the main cause of switchgear failure. At present, transient earth voltages (TEV) detection method is one of the more effective partial discharge detection methods for switchgear. But the accurate pattern recognition of partial discharge signal is still one of the more difficult research tasks. Based on the traditional waveform features, moment features, typing features, statistical features and wavelet methods, this paper proposes to add higher-order moments as feature parameters, using support vector machine and probabilistic neural network as classifiers for comparative study. The typical discharges such as tip discharge, surface discharge, internal air gap discharge and suspension discharge were simulated on the switchgear in the laboratory, and 50 groups of data were collected for analysis. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of typical discharge types in switchgear is 86.25% and 88.75% respectively when classifier is probabilistic neural network and support vector machine. They are 15% and 27.5% higher than that of traditional five identification parameters. It can be seen that the identification accuracy can be effectively improved by incorporating high-order moments into the characteristic parameters. Therefore, this method has guiding significance for the identification of typical partial discharge signals.

articleTitle: Scheme and Operation Characteristic Analysis of Large Sending Terminal DC Grid Based on Flexible DC in West China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy will play an important role in the future energy development of West China. Voltage source converter based on high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) has a strong regulation capability of voltage and power, and can be interconnected with weak AC grid or even passive grid. A ± 1000kV large west sending terminal DC power grid based on VSC-HVDC is constructed, by which with rich distributed resources in West China can be centrally dispatched to East China, avoiding the uncertainty impact of renewable energy power generation on power system stability. Steady and transient characteristics of the sending terminal DC grid are simulated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical-Social Systems for Wind Power Operation and maintenance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Taking the short circuit fault between gates as an example, this paper presents a method of training wind power operation and maintenance personnel based on the Cyber-Physical-Social Systems (CPSS) of wind power operation and maintenance. The ability of wind power operation and maintenance personnel is measured by cognitive measurement model. At the same time, the intelligent guidance system of operation and maintenance is established, and the operation and maintenance personnel can train according to the measurement results. Finally, the experiment shows that the social physical information system of wind power operation and maintenance can reduce the cost of operation and maintenance, improving the efficiency of operation and maintenance and generate electricity.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Power Transformer Based on RVFL Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safe operation of transformer is very important to power network. Random vector function chain network (RVFL) has the characteristics of fast training speed and strong generalization performance. Based on RVFL algorithm, this paper constructs a three-layer-four-classification model. By discussing the optimal value of relevant parameters, the sample data is used for optimization under two different input characteristics, and then, the test results of four independent classifiers in the model and the test results of overall classification of sample data are analyzed. Examples show that the parameter selection under different sample data is closely related to the diagnostic accuracy of the network. The simulation results and comparison with other algorithms verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: random vector functional link neural network

articleTitle: Strategy on Interruptible Load Selection for Precise Load Shedding System of Source-Grid-Load Friendly Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The precise load shedding of source-grid-load friendly interaction system can realize accurate control of the interruptible load on the user side when UHV DC fault occurs through classified management of user side load. Compared with the traditional way of integral power cut-off, it can greatly reduce the social impact caused by faults. This paper analyzes the control requirements of the load shedding system, establishes the load classification model based on the precise load shedding system, discusses the load selection algorithm, and proposes a load selection method for load shedding margin optimization based on the basic load selection (BLS) algorithm. The simulation on the algorithm shows that the method effectively optimizes the allowable load shedding of the system and achieves the requirement of the precise load shedding.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Indicator System of "Source-Grid-Load" Interaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The "source-grid-load" interaction involving three major types of entities which are obviously source, gird and load, will have an important impact on the entire power system. In order to evaluate the interaction effect, this paper designs an overall evaluation framework and proposes a comprehensive indicator system respectively related to each participant. The research results can help to guide the positive interaction among source, grid and load, and promote the optimal allocation of power system resources.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Transient Model and Parameters Identification of PMSG-Based Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to study the equivalent electromagnetic transient characteristics of PMSG-based wind farm, the structure, control strategy and coordinates transformation method of PMSG-based wind turbine generator are analyzed in this paper. To this end, a detailed electromagnetic transient model of PMSG-based wind turbine generator is established. The steady state equivalent circuit, phasor graph and initializing method of state variable are developed. Then, the process of parameters identification using genetic algorithm is introduced. Since in the transient process, the change of rotor speed is very small, and the input mechanical torque of the wind turbine can be approximately considered constant. Therefore, the parameters of the mechanical torque need not to be identified, which greatly reduces the number of parameters involved in the identification and improves the convergence speed of the algorithm and the stability of the identification results. Finally, a simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed electromagnetic transient model and the parameters identification method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Management Interface Device of Grid-Connected DGs Based on Wide-Time Scale
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing demand for distributed generators (DGs), the grid-connection of DGs has become an important issue. In order to connect to gird friendly, and effectively control and manage DGs, in the paper, an adaptive protecting and monitoring management interface device of grid-connected DGs is proposed. Firstly, based on the operation of DGs, the management device can adaptively complete the functions of protection, monitoring and communication management in accordance with wide time scale and frequency. In the actual testing, the proposed strategy can not only enhance the timeliness of data utilization and the accuracy of control, but also improve the security and stability of DGs and other devices. In addition, the solution can optimize the allocation of power and the fault-tolerant protection capability of the device.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Multi-label Fault Recognition Based on Combined Feature Selection and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing status of renewable energy in energy system, efficient wind power generation has become one of the hot issues. As the layout and running environment of wind turbines are often complicated, high fault rate becomes a key factor influencing the improvement of power generation efficiency. In order to reduce operation, maintenance cost, and improve system reliability, we focus on early-warning wind turbine system fault type. This paper proposes a combined feature selection method and BP Neural Network model to realize the prediction of multi-label fault types of the wind turbine. This method combines the advantages of ML-ReliefF and PCA in feature selection to farthest minimize irrelevant and redundant features. The BP Neural Network is then constructed and trained to predict multiple fault types which will possibly occur. Based on the real SCADA system monitoring data, our experimental results show that feature selection method has significant effect on prediction, and the combined one of ML-ReliefF and PCA performs better than each single one of them. Based on it, the BP Neural Network multi-label fault prediction model can implement the fault early warning task with superior accuracy.

articleTitle: The Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things Based on Dynamic and Reconfigurable ROF Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction of " Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Power System", the transmission of power information data is put forward higher requirements for power communication network. In this paper, a ubiquitous internet of things in power system based on dynamic and reconfigurable ROF technology is proposed based on the current construction situation of power communication network. This system adopts ROF technology to transform the base station architecture of cellular mobile communication network into the compound of remote antenna unit(RAU) that closes to users and the central office(CO). At the same time, in order to cope with the increasingly complex situation of terminals wireless access, an information transmission network based on dynamic and reconfigurable ROF technology is proposed by tunable filters, which can achieve flexible conversion of signal modulation and dynamic switch of multi-frequency. This technology can improve the utilization rate of spectrum resources, realize dynamic control of bandwidth resources, and provide communication network with low cost, wide bandwidth, flexible networking and reliable transmission for ubiquitous internet of things in power.

articleTitle: Function System and Application Scenario Design of Energy Big Data Application Center
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Giant potential value lies in the application of energy big data on energy resource distribution and energy structure transformation. On the basis of the investigation of the national energy information system and big data platform for energy enterprises, development goals are specified, the overall structural design of the "three platforms and two systems" and the scheme of data management are proposed. Aiming at government, enterprises, and the public, design and blueprint of the multi-dimensional application scenario system are presented, and the function scheme of typical application scenarios serving the government and the public are discussed.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of HVDC Transmission Protection Operational Defects in Hubei Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, events which DC systems have been shut down or blocked due to DC protection system failures have occurred occasionally. By analyzing the blocking event of DC converter station of the State Grid Corporation in recent ten years, it can be concluded that the sampling system failure, secondary circuit fault, board fault, host fault, etc. of the protection system caused more than 10% of the DC system blocking which seriously affects safe and stable operation of DC system. Therefore, statistical analysis of defects in DC transmission protection operation is required, providing basis for subsequent research on indicators and methods of DC protection reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Optional two-part electricity price based on user load rate
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem that the current sales price structure fails to reflect the power consumption characteristics, an optional two-tier price model is constructed based on the user load rate. Firstly, the marginal capacity cost and electricity cost of electricity production are determined according to the peak load liability law. Then, according to the load rate-simultaneous rate curve, the power cost allocation is optimized, and the load rate is used to divide the user load characteristics. Based on the principle of incentive compatibility, the design can choose the electricity price package. Taking 10KV users as an example, the model is analyzed. The designed electricity price package can optimize the power cost allocation, scientifically identify the real information of the user load rate. And the user only has the lowest cost for obtaining good economic efficiency and fairness under the load rate price matching with the load rate, verifying the rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Bidding of Retail Electricity Market Considering Uncertainty of Forecasted Nodal Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In a competitive retail electricity market, the bidding strategy based on a forecasted nodal price is important for individual generators to guarantee a successful bid. However, sufficient attentions have not been given to the uncertainty of the forecasted nodal price. This paper focuses on bidding strategy of individual generators considering uncertainty of the forecasted nodal price. The probability of the forecasted nodal price is used to derive the expected benefit of individual generators, based on which the generators' self-benefit is maximized. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Interaction between Distributed Power, Energy Storage and Diverse Loads in a Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the interaction between distributed power, energy storage and diverse loads in a smart home, and the impact of time-of-use tariffs, an intelligent family management model is established in this paper. An example is designed to analyze the interaction between different types of equipment in optimizing process, for further analyzing the optimal scheduling effect of the home energy management system (HEMS). The result shows that, in the scheduling process of household energy management system, there is an interaction among household photovoltaic system, energy storage device and diverse loads, which is carried out under the agreed objective function, and has a certain impact on household energy efficiency, photovoltaic self-consumption and daily energy costs.

articleTitle: SO2 Concentration Prediction in Atmospheric Based on CEEMDAN-ApEn-RBFNN-BPNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the complexity of the pollution gas data, the general prediction model can not fully understand its change law, so a concentration time series prediction method based on complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN), approximate entropy (AE), radial basis functional neural network (RBFNN), and back propagation neural networks (BPNN) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the method simplifies the data by using CEEMDAN and AE. Then, the simplified multi-dimensional simple data are trained and predicted by using RBFNN. The prediction results of multidimensional data are accumulated. Finally, the error is corrected by using BPNN, and the predicted value is added to the error correction value to get the final result. The most complex sulfur dioxide gas was selected and simulated. The results show that the prediction model can fully study complex data, and the accuracy of prediction can reach more than 91%.

articleTitle: Combined Simulation Method of Multi-source Automatic Generation Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interaction between ultra-high voltage (UHV) AC and DC transmission terminals is becoming closer and closer, and the impact of faults on the operation of power grid is changing from local to global. High power loss due to UHV DC blocking has serious impact on safe operation of the receiving system, yet the system frequency can fast recover by using multi-area automatic generation control (AGC). Based on the whole power grid model of testing platform, the external multi-area AGC system is simulated in this paper. Then a combined simulation system is formed by the simulated AGC system. The combined simulation system covers the whole power grid, which can improve the accuracy of active power response.

articleTitle: Negative Sample Generation of Bushing Fault Diagnose Based on CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As one of the most important structures of the transformer, the bushing ensures that its normal operation is beneficial to the normal operation of the power system. The thermal failure of the bushing is one of the main causes of the failure, and the infrared image can well reflect the thermal failure. In this paper, based on the infrared image of the bushing, the negative sample data imbalance problem occurred in the fault diagnosis, and the creation of negative samples is proposed. The main method used is CycleGAN, which processes the image and generates fault samples with normal data to improve the fault diagnosis in deep learning. By using the convolutional neural network to train and test the data samples before and after the generation, it is proved that the accuracy before the negative sample generation is 61.54%, and the accuracy after the negative samples generation is 100%. The proposed method is confirmed to be able to generate negative samples and improve the imbalance of the dataset in deep learning.

articleTitle: Prediction of Probability Density of Electric Vehicle Load Based on Deep Learning QRDCC Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale access of electric vehicle charging load to the grid will bring some difficulties to the operation and scheduling of the grid. In this paper, a prediction model of electric vehicle load probability density prediction based on the quantile regression dilated causal convolution (QRDCC) is proposed. First, the weight sharing method is used to reduce the number of convolutional neural network parameters. Because the historical data of electric vehicles has strong self-correlation characteristics, the stacking convolutional layer structure is chose to learn the relationship. Then the fundamental of QRDCC is introduced, and the Adam random gradient is used to optimizing the parameters of the model. Combined with Gaussian kernel density estimation, the conditional density prediction of the final electric vehicle load is obtained. The experimental results show that the QRDCC prediction model not only outperforms the quasi-recurrent neural networks (QRNN) in the interval prediction of the load, but also has a high fitting effect on the real data in the point prediction of the median regression, which verifies the practicability and reliability of the QRDCC prediction model.

articleTitle: A Service Data Flow Control Method Based on Network Isolation Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a service data flow control method based on network isolation architecture. This method not only makes the access of service data in the high security zone for enterprise internet mobile applications possible, but also ensures the security of key data in service system. Under the requirements of network security protection, the mobile access gateway is introduced to decompose the interaction process of service data crossing the security zone firstly. Then, it designs an access conversion and communication method, which realizes the safe and reliable transmission of service data through various isolation devices and service flow control. The method has been widely used in many business areas such as employee reimbursement, attendance punching, power system distribution repair and mobile inspection.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Fault Location with Traveling Wave for 35kV Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of precise fault location with prior-art methods for 35kV distribution networks, a traveling wave method valid for earth faults location for transmission networks was applied to 35kV distribution networks. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method were verified and the precision of fault location was in the range of practical acceptance. Finally, the influence of fault distance, fault resistance and parallel capacitive equipment on traveling wave was studied.

articleTitle: Life Assessment Study on Distribution Electric Power Transmission Equipment Based on Harmonic Modified Hot Spot Temperature Calculating Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution transformer is widely used as an important energy transmission equipment. With a large number of new energy such as photovoltaic and wind power connected to the grid, the harmonic interference in the power system becomes more and more serious. Harmonic disturbance has a continuous impact on the daily operation of distribution transformers. In this paper, the relationship between harmonic disturbance and service life of distribution transformer is studied. Firstly, combined with harmonic no-load loss and winding skin effect, the hot spot temperature calculation model is improved. Secondly, the temperature rise test is carried out to verify the accuracy of the model. Finally, based on the improved hot spot temperature calculation model, the corresponding life evaluation model of distribution transformer is proposed. The results show that the harmonic current disturbance will cause a sharp increase in the relative aging rate of the transformer and seriously shorten the life of the transformer.

articleTitle: High-precision Calculation of Geographical Current Density of DC Grounding Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The corrosion of underground buried metal facilities is affected by the geographical current density of DC grounding electrodes. If there is too much leakage current, it will impede the normal operation of the catholic protection device of the pipeline systems. In this paper, we theoretically analyze the geographical current density distribution of ground electrode in horizontal wide-area multi-layer earth, and derive the current density calculation formula. Then, a linear filtering method for high-frequency electromagnetic field calculation (KONG-201) is introduced, which is used to solve the geographical current density distribution of the grounding electrode. The simulation results show that the KONG-201 method is consistent with the high-order complex mirror method (HOCIM), faster speed calculation, and the higher precision. The method solves the problem of assessing the distribution of geographical current density of the DC grounding electrode, and it has a great application prospect.

articleTitle: Research on Tree Crown Segmentation Method in Tree Height Image Monitoring of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The ultra-high trees below the transmission lines can cause short-circuit faults. The segmentation of the crown below the transmission line and the extraction of the tree tip or branches are the key and premise for the tree height image monitoring device to automatically calculate the distance between the tree tip or the branch and the wire. In this paper, a tree crown bicolor model segmentation method based on RGB and HSV color features is proposed. The segmentation model of the crown in RGB and HSV color space is established. In order to accurately obtain the edge position of the tree tip or branches in the crown, a tree tip or branches extraction method based on the improved Harris corner detection algorithm is proposed. In the case study, the proposed method achieves the accurate segmentation of the crown and the accurate extraction of the tree tip or branches in the crown, and the validity and accuracy of the proposed method is verified. The research results in this paper can be used to calculate the distance between branches and wires, which lays a foundation for realizing accurate warning of ultra-high branches in tree height image monitoring of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Topology and Simulation of Charged Melting Ice On Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Icing of the transmission line seriously affects the safe operation of the power system. The most effective method to deal with the line ice coating would be current ice melting. However, the existing power melting ice needs to be powered off. Because the power failure has a great impact on the power system, the existing method of charged ice melting is not practical. To solve this problem, a charged ice melting topology is proposed that the AC and DC isolation is realized through the resonant circuit. The DC ice melting device is connected to the AC system through the LC circuit. Meanwhile, a three-phase short circuit is adopted at the end of the line, so as to realize charged melting ice. Finally, Simulation and parameter design of the topology confirm that the topology can achieve charged ice melting.

articleTitle: AGC Real-Time Control Strategy Based on DFT Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid growth of photovoltaic and wind power generation in our country has led to the increase of power fluctuation in the tie line, which means that the existing grid frequency modulation strategy is no longer applicable. At present, AGC control adopts closed-loop PI control, and its parameter value is determined empirically. Due to the fluctuations caused by the large number to renewable energy, it is difficult for PI control to achieve precise control and adjust the control strategy under the new situation. Therefore, the dispatching organization is urgently required to upgrade the existing AGC control strategy. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes an AGC real-time control strategy based on discrete Fourier transform (DFT). The strategy classifies the power fluctuations of tie line by DFT for separating the load fluctuations belonging to the primary frequency modulation and economic dispatch categories, and only compensates for the intermediate frequency part. The simulation results show that the strategy can realize the real-time tracking of the tie line plan power with a low number of command times, and maintain the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Pressure Simulation and Experimental Study of GIS/GIL Disc Insulators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve efficiency and accuracy of the hydraulic simulation for disc insulators, the mechanical constitutive equations parameters of epoxy resin and rubber material were measured, and the hydraulic simulation model considering the sealing ring was established in this paper. The simulation results show that the contact pressure between the disc insulator and the lower flange reaches about 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>Pa, while the contact pressure between the seal ring and the middle flange is below 1.246×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>Pa, which means that the disc insulator is mainly supported by the lower flange. Ignoring the influence of the sealing ring, the upper flange and the middle flange, a simplified simulation model was established. The results of the two models were about the same, but the efficiency of the simplified model was improved by 55 times. The simulation strategy for product development is proposed: the simulation model considering sealing ring is used to optimize the shape of the sealing groove and the flange structure. Then keep the structure unchanged, and the simple simulation model is established to optimize the main part of the disk insulator. Finally, the results of hydraulic strain measurement show that the simulation and measurement results are consistent, and the maximum relative error is 5.1%, which proves the rationality of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Optimization Method of Disconnecting Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of power intelligent equipment technology, disconnecting circuit breakers (DCB) has become a research focus. But its high integration of isolation, circuit breaking, data acquisition, intelligent control and other functions has led to the problem of low reliability. Therefore, the reliability optimization method of DCB is proposed in this paper. Based on the reliability analysis of functional units of DCB, several equivalent models of DCB are established, and the reliability calculation of the models is analyzed. The reliability of the DCB basic model is deduced, and the optimal calculation method affecting the reliability of equipment is found out. From the standpoint of system optimization, several reliability optimization methods are studied, such as topology optimization, reliability configuration optimization and redundancy optimization. Reliability analysis is carried out for these three methods, and the advantages and disadvantages of different optimization methods are explained in detail. Finally, statistical data are used to calculate the reliability of products designed by different optimization methods. Through the analysis and comparison of reliability values, it is proved that the proposed methods can improve the reliability of equipment effectively, and have a good guiding role in the reliability design of DCB.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch Considering Flexibility Provided by Load Static Voltage Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of proportion of renewable energy in the power system, the uncertainty in the power system is significantly increase, and the system's renewable energy consumption is facing more challenges. In traditional economic dispatch module, the load is often expressed by constant power, which cannot reflect the impact of static load voltage regulation on system operation. This paper proposes a new economic dispatching model in which the static load voltage regulation is respected. The proposed model can fully exert the automatic adjustment ability of load and provide some flexibility for the system. The results of the example show that considering the precise load model in scheduling helps to enhance the system to accommodate more renewable energy and improve the economics of system operation.

articleTitle: Secondary Power Sharing Control Strategy for Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid via Maximum Power Coordination Factor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Proper power sharing among distributed renewable energy generators (DGs) in hybrid AC/DC microgrid is an important prerequisite for the stable system operation. In this paper, a secondary power sharing control strategy is proposed for hybrid microgrid based on a maximum power coordination factor (MPCF). Firstly, the time delay algorithm is presented to help automatically identify the MPCF within each sub-grid. Then the MPCF is employed as a unified reference to be shared with other DGs through communication. Upon this, the bidirectional interlinking converters (BIC) only needs to collect MPCF of each sub-grid to achieve accurate power sharing among the hybrid system regardless of influence from line impedance or other interference. Compared with conventional methods, the power sharing accuracy is improved and the communication burden is greatly relieved. Finally, simulation and experimental tests are conducted to verify effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Using power side-channel to implement anomaly-based intrusion detection on smart grid terminals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Security threats of smart grid terminals continue to increase. In order to realize non-invasive intrusion detection of power distribution terminal devices in smart grid, we propose a novel anomaly-based intrusion detection approach that use power side-channel. The approach monitors programs running in the terminals by collecting and analyzing the power consumption data of terminal devices. We run three abnormal programs and one normal program in the distribution terminal units (DTUs), and then extract feature values of the power consumption data and lastly conducted anomaly-based intrusion detection through LSTM neural network. Our evaluation results demonstrate that a false positive rate is less than 2% and an accuracy rate is more than 90%.

articleTitle: Research on the Whole Life Cycle Cost Management and Maintenance Decision of Secondary Equipment Based on Physical ID
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the key equipment in the power grid system, the reliability and economy of substation secondary equipment are closely related to the safety of power grid. From the perspective of whole life cycle cost, to balance the reliability and economy of the secondary equipment reliability and economy, and determine the optimal maintenance strategy, based on material object ID, the overhaul method under dynamic recursion back factors and minor repairs to the recursion back and the influence of failure rate, overhaul and minor repair, under the influence of dynamic recursion back model, and on the basis of establishing the minimum total life cycle cost as the target of substation secondary equipment life cycle cost model, is proposed at the same time. At the same time, the adaptive strategy of search step size and parameter Pa are combined to improve the cuckoo algorithm, and then, the improved cuckoo algorithm is applied to optimize the secondary equipment maintenance cost model. The optimal overhaul time and corresponding full life cycle cost is also obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-variable Grey Prediction Model for Icing Thickness
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The icing disaster seriously affects the safe operation of the power grid. Through predicting the icing growth trend in the early stage of icing, the deicing and the hidden icing danger could be guided and eliminated. In this paper, a multi-variable grey prediction model for icing thickness is studied. Firstly, the correlation between micro-meteorological parameters such as ambient temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction and icing thickness is analyzed by grey correlation analysis method. Furthermore, considering the grey correlation analysis results, a multivariate grey prediction model of icing thickness is established based on the icing thickness, ambient temperature and wind speed. The validity of the model is verified by the online monitoring data of an icing process. The prediction error is within 5%, which satisfies the engineering application requirements of the transmission line icing prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Grid-Connected Inverter in Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In microgrid system, the grid-connected inverter is the important interface between the system and the grid, and the control of grid-connected inverter allows the microgrid system to connect or disconnect in any time, achieving plug-and play function. This paper adopts the control strategy of grid-connected inverter. This strategy can meet the requirements of micro-grid when it is in the grid-connected and independent modes. The strategy uses PQ control mode when it is in grid-connected mode, choosing the best grid-connected time by the same period grid-connected control part. And it uses droop control for running independently. Simulation results for the two modes of switching verify the feasibility and correctness.

articleTitle: Bi-level Multi-agents Interactive Decision-making Model in Regional Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the high coupling characteristics between supply and demand sides in regional integrated energy system (RIES), a bi-level interactive decision-making model with multiple agents is proposed. A RIES market with multiple micro integrated energy grid investors and integrated energy customer aggregator is constructed. To study the operation of regional integrated energy market, a multi-agent interactive decision-making model is established, and a bi-level optimization algorithm is used to solve the equilibrium of the model. In the external level, multiple market players participate in non-cooperative game in order to maximize their own profits, reinforcement learning algorithm is adopted to search the optimal bidding strategies. In the internal level, RIES operator clears the market under the constraints of safe and stable operation in RIES, Aiming at maximizing the social welfare in RIES, the interior point method is applied to optimize the clearing results. Finally, a simulation example is given to study the non-cooperative dynamic game process of the proposed model in RIES market.

articleTitle: A Novel Synchronous Reference Frame Transformation Technique for Background Harmonics Elimination and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the background harmonics in the grid are increasing for the substantial increase of non-linear loads. Background harmonics feed into the d-q coordinate system by reference frame transformation, which causes considerable errors in the d-q decoupled control strategy. The traditional phase-locked loop (PLL) solves this problem by using low-pass filters (LPFs). However, with the complication in tuning of LPF, the parameters in time under the condition of changing the operating mode is still difficult to adjust. To deal with such issues, this paper proposes a novel technique to reduce the background harmonic in the d-q coordinate system by means of reference frame transformation. Named nested decoupled synchronous reference frame (NDSRF) transformation, this technique decomposes the fundamental-frequency positive-sequence component and harmonic components by multilayer d-q synchronous transformation. Compared with existing transformation techniques, the proposed NDSRF technique is able to sharply reduce the undesirable transfer of background harmonic without filters. Furthermore, the proposed NDSRF is applicable to the modular multilevel converter (MMC) controller. Finally, the validity of the NDSRF technique and the proposed MMC controller are verified by a three-phase MMC based HVDC system, which is established in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results show that the proposed novel NDSRF technique is superior over existing single synchronous reference frame (SSRF) and decoupled double synchronous reference frame (DDSRF) transformation techniques, in terms of less harmonic distortion for MMC controller under the background harmonics condition.

articleTitle: Precise Analysis of Interruption Response Rate and Interruptible Capacity of Large Users
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The research of interruptible features of large users is the basis to make dis-patching plan of interruptible loads. Interruption response rate and interruptible capacity are the critical characteristics of interruptible loads. In order to analyze the characteristics of the maximal interruption rate and maximal interruption capacity of large users, a quadratic classification model is used to cluster the daily load data of users. Besides, the fuzzy C-means clustering method is adopted for each classification. The first classification is used to separate the interruption response data from the conventional data. The second classification aims to obtain the refined interruption patterns. Then, the response rate and interruptible capacity are analyzed from two dimensions which are time dimension and industry dimension. The results show that the quadratic classification model can effectively excavate the users' maximal response rate and maximal interruptible capacity.

articleTitle: Research on active power regulation of hydropower unit monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the monitoring system's power closed-loop regulation is the main method of hydropower unit power regulation, and the simulation research on active power regulation of hydropower unit monitoring system is carried out. Meanwhile, the detailed active power regulation mathematical model including LCU, governor, water conveyance system and hydro turbine is established. By the measured results, the accuracy of the mathematical model is verified. Based on the simulation given in the paper, the influence of monitoring system and governor parameters on the transient process of active power regulation is analyzed. What's more, the pulse width calculation parameter of the monitoring system β mainly affects the adjustment process closing to the target value in the active power regulation. Also, the minimum pulse width T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">kmin</sub> has no effect on the speed of active power regulation, but affecting the accuracy of regulation. The speed of guide vane opening regulation is determined by the parameter T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">iy</sub>, which may lead to overshoot and even oscillation of active power and guide vane opening if the setting of the T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">iy</sub> is too small.

articleTitle: An Analysis Method of Electric-thermal Load Coupling Relationship of Park Based on Fusion Feature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Operation and optimization of integrated energy systems represented by industrial parks are an important research hotspot in recent years, and have produced a large number of research results. The integrated energy system represented by industrial parks is of great significance for improving load utilization efficiency and reducing industrial production costs. This paper first introduces a data fusion method. Based on this, the fusion data is classified by the clustering method, and the results are evaluated by combining relevant indicators. Finally, this paper uses the daily electricity load and daily heat load data of industrial parks in Jiangsu Province as an example to analyze the coupling relationship between electric heating loads. This method facilitates industrial parks to develop strategies to reduce energy costs and increase production efficiency.

articleTitle: Summary of Load Modeling Methods Considering Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
