abstract: With the continuous development of distributed generation, electric vehicles, other new energy sources, and the operation of power system will inevitably be affected. The load modeling research under the condition of large-scale access to new energy is the basic work of power grid planning, design and operation scheduling control. In this paper, the principle and methods of load modeling are briefly described. Aiming at the problems of large-scale access of new energy to distribution network, the existing load modeling methods are introduced. The unsolved issues in this field and future research direction are also pointed out, which can provide some references for researchers engaged in load modeling.

articleTitle: Day-ahaead And Intraday Coordinated Scheduling Model Considering Flexible Load Response Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The day-ahead and intraday coordinated scheduling model is proposed considering the flexible load response uncertainty and the response characteristics of various flexible loads on multiple time scales. Firstly, on the basis of the principle of consumer psychology and the influence of uncertainty, the transferable load response model is established. Secondly, the compensation mechanism of the curtailable load is constructed to incorporate the curtailable load into the scheduling plan. Besides, to coordinate the transferable load, the curtailable load, the regular units and wind power in multi-time scale, a day-ahead and intraday coordinated scheduling model is established with fuzzy chance constrained programming theory. The role that flexible loads playing in scheduling plan is analyzed with cases. The results show that the model can help to improve wind consumption and reduce the cost of dispatching.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method of Intelligent Wind Power Operation and Maintenance Based on Cyber-Physical-Social Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of industrial system, the development of Cyber-Physical-Social Systems (CPSS) based on Cyber-Physical-Systems (CPS) has become a trend. In this paper, the basic framework of wind power operation and maintenance CPSS is constructed, and an intelligent evaluation method of operation and maintenance engineers based on Bayesian psychometric model is proposed. Taking the rotor cognitive ability of wind turbine as an example, the capability model is constructed. Then, the evidence variables of appropriate granularity, which are involved in the practical task of rotor winding insulation fault diagnosis, are extracted to design the evidence model. According to the Item Response Theory (IRT), the relationship between the potential variables in the model is estimated, and the Graded Response Model (GRM) and the Effective Theta method are used to adjust the appropriate parameters. Finally, the evaluation results are obtained by simulating the model with Winbugs. The method is used to test the operation and maintenance engineers of a wind power company, and the results show that the proposed method is feasible and it can effectively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of wind power company.

articleTitle: The Risk Assessment Optimization for the Relay Protection System Based on Proportional Intensity Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A risk assessment optimization method for the relay protection system based on the proportional intensity model (PIM) is proposed. The operating and monitoring information is used to evaluate the equipment condition, and the minimal risk costs per unit time are obtained considering maintenance costs and failure costs. Firstly, the optimal risk assessment model based on PIM is established. Secondly, the parameter estimation for PIM according to the operating and monitoring information as well as the calculation method for failure rate are given. At last, the proposed risk assessment optimization method is used for the protection devices and transformer secondary circuits in different regions. The simulation result shows that the proposed method can evaluate the minimal risk costs for relay protections according to their operating environments, which provides the theoretical basis for maintenance works.

articleTitle: Research on Non-intrusive Load Identification Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To address the problem that the non-intrusive load monitoring algorithm has limitations and low recognition rate, the load identification method based on convolution neural network is proposed. Firstly, the method obtains load start-stop state by an incident detection algorithm, which includes steps of zero-crossing, curve similarity, threshold judgment, and current waveform acquisition. Secondly, the current waveform is converted into a grayscale graph, and the load waveform identification of the varying current waveform is performed according to the grayscale database of each load and the convolutional neural network. Then, the identification of the load type during the load start-stop state is completed. Finally, through the simulation experiments of single load identification, multi-load identification, resident user load identification and different load recognition algorithms, the average value of load accuracy based on convolutional neural network is above 93%, proving that the rationality and immediacy of the proposed algorithm could meet the load identification requirements.

articleTitle: A Synchrophasor Estimation of Power Systems under Out-of-band Interference
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Synchrophasor estimation in power systems provides reliable information exchange basis for energy internet, yet the out-of-band interference (OOBI) in power signals will reduce the phasor estimation accuracy. Based on an enhanced phasor model, a synchrophasor estimation under OOBI is proposed in this paper. With the help of the pre-estimated fundamental frequency and OOBI frequency, which are both calculated by the historical phasors from discrete Fourier transform with various filtering frequencies, the accurate fundamental phasor and frequency can finally be achieved by the solved Taylor derivatives. The proposed estimation is verified to be valid under the 10% OOBI tests required by the IEEE Standard C37.118.1-2011 through the simulation results, with a reasonable increment in computation.

articleTitle: Battery Energy Storage System Participates in Power Market Analysis Based on Energy Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Participating in the bidding of the electricity market is a new profit way for electric energy storage system. In the existing electricity market, the calculation model of bidding strategy for electricity energy storage technology is relatively single, and the dynamic energy characteristics of battery energy storage are neglected. Therefore, taking the battery energy storage system as the research object, a bidding strategy based on energy distribution for battery energy storage power market is proposed in the paper. Firstly, the dynamic energy model of battery is established. Secondly, the energy of batteries is allocated according to the time-of-use (TOU) electricity price policy. With the maximum economic benefit of electricity energy storage system and bidding income of the energy storage market in the day as the optimization targets, the energy bidding strategy of battery energy storage system was formulated. Finally, the power, state of charging (SOC) and revenue of lithium battery energy storage under different bidding strategies are calculated and analyzed according to the TOU price of a certain area. The case study results show that the energy market's revenue can be increased by 57.8% using the energy bidding strategy proposed in the paper. The research results can provide a reference for bidding strategy of electric energy storage market, and it also provide a theoretical basis for economic evaluation of energy storage technology.

articleTitle: Testing Method for the Enclosed Space Based on Image Identification and Unity3D Virtual Comparison Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hydropower turbine runner chamber, thermal power boiler header and pipeline are all typical enclosed spaces. To solve the technical problems of the existing testing methods for the key hidden metal components (such as the decompression panel and the water board of turbine runner chamber, the welded structures and foreign matters of header and pipeline) of the enclosed spaces, such as the poor reliability and the larger testing blind spots of the testing device, under the downtime without opening the cover of the enclosed spaces, an testing method for the enclosed space based on image identification and Unity 3-D simulation comparison techniques was proposed. The tracked magnetic creeper car which carries the real-time image collection instrument was used to complete the crawling work on the inner surface of the closed space. After the location is collected by the positioning assistant device, the position of the real-time testing image in the virtual 3D model is calibrated. Comparison between real-time testing image and simulation image, the different regions could be calibrated in the virtual simulation image, and then the defects or foreign bodies fall into could be accurately positioning. The field application test indicated that the field application test shows that the device can be calibrated accurately without opening the cover of the closed space. It is convenient to remove foreign bodies, and it is easy to maintain and clean.

articleTitle: Grid Benefit Analysis Considering the Correlation Between Load Characteristics and Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing investment analysis of the engineering projects lacks a comprehensive consideration from the correlation between load characteristics and electricity price. With the implementation of the policy of reducing price and burden, it is very important to analyze the sustainable development of power grid enterprises according to the investment of power grid. This paper mainly discusses the method of calculating the comprehensive benefit considering the load characteristics. First of all, taking economic benefit, technical benefit and social benefit aspects into consideration, a comprehensive index system is proposed to describe the characteristics of those projects; Secondly, according to the different functions, namely Meet the Demand of New Load, Power Out Engineering, Substation Sending Out, based on the method of involving Analytic Hierarchy Process and Entropy Weight, a combination weight strategy is proposed accounting of the differences functions of distribution power grids projects; Finally, a new concept called investment entropy is pointed out to measure the relationship between benefit and investment structure. Taking the data of the State Grid Hunan Electric Power Corporation from 2012 to 2016, the analysis results show that this evaluation method can effectively analyze the correlation between the load characteristics and electricity price.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Dimensional Electricity Characteristic Evaluation Indicator System for Resident Users
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The analysis and mining of electricity consumption characteristics of residentials provide more accurate theoretical support and scientific basis for the interaction between users and power grid. This paper refines the load composition of residents, the main influencing factors of electricity consumption and the load characteristics of residents. The electricity consumption characteristics of residents is analyzed from five dimensions: electric energy consumption, load curve characteristic, load composition, behavior awareness and user attribute. 11 indicators including energy consumption level, energy efficiency level, daily load shape, calendar attribute, air conditioning load, electrothermal load, policy sensitivity, electricity bill sensitivity, social awareness, family attribute and new energy attribute were proposed. Therefore, a novel multi-dimensional Indicator system of electricity consumption characteristics of residents is established. Taking 477 residents in Changzhou of Jiangsu Province, China, as an example, the multi-dimensional electricity characteristics analysis and user classification are carried out. The results of user classification in case verify the validity and correctness of the evaluation Indicator system.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation Method of Energy Stations of Large Park Integral Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy network will greatly affect the operation and planning of large park integral energy system. Therefore, this paper proposed a bi-level allocation method for large park integral energy system considering energy network. The upper level aimed at minimum investment and operation cost of every energy station. While, the lower level aimed at minimum annual operation cost under the determined grid configuration given by upper level. In order to improve the calculation speed, the lower level model was established based on Distflow second order cone (SOC) model and linear heat network energy flow model. Finally, the simulation tests of different scenarios were carried out and the feasibility of the proposed method was verified.

Author Keywords: linear heat network energy flow model

articleTitle: Design of Energy-Use Scoring Rule for Student Dormitories Based on Period and Electricity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, problems of high energy consumption, serious waste, and absence of effective power management mechanism are being faced by colleges of China. Therefore, in this paper a scoring rule of electricity consumption based on punishment psychology for campus dormitories is designed to improve student's energy-use behaviors. Firstly, the characteristics of electricity use in university dormitories are analyzed. According to the principles of the proposed scoring rule, school administrators and students are regarded as principals and agents respectively with an agreement signed for both sides. Based on the time periods and power-use standards, the hourly and monthly power-use curves are both divided into the bottom, basic and top lines separately. Hourly score is then calculated, followed by monthly score calculation using the revised hourly score. Rewards and punishments are also set based on the final scores of each dormitory. The numerical result shows that the proposed scoring mechanism can contribute to rational electricity consumption in school dormitories.

articleTitle: Multi-Microgrid Optimal Scheduling Considering Electric Vehicle Participation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of optimal scheduling caused by the coordinated operation of multi-microgrid and distribution network in the region, a cooperative optimization scheduling method for multi-microgrid and distribution network is proposed based on taking into account the participation of electric vehicles. This method can fully utilize the distributed energy in the microgrid and improve the power quality of distribution network and the economic benefits of the microgrid. The satisfaction degree of electric vehicle users is also considered. Coordination between multi-microgrid and distribution network using two-layer model hierarchical coordination method. The upper layer is the distribution network system, and the lower layer is the Multi-microgrid system. Based on the prediction of power supply and load, the optimal objective function of each layer is established. The effectiveness of the two-layer model is verified by simulation, compared with other methods, the advantages of this method in multi-microgrid economic model and distribution network stability are proved.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimization Scheduling for Photovoltaic Storage Home Energy Management System Considering User Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper constructs the photo-voltaic storage home energy management system (PV Storage HEMS) including PV power generation, battery energy storage, and electrical load. Based on the analysis of load working state model, the paper founds an integrated objective function considering electricity charge and user satisfaction, a coefficient is used to adjust the proportion of user satisfaction in the function. Furthermore, a coordinated optimization scheduling strategy for the system is proposed under operation constraints. Finally, the case study is carried out to analyze electricity usage and satisfaction for different scheduling modes, as well as verifying the application value of the strategy.

articleTitle: Dispatching Potential Evaluation of Thermostatically Controlled Loads Based on Realistic Customer Electricity Data in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the information and communication technologies, demand response (DR) can be realized more easily and considered as one of effective methods to provide regulation services for the power system. Among the flexible loads for DR, thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) are regarded as one of the most important loads, because of the large share of power consumption and suitable regulation characteristics without impacting customers' comfort. However, the dispatching potential of TCLs is difficult to be evaluated due to the limitation of measuring equipment. Faced with this issue, this paper proposes a method for evaluating the dispatching potential of TCLs based on the realistic customer electricity data in China. The relationship between the dispatching potential of TCLs and the ambient temperature is obtained. In this way, the system operator can calculate the dispatching potential of TCLs according to the weather forecast. The effectiveness of the proposed model and method is verified in the case studies.

articleTitle: Research on the credit evaluation model of electricity selling company based on GA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of China's electric power system reform and the development of energy utilization technology, power selling companies are becoming the main body of multi-energy market. Reasonable credit evaluation analysis of power selling companies are carried out to improve the selectivity of customers in choosing power selling companies. To establish the credit evaluation system of power selling companies, this paper takes four aspects into consideration including the basic quality of the company, the financial status of the company, the rewards and punishments of the company and the fulfillment of social responsibilities. The weight of the indicator is determined based on the differentiated weighting model. MATLAB software is used to set the model parameters of genetic algorithm and support vector machine. Finally, the GA-SVM model after setting the parameters is used to train and test the data samples of the two sales companies A and B respectively, and the test results of the GA-SVM model are analyzed to obtain the reasons for the different credit evaluation scores of A and B. At the same time, it provides suggestions for the sales company to improve its credit level.

articleTitle: Research on the UAV Intelligent Inspection System to Monitor and Prevent Abnormal Heat of Composite Insulators for 500kV Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Ensuring a strong and reliable operation of the 500kV transmission system is critical to the energy internet. A large scale of composite insulators in the transmission system were found abnormal heat in a 500kV line after 7 years of operation. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) are powerful tools replacing human power to monitor transmission systems. In this paper, a UAV intelligent inspection system is proposed to monitor and prevent abnormal heat of composite insulators in 500kV transmission system. The reason of the insulators' abnormal heat is well discussed based on infrared images captured by the UAV. By adjusting the position in the shielding rings of running composite insulators, the temperature rise of the composite insulator decreased significantly. The mechanism how the UAV intelligent inspection system operates and the key technology to realize fault monitoring and prevention are well discussed. It is proved that the UAV is promisingly of great feasibility to help the maintenance department to recognize potential fault on the transmission lines and prevent severe faults.

articleTitle: A Simplified Analysis Method of Voltage Stability Suitable for Large Power System with VSC-HVDC Connection for Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: After the offshore wind power is connected to large power system via VSC-HVDC, the system voltage stability analysis has become more difficult. A simplified method for voltage stability analysis of this system is proposed in this paper. The details are as follows: Firstly, the difficulties of voltage stability analysis of large power grid with flexible DC connection for offshore wind power is analyzed. Secondly, based on the conventional equivalent method and the branch voltage stability index, a simplified method for voltage stability analysis of large power grid is proposed. Finally, based on an actual power grid, the adaptability analysis under different wind power output and different reactive power compensation is carried out, and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: The Method for Power Flow Calculation with Doubly-fed Wind Turbine Integration into Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the construct of doubly-fed wind turbine is different from synchronous generator, when wind farm based on doubly-fed wind turbine integration into power system, the method for traditional power flow calculation may cause more calculation error. This paper researches on the electromagnetic characteristics and control strategy of doubly-fed wind turbine, and proposes the processing method for doubly-fed wind turbine when using newton raphson method for power flow calculation. The validity of this method is validated on IEEE 14 bus system.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of a Microgrid using Dynamic Bayesian Belief Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reliability analysis is made more difficult by the variability and intermittency of renewable energy sources that accompany the ageing of components. Most of the existing approaches predict the probability of generation as a single-point value or presume a predefined parametric model for it. Their drawback lies in that they rarely grasp low-probability events which are actually vital to reliability analysis. To overcome this shortcoming, this paper proposes a data-driven sequential unit commitment using the dynamic Bayesian belief networks and makes it the internal model of system operation inside the Monte Carlo simulation for reliability analysis. In each time step, the dynamic Bayesian belief network first generates the probability distributions of renewable energy generation. Then a realization of renewable energy generation is sampled as the boundary of the unit commitment of the present time step. The unit commitment is solved, and its impact of operating the generators on their ageing conditions is accumulated. The dynamic Bayesian belief network prediction and the unit commitment in sequence traverse step by step throughout the time horizon, and form one bid of the Monte Carlo simulation. The convergence of the Monte Carlo simulation is measured by a popular reliability indicator, loss of load probability. The proposed method has its effectiveness justified in its comparison with a point estimation method.

articleTitle: Reactive power control strategy based on electrochemical energy storage power plant to resist the risk of commutation failure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The commutation failure of the converter station of a single DC transmission network is prone to failure when the AC side fails. Aiming at this issue, a reactive power control strategy based on the electrochemical energy storage station to resist the risk of commutation failure is proposed in the paper. The paper analyzes the causes and countermeasures of the commutation failure occurred in HVDC systems. Based on the existing commutation fault prediction method, a reactive power control strategy based on electrochemical energy storage power plant is proposed to resist the risk of commutation failure. A ±500kV direct unipolar DC transmission model is built on the PSACD/EMTDC simulation platform. The feasibility of the control strategy is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Study for Distributed Power Flow Controller Investment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DPFC is composed of several series converters, which can be installed and disassembled in stages and batches. This paper considers the ability of DPFC to regulate the power grid, and proposes the investment cost function which takes the regulation variables of the distributed converter into account. Due to increased transmission capacity, the economic benefit function and the economic revenue function are caused by the expansion of voltage safety and stability range, and the economic revenue function is caused by expanding the stability range of power angle. Meanwhile, an objective function Z, which takes into account the security constraints of power grid operation, is proposed to maximize the difference between revenue and expense. Finally, by solving the constrained equation based on the dynamic programming method, the capacity of DPFC built in batches with the largest revenue could be derived, and the capital idleness and equipment depreciation losses caused by one-off construction will be avoided. Implementation results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Study on the Correlation between Internal and External Transient Phenomena Caused by Disconnector Operation in GIS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to explore the correlation between the electromagnetic transient phenomenon caused by the GIS internal and external transient loops caused by the isolation switch operation, in this paper, the 126kV GIS intelligent substation is taken as the research object. According to the field size of 126kV GIS and the corresponding voltage level, the corresponding components in GIS are equivalently modeled and analyzed, and the Mayr arc model is also applied. Based on the analog isolating switch, the GIS internal and external transient simulation loop of the ideal transformer with the ratio of 1:1 is used. The electromagnetic transient simulation software Atp-emtp is used to simulate the internal and external transient loops of GIS. Through the analysis of the transient simulation inside and outside the GIS, the transient characteristics of VFTO and VFTC generated in GIS are basically the same; the main time of the transient phenomenon caused by the isolation switch operation in GIS is basically the same; the most intense oscillations in VFTO, VFTC and TEV in GIS occur at the initial moment of transient generation, indicating that transient phenomenon is the strongest at the initial moment once transient phenomenon occurs.

articleTitle: Gale Change and Grading for Power Grid Wind Zone in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the data of Jiangsu gale stations in lately 50 years is analyzed, and temporal-spatial variation characteristics of gale in this region is revealed. Firstly, type I extreme value distribution probability model is used to calculate the statistical wind speed values of the meteorological stations in Jiangsu Province and is completed maximum wind speed statistics of 30-year and 50-year return period for Jiangsu power grid. Then the grading standards of wind zone in Jiangsu power grid is also discussed for giving the wind-distribution map of power grid and its application principles and recommendations, so as to provide technical support for wind disaster prevention of overhead transmission lines of Jiangsu power grid.

articleTitle: Business Model Selection Model of Distributed Photovoltaic Energy Storage System in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There have been researches on the evaluation of the business model of distributed photovoltaic energy storage system (DPESS). The main achievement is to select evaluation indexes from the economic point of view. First, considering the dominant and hidden benefits of DPESS, a complete evaluation index system for business model of DPESS is established from economic benefit, environmental benefit and social benefit. Then, the integrated weighting model which considers the advantages of subjective and objective weighting method is constructed, and the gray cluster trigonometric function evaluation model of DPESS is proposed. The case study shows that the proposed comprehensive evaluation model can rank the comprehensive benefits of the business model of DPESS. Finally, based on the comprehensive evaluation results, a complete DPESS business model site selection evaluation index system from multiple perspectives is constructed, which can provide the basis of selecting DPESS business model for decision makers.

articleTitle: Microgrid Optimal Dispatch Model Considering Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to alleviate the impact of grid-connected new energy micro-grid including wind power and photovoltaic on the safe operation of the system, a micro-network optimization scheduling strategy considering energy storage system under time-sharing electricity price is proposed. The investment cost, pollution penalty cost and main network purchase cost are considered respectively, and the micro-network main network joint operation optimization model is established. The simulation results are used to analyze the optimization results under different scenarios. The results of the example show that the proposed strategy and model can effectively realize the micro-network optimization scheduling, effectively reduce the annual operating cost of the micro-grid including electric vehicles and storage batteries, and ensure the joint safe operation of the micro-network and the main network.

articleTitle: Research on Model Integration Strategy in Shortterm Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-model ensemble model is an effective method to improve forecast accuracy in short-term load forecasting which is becoming popular in recent years. However, the research on model integration method is relatively limited. This paper investigates the performance of combining different load forecasting method based on multiple integration method. Nine integration strategies are considered and the effectiveness of these strategies are validated based on ISO New England public dataset. Case studies demonstrate that the accuracy of ensemble models significantly outperform that of the benchmark methods in terms of mean absolute percentage error.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method of Energy Storage Interface for DC Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The non-isolated bidirectional DC/DC converter is used as the converter of the battery energy storage system to connect the DC micro-grid. In this paper, the improved droop control method and the frequency control method are used to control the parallel connection of the energy storage interface converter respectively. The output power of each energy storage interface converter is balanced while maintaining the bus voltage constantly. The simulation model of MATLAB / Simulink platform is built and verified by simulation experiments. The simulation results show the feasibility of the control method.

articleTitle: Heavy Precipitation Numerical Prediction Model Based on Himawari-8 Sounder Data Assimilation: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heavy precipitation may cause grid tower landslide and substation submergence. It will bring great loss to power grid. However the accuracy of heavy rainfall forecast is very low. This study proposes a method to enhance heavy rainfall forecast ability. The geostationary satellite Himawari-8 data are added into forecast system by data assimilation. It will adjust the distribution of precipitable water which is the key factor in precipitation forecast. The heavy rainfall in Shandong Province on 19 August 2018 is taken as a case to testify this method. The results show that precipitable water content is increased in initial field after data assimilation. By comparing with site observations, the precipitation forecast results is closer to reality. Thus, the forecasting method is proved to enhance the ability of heavy precipitation prediction.

articleTitle: Response Characteristics of Power Grid Rainstorm Convection Disaster to ENSO in Spring and Winter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The occurrence and distribution of rainstorm convection affect the safe operation of power grid. In this study, the response characteristics of power grid rainstorm convection disaster to ENSO in spring and winter are analyzed, by taking lightning as a proxy index. It is found that the increase center of lightning(sever convection) during El Nino spring and winter, and the decrease center of lightning(sever convection) during La Nina spring and winter are both located over the southern side of the Qinghai Tibet Plateau, and the two sides of the Yunnan Guizhou Plateau. During the ENSO period, frequency difference of lightning (sever convection) over the adjacent elevations is mainly reduced. Intensity variations of El Nino events can affect lighting (sever convection) over higher altitudes more dramatically, while La Nina has an opposite characteristic. This study summarizes the temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of lightning over different altitudes during ENSO period, and summarizes the response of lightning and sever convection variation to ENSO intensity, which provides guidance for sever convection protection and lightning protection of power grid under special climatic conditions.
